domains.name: highway
domains.description: Core highway operations including roadway construction, maintenance, pavement management, and highway performance monitoring. Manages the state highway system infrastructure, roadway assets, and maintenance activities aligned with FHWA HPMS standards. Encompasses DOH functions for state highway system operations and preservation.

products.name: segment
products.description: Master record for each linear highway segment, including segment identifier, start and end milepoints, jurisdiction, and functional class.

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each linear highway segment in the state highway system. Primary key for the segment master record.

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the highway route to which this segment belongs. Represents the route number or designation (e.g., I-40, US-1, NC-55).

attributes.name: begin_milepoint
attributes.description: Starting milepoint of the highway segment measured from the route origin. Used to define the linear referencing system position.

attributes.name: end_milepoint
attributes.description: Ending milepoint of the highway segment measured from the route origin. Used to define the linear referencing system position.

attributes.name: length_miles
attributes.description: Total length of the highway segment measured in miles. Calculated as the difference between end and begin milepoints.

attributes.name: functional_class_code
attributes.description: FHWA functional classification code indicating the role of the segment in the highway network (e.g., 1=Interstate, 2=Principal Arterial, 7=Local).

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the governmental entity responsible for the segment (e.g., 1=State Highway Agency, 2=County, 3=Town/Township, 4=City/Municipal).

attributes.name: jurisdiction_name
attributes.description: Name of the governmental entity responsible for maintaining and operating the highway segment.

attributes.name: ownership_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the governmental entity that owns the segment, which may differ from the jurisdiction responsible for maintenance.

attributes.name: nhs_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the segment is part of the National Highway System, a network of strategic highways important to the nation's economy, defense, and mobility.

attributes.name: nhs_type
attributes.description: Classification of the NHS designation if the segment is part of the NHS (e.g., Interstate, Principal Arterial, Intermodal Connector).
attributes.value_regex: Interstate|Principal Arterial|Intermodal Connector|Strategic Highway Network|Not NHS|

attributes.name: strahnet_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the segment is part of the Strategic Highway Network, a system of highways important to national defense and emergency mobilization.

attributes.name: truck_route_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the segment is designated as a truck route for commercial vehicle traffic.

attributes.name: urban_code
attributes.description: Census-defined urban area code if the segment is located within an urbanized area or urban cluster.
attributes.references: US Census Bureau Urban Area Criteria

attributes.name: urban_area_name
attributes.description: Name of the urban area in which the segment is located, if applicable.
attributes.references: US Census Bureau Urban Area Criteria

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Type of highway facility represented by the segment (e.g., mainline, ramp, collector-distributor road).

attributes.name: through_lanes
attributes.description: Total number of through traffic lanes in the predominant direction of travel, excluding auxiliary lanes, turn lanes, and shoulders.

attributes.name: direction_of_inventory
attributes.description: Cardinal direction or milepoint direction used for inventory and reporting purposes (e.g., North, South, Increasing milepoint).

attributes.name: median_type
attributes.description: Type of median separating opposing traffic flows (e.g., None, Unprotected, Curbed, Positive Barrier).

attributes.name: median_width_feet
attributes.description: Width of the median measured in feet from edge of traveled way to edge of traveled way.

attributes.name: access_control
attributes.description: Level of access control for the segment indicating the degree to which access is limited (e.g., Full for Interstate, Partial, None).

attributes.name: terrain_type
attributes.description: General terrain classification of the area through which the segment passes (Flat, Rolling, or Mountainous).

attributes.name: surface_type
attributes.description: Type of pavement surface material on the segment (e.g., Asphalt, Concrete, Composite, Unpaved).

attributes.name: pavement_condition_rating
attributes.description: Numeric rating representing the overall condition of the pavement surface, typically on a 0-100 scale where higher values indicate better condition.

attributes.name: iri_value
attributes.description: International Roughness Index measurement in inches per mile, representing pavement smoothness and ride quality. Lower values indicate smoother pavement.

attributes.name: psi_value
attributes.description: Present Serviceability Index rating on a 0-5 scale representing pavement serviceability and user comfort. Higher values indicate better serviceability.

attributes.name: rutting_depth_inches
attributes.description: Average depth of pavement rutting measured in inches, indicating surface deformation in wheel paths.

attributes.name: cracking_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of pavement surface area exhibiting cracking distress.

attributes.name: last_overlay_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent pavement overlay or resurfacing was completed on the segment.

attributes.name: last_rehabilitation_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent major pavement rehabilitation work was completed on the segment.

attributes.name: shoulder_type_right
attributes.description: Type of shoulder material on the right side of the traveled way in the direction of inventory.

attributes.name: shoulder_width_right_feet
attributes.description: Width of the right shoulder measured in feet from the edge of traveled way.

attributes.name: shoulder_type_left
attributes.description: Type of shoulder material on the left side of the traveled way in the direction of inventory.

attributes.name: shoulder_width_left_feet
attributes.description: Width of the left shoulder measured in feet from the edge of traveled way.

attributes.name: lane_width_feet
attributes.description: Width of a typical through lane on the segment measured in feet.

attributes.name: speed_limit_mph
attributes.business_glossary_term: Speed Limit in Miles Per Hour
attributes.description: Posted speed limit for the segment in miles per hour.

attributes.name: aadt
attributes.description: Annual Average Daily Traffic count representing the total volume of vehicle traffic on the segment for a year divided by 365 days.

attributes.name: aadt_year
attributes.description: Year for which the AADT value was calculated or estimated.

attributes.name: aadt_single_unit_trucks
attributes.business_glossary_term: Annual Average Daily Traffic (AADT) Single Unit Trucks
attributes.description: Annual average daily traffic count for single-unit trucks (typically 2-axle, 6-tire vehicles or larger single-frame trucks).

attributes.name: aadt_combination_trucks
attributes.business_glossary_term: Annual Average Daily Traffic (AADT) Combination Trucks
attributes.description: Annual average daily traffic count for combination trucks (tractor-trailer units with 5 or more axles).

attributes.name: truck_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of total AADT comprised of truck traffic (single-unit and combination trucks).

attributes.name: k_factor
attributes.description: Proportion of annual average daily traffic occurring during the peak hour, used for capacity and design analysis.

attributes.name: d_factor
attributes.description: Directional distribution factor representing the percentage of peak hour traffic traveling in the peak direction.

attributes.name: peak_parking_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether parking is allowed on the segment during peak traffic hours.

attributes.name: signal_type
attributes.description: Type of traffic signal control present on the segment, if any (e.g., No Signal, Fixed Time, Actuated, Adaptive).

attributes.name: toll_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the segment is a toll facility requiring payment for use.

attributes.name: toll_type
attributes.description: Type of toll collection system used on the segment if it is a toll facility.
attributes.value_regex: Not Tolled|Barrier Toll|Ticket System|Electronic Toll Collection|

attributes.name: hov_type
attributes.description: Type of high-occupancy vehicle facility or restriction on the segment, if applicable (e.g., HOV 2+, HOV 3+, HOT Lane).

attributes.name: county_code
attributes.description: FIPS county code for the county in which the segment is located.

attributes.name: county_name
attributes.description: Name of the county in which the segment is located.

attributes.name: division_number
attributes.description: NCDOT Division number responsible for maintenance and operations of the segment. NCDOT is organized into 14 geographic divisions.

attributes.name: maintenance_responsibility
attributes.description: Entity responsible for routine maintenance activities on the segment.

attributes.name: mpo_code
attributes.description: Code for the Metropolitan Planning Organization with jurisdiction over the segment, if located within an MPO boundary.

attributes.name: mpo_name
attributes.description: Name of the Metropolitan Planning Organization with jurisdiction over the segment, if applicable.

attributes.name: rpo_code
attributes.description: Code for the Rural Planning Organization with jurisdiction over the segment, if located within an RPO boundary.

attributes.name: rpo_name
attributes.description: Name of the Rural Planning Organization with jurisdiction over the segment, if applicable.

attributes.name: stip_project_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: State Transportation Improvement Program (STIP) Project Identifier
attributes.description: Project identifier from the State Transportation Improvement Program if the segment is part of a programmed improvement project.

attributes.name: construction_year
attributes.description: Year when the segment was originally constructed or opened to traffic.

attributes.name: reconstruction_year
attributes.description: Year when the segment was last reconstructed with major structural improvements.

attributes.name: base_type
attributes.description: Type of base material used in the pavement structure beneath the surface layer.

attributes.name: base_thickness_inches
attributes.description: Thickness of the base layer in the pavement structure measured in inches.

attributes.name: surface_thickness_inches
attributes.description: Thickness of the surface pavement layer measured in inches.

attributes.name: drainage_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative rating of the drainage system effectiveness for the segment.

attributes.name: lighting_type
attributes.description: Type and extent of roadway lighting present on the segment.

attributes.name: barrier_type
attributes.description: Type of roadside barrier or median barrier installed on the segment for safety purposes.

attributes.name: rumble_strip_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether rumble strips are installed on the segment for driver alertness.

attributes.name: bike_lane_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether dedicated bicycle lanes are present on the segment.
attributes.references: AASHTO Guide for Development of Bicycle Facilities

attributes.name: sidewalk_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether sidewalks are present along the segment.
attributes.references: AASHTO Guide for Planning, Design, and Operation of Pedestrian Facilities

attributes.name: ada_compliant_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Compliant Indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the segment meets ADA accessibility requirements for pedestrian facilities.

attributes.name: bridge_count
attributes.description: Number of bridges located on or intersecting the segment.

attributes.name: culvert_count
attributes.description: Number of culverts located on the segment for drainage purposes.

attributes.name: pavement_warranty_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the pavement on the segment is under a performance warranty from the contractor.

attributes.name: pavement_warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the pavement performance warranty expires, if applicable.

attributes.name: environmental_classification
attributes.description: NEPA environmental classification for the segment indicating the level of environmental review conducted.

attributes.name: historic_designation
attributes.description: Historic or scenic designation status of the segment, if applicable (e.g., National Register, Scenic Byway).
attributes.value_regex: None|National Register|State Register|Local Historic District|Scenic Byway|

attributes.name: scenic_byway_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the segment is designated as a scenic byway.

attributes.name: emergency_route_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the segment is designated as an emergency evacuation or response route.

attributes.name: hurricane_evacuation_route
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the segment is part of the designated hurricane evacuation route network.

attributes.name: its_equipped_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the segment is equipped with ITS infrastructure such as cameras, sensors, or dynamic message signs.

attributes.name: tmc_code
attributes.description: Traffic Message Channel location code used for real-time traffic information and navigation systems.

attributes.name: gis_centerline_feature_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier linking the segment to the GIS centerline feature in the spatial database.

attributes.name: linear_referencing_method
attributes.description: Method used for linear referencing and location identification on the segment (e.g., Route-Milepoint, Link-Node).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the highway segment.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the current segment record became effective in the system.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the segment record expires or is superseded by a new record, if applicable.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Source system or method from which the segment data was collected or derived (e.g., HPMS, Field Survey, GIS).

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date when the segment was last inspected for condition assessment purposes.

attributes.name: next_inspection_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next condition inspection of the segment.

attributes.name: maintenance_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the segment for maintenance planning and resource allocation.

attributes.name: winter_maintenance_route
attributes.description: Classification of the segment for winter weather maintenance operations (snow and ice removal priority).

attributes.name: roadway_classification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to highway.roadway_classification. Business justification: Segments are classified by functional class (Interstate, Principal Arterial, Collector, etc.) which determines funding eligibility, design standards, and reporting requirements. Segment has functional

attributes.name: terminal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ferry.terminal. Business justification: Highway segments physically connect to ferry terminals as part of the continuous transportation network. NCDOT maintains roads leading to/from ferry terminals and tracks this for route planning and ma

attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rightofway.parcel. Business justification: Highway segments physically exist on land parcels. NCDOT must track which parcel each segment occupies for legal ownership, maintenance jurisdiction, and right-of-way compliance. Used daily in asset m

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset. Business justification: Highway segments are physical infrastructure assets requiring lifecycle tracking, depreciation, and maintenance scheduling. Asset management uses this to track capital investment and replacement plann

attributes.name: feature_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gis.feature. Business justification: Highway segments are geographic features with spatial geometry. GIS feature stores the authoritative spatial representation used for mapping, routing, and spatial analysis across NCDOT systems.

products.name: lane
products.description: Definition of individual lanes within a segment, capturing lane number, width, and usage (e.g., HOV, truck). Also consolidates: highway.lane, traffic.lane.

attributes.name: lane_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the lane within the highway system. Primary key for the lane entity.

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the roadway segment to which this lane belongs. Links lane to its parent segment.

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: The route identifier for the highway or roadway containing this lane (e.g., I-40, US-1, NC-55).

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Sequential number of the lane within the segment, typically numbered from left to right or median to shoulder.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: The direction of travel for this lane (northbound, southbound, eastbound, westbound, or bidirectional).

attributes.name: width_ft
attributes.description: The width of the lane measured in feet. Standard lane widths typically range from 10 to 12 feet.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the lane based on its designated usage (e.g., general purpose, HOV, truck, bus, bike, turn lane, acceleration/deceleration, auxiliary, reversible, shoulder, parking).

attributes.name: usage_restriction
attributes.description: Specific restrictions or requirements for using this lane (e.g., HOV 2+, trucks only, no trucks, buses only, time-of-day restrictions).

attributes.name: functional_class
attributes.description: The functional classification of the roadway containing this lane per FHWA standards (interstate, principal arterial, minor arterial, major collector, minor collector, local).

attributes.name: surface_type
attributes.description: The type of pavement surface material used for this lane (asphalt, concrete, composite, gravel, unpaved).

attributes.name: surface_condition
attributes.description: Current condition rating of the lane surface based on visual inspection and condition assessment.

attributes.name: pci_score
attributes.description: Numerical rating of pavement condition on a scale of 0-100, where 100 represents excellent condition. Used for pavement management and maintenance prioritization.

attributes.name: iri_value
attributes.description: Measurement of pavement roughness in inches per mile. Lower values indicate smoother pavement. Critical metric for ride quality and HPMS reporting.

attributes.name: rutting_depth_in
attributes.description: Maximum depth of rutting (wheel path depressions) measured in inches. Indicator of pavement structural distress.

attributes.name: marking_type
attributes.description: Type of pavement marking delineating the lane boundaries (solid white, dashed white, solid yellow, dashed yellow, double yellow, none).

attributes.name: marking_condition
attributes.description: Current condition of the lane markings based on visibility and retroreflectivity assessment.

attributes.name: marking_retroreflectivity
attributes.description: Measured retroreflectivity of lane markings in millicandelas per lux per square meter (mcd/lx/m²). Indicates nighttime visibility performance.

attributes.name: shoulder_type_left
attributes.description: Type of shoulder on the left side of the lane (paved, gravel, turf, none).

attributes.name: shoulder_width_left_ft
attributes.description: Width of the left shoulder adjacent to this lane, measured in feet.

attributes.name: shoulder_type_right
attributes.description: Type of shoulder on the right side of the lane (paved, gravel, turf, none).

attributes.name: shoulder_width_right_ft
attributes.description: Width of the right shoulder adjacent to this lane, measured in feet.

attributes.name: median_type
attributes.description: Type of median separating opposing traffic flows (barrier, depressed, raised, flush, none). Applicable for lanes adjacent to median.

attributes.name: median_width_ft
attributes.description: Width of the median measured in feet. Applicable for lanes adjacent to median.

attributes.name: barrier_type
attributes.description: Type of roadside barrier or median barrier adjacent to the lane (concrete, cable, guardrail, none).

attributes.name: barrier_offset_ft
attributes.description: Distance from the edge of the lane to the nearest barrier, measured in feet.

attributes.name: speed_limit_mph
attributes.business_glossary_term: Posted Speed Limit in Miles Per Hour
attributes.description: The posted speed limit for this lane in miles per hour (mph).

attributes.name: design_speed_mph
attributes.business_glossary_term: Design Speed in Miles Per Hour
attributes.description: The design speed used for geometric design of this lane in miles per hour (mph).

attributes.name: aadt
attributes.description: The total volume of vehicle traffic on this lane for a year divided by 365 days. Key metric for capacity and planning analysis.

attributes.name: truck_aadt
attributes.description: The annual average daily traffic volume for trucks and heavy vehicles on this lane.

attributes.name: truck_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of total traffic volume that consists of trucks and heavy vehicles.

attributes.name: peak_hour_volume
attributes.description: Maximum hourly traffic volume observed on this lane during peak periods.

attributes.name: los_rating
attributes.description: Level of Service rating (A through F) indicating traffic flow quality and congestion level. A represents free flow, F represents forced flow/breakdown.

attributes.name: capacity_vehicles_per_hour
attributes.business_glossary_term: Lane Capacity in Vehicles Per Hour
attributes.description: Maximum number of vehicles that can pass through this lane per hour under prevailing conditions.

attributes.name: hov_minimum_occupancy
attributes.description: Minimum number of occupants required for a vehicle to use this HOV lane (e.g., 2 for HOV 2+, 3 for HOV 3+). Null if not an HOV lane.

attributes.name: hov_enforcement_hours
attributes.description: Time periods during which HOV restrictions are enforced (e.g., 6:00 AM - 9:00 AM, 4:00 PM - 7:00 PM). Null if not an HOV lane.

attributes.name: toll_facility_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lane is part of a toll facility requiring payment for use.

attributes.name: toll_rate_structure
attributes.description: Type of toll rate structure applied to this lane (flat, distance-based, time-of-day, dynamic pricing, none).

attributes.name: its_equipped_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lane is equipped with ITS infrastructure (sensors, cameras, dynamic message signs, etc.).

attributes.name: its_sensor_type
attributes.description: Type of ITS sensors deployed in this lane (e.g., loop detectors, radar, video detection, bluetooth, RFID).

attributes.name: lighting_type
attributes.description: Type of roadway lighting installed for this lane (LED, high pressure sodium, metal halide, none).

attributes.name: lighting_condition
attributes.description: Current condition of roadway lighting infrastructure serving this lane.

attributes.name: drainage_adequacy
attributes.description: Assessment of the adequacy of drainage infrastructure for this lane (adequate, marginal, inadequate, unknown).

attributes.name: cross_slope_percent
attributes.description: Transverse slope of the lane surface expressed as a percentage. Critical for drainage and safety.

attributes.name: grade_percent
attributes.description: Longitudinal slope or grade of the lane expressed as a percentage. Positive values indicate uphill grade.

attributes.name: curve_radius_ft
attributes.description: Radius of horizontal curvature in feet. Null for tangent (straight) sections.

attributes.name: superelevation_percent
attributes.description: Banking of the roadway on horizontal curves expressed as a percentage. Used to counteract centrifugal force.

attributes.name: sight_distance_ft
attributes.description: Available stopping sight distance for this lane measured in feet. Critical safety metric.

attributes.name: nhs_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lane is part of the National Highway System, which includes roadways important to the nation's economy, defense, and mobility.

attributes.name: truck_route_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lane is part of a designated truck route for commercial vehicle traffic.

attributes.name: emergency_route_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lane is designated as an emergency evacuation route for disaster response.

attributes.name: construction_year
attributes.description: Year when this lane was originally constructed.

attributes.name: last_resurfacing_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent resurfacing or overlay work performed on this lane.

attributes.name: last_rehabilitation_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent major rehabilitation work performed on this lane.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent condition inspection performed on this lane.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the next scheduled maintenance activity on this lane.

attributes.name: maintenance_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned for maintenance activities based on condition assessment and traffic importance (critical, high, medium, low).

attributes.name: pavement_age_years
attributes.description: Age of the current pavement surface in years since last major rehabilitation or reconstruction.

attributes.name: remaining_service_life_years
attributes.description: Estimated remaining service life of the pavement before major rehabilitation is required, expressed in years.

attributes.name: asset_value_dollars
attributes.description: Estimated replacement value of this lane asset in dollars for asset management and financial reporting.

attributes.name: maintenance_district
attributes.description: NCDOT maintenance district responsible for this lane (e.g., District 1, District 2, etc.).

attributes.name: maintenance_unit
attributes.description: Specific maintenance unit or crew responsible for routine maintenance of this lane.

attributes.name: county_code
attributes.description: FIPS county code where this lane is located.

attributes.name: mpo_name
attributes.description: Name of the Metropolitan Planning Organization with jurisdiction over this lane, if applicable.

attributes.name: rpo_name
attributes.description: Name of the Rural Planning Organization with jurisdiction over this lane, if applicable.

attributes.name: begin_milepost
attributes.description: Starting milepost location of this lane along the route.

attributes.name: end_milepost
attributes.description: Ending milepost location of this lane along the route.

attributes.name: length_miles
attributes.description: Total length of this lane segment measured in miles.

attributes.name: begin_latitude
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of the beginning point of this lane in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: begin_longitude
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the beginning point of this lane in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: end_latitude
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of the ending point of this lane in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: end_longitude
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the ending point of this lane in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: gis_feature_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this lane in the NCDOT GIS system for spatial analysis and mapping.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the lane (active, closed, under construction, planned, decommissioned).

attributes.name: closure_reason
attributes.description: Reason for lane closure if status is closed (e.g., construction, incident, maintenance, weather).

attributes.name: closure_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the lane closure began.

attributes.name: closure_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the lane closure is expected to end or actually ended.

attributes.name: incident_frequency_annual
attributes.description: Number of traffic incidents (crashes, breakdowns, etc.) occurring in this lane annually.

attributes.name: crash_rate_per_million_vmt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Crash Rate Per Million Vehicle Miles Traveled (VMT)
attributes.description: Number of crashes per million vehicle miles traveled on this lane. Key safety performance metric.

attributes.name: hsip_eligible_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Highway Safety Improvement Program (HSIP) Eligible Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lane is eligible for HSIP funding based on safety performance criteria.

attributes.name: ada_compliant_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Compliant Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lane and adjacent facilities meet ADA accessibility requirements.

attributes.name: environmental_mitigation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether environmental mitigation measures are required for this lane due to environmental impacts.

attributes.name: stormwater_permit_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the stormwater management permit associated with this lane, if applicable.

attributes.name: noise_barrier_present_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether noise barriers are present adjacent to this lane for noise mitigation.

attributes.name: federal_aid_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lane is eligible for federal aid funding programs.

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Primary funding source for construction and maintenance of this lane (e.g., state, federal, local, toll revenue).

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the construction or maintenance project associated with this lane, if applicable.

attributes.name: stip_number
attributes.description: STIP project number associated with this lane for planned improvements or construction.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Source system or method from which lane data was collected (e.g., field survey, GIS, HPMS, automated sensors).

attributes.name: data_collection_date
attributes.description: Date when the lane attribute data was collected or last updated.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Quality score for lane data on a scale of 0-1, where 1 represents highest quality and completeness.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, notes, or special conditions related to this lane.

products.name: pavement_section
products.description: Master entity for pavement sections, linking to segment and storing surface type, design thickness, and construction year.

attributes.name: pavement_section_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the pavement section within the highway system. Primary key for the pavement section master entity.

attributes.name: begin_milepost
attributes.description: Starting milepost location of the pavement section along the route. Measured in miles from route origin.

attributes.name: end_milepost
attributes.description: Ending milepost location of the pavement section along the route. Measured in miles from route origin.

attributes.name: section_length_miles
attributes.description: Total length of the pavement section measured in miles. Calculated as end_milepost minus begin_milepost.

attributes.name: county_code
attributes.description: North Carolina county code where the pavement section is located. Used for geographic and administrative reporting.

attributes.name: division_number
attributes.description: NCDOT Division of Highways division number responsible for maintenance and operations of this pavement section. North Carolina has 14 highway divisions.

attributes.name: maintenance_unit
attributes.description: Maintenance unit or crew responsible for routine maintenance activities on this pavement section.

attributes.name: surface_type_code
attributes.description: Code representing the pavement surface type. AC=Asphalt Concrete, PCC=Portland Cement Concrete, COMP=Composite, UNPAVED=Gravel or Dirt, BRICK=Brick or Block, OTHER=Other surface types.

attributes.name: surface_type_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the pavement surface type and composition, including specific materials and construction methods used.

attributes.name: pavement_structure_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pavement structural design. FLEXIBLE=asphalt layers on aggregate base, RIGID=concrete slab, COMPOSITE=asphalt overlay on concrete base.
attributes.references: AASHTO Guide for Design of Pavement Structures

attributes.name: design_thickness_inches
attributes.description: Total design thickness of the pavement structure measured in inches, including all layers from surface to subgrade.
attributes.references: AASHTO Guide for Design of Pavement Structures

attributes.name: surface_course_thickness_inches
attributes.description: Thickness of the surface course layer measured in inches. The wearing surface that provides skid resistance and smoothness.

attributes.name: base_course_thickness_inches
attributes.description: Thickness of the base course layer measured in inches. Provides structural support and load distribution.
attributes.references: AASHTO Guide for Design of Pavement Structures

attributes.name: construction_year
attributes.description: Year when the pavement section was originally constructed. Used for age-based deterioration modeling and lifecycle analysis.

attributes.name: construction_date
attributes.description: Specific date when the pavement section construction was completed and opened to traffic.

attributes.name: functional_class_code
attributes.description: FHWA functional classification code indicating the role of the roadway in serving mobility versus land access. Ranges from 1 (Interstate) to 9 (Local).

attributes.name: functional_class_description
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the functional classification (e.g., Interstate, Principal Arterial, Minor Collector, Local).

attributes.name: nhs_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this pavement section is part of the National Highway System, which includes roadways important to the nation's economy, defense, and mobility.

attributes.name: urban_rural_designation
attributes.description: Classification of the pavement section location as urban, rural, or small urban area based on Census Bureau definitions and population density.

attributes.name: number_of_lanes
attributes.description: Total number of through traffic lanes in both directions for this pavement section. Does not include auxiliary lanes, turn lanes, or shoulders.

attributes.name: lane_width_feet
attributes.description: Average width of a single traffic lane measured in feet. Standard lane widths range from 10 to 12 feet.

attributes.name: shoulder_width_feet
attributes.description: Average width of the paved or unpaved shoulder measured in feet. Provides emergency stopping area and lateral support for pavement structure.

attributes.name: median_type
attributes.description: Type of median separating opposing traffic directions. NONE=undivided, PAINTED=painted centerline only, RAISED=raised median, BARRIER=concrete barrier, DEPRESSED=depressed median.

attributes.name: median_width_feet
attributes.description: Width of the median measured in feet from edge of traveled way to edge of traveled way. Applicable only for divided highways.

attributes.name: aadt
attributes.description: Annual Average Daily Traffic volume representing the total volume of vehicle traffic on the pavement section for a year divided by 365 days. Key metric for pavement loading and deterioration.

attributes.name: aadt_year
attributes.description: Year for which the AADT value was calculated or estimated.

attributes.name: truck_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of total traffic volume consisting of trucks and heavy vehicles. Critical for pavement design and deterioration modeling as trucks cause significantly more pavement damage than passenger vehicles.

attributes.name: esal_design_value
attributes.business_glossary_term: Equivalent Single Axle Load (ESAL) Design Value
attributes.description: Design traffic loading expressed as cumulative 18,000-pound equivalent single axle loads over the pavement design life. Used for structural pavement design.
attributes.references: AASHTO Guide for Design of Pavement Structures

attributes.name: iri_value
attributes.description: International Roughness Index measured in inches per mile. Quantifies pavement roughness and ride quality. Lower values indicate smoother pavement. Typical range 40-200 inches/mile.

attributes.name: iri_collection_date
attributes.description: Date when the IRI measurement was collected using automated pavement condition survey equipment.

attributes.name: psi_value
attributes.description: Present Serviceability Index rating on a scale of 0 to 5, where 5 represents excellent pavement condition and 0 represents failed pavement. Subjective measure of pavement ride quality.
attributes.references: AASHTO Guide for Design of Pavement Structures

attributes.name: pci_value
attributes.description: Pavement Condition Index rating on a scale of 0 to 100, where 100 represents excellent condition and 0 represents failed pavement. Composite measure based on distress type, severity, and extent.

attributes.name: pci_collection_date
attributes.description: Date when the PCI rating was determined through visual distress survey or automated assessment.

attributes.name: rutting_depth_inches
attributes.description: Maximum rut depth measured in inches in the wheel path. Rutting is a longitudinal depression in the pavement surface caused by consolidation or lateral movement of materials.

attributes.name: cracking_severity
attributes.description: Overall severity rating of pavement cracking distresses including alligator cracking, longitudinal cracking, and transverse cracking. Ranges from NONE to SEVERE.

attributes.name: alligator_cracking_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of pavement section area affected by alligator (fatigue) cracking. Interconnected cracks forming a pattern resembling alligator skin, indicating structural failure.

attributes.name: longitudinal_cracking_feet
attributes.description: Total linear feet of longitudinal cracking parallel to the pavement centerline. Often occurs along construction joints or wheel paths.

attributes.name: transverse_cracking_count
attributes.description: Number of transverse cracks perpendicular to the pavement centerline. Often caused by thermal contraction or reflection from underlying layers.

attributes.name: patching_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of pavement section area that has been patched or repaired. Indicates previous maintenance activity and potential for future deterioration.

attributes.name: faulting_inches
attributes.description: Difference in elevation across concrete pavement joints measured in inches. Applicable to rigid pavements only. Caused by pumping and erosion of base materials.

attributes.name: overall_condition_rating
attributes.description: Composite overall condition rating of the pavement section based on multiple distress indicators and performance measures. Used for prioritization and decision-making.

attributes.name: treatment_priority_rank
attributes.description: Numerical ranking of this pavement section for treatment priority within the network. Lower numbers indicate higher priority for maintenance or rehabilitation.

attributes.name: recommended_treatment_type
attributes.description: Type of pavement treatment recommended based on current condition and deterioration modeling. Categories align with NCDOT pavement preservation strategies.

attributes.name: recommended_treatment_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year when the recommended pavement treatment should be performed based on condition forecasting and budget optimization.

attributes.name: estimated_treatment_cost
attributes.description: Estimated cost in US dollars to perform the recommended pavement treatment. Based on unit costs and section characteristics.

attributes.name: pavement_age_years
attributes.description: Age of the pavement section in years since original construction or last major rehabilitation. Used for deterioration modeling and lifecycle analysis.

attributes.name: design_life_years
attributes.description: Expected design life of the pavement structure in years. Typically 20 years for flexible pavements and 30-40 years for rigid pavements.
attributes.references: AASHTO Guide for Design of Pavement Structures

attributes.name: remaining_service_life_years
attributes.description: Estimated remaining service life in years before the pavement reaches terminal condition requiring major rehabilitation or reconstruction.

attributes.name: climate_zone
attributes.description: North Carolina climate zone classification for the pavement section location. Affects pavement design parameters and deterioration rates. COASTAL=eastern coastal plain, PIEDMONT=central region, MOUNTAIN=western mountains.

attributes.name: frost_penetration_depth_inches
attributes.description: Expected depth of frost penetration into the pavement structure and subgrade measured in inches. Critical for pavement design in freeze-thaw climates.
attributes.references: AASHTO Guide for Design of Pavement Structures

attributes.name: drainage_rating
attributes.description: Rating of the pavement drainage system effectiveness. Good drainage is critical for pavement performance and longevity.
attributes.references: AASHTO Guide for Design of Pavement Structures

attributes.name: subgrade_type
attributes.description: Classification of the subgrade soil type underlying the pavement structure. Affects bearing capacity and pavement design requirements.

attributes.name: subgrade_resilient_modulus_psi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Subgrade Resilient Modulus in Pounds per Square Inch (PSI)
attributes.description: Resilient modulus of the subgrade soil measured in pounds per square inch. Represents the elastic stiffness of the subgrade under repeated loading. Key input for mechanistic pavement design.
attributes.references: AASHTO Guide for Design of Pavement Structures

attributes.name: structural_number
attributes.description: AASHTO Structural Number representing the overall structural capacity of the pavement. Calculated from layer thicknesses and material coefficients. Higher values indicate stronger pavement structure.
attributes.references: AASHTO Guide for Design of Pavement Structures

attributes.name: load_transfer_efficiency_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of load transferred across joints or cracks in rigid pavements. Measured using deflection testing. Higher values indicate better load transfer and structural performance.

attributes.name: deflection_basin_area
attributes.description: Area under the deflection basin curve measured during Falling Weight Deflectometer testing. Indicates overall pavement structural capacity and remaining life.

attributes.name: friction_number
attributes.description: Skid resistance measurement representing the friction between vehicle tires and pavement surface. Critical for safety. Measured using standardized friction testing equipment.

attributes.name: friction_test_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent pavement friction testing was performed.

attributes.name: texture_depth_mm
attributes.description: Mean texture depth of the pavement surface measured in millimeters. Affects skid resistance, noise, and splash/spray. Measured using sand patch or laser methods.

attributes.name: noise_level_db
attributes.description: Tire-pavement noise level measured in decibels using on-board sound intensity method. Lower values indicate quieter pavement surfaces.

attributes.name: permeability_rating
attributes.description: Rating of pavement surface permeability to water infiltration. Affects durability and moisture-related distresses. Permeable pavements allow water to drain through the surface.

attributes.name: warranty_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this pavement section was constructed under a warranty contract requiring the contractor to maintain performance standards for a specified period.

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the construction warranty period expires. Applicable only for warranty projects.

attributes.name: project_number
attributes.description: NCDOT project number associated with the construction or major rehabilitation of this pavement section. Links to project management and financial systems.

attributes.name: letting_date
attributes.description: Date when the construction contract for this pavement section was let (awarded) to a contractor. Key milestone in project delivery.

attributes.name: contractor_name
attributes.description: Name of the contractor who constructed or performed major rehabilitation on this pavement section.

attributes.name: construction_cost
attributes.description: Actual construction cost in US dollars for building or rehabilitating this pavement section. Includes materials, labor, and equipment.

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Primary source of funding for the pavement construction or rehabilitation. STATE=state funds only, FEDERAL=federal funds, LOCAL=local funds, MIXED=combination of sources.

attributes.name: federal_aid_program
attributes.description: Specific federal aid program providing funding for this pavement section (e.g., NHPP, STP, HSIP, CMAQ). Applicable only for federally funded projects.

attributes.name: stip_project_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: State Transportation Improvement Program (STIP) Project Indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this pavement section is part of a project included in the North Carolina State Transportation Improvement Program.

attributes.name: environmental_clearance_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA) Clearance Type
attributes.description: Type of NEPA environmental clearance obtained for the pavement project. CE=Categorical Exclusion, EA=Environmental Assessment, EIS=Environmental Impact Statement, FONSI=Finding of No Significant Impact.

attributes.name: hpms_sample_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Highway Performance Monitoring System (HPMS) Sample Indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this pavement section is part of the HPMS sample for federal reporting. HPMS sample sections require more detailed data collection and reporting.

attributes.name: gis_latitude
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of the pavement section midpoint in decimal degrees. Used for spatial analysis and mapping.

attributes.name: gis_longitude
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the pavement section midpoint in decimal degrees. Used for spatial analysis and mapping.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the pavement section. ACTIVE=in service, INACTIVE=temporarily closed, PLANNED=future construction, UNDER_CONSTRUCTION=currently being built, DECOMMISSIONED=removed from service.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent pavement condition inspection or survey.

attributes.name: next_inspection_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next pavement condition inspection or survey based on inspection frequency requirements.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Source system or database from which the pavement section data was obtained (e.g., Agile Assets, TIMS, HiCAMS).

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the pavement section record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special conditions related to the pavement section that do not fit in structured fields.

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to highway.segment. Business justification: Pavement sections are linear subdivisions of highway segments for pavement management purposes. Each pavement section belongs to exactly one segment, defined by route and milepost range. Adding segmen

attributes.name: feature_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gis.feature. Business justification: Pavement sections have defined geographic boundaries for maintenance planning and asset management. GIS feature provides spatial extent for work zone planning and material quantity calculations.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to traffic.detector. Business justification: Traffic counts are collected from specific traffic detectors. Highway planning staff references detector metadata to validate count data quality and understand collection methodology for traffic studi

attributes.name: feature_id
