products.name: construction_activity
products.description: Record of construction activities on a segment, such as earthwork, paving, and bridge work, with start/end dates, crew, and equipment used.

attributes.name: construction_activity_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the construction activity record. Primary key for tracking individual construction activities on highway segments.

attributes.name: activity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the construction activity being performed on the highway segment. Defines the nature of work such as earthwork, paving, bridge work, or drainage installation.

attributes.name: activity_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the construction activity type. Used for reporting and cost tracking alignment with NCDOT construction standards.
attributes.references: NCDOT Standard Specifications for Roads and Structures

attributes.name: activity_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the specific construction activity being performed, including scope, materials, and methods.

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the specific highway segment where construction activity is occurring. Used for asset management and location referencing.

attributes.name: begin_milepost
attributes.description: Starting milepost location of the construction activity on the highway route. Measured in miles from the route origin.

attributes.name: end_milepost
attributes.description: Ending milepost location of the construction activity on the highway route. Measured in miles from the route origin.

attributes.name: county_code
attributes.description: Code representing the North Carolina county where the construction activity is located. Used for geographic reporting and resource allocation.

attributes.name: county_name
attributes.description: Full name of the North Carolina county where the construction activity is taking place.

attributes.name: division_number
attributes.description: NCDOT Division of Highways regional division number responsible for the construction activity. North Carolina has 14 highway divisions.

attributes.name: project_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the parent construction project under which this activity is being performed. Links to the State Transportation Improvement Program (STIP).

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the construction contract governing this activity. References the awarded construction contract.

attributes.name: contractor_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the contractor performing the construction activity. Primary contractor responsible for execution.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned to the contractor by NCDOT. Used for contractor performance tracking and payment processing.

attributes.name: subcontractor_name
attributes.description: Name of the subcontractor performing specialized work for this construction activity, if applicable.

attributes.name: crew_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the construction crew assigned to perform this activity. Used for labor tracking and productivity analysis.

attributes.name: crew_size
attributes.description: Number of workers assigned to the construction crew for this activity. Used for labor cost allocation and safety planning.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the construction activity to begin as specified in the project schedule.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the construction activity commenced on site. Used for schedule variance analysis.

attributes.name: scheduled_end_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the construction activity to be completed as specified in the project schedule.

attributes.name: actual_end_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the construction activity was completed. Used for schedule performance tracking and closeout.

attributes.name: duration_days
attributes.description: Total number of calendar days the construction activity took to complete from start to finish.

attributes.name: work_days_completed
attributes.description: Number of actual working days spent on the construction activity, excluding weather delays and non-work days.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the construction activity in its lifecycle. Indicates whether work is planned, active, completed, or suspended.

attributes.name: completion_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the construction activity that has been completed. Used for progress tracking and payment calculations. Value between 0 and 100.

attributes.name: quantity_planned
attributes.description: Planned quantity of work to be performed for this construction activity, measured in the appropriate unit (e.g., cubic yards, square feet, linear feet).
attributes.references: NCDOT Standard Specifications for Roads and Structures

attributes.name: quantity_completed
attributes.description: Actual quantity of work completed for this construction activity, measured in the appropriate unit. Used for payment and progress reporting.
attributes.references: NCDOT Standard Specifications for Roads and Structures

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measurement for quantifying the construction activity work. Aligns with NCDOT pay item specifications.
attributes.references: NCDOT Standard Specifications for Roads and Structures

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Contract unit price for the construction activity per unit of measure. Used for payment calculations and cost tracking.

attributes.name: estimated_cost
attributes.description: Estimated total cost for the construction activity based on planned quantities and unit prices. Used for budget planning and tracking.

attributes.name: actual_cost
attributes.description: Actual total cost incurred for the construction activity based on completed quantities and unit prices. Used for financial reporting and variance analysis.

attributes.name: labor_cost
attributes.description: Total labor cost associated with the construction activity. Includes wages, benefits, and labor burden.

attributes.name: material_cost
attributes.description: Total cost of materials used in the construction activity. Includes all raw materials, supplies, and consumables.

attributes.name: equipment_cost
attributes.description: Total cost of equipment usage for the construction activity. Includes rental, fuel, maintenance, and operator costs.

attributes.name: pay_item_number
attributes.description: NCDOT standard pay item number associated with this construction activity. Used for contract payment and cost accounting.
attributes.references: NCDOT Standard Specifications for Roads and Structures

attributes.name: pay_item_description
attributes.description: Standard description of the pay item associated with this construction activity as defined in NCDOT specifications.
attributes.references: NCDOT Standard Specifications for Roads and Structures

attributes.name: equipment_type
attributes.description: Type or category of primary construction equipment used for this activity (e.g., excavator, paver, roller, grader).

attributes.name: equipment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the specific piece of equipment used in the construction activity. Used for equipment tracking and utilization analysis.

attributes.name: equipment_hours
attributes.description: Total hours of equipment operation for this construction activity. Used for equipment cost allocation and maintenance scheduling.

attributes.name: material_type
attributes.description: Primary type of material used in the construction activity (e.g., asphalt, concrete, aggregate, steel).

attributes.name: material_source
attributes.description: Source location or supplier of the primary material used in the construction activity. Used for quality control and supply chain tracking.

attributes.name: material_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of primary material used in the construction activity, measured in appropriate units (tons, cubic yards, etc.).

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Predominant weather conditions during the construction activity. Used for schedule impact analysis and quality control documentation.

attributes.name: temperature_fahrenheit
attributes.description: Average ambient temperature during the construction activity in degrees Fahrenheit. Critical for quality control of temperature-sensitive materials like asphalt and concrete.

attributes.name: weather_delay_hours
attributes.description: Total hours of work delay attributed to adverse weather conditions. Used for schedule variance analysis and contract time adjustments.

attributes.name: traffic_control_type
attributes.description: Type of traffic control measures implemented for the construction activity. Ensures compliance with MUTCD work zone safety standards.

attributes.name: lane_closure_count
attributes.description: Number of traffic lanes closed during the construction activity. Used for traffic impact analysis and public communication.

attributes.name: traffic_control_plan_number
attributes.description: Identifier for the approved traffic control plan governing work zone safety for this construction activity.

attributes.name: work_zone_speed_limit
attributes.description: Posted speed limit in miles per hour within the construction work zone. Enforced for worker and motorist safety.

attributes.name: safety_incident_count
attributes.description: Number of safety incidents or near-misses that occurred during the construction activity. Used for safety performance tracking.

attributes.name: osha_recordable_incident
attributes.business_glossary_term: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Recordable Incident
attributes.description: Indicates whether an OSHA-recordable safety incident occurred during the construction activity. Used for regulatory compliance reporting.

attributes.name: environmental_permit_number
attributes.description: Identifier for environmental permits required for the construction activity (e.g., stormwater, wetlands, air quality permits).
attributes.references: NEPA and Clean Water Act Section 404

attributes.name: erosion_control_measures
attributes.description: Description of erosion and sediment control measures implemented during the construction activity to comply with environmental regulations.
attributes.references: NCDEQ Erosion and Sediment Control Manual

attributes.name: stormwater_compliance
attributes.description: Indicates whether the construction activity is in compliance with stormwater management requirements and permits.
attributes.references: Clean Water Act and NCDEQ Stormwater Rules

attributes.name: quality_control_test_count
attributes.description: Number of quality control tests performed during the construction activity. Used for quality assurance documentation.

attributes.name: quality_assurance_passed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the construction activity passed all required quality assurance inspections and tests.

attributes.name: acceptance_date
attributes.description: Date when the construction activity was formally accepted by NCDOT as meeting all specifications and quality requirements.

attributes.name: warranty_period_months
attributes.description: Duration of the warranty period in months for the completed construction activity. Contractor is responsible for defects during this period.
attributes.references: NCDOT Standard Specifications for Roads and Structures

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the warranty period for the construction activity expires. After this date, NCDOT assumes full maintenance responsibility.
attributes.references: NCDOT Standard Specifications for Roads and Structures

attributes.name: federal_funding_source
attributes.description: Federal funding program providing financial support for the construction activity. Used for grant compliance and financial reporting.
attributes.references: 23 CFR and OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: federal_aid_project
attributes.description: Indicates whether the construction activity is part of a federally-funded project subject to federal oversight and compliance requirements.

attributes.name: dbe_participation_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of contract value awarded to DBE firms for this construction activity. Used for federal DBE program compliance reporting.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or observations about the construction activity. Used for documenting special conditions, issues, or deviations.

attributes.name: change_order_number
attributes.description: Identifier for any contract change order affecting this construction activity. Used for tracking scope and cost modifications.

attributes.name: change_order_impact
attributes.description: Type of impact the change order has on the construction activity (scope, cost, or schedule).

attributes.name: daily_report_number
attributes.description: Identifier for the daily construction report documenting this activity. Used for project documentation and record-keeping.

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: Type of work shift during which the construction activity was performed. Affects labor rates and traffic impact.

attributes.name: night_work_premium
attributes.description: Indicates whether night work premium rates apply to this construction activity. Used for cost accounting and payment processing.

attributes.name: gps_latitude
attributes.description: GPS latitude coordinate of the construction activity location. Used for GIS mapping and spatial analysis.

attributes.name: gps_longitude
attributes.description: GPS longitude coordinate of the construction activity location. Used for GIS mapping and spatial analysis.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the construction activity record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit purposes.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the construction activity record was last updated in the system. Used for data currency tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: terminal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ferry.terminal. Business justification: Highway construction activities near ferry terminals require coordination to manage traffic flow and access. NCDOT tracks terminal-adjacent construction to coordinate detours and maintain ferry access

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to dmv.vehicle. Business justification: Construction activities must track contractor vehicles operating on highway projects for regulatory compliance, insurance verification, and access control. Highway operations validates vehicle registr

attributes.name: crash_report_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.crash_report. Business justification: Construction activities may be initiated in response to crashes (guardrail repair, signage improvements). Engineering teams link construction work to originating crash reports for safety justification

attributes.name: bridge_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to bridge.bridge. Business justification: Construction activities often involve bridge work (repairs, replacements, painting). Project managers track which bridge is affected to coordinate closures, detours, and resource allocation. Optional

attributes.name: grade_crossing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rail.grade_crossing. Business justification: Highway construction near grade crossings requires coordination with rail operations for safety and access. Construction activities must reference affected crossings to ensure proper flagging, detours

attributes.name: crew_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.crew_assignment. Business justification: Construction activities require assigned work crews. Operations teams use this daily to track which crew is performing roadwork, ensuring accountability and resource allocation for highway maintenance

attributes.name: project_boundary_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gis.project_boundary. Business justification: Construction activities occur within defined project boundaries. Project boundary defines work zone limits for public notification, traffic management, contractor scope, and environmental compliance t

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Construction activities must track costs against specific cost centers for financial reporting and budget tracking. Project managers use this daily to monitor expenditures against allocated budgets.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fund. Business justification: Highway construction projects are financed from specific funds (federal, state, bond). Finance and project teams track which fund pays for each activity for compliance and audit requirements.

products.name: sensor_reading
products.description: Telemetry from roadway sensors (e.g., temperature, moisture, strain), timestamped for condition monitoring and predictive maintenance.

attributes.name: sensor_reading_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each sensor reading record captured from roadway monitoring equipment.

attributes.name: equipment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the physical sensor device that captured this reading.

attributes.name: sensor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the sensor type indicating what physical property or condition is being measured.

attributes.name: sensor_manufacturer
attributes.description: Name of the manufacturer or vendor that produced the sensor device.

attributes.name: sensor_model
attributes.description: Model number or designation of the sensor device as specified by the manufacturer.

attributes.name: sensor_serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number assigned by the manufacturer to the individual sensor unit.

attributes.name: reading_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the sensor reading was captured, formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: reading_value
attributes.description: Numeric value of the measurement captured by the sensor at the reading timestamp.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measurement for the reading value (e.g., Celsius for temperature, percent for moisture, microstrain for strain).

attributes.name: reading_quality_code
attributes.description: Quality assessment code indicating the reliability and validity of the sensor reading.

attributes.name: reading_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the sensor reading within the data management lifecycle.

attributes.name: milepost
attributes.description: Milepost location along the route where the sensor is positioned, measured from the route origin.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the sensor location in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the sensor location in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: county_code
attributes.description: North Carolina county code where the sensor is located.

attributes.name: county_name
attributes.description: Name of the North Carolina county where the sensor is located.

attributes.name: division_number
attributes.description: NCDOT Division of Highways division number responsible for the roadway segment where the sensor is installed.

attributes.name: pavement_layer
attributes.description: Pavement structural layer where the sensor is embedded or monitoring (applicable for pavement sensors).

attributes.name: installation_depth_mm
attributes.description: Depth in millimeters at which the sensor is installed below the pavement surface or reference point.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Direction of traffic flow for the roadway segment being monitored by the sensor.

attributes.name: functional_class
attributes.description: FHWA functional classification of the roadway where the sensor is installed.

attributes.name: nhs_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the roadway segment is part of the National Highway System.

attributes.name: temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Temperature measurement in degrees Celsius captured by temperature sensors for pavement or ambient conditions.

attributes.name: moisture_percent
attributes.description: Moisture content percentage measured in pavement layers or subgrade materials.

attributes.name: strain_microstrain
attributes.description: Strain measurement in microstrain units indicating deformation or stress in pavement structure.

attributes.name: pressure_psi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pressure Reading in Pounds per Square Inch (PSI)
attributes.description: Pressure measurement in pounds per square inch for stress or load monitoring.

attributes.name: vibration_frequency_hz
attributes.description: Vibration frequency measurement in Hertz for structural health monitoring.

attributes.name: traffic_volume_count
attributes.description: Number of vehicles counted by traffic counter sensors during the measurement interval.

attributes.name: vehicle_speed_mph
attributes.business_glossary_term: Vehicle Speed in Miles per Hour (MPH)
attributes.description: Vehicle speed measurement in miles per hour captured by traffic monitoring sensors.

attributes.name: vehicle_weight_tons
attributes.description: Vehicle weight measurement in tons captured by weigh-in-motion sensors.

attributes.name: axle_count
attributes.description: Number of axles detected on a vehicle by weigh-in-motion or classification sensors.

attributes.name: vehicle_class
attributes.description: FHWA vehicle classification code (1-13) identifying the vehicle type based on axle configuration.

attributes.name: pavement_condition_index
attributes.description: Pavement Condition Index score (0-100) indicating overall pavement condition based on sensor-derived distress measurements.

attributes.name: international_roughness_index
attributes.description: International Roughness Index measurement in meters per kilometer or inches per mile indicating pavement smoothness.

attributes.name: rut_depth_mm
attributes.description: Pavement rutting depth measurement in millimeters captured by automated profiling sensors.

attributes.name: crack_density_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of pavement surface area affected by cracking as measured by automated distress detection sensors.

attributes.name: air_temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Ambient air temperature measurement in degrees Celsius from weather station sensors.

attributes.name: precipitation_mm
attributes.description: Precipitation amount in millimeters measured during the reading interval by weather sensors.

attributes.name: wind_speed_mph
attributes.business_glossary_term: Wind Speed in Miles per Hour (MPH)
attributes.description: Wind speed measurement in miles per hour from weather station sensors.

attributes.name: wind_direction_degrees
attributes.description: Wind direction in degrees (0-360) from true north measured by weather station sensors.

attributes.name: relative_humidity_percent
attributes.description: Relative humidity percentage measured by weather station sensors.

attributes.name: visibility_meters
attributes.description: Visibility distance in meters measured by weather station sensors for roadway safety monitoring.

attributes.name: road_surface_condition
attributes.description: Current road surface condition detected by environmental sensors for winter maintenance operations.

attributes.name: freezing_point_celsius
attributes.description: Calculated freezing point temperature of the pavement surface considering chemical treatments.

attributes.name: salt_concentration_percent
attributes.description: Salt or chemical treatment concentration percentage on the pavement surface measured by environmental sensors.

attributes.name: air_quality_index
attributes.description: Air Quality Index value (0-500) measured by air quality monitoring sensors near roadways.

attributes.name: particulate_matter_pm25
attributes.description: Concentration of particulate matter 2.5 micrometers or smaller in micrograms per cubic meter.

attributes.name: particulate_matter_pm10
attributes.description: Concentration of particulate matter 10 micrometers or smaller in micrograms per cubic meter.

attributes.name: noise_level_decibels
attributes.description: Ambient noise level measurement in decibels from roadway noise monitoring sensors.

attributes.name: battery_voltage
attributes.description: Current battery voltage of the sensor device for remote monitoring of power status.

attributes.name: signal_strength_dbm
attributes.description: Communication signal strength in dBm for wireless sensor connectivity monitoring.

attributes.name: data_transmission_status
attributes.description: Status of data transmission from the sensor to the central data collection system.

attributes.name: calibration_date
attributes.description: Date when the sensor was last calibrated to ensure measurement accuracy.

attributes.name: calibration_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next required sensor calibration based on maintenance intervals.

attributes.name: maintenance_status
attributes.description: Current maintenance status of the sensor device.

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date when the sensor was installed at the current location.

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the manufacturer warranty for the sensor device expires.

attributes.name: expected_service_life_years
attributes.description: Expected operational service life of the sensor in years as specified by the manufacturer.

attributes.name: data_collection_interval_seconds
attributes.description: Configured time interval in seconds between consecutive sensor readings.

attributes.name: aggregation_period_minutes
attributes.description: Time period in minutes over which sensor readings are aggregated for reporting (e.g., 5-minute, 15-minute intervals).

attributes.name: alert_threshold_value
attributes.description: Configured threshold value that triggers an alert or notification when exceeded by sensor readings.

attributes.name: alert_triggered_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this sensor reading triggered an alert condition based on configured thresholds.

attributes.name: alert_severity
attributes.description: Severity level of the alert triggered by this sensor reading.

attributes.name: validation_method
attributes.description: Method used to validate the accuracy and quality of the sensor reading.

attributes.name: validated_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the person or system that validated the sensor reading.

attributes.name: validation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the sensor reading was validated.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system or platform that collected and transmitted the sensor reading (e.g., TIMS, ATLAS, ITS Central).

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the construction or maintenance project associated with the sensor installation.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Contract number under which the sensor was procured or installed.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: NCDOT asset management system identifier for the sensor as a trackable asset.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes about the sensor reading, anomalies, or special conditions.

attributes.name: data_classification
attributes.description: Security classification level of the sensor reading data.

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to highway.segment. Business justification: Roadway sensors (temperature, moisture, strain gauges) are installed at specific locations on highway segments. Each sensor reading is associated with the segment being monitored, identified by route

attributes.name: lane_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to highway.lane. Business justification: Many roadway sensors are installed in specific lanes for lane-level monitoring (e.g., weigh-in-motion sensors, lane-specific traffic counters, pavement strain gauges). Sensor_reading has lane_number a

attributes.name: feature_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gis.feature. Business justification: Highway sensors (weather, traffic, pavement) have fixed installation locations. GIS feature stores sensor point geometry for real-time condition mapping and ITS operations.

products.name: service_request
products.description: Requests submitted by the public (e.g., pothole report, signage issue), capturing location, description, priority, and resolution status.

attributes.name: service_request_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the service request submitted by the public or internal stakeholders.

attributes.name: request_number
attributes.description: Human-readable service request number displayed to citizens and staff for tracking purposes.

attributes.name: request_type
attributes.description: Category of the service request indicating the nature of the issue reported.

attributes.name: request_subtype
attributes.description: Detailed subcategory providing additional classification granularity for the service request type.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the service request based on safety impact, traffic disruption, and urgency.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the service request from submission through resolution.

attributes.name: submitted_date
attributes.description: Date when the service request was originally submitted by the requester.

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the service request was submitted into the system.

attributes.name: acknowledged_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the service request was acknowledged by NCDOT staff.

attributes.name: assigned_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the service request was assigned to a maintenance crew or contractor.

attributes.name: in_progress_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when work on the service request was initiated by the assigned crew.

attributes.name: completed_timestamp

attributes.name: closed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the service request was officially closed in the system.

attributes.name: target_completion_date
attributes.description: Planned date by which the service request should be completed based on priority and resource availability.

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the service request work was completed.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the issue or concern provided by the requester.

attributes.name: location_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the location where the issue exists, as provided by the requester.

attributes.name: milepost

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Direction of travel or side of the roadway where the issue is located.

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: North Carolina county where the service request issue is located.

attributes.name: municipality
attributes.description: City or town where the service request issue is located, if applicable.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the service request location in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the service request location in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: coordinate_accuracy
attributes.description: Accuracy level of the geographic coordinates provided for the service request location.

attributes.name: address
attributes.description: Street address nearest to the service request location.

attributes.name: cross_street
attributes.description: Nearest cross street or intersection to help identify the service request location.

attributes.name: division
attributes.description: NCDOT highway division number responsible for the geographic area where the issue is located.
attributes.references: NCDOT Division of Highways (DOH) Organization Structure

attributes.name: maintenance_unit
attributes.description: Maintenance unit or yard responsible for addressing the service request.

attributes.name: requester_type
attributes.description: Type or category of the individual or entity submitting the service request.

attributes.name: requester_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual submitting the service request.

attributes.name: requester_email
attributes.description: Email address of the requester for communication and status updates.

attributes.name: requester_phone
attributes.description: Contact phone number of the requester for follow-up communication.

attributes.name: requester_address
attributes.description: Mailing address of the requester if provided for correspondence.

attributes.name: contact_preference
attributes.description: Preferred method of communication for status updates as indicated by the requester.

attributes.name: submission_channel

attributes.name: assigned_crew_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the maintenance crew assigned to resolve the service request.

attributes.name: contractor_name
attributes.description: Name of the contractor assigned to perform the work if outsourced.

attributes.name: work_order_number
attributes.description: Work order number generated for the maintenance activity associated with the service request.

attributes.name: resolution_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the actions taken to resolve the service request.

attributes.name: resolution_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the outcome or resolution of the service request.

attributes.name: actual_cost
attributes.description: Actual cost in US dollars incurred to complete the service request work.

attributes.name: labor_hours
attributes.description: Total labor hours expended to complete the service request work.

attributes.name: materials_used
attributes.description: Description of materials used to complete the service request work.

attributes.name: equipment_used
attributes.description: Description of equipment or vehicles used to complete the service request work.

attributes.name: safety_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of the safety impact or hazard level posed by the reported issue.

attributes.name: traffic_impact

attributes.name: nhs_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the service request location is on the National Highway System.

attributes.name: functional_class

attributes.name: pavement_condition_index
attributes.description: Pavement Condition Index score for the roadway segment where the service request is located.

attributes.name: weather_conditions
attributes.description: Weather conditions at the time the service request was submitted or when the issue was observed.

attributes.name: photo_url

attributes.name: photo_count
attributes.description: Number of photos attached to the service request for documentation.

attributes.name: inspection_required

attributes.name: inspection_completed_date
attributes.description: Date when the inspection of the service request issue was completed.

attributes.name: inspector_name
attributes.description: Name of the inspector who conducted the site inspection for the service request.

attributes.name: permit_required

attributes.name: permit_number

attributes.name: environmental_clearance

attributes.name: duplicate_of_request_id

attributes.name: related_incident_number

attributes.name: typical_shoulder_width_feet

attributes.name: median_type

attributes.description: Approximate percentage of statewide Vehicle Miles Traveled contributed by roadways in this functional classification. Used for system performance analysis.

attributes.description: Approximate percentage of total state highway system centerline miles represented by roadways in this functional classification.

attributes.name: pavement_performance_target_pci

products.name: pavement_treatment
products.description: This association product represents the treatment event between pavement_section and project. It captures the specific work performed on a pavement section as part of a transportation project. Each record links one pavement_section to one project with attributes that describe the treatment type, timing, scope, and condition assessment before and after the work.. Existence Justification: In NCDOT pavement management operations, a single pavement section receives multiple treatments over its lifecycle (crack seal in 2020, overlay in 2023, rehabilitation in 2028), and a single transportation project typically treats multiple pavement sections (a district-wide resurfacing contract may treat 50+ sections). The relationship between pavement sections and projects is operationally managed as treatment events with specific attributes: treatment type, scheduled and actual dates, before/after condition ratings, and work scope details.

attributes.name: pavement_treatment_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the pavement_treatment association

attributes.name: pavement_section_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the pavement section receiving treatment

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the transportation project that delivered the treatment

attributes.name: treatment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pavement treatment work performed. Identifies the specific maintenance or rehabilitation strategy applied to the section.

attributes.name: scheduled_work_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the treatment work to be performed on this pavement section as part of the project schedule.

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the treatment work was completed and the pavement section was reopened to traffic.

attributes.name: pre_condition_rating
attributes.description: Pavement condition index or rating assessed before the treatment was applied. Used to establish baseline condition and justify treatment selection.

attributes.name: post_condition_rating
attributes.description: Pavement condition index or rating assessed after the treatment was completed. Used to measure treatment effectiveness and expected service life extension.

attributes.name: work_scope
attributes.description: Detailed description of the specific work performed on this pavement section, including materials used, layer thicknesses, and any special treatments or conditions.

attributes.name: last_overlay_year
attributes.description: Year when the most recent overlay or resurfacing treatment was applied to the pavement section. [Moved from pavement_section: This attribute represents the most recent overlay treatment, which should be derived from the pavement_treatment association rather than stored redundantly on pavement_section. The association provides the complete treatment history.]

attributes.name: last_overlay_date
attributes.description: Specific date when the most recent overlay or resurfacing treatment was completed. [Moved from pavement_section: This attribute represents the most recent overlay treatment date, which should be derived from the pavement_treatment association rather than stored redundantly on pavement_section.]

attributes.name: last_rehabilitation_year
attributes.description: Year when the most recent major rehabilitation work was performed on the pavement section, including reconstruction or major structural improvements. [Moved from pavement_section: This attribute represents the most recent rehabilitation treatment, which should be derived from the pavement_treatment association rather than stored redundantly on pavement_section.]

attributes.name: last_rehabilitation_date
attributes.description: Specific date when the most recent major rehabilitation work was completed. [Moved from pavement_section: This attribute represents the most recent rehabilitation treatment date, which should be derived from the pavement_treatment association rather than stored redundantly on pavement_section.]

products.name: construction_impact
products.description: This association product represents the impact event between construction_activity and route. It captures the specific effects of highway construction on transit route operations, including detours, service modifications, and public notification requirements. Each record links one construction_activity to one route with attributes that exist only in the context of this relationship.. Existence Justification: Highway construction activities frequently impact multiple transit routes simultaneously when work occurs in areas served by multiple bus, rail, or ferry routes. Conversely, each transit route is affected by multiple construction activities over time as different highway segments along or near the route undergo maintenance and improvement. NCDOT actively manages these impacts as operational events, tracking specific detour requirements, service modifications, and public notification status for each construction-route combination to coordinate multimodal transportation operations.

attributes.name: construction_impact_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the construction_impact association

attributes.name: construction_activity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the highway construction activity causing the transit impact

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the transit route affected by the construction activity

attributes.name: impact_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the construction activity begins to affect the transit route operations. Used for scheduling service modifications and public notifications.

attributes.name: impact_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the construction activity impact on the transit route is expected to end and normal service resumes. Used for planning restoration of regular service.

attributes.name: detour_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transit route must be detoured due to this construction activity. Triggers detour planning and signage updates.

attributes.name: service_modification_type
attributes.description: Classification of how the transit service must be modified due to the construction activity. Determines operational response and public communication strategy.

attributes.name: notification_status
attributes.description: Current status of public notification regarding this construction impact. Tracks whether affected riders have been informed of service changes.

products.name: segment_scenario_treatment
products.description: This association product represents the treatment or improvement strategy applied to a specific highway segment within a specific planning scenario. It captures the investment decisions, cost estimates, and implementation priorities that exist only in the context of evaluating a segment under a particular planning scenario. Each record links one segment to one scenario with attributes describing the proposed treatment approach.. Existence Justification: In transportation planning operations, NCDOT creates multiple planning scenarios (baseline, growth, climate-impact) to evaluate different investment strategies. Each scenario evaluates hundreds or thousands of highway segments with different proposed treatments, costs, and priorities. A single segment appears in multiple scenarios with different treatment approaches (e.g., overlay in baseline, reconstruction in growth scenario), and each scenario includes many segments. Planning analysts actively manage these segment-scenario-treatment combinations to compare funding allocation strategies.

attributes.name: segment_scenario_treatment_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Segment Scenario Treatment - Segment Scenario Treatment Id
attributes.description: Primary key for the segment_scenario_treatment association

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the highway segment being evaluated in this scenario

attributes.name: scenario_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the planning scenario under which this treatment is proposed

attributes.name: treatment_type
attributes.description: The type of treatment or improvement strategy proposed for this segment in this scenario (e.g., Overlay, Rehabilitation, Reconstruction, Widening)

attributes.name: estimated_cost
attributes.description: The estimated cost in dollars for implementing the proposed treatment on this segment under this scenario

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: The priority ranking of this segment treatment within the scenario, used for funding allocation decisions

attributes.name: implementation_year
attributes.description: The target year for implementing this treatment on this segment within the scenario timeline

attributes.name: condition_improvement
attributes.description: The expected improvement in pavement condition rating resulting from this treatment in this scenario

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this segment-scenario treatment record was created in the planning system

attributes.name: modified_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this segment-scenario treatment record was last modified

products.name: route
products.description: Master reference table for route. Referenced by route_id.

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Primary key for route

attributes.name: route_number
attributes.description: The official route designation number as displayed on highway signage (e.g., I-40, US-1, NC-55). This is the public-facing route identifier used by travelers and in official documentation.

attributes.name: route_name
attributes.description: The common or official name of the route if applicable (e.g., Blue Ridge Parkway, Outer Banks Scenic Byway). May be null for routes without designated names.

attributes.name: route_type
attributes.description: Classification of the route based on functional hierarchy and jurisdiction within the transportation network. Determines maintenance responsibility and funding eligibility.

attributes.name: route_prefix
attributes.description: Standard prefix code indicating the route classification (I=Interstate, US=US Highway, NC=NC State Route, SR=Secondary Road, BUS=Business Route, ALT=Alternate Route, BYP=Bypass, SPUR=Spur Route, LOOP=Loop Route, CONN=Connector).

attributes.name: route_suffix
attributes.description: Optional suffix code providing additional route designation information such as directional indicators (N/S/E/W) or special designations (ALT/BUS/BYP). May be null for routes without suffixes.

attributes.name: functional_class
attributes.description: FHWA functional classification code indicating the role of the route in the highway network hierarchy. Used for federal funding eligibility and performance monitoring requirements.

attributes.name: ownership
attributes.description: Entity responsible for ownership and jurisdiction of the route. Determines maintenance responsibility and funding sources.

attributes.name: maintenance_responsibility
attributes.description: Entity responsible for routine and major maintenance activities on the route. May differ from ownership in cases of maintenance agreements. DOH (Department of Highways) indicates NCDOT state maintenance responsibility.

attributes.name: total_length_miles
attributes.description: Total centerline length of the route in miles within North Carolina state boundaries. Used for asset inventory, funding allocation, and performance reporting.

attributes.name: begin_milepost
attributes.description: Starting milepost reference point for the route. Typically 0.000 for route origin but may vary for route segments or realignments.

attributes.name: end_milepost
attributes.description: Ending milepost reference point for the route. Represents the terminal point of the route within the state system.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Primary directional orientation or traffic flow direction of the route. Used for route identification and traffic management purposes.

attributes.name: surface_type
attributes.description: Predominant pavement surface type for the route. Critical for maintenance planning, performance monitoring, and lifecycle cost analysis.

attributes.name: number_of_lanes
attributes.description: Total number of through traffic lanes in both directions for the route. Excludes auxiliary lanes, turn lanes, and shoulders. Used for capacity analysis and safety assessments.

attributes.name: median_type
attributes.description: Type of median separation between opposing traffic flows. Critical safety feature affecting crash rates and access management.

attributes.name: access_control
attributes.description: Level of access control limiting entry and exit points along the route. Full control (interstates) allows access only at interchanges; partial control limits driveways and intersections; no control allows unrestricted access.

attributes.name: nhs_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the route is part of the National Highway System, a network of strategic highways important to the nation's economy, defense, and mobility. NHS designation affects federal funding eligibility and performance monitoring requirements.

attributes.name: truck_route_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the route is designated for commercial truck traffic with appropriate weight limits, clearances, and geometric standards.

attributes.name: scenic_byway_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the route is designated as a state or national scenic byway based on scenic, historic, cultural, natural, recreational, or archaeological qualities.

attributes.name: toll_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the route includes toll collection facilities requiring payment for use.

attributes.name: speed_limit_mph
attributes.description: Primary posted speed limit for the route in miles per hour. May vary by segment; this represents the predominant or maximum speed limit for the route.

attributes.name: annual_average_daily_traffic
attributes.description: Average number of vehicles traveling on the route per day over a one-year period. Critical metric for capacity planning, safety analysis, pavement design, and funding allocation.

attributes.name: truck_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of total traffic volume consisting of commercial trucks and heavy vehicles. Used for pavement design, maintenance planning, and freight mobility analysis.

attributes.name: pavement_condition_rating
attributes.description: Composite pavement condition score based on distress surveys, roughness measurements, and structural adequacy. Scale typically 0-100 with higher values indicating better condition. Used for maintenance prioritization and asset management.

attributes.name: last_resurfacing_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent major resurfacing or pavement rehabilitation project on the route. Used for lifecycle analysis and maintenance scheduling.

attributes.name: construction_year
attributes.description: Year the route was originally constructed and opened to traffic. Used for historical analysis and asset age tracking.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the route within the state highway system. Active routes are open to traffic; inactive routes are closed or removed from the system; under construction routes are being built or reconstructed.

attributes.name: urban_rural_designation
attributes.description: Classification of the route location as urban or rural based on population density and Census Bureau urbanized area boundaries. Affects functional classification, design standards, and federal funding formulas.

attributes.name: emergency_route_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the route is designated as an emergency evacuation route for natural disasters or other emergency situations. Affects maintenance priorities and emergency response planning.

attributes.name: strahnet_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the route is part of the Strategic Highway Network, a system of public highways designated for defense purposes and military mobilization. STRAHNET routes must meet specific geometric and weight standards.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the current route designation, classification, or configuration became effective. Used for temporal tracking and historical analysis of route changes.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the route designation was terminated, decommissioned, or reclassified. Null for active routes. Used for historical tracking and system changes.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special conditions, historical information, or operational considerations related to the route that do not fit in structured fields.

products.name: license

attributes.name: self_certification_type

attributes.description: The date on which a license suspension began, if applicable.

attributes.name: suspension_end_date

attributes.name: revocation_date

attributes.description: The reason for license revocation (e.g., multiple DWI offenses, felony involving motor vehicle, habitual offender).

attributes.name: points_balance

attributes.name: provisional_expiration_date

attributes.name: driver_education_completion_date

attributes.name: road_test_date

attributes.name: written_test_date

attributes.name: vision_test_date

attributes.name: corrective_lenses_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the driver is required to wear corrective lenses while operating a vehicle.

attributes.name: ignition_interlock_required

attributes.name: out_of_state_conviction_indicator

attributes.name: commercial_learner_permit_indicator

attributes.name: lawful_presence_verified_date

attributes.name: limited_term_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a limited-term license issued to non-citizens with temporary lawful presence, with expiration tied to authorized stay period.

attributes.description: The expiration date of the driver's authorized stay in the United States, applicable to limited-term licenses.

products.name: vehicle
products.description: Master record for each vehicle registered in North Carolina, storing VIN, make, model, year, body type, and ownership links.

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for each vehicle registered in North Carolina. Primary key for the vehicle master record.

attributes.name: vin
attributes.description: 17-character alphanumeric code assigned by the manufacturer that uniquely identifies the vehicle. Used for titling, registration, and tracking throughout the vehicle lifecycle.

attributes.name: make
attributes.description: Manufacturer or brand name of the vehicle (e.g., Ford, Toyota, Honda).

attributes.name: model
attributes.description: Specific model name or designation assigned by the manufacturer (e.g., Camry, F-150, Civic).

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: Year designated by the manufacturer for the vehicle model, which may differ from the calendar year of manufacture.

attributes.name: body_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vehicle based on its body configuration and design (e.g., sedan, SUV, pickup truck).

attributes.name: class
attributes.description: Primary classification category for registration and regulatory purposes (e.g., passenger, commercial, motorcycle).

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: Primary fuel or energy source used to power the vehicle.

attributes.name: engine_type
attributes.description: Description of the engine configuration and characteristics (e.g., V6, inline-4, electric motor).

attributes.name: engine_displacement_liters
attributes.description: Total volume of all cylinders in the engine measured in liters. Not applicable for electric vehicles.

attributes.name: cylinder_count
attributes.description: Number of cylinders in the engine. Not applicable for electric vehicles.

attributes.name: transmission_type
attributes.description: Type of transmission system used in the vehicle (e.g., automatic, manual, continuously variable).

attributes.name: drive_type
attributes.description: Drivetrain configuration indicating which wheels receive power from the engine (front-wheel drive, rear-wheel drive, all-wheel drive, four-wheel drive).

attributes.name: color_primary
attributes.description: Primary exterior color of the vehicle as recorded at registration.

attributes.name: color_secondary
attributes.description: Secondary exterior color for multi-tone vehicles. Null if vehicle has single color.

attributes.name: gross_vehicle_weight_rating_lbs
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) in Pounds
attributes.description: Maximum total weight of the vehicle including passengers, cargo, and fuel as specified by the manufacturer. Critical for commercial vehicle classification and road use regulations.

attributes.name: curb_weight_lbs
attributes.description: Weight of the vehicle without passengers or cargo but with standard equipment and full fluids.

attributes.name: seating_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of passengers the vehicle is designed to accommodate, including the driver.

attributes.name: door_count
attributes.description: Number of doors on the vehicle, including rear hatch or tailgate if applicable.

attributes.name: axle_count
attributes.description: Number of axles on the vehicle. Important for commercial vehicles and weight-based fees.

attributes.name: tire_size
attributes.description: Standard tire size specification for the vehicle (e.g., P215/65R15).

attributes.name: odometer_reading
attributes.description: Most recent recorded mileage from the vehicle odometer, typically captured at registration renewal or title transfer.

attributes.name: odometer_reading_date
attributes.description: Date when the odometer reading was recorded.

attributes.name: odometer_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for the odometer reading (miles or kilometers).

attributes.name: odometer_brand
attributes.description: Federal odometer disclosure brand indicating the accuracy status of the odometer reading.

attributes.name: title_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned to the certificate of title for this vehicle in North Carolina.

attributes.name: title_status
attributes.description: Current status of the vehicle title indicating any brands or conditions affecting ownership.

attributes.name: title_issue_date
attributes.description: Date when the current North Carolina title was issued for this vehicle.

attributes.name: title_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code indicating which state currently holds the title for this vehicle.

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: Current registration number assigned to the vehicle in North Carolina.

attributes.name: registration_status
attributes.description: Current status of the vehicle registration indicating whether the vehicle is legally authorized for road use.

attributes.name: registration_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the current registration period began.

attributes.name: registration_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the current registration expires and renewal is required.

attributes.name: registration_renewal_month
attributes.description: Month (1-12) when annual registration renewal is due for this vehicle.

attributes.name: license_plate_number
attributes.description: Current license plate number displayed on the vehicle. Personally identifiable as it can be linked to the registered owner.

attributes.name: license_plate_type
attributes.description: Category of license plate issued to the vehicle indicating special status or owner preference.

attributes.name: license_plate_issue_date
attributes.description: Date when the current license plate was issued to this vehicle.

attributes.name: inspection_status
attributes.description: Current status of the vehicle safety and emissions inspection as required by North Carolina law.

attributes.name: inspection_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the current vehicle inspection expires and re-inspection is required.

attributes.name: inspection_station_number
attributes.description: Identifier for the licensed inspection station that performed the most recent vehicle inspection.

attributes.name: emissions_test_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vehicle is subject to emissions testing based on model year, county of registration, and vehicle type.

attributes.name: emissions_test_status
attributes.description: Result of the most recent emissions test if applicable.

attributes.name: insurance_company_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the insurance company providing liability coverage for the vehicle as reported to DMV.

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number for the current liability insurance coverage on the vehicle.

attributes.name: insurance_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the current insurance policy became effective.

attributes.name: insurance_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the current insurance policy expires.

attributes.name: insurance_verification_status
attributes.description: Status of insurance verification through the DMV insurance verification system.

attributes.name: lien_holder_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution or entity holding a lien on the vehicle. Null if no lien exists.

attributes.name: lien_holder_address
attributes.description: Mailing address of the lien holder for title and lien release correspondence.

attributes.name: lien_date
attributes.description: Date when the lien was recorded on the vehicle title.

attributes.name: lien_release_date
attributes.description: Date when the lien was satisfied and released. Null if lien is still active.

attributes.name: purchase_date
attributes.description: Date when the current owner acquired the vehicle, as recorded on the title application.

attributes.name: purchase_price_amount
attributes.description: Purchase price paid for the vehicle as declared on the title application. Used for calculating highway use tax.

attributes.name: assessed_value_amount
attributes.description: Current assessed value of the vehicle for property tax purposes as determined by county tax assessor.

attributes.name: property_tax_paid_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether property taxes have been paid for the current tax year. Required for registration renewal.

attributes.name: property_tax_paid_date
attributes.description: Date when property taxes were paid for the current tax year.

attributes.name: highway_use_tax_amount
attributes.description: Amount of highway use tax paid at the time of title transfer, calculated as percentage of purchase price.

attributes.name: highway_use_tax_paid_date
attributes.description: Date when highway use tax was paid for this vehicle.

attributes.name: registration_fee_amount
attributes.description: Amount of registration fee paid for the current registration period.

attributes.name: registration_fee_paid_date
attributes.description: Date when the registration fee was paid.

attributes.name: county_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the North Carolina county where the vehicle is registered and garaged.

attributes.name: garaged_zip_code
attributes.description: ZIP code where the vehicle is primarily garaged or stored.

attributes.name: use_type
attributes.description: Primary use classification for the vehicle affecting registration requirements and fees.

attributes.name: commercial_use_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vehicle is used for commercial purposes requiring additional permits or endorsements.

attributes.name: fleet_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vehicle is part of a commercial or government fleet.

attributes.name: fleet_number
attributes.description: Fleet identifier if the vehicle is part of a registered fleet. Null if not a fleet vehicle.

attributes.name: antique_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vehicle qualifies for antique vehicle registration based on age and condition.

attributes.name: salvage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vehicle has been declared a total loss by an insurance company and branded as salvage.

attributes.name: rebuilt_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vehicle was previously salvaged and has been rebuilt and inspected for road use.

attributes.name: stolen_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vehicle has been reported stolen and is in the National Crime Information Center (NCIC) database.

attributes.name: stolen_date
attributes.description: Date when the vehicle was reported stolen. Null if vehicle has not been reported stolen.

attributes.name: recovered_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a previously stolen vehicle has been recovered.

attributes.name: recovered_date
attributes.description: Date when a stolen vehicle was recovered. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: recall_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether there are open safety recalls for this vehicle as reported by NHTSA.

attributes.name: recall_count
attributes.description: Number of open safety recalls affecting this vehicle.

attributes.name: manufacturer_country
attributes.description: Three-letter country code indicating the country where the vehicle was manufactured, derived from VIN.

attributes.name: assembly_plant
attributes.description: Manufacturing plant or facility where the vehicle was assembled, derived from VIN.

attributes.name: import_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vehicle was imported from outside the United States.

attributes.name: import_date
attributes.description: Date when the vehicle was imported into the United States. Null if domestically manufactured.

attributes.name: first_registration_date
attributes.description: Date when the vehicle was first registered in any jurisdiction, typically when sold as new.

attributes.name: nc_first_registration_date
attributes.description: Date when the vehicle was first registered in North Carolina, which may differ from first registration date if vehicle was transferred from another state.

attributes.name: previous_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code indicating the state where the vehicle was previously registered before North Carolina. Null if first registration.

attributes.name: out_of_state_title_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vehicle currently holds a title from another state and is pending North Carolina title transfer.

attributes.name: msrp_amount
attributes.description: Original manufacturer suggested retail price when the vehicle was new.

attributes.name: trim_level
attributes.description: Specific trim level or package designation for the vehicle model (e.g., LX, EX, Limited, Sport).

attributes.name: series
attributes.description: Vehicle series designation within the model line (e.g., 1500, 2500 for trucks).

attributes.name: cab_type
attributes.description: Cab configuration for trucks and commercial vehicles (e.g., regular cab, crew cab, extended cab).

attributes.name: bed_length_inches
attributes.description: Length of the cargo bed for pickup trucks measured in inches.

attributes.name: wheelchair_accessible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vehicle has been modified for wheelchair accessibility in compliance with ADA requirements.

attributes.name: airbag_count
attributes.description: Total number of airbags installed in the vehicle as a safety feature.

attributes.name: abs_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vehicle is equipped with anti-lock braking system.

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Current status of the vehicle master record in the DMV system.

attributes.name: record_created_date
attributes.description: Date when the vehicle record was first created in the North Carolina DMV system.

attributes.name: record_last_updated_date
attributes.description: Date when the vehicle record was most recently updated in the DMV system.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record that is the authoritative source for this vehicle record.

attributes.description: The date when the current registration expires and must be renewed.

attributes.description: The number of months for which the registration is valid before renewal is required.

attributes.name: vehicle_use

attributes.name: gross_vehicle_weight

products.name: fee
products.description: Reference table of all fee types charged by the DMV (e.g., license issuance, renewal, title transfer), with amount, applicable vehicle class, and regulatory code.

attributes.name: fee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fee record in the DMV fee reference table.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code representing the fee type (e.g., DL01 for driver license issuance, REG01 for vehicle registration).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Official name of the fee as it appears on DMV documentation and receipts.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the fee purpose, applicability, and any special conditions or exemptions.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the fee type (e.g., license, registration, title, inspection).

attributes.name: subcategory
attributes.description: More granular classification within the fee category (e.g., original issuance, renewal, replacement, transfer).

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Standard fee amount charged in US dollars for the service or transaction.

attributes.name: minimum_amount
attributes.description: Minimum fee amount applicable when the fee is variable or calculated based on specific criteria.

attributes.name: maximum_amount
attributes.description: Maximum fee amount applicable when the fee is variable or has a statutory cap.

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate the fee amount (e.g., fixed, weight-based for vehicle registration, value-based for title transfer).

attributes.name: vehicle_class
attributes.description: Vehicle classification to which this fee applies (e.g., passenger, motorcycle, commercial, trailer). Null if not vehicle-specific.

attributes.name: license_type
attributes.description: Driver license type to which this fee applies (e.g., Class C, CDL Class A, CDL Class B, learner permit, provisional). Null if not license-specific.

attributes.name: cdl_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fee applies specifically to Commercial Driver License (CDL) transactions.

attributes.name: duration_years
attributes.description: Number of years the fee covers (e.g., 5 years for standard driver license, 1 year for vehicle registration). Null if not duration-based.

attributes.name: statutory_reference
attributes.description: North Carolina General Statute (NCGS) citation that establishes the legal authority and amount for this fee.

attributes.name: revenue_code
attributes.description: Accounting code used to classify and track revenue from this fee in the state financial system.

attributes.name: fund_code
attributes.description: State fund to which revenue from this fee is allocated (e.g., Highway Fund, Highway Trust Fund, General Fund).

attributes.name: distribution_method
attributes.description: Method by which fee revenue is distributed across state funds or agencies (e.g., single fund, split between multiple funds, formula-based allocation).

attributes.name: payment_methods_accepted
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of payment methods accepted for this fee (e.g., cash, check, credit card, debit card, electronic funds transfer).

attributes.name: online_payment_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fee can be paid through the DMV online portal or web applications.

attributes.name: refundable_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fee is refundable under certain conditions (e.g., duplicate payment, service not rendered).

attributes.name: waiver_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fee is eligible for waiver under specific circumstances (e.g., military service, disability, hardship).

attributes.name: waiver_conditions
attributes.description: Description of conditions under which the fee may be waived (e.g., active military duty, Purple Heart recipient, disabled veteran).

attributes.name: revision_authority
attributes.description: Authority responsible for the most recent fee revision (e.g., NC General Assembly, NCDOT Commissioner, DMV Director).

attributes.description: Current operational status of the fee (active, inactive, suspended, pending legislative approval, superseded by newer fee).

attributes.description: Indicates whether the fee can be prorated based on partial service period (e.g., mid-year vehicle registration).

attributes.name: proration_method

attributes.description: Percentage-based late penalty applied to the original fee amount. Null if late penalty is fixed amount or not applicable.

attributes.description: Number of days after the due date before late penalties are assessed. Null if no grace period exists.

attributes.name: state_portion_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the fee amount retained by the state after vendor fees and distribution. Null if entire amount goes to state.

attributes.name: federal_program_code
attributes.description: Federal program or funding source code associated with this fee for reporting purposes. Null if not federally related.

attributes.name: audit_frequency

attributes.name: cancellation_reason

attributes.name: cancellation_notes

attributes.name: rescheduled_from_appointment_id

attributes.name: booking_channel

attributes.name: wait_time_minutes

attributes.name: service_duration_minutes

attributes.name: service_window_number

attributes.name: staff_employee_id

attributes.name: service_outcome

attributes.name: service_outcome_notes

attributes.name: documents_verified_flag

attributes.name: payment_required_flag

attributes.name: payment_amount

attributes.name: payment_method

attributes.name: payment_id

attributes.name: test_type

attributes.name: test_result

attributes.name: test_score

attributes.name: cdl_class

attributes.name: cdl_endorsements

attributes.name: real_id_compliant_flag

attributes.name: interpreter_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether language interpretation services were requested or required for the appointment.

attributes.name: interpreter_language

attributes.name: accessibility_accommodation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether accessibility accommodations were requested or provided for the appointment under ADA requirements.

attributes.name: priority_service_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the appointment was designated for priority service (e.g., senior citizen, veteran, disability).

attributes.name: priority_service_reason

attributes.name: no_show_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the citizen failed to appear for their scheduled appointment.

attributes.name: late_arrival_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the citizen arrived late for their scheduled appointment time.

attributes.name: late_arrival_minutes
attributes.description: Number of minutes the citizen arrived late relative to their scheduled appointment time.

attributes.name: customer_satisfaction_score
attributes.description: Customer satisfaction rating provided by the citizen after the appointment on a scale of 1 to 5.

attributes.name: customer_feedback_comments
attributes.description: Free-text feedback comments provided by the citizen about their appointment experience.

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Special instructions or notes associated with the appointment for staff reference.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Source system from which the appointment record originated.

attributes.name: fee_id

products.name: office
products.description: Master record for each DMV office location, containing address, contact information, operating hours, and service capabilities.

attributes.name: office_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the DMV office location. Primary key for the office entity.

attributes.name: code

attributes.name: name

attributes.name: type

attributes.name: status

attributes.name: address_line_1

attributes.name: address_line_2

attributes.name: city

attributes.name: friday_open_time

attributes.name: friday_close_time
attributes.description: Time when the DMV office closes for business on Fridays, in 24-hour format (HH:MM). Value is 'closed' if office is not open on Fridays.

attributes.name: saturday_open_time
attributes.description: Time when the DMV office opens for business on Saturdays, in 24-hour format (HH:MM). Value is 'closed' if office is not open on Saturdays.

attributes.name: saturday_close_time
attributes.description: Time when the DMV office closes for business on Saturdays, in 24-hour format (HH:MM). Value is 'closed' if office is not open on Saturdays.

attributes.name: sunday_open_time
attributes.description: Time when the DMV office opens for business on Sundays, in 24-hour format (HH:MM). Value is 'closed' if office is not open on Sundays.

attributes.name: sunday_close_time
attributes.description: Time when the DMV office closes for business on Sundays, in 24-hour format (HH:MM). Value is 'closed' if office is not open on Sundays.

attributes.name: appointment_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether citizens must schedule an appointment to receive services at this DMV office, or if walk-in service is available.

attributes.name: walk_in_accepted_flag

attributes.name: online_check_in_available_flag
