attributes.name: driver_license_services_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this DMV office provides driver license services including new licenses, renewals, duplicates, and address changes.

attributes.name: cdl_services_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this DMV office provides Commercial Driver License services including CDL testing, issuance, and endorsements.

attributes.name: vehicle_registration_services_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this DMV office provides vehicle registration services including new registrations, renewals, and transfers.

attributes.name: vehicle_titling_services_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this DMV office provides vehicle titling services including title transfers, duplicate titles, and lien processing.

attributes.name: license_plate_services_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this DMV office provides license plate services including issuance, replacement, and specialty plate orders.

attributes.name: road_test_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this DMV office conducts on-road driving tests for driver license applicants.

attributes.name: written_test_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this DMV office administers written knowledge tests for driver license applicants.

attributes.name: vision_test_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this DMV office conducts vision screening tests for driver license applicants and renewals.

attributes.name: motorcycle_endorsement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this DMV office provides motorcycle endorsement services including testing and license endorsement.

attributes.name: real_id_services_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this DMV office can issue REAL ID compliant driver licenses and identification cards meeting federal standards.

attributes.name: identification_card_services_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this DMV office issues state identification cards for non-drivers.

attributes.name: handicap_placard_services_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this DMV office issues handicap parking placards and plates for eligible individuals.

attributes.name: ada_accessible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) Accessible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DMV office facility is fully accessible to individuals with disabilities, meeting ADA compliance standards.

attributes.name: parking_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether parking facilities are available at or near the DMV office location for customer use.

attributes.name: public_transit_accessible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DMV office is accessible via public transportation services.

attributes.name: service_window_count
attributes.description: Number of customer service windows or stations available at the DMV office for processing transactions.

attributes.name: staff_count
attributes.description: Total number of staff members assigned to the DMV office, including full-time and part-time employees.

attributes.name: average_wait_time_minutes
attributes.description: Average customer wait time in minutes at the DMV office, calculated from recent service metrics.

attributes.name: building_ownership_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DMV office facility is owned by the state, leased from a private landlord, shared with other agencies, or operated by a contractor.

attributes.name: square_footage
attributes.description: Total interior square footage of the DMV office facility.

attributes.name: lease_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the current lease agreement for the DMV office facility expires, if applicable. Used for lease management and renewal planning.

attributes.name: opened_date
attributes.description: Date when the DMV office first opened for business at its current location.

attributes.name: closed_date

attributes.name: last_renovation_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent major renovation or facility upgrade at the DMV office.

attributes.name: manager_email
attributes.description: Email address of the DMV office manager for official correspondence and escalations.

attributes.name: manager_phone
attributes.description: Direct phone number for the DMV office manager.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the NCDOT administrative region to which the DMV office belongs, used for regional management and reporting.

attributes.name: district_code

attributes.name: time_zone

attributes.name: special_services_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field describing any special services, programs, or capabilities unique to this DMV office that are not captured in standard service flags.

attributes.name: temporary_closure_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the DMV office is temporarily closed, if applicable. Examples include weather events, facility maintenance, or staffing shortages.

attributes.name: temporary_closure_start_date
attributes.description: Date when a temporary closure of the DMV office began.

attributes.name: temporary_closure_end_date
attributes.description: Expected or actual date when the DMV office will reopen or reopened after a temporary closure.

attributes.name: holiday_schedule_notes
attributes.description: Information about the DMV office schedule during state and federal holidays, including closures and modified hours.

attributes.name: language_services_available
attributes.description: List of languages in which the DMV office can provide services, either through bilingual staff or interpretation services.

attributes.name: payment_methods_accepted
attributes.description: List of payment methods accepted at the DMV office, such as cash, check, credit card, debit card, or electronic payment.

attributes.name: kiosk_count
attributes.description: Number of self-service kiosks available at the DMV office for automated transactions such as registration renewals.

attributes.name: photo_capture_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DMV office has equipment to capture driver license and identification card photos on-site.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the current office record information became effective. Used for tracking historical changes to office attributes.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the current office record information expires or is superseded by a new record. Null for current active records.

attributes.name: record_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system from which this office record was sourced, such as DB2 Mainframe, SharePoint, or Web Applications.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the office record was last updated in the source system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone.

attributes.name: location_feature_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gis.feature. Business justification: DMV offices are physical locations requiring precise geospatial representation for mapping, routing citizens to nearest office, and spatial analysis of service coverage areas.

attributes.name: manager_employee_id

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Each DMV office operates as a cost center for budget tracking, expense allocation, and performance reporting. Finance uses this for operational cost analysis and budget variance reporting by location.

products.name: license_type
products.description: Reference data defining the categories of driver licenses (e.g., Class A, B, C, CDL), including eligibility criteria and privileges.

attributes.name: license_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the license type record. Primary key for the license type reference data.

attributes.name: license_class_code
attributes.description: Standard classification code for the driver license type (e.g., A, B, C for commercial classes, or C for regular operator license). Aligns with federal CDL classifications.
attributes.references: 49 CFR Part 383 - Commercial Driver's License Standards

attributes.name: license_class_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the license class (e.g., Class A Commercial Driver License, Class C Operator License).

attributes.name: license_category
attributes.description: High-level category grouping for the license type, distinguishing between commercial, non-commercial, motorcycle, learner permits, provisional, and restricted licenses.

attributes.name: is_cdl
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this license type is a Commercial Driver License (CDL) requiring federal compliance and additional testing.
attributes.references: 49 CFR Part 383 - Commercial Driver's License Standards

attributes.name: minimum_age_years
attributes.description: Minimum age in years required for an applicant to be eligible for this license type. Varies by license class and endorsements.

attributes.name: maximum_age_years
attributes.description: Maximum age in years for eligibility or special requirements for this license type. Typically null unless age-based restrictions apply.

attributes.name: vehicle_weight_class_min_lbs
attributes.business_glossary_term: Minimum Vehicle Weight Class in Pounds
attributes.description: Minimum gross vehicle weight rating (GVWR) or gross combination weight rating (GCWR) in pounds that this license class authorizes the holder to operate.
attributes.references: 49 CFR Part 383 - Commercial Driver's License Standards

attributes.name: vehicle_weight_class_max_lbs
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Vehicle Weight Class in Pounds
attributes.description: Maximum gross vehicle weight rating (GVWR) or gross combination weight rating (GCWR) in pounds that this license class authorizes the holder to operate.
attributes.references: 49 CFR Part 383 - Commercial Driver's License Standards

attributes.name: passenger_capacity_min
attributes.description: Minimum number of passengers (including driver) that vehicles authorized under this license type may carry. Relevant for passenger endorsements.
attributes.references: 49 CFR Part 383 - Commercial Driver's License Standards

attributes.name: passenger_capacity_max
attributes.description: Maximum number of passengers (including driver) that vehicles authorized under this license type may carry. Relevant for passenger endorsements.
attributes.references: 49 CFR Part 383 - Commercial Driver's License Standards

attributes.name: authorized_vehicle_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of vehicle types that the license holder is authorized to operate (e.g., combination vehicles, single vehicles, motorcycles, passenger vehicles).

attributes.name: requires_endorsement
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this license type requires additional endorsements for specific vehicle types or cargo (e.g., hazmat, tanker, passenger, school bus).
attributes.references: 49 CFR Part 383 - Commercial Driver's License Standards

attributes.name: eligible_endorsements
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of endorsement codes that can be added to this license type (e.g., H for Hazmat, N for Tank Vehicle, P for Passenger, S for School Bus, T for Double/Triple Trailers).
attributes.references: 49 CFR Part 383 - Commercial Driver's License Standards

attributes.name: requires_medical_certification
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this license type requires a valid medical examiner's certificate (typically required for CDL holders).

attributes.name: medical_certification_class
attributes.description: Classification of medical certification required for CDL holders, distinguishing between interstate/intrastate and excepted/non-excepted operations.

attributes.name: knowledge_test_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a written knowledge test is required to obtain this license type.

attributes.name: skills_test_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a practical driving skills test is required to obtain this license type.

attributes.name: vision_test_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a vision screening test is required to obtain or renew this license type.

attributes.name: minimum_vision_acuity
attributes.description: Minimum visual acuity standard required for this license type (e.g., 20/40 in each eye, 20/70 in one eye with restrictions).

attributes.name: training_hours_required
attributes.description: Minimum number of training hours required before an applicant can test for this license type. Particularly relevant for CDL and learner permits.

attributes.name: supervised_driving_hours_required
attributes.description: Minimum number of supervised driving hours required for provisional or learner permit holders before advancing to this license type.

attributes.name: validity_period_years
attributes.description: Standard validity period in years for this license type before renewal is required. Typically ranges from 5 to 8 years for standard licenses.

attributes.name: renewal_grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after expiration during which the license can be renewed without additional testing or penalties.

attributes.name: application_fee_amount
attributes.description: Standard fee amount in US dollars charged for initial application for this license type.

attributes.name: renewal_fee_amount
attributes.description: Standard fee amount in US dollars charged for renewal of this license type.

attributes.name: duplicate_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee amount in US dollars charged for issuing a duplicate license due to loss, theft, or damage.

attributes.name: restriction_codes_allowed
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of restriction codes that may be applied to this license type (e.g., corrective lenses, daylight only, automatic transmission, hearing aid).

attributes.name: reciprocity_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this license type is eligible for reciprocity agreements with other states or jurisdictions.

attributes.name: real_id_compliant
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this license type meets federal REAL ID Act requirements for identification purposes.

attributes.name: hazmat_endorsement_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this license type is eligible for a hazardous materials (HAZMAT) endorsement, requiring TSA background check.
attributes.references: 49 CFR Part 383 - Commercial Driver's License Standards

attributes.name: tsa_background_check_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Transportation Security Administration (TSA) Background Check Required Indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a TSA security threat assessment is required for this license type (typically for HAZMAT endorsements).

attributes.name: out_of_state_transfer_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether holders of equivalent out-of-state licenses can transfer to this license type without retesting.

attributes.name: military_waiver_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether military personnel with equivalent military vehicle operation experience may receive waivers for certain testing requirements.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this license type in the DMV system. Active types are available for issuance; inactive or obsolete types are no longer issued but may still be valid for existing holders.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this license type became or will become effective and available for issuance in the DMV system.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this license type is no longer available for new issuance. Null if the license type remains active indefinitely.

attributes.name: federal_standard_code
attributes.description: Federal classification code for this license type as defined by FHWA or other federal transportation authorities for interstate reporting.
attributes.references: 49 CFR Part 383 - Commercial Driver's License Standards

attributes.name: state_specific_code
attributes.description: North Carolina-specific classification code for this license type used in internal DMV systems and state reporting.

attributes.name: aamva_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: American Association of Motor Vehicle Administrators (AAMVA) Code
attributes.description: Standardized license type code as defined by AAMVA for interstate data exchange and reciprocity purposes.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the license type, including privileges, restrictions, and typical use cases.

attributes.name: eligibility_criteria
attributes.description: Comprehensive description of eligibility requirements for obtaining this license type, including age, residency, training, and testing requirements.

attributes.name: disqualifying_offenses
attributes.description: Description of criminal offenses or traffic violations that disqualify an applicant from obtaining or maintaining this license type.

attributes.name: renewal_requirements
attributes.description: Description of requirements for renewing this license type, including any retesting, medical certification updates, or documentation needed.

attributes.name: upgrade_path
attributes.description: Description of the progression path from this license type to higher classes or endorsements, including prerequisites and testing requirements.

attributes.name: downgrade_path
attributes.description: Description of circumstances and procedures for downgrading from this license type to a lower class, typically due to medical conditions or voluntary surrender of privileges.

attributes.name: insurance_requirements
attributes.description: Description of minimum insurance coverage requirements for holders of this license type, particularly relevant for commercial licenses.

attributes.name: display_order
attributes.description: Numeric value used to control the display sequence of license types in user interfaces and reports, typically ordered by hierarchy or frequency of use.

attributes.name: is_provisional
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is a provisional license type with graduated licensing restrictions for new drivers.

attributes.name: provisional_restrictions
attributes.description: Description of restrictions applicable to provisional license holders, such as passenger limitations, nighttime driving restrictions, and supervision requirements.

attributes.name: international_driving_permit_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether holders of this license type are eligible to obtain an International Driving Permit for driving abroad.

attributes.name: sadls_system_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: State Automated Driver License System (SADLS) Code
attributes.description: Internal system code used in the State Automated Driver License System (SADLS) to identify this license type in the legacy mainframe database.

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: Date when this license type reference record was last modified in the system, used for change tracking and audit purposes.

products.name: vehicle_class

attributes.name: vehicle_id

attributes.name: class_category

attributes.name: fhwa_vehicle_type

attributes.name: weight_class

attributes.name: maximum_weight_lbs

attributes.name: requires_cdl

attributes.name: cdl_class_required
attributes.description: Specific CDL class required to operate vehicles in this classification (Class A, B, C, or none).

attributes.name: registration_fee_amount

attributes.name: title_fee_amount
attributes.description: Standard title fee amount in US dollars for vehicles in this classification.

products.name: crash_involvement
products.description: This association product represents the involvement of a driver in a crash event. It captures the specific role, fault determination, injury status, and citations for each driver involved in each crash. Each record links one driver to one crash_report with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific involvement.. Existence Justification: In NCDOT operations, a single crash event routinely involves multiple drivers (multi-vehicle collisions, witnesses, pedestrians), and individual drivers accumulate involvement in multiple crashes over their driving history. Law enforcement and safety investigators actively manage crash involvement records as operational entities, documenting each driver's specific role, fault determination, injury status, and citations issued at the scene. This is not an analytical correlation but an operational business process where crash investigators create, update, and query involvement records.

products.name: vehicle_crash_involvement
products.description: This association product represents the involvement of a specific vehicle in a specific crash event. It captures the operational details of each vehicle's participation in a crash, including the vehicle's role in the collision, damage assessment, towing status, and occupant count. Each record links one vehicle to one crash report with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific involvement.. Existence Justification: In North Carolina crash reporting operations, a single crash event routinely involves multiple vehicles (pile-ups, intersection collisions, multi-vehicle chain reactions), and any given vehicle can be involved in multiple separate crash events over its registration lifetime. NCDOT crash investigators actively create and manage vehicle involvement records as part of the crash investigation process, documenting each vehicle's specific role, damage level, and contributing factors for every crash.
