attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the impact this condition rating has on the structural load-carrying capacity of the bridge element.

attributes.name: public_safety_risk_level
attributes.description: Risk level to public safety associated with bridge elements at this condition rating, used for prioritization and resource allocation.

attributes.name: reporting_category
attributes.description: Simplified three-tier reporting category (Good, Fair, Poor) used for federal performance measure reporting and FHWA submissions.

attributes.name: map21_performance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Moving Ahead for Progress in the 21st Century Act (MAP-21) Performance Measure Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this condition rating is used in MAP-21 and subsequent federal transportation performance measure calculations.

attributes.name: display_color_code
attributes.description: Hexadecimal color code used for visual representation of this condition rating in maps, dashboards, and reports.

attributes.name: display_order
attributes.description: Numeric value controlling the sort order for displaying condition ratings in user interfaces and reports.

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this condition rating code is currently active and available for use in bridge inspections.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this condition rating code became effective and available for use in the bridge management system.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this condition rating code was retired or superseded, null if currently active.

attributes.name: superseded_by_rating_code
attributes.description: The condition rating code that replaced this code if it has been superseded or retired.

attributes.name: usage_notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, guidelines, or instructions for bridge inspectors on proper application and interpretation of this condition rating code.

attributes.name: inspector_guidance
attributes.description: Detailed field guidance for bridge inspectors describing observable conditions and criteria for assigning this rating during inspections.

attributes.name: photographic_example_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL to photographic examples illustrating typical conditions associated with this rating code.

attributes.name: regulatory_citation
attributes.description: Specific citation to federal or state regulations, standards, or guidance documents that define or govern the use of this condition rating.

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: Date when this condition rating record was last updated or modified in the system.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the condition rating definition, incremented when rating criteria or descriptions are updated.

attributes.name: condition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.condition. Business justification: Bridge condition ratings map to standardized asset condition classifications used across all NCDOT infrastructure. This enables enterprise-wide condition reporting, capital planning, and compliance wi

attributes.name: safety_inspection_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.safety_inspection. Business justification: Bridge condition ratings are determined during safety inspections. Each rating must reference the specific inspection that produced it for audit trail and regulatory compliance (FHWA requirements).

attributes.name: rated_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Condition ratings must be assigned by qualified bridge engineers. NCDOT tracks who performed the rating for professional liability, audit trails, and quality assurance purposes.

products.name: inspection_type
products.description: Lookup table defining types of bridge inspections (e.g., routine, special, post‑event, underwater) used to classify inspection records.

attributes.name: inspection_type_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the bridge inspection type. Primary key for the inspection type lookup table.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the inspection type (e.g., ROUTINE, SPECIAL, FRACTURE, UNDERWATER, DAMAGE). Used for system integration and reporting.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the inspection type (e.g., Routine Inspection, Special Inspection, Fracture Critical Member Inspection, Underwater Inspection, Damage Inspection, In-Depth Inspection).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the inspection type, including its purpose, scope, and when it should be performed according to NBIS standards and NCDOT policies.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: High-level category classifying the inspection type by scheduling nature: scheduled (routine, periodic), unscheduled (damage, post-event), special (fracture critical, underwater), regulatory (compliance-driven), or emergency (immediate response).

attributes.name: nbis_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Bridge Inspection Standards (NBIS) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inspection type is mandated by federal NBIS regulations (23 CFR 650). True for routine, fracture critical, and underwater inspections; false for optional or state-specific inspection types.

attributes.name: frequency_months
attributes.description: Standard inspection frequency interval in months as defined by NBIS or NCDOT policy. For example, routine inspections are typically 24 months, fracture critical inspections may be 24 months, and underwater inspections may be 60 months.

attributes.name: minimum_frequency_months
attributes.description: Minimum allowable frequency interval in months for this inspection type, representing the most frequent inspection cycle permitted under NBIS or NCDOT standards.

attributes.name: maximum_frequency_months
attributes.description: Maximum allowable frequency interval in months for this inspection type, representing the longest permissible time between inspections under NBIS or NCDOT standards before non-compliance occurs.

attributes.name: trigger_event
attributes.description: Specific event or condition that triggers this inspection type (e.g., hurricane, flood, earthquake, vehicle impact, fire, structural damage report, routine schedule). Applicable primarily to unscheduled and emergency inspection types.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Defines the extent of the bridge structure covered by this inspection type: full structure (entire bridge), partial structure (selected spans or sections), specific component (deck, superstructure, substructure), underwater only (submerged elements), or fracture critical only (FCM members).

attributes.name: inspection_level
attributes.description: Inspection depth level as defined by AASHTO Manual for Bridge Evaluation: Level 1 (visual), Level 2 (detailed visual with access), Level 3 (highly detailed with NDE), Level 4 (laboratory testing).

attributes.name: access_requirements
attributes.description: Description of special access equipment or methods required to perform this inspection type (e.g., snooper truck, ladder, boat, diving equipment, rope access, traffic control, lane closure).

attributes.name: special_equipment_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether specialized equipment beyond standard inspection tools is required for this inspection type (e.g., underwater diving gear, ultrasonic testing equipment, snooper trucks, drones).

attributes.name: qualified_inspector_level
attributes.description: Minimum qualification level required for inspectors performing this inspection type, as defined by NBIS and NCDOT certification standards (e.g., team leader, bridge inspector, fracture critical inspector, underwater inspector, NDE technician).

attributes.name: certification_required
attributes.description: Specific certifications or training required for inspectors to perform this inspection type (e.g., NBIS Bridge Inspector Certification, Fracture Critical Inspector Training, Underwater Bridge Inspection Certification, NDE Level II Certification).

attributes.name: estimated_duration_hours
attributes.description: Typical estimated duration in hours to complete this inspection type for an average bridge structure. Used for resource planning and scheduling.

attributes.name: team_size_minimum
attributes.description: Minimum number of qualified personnel required to safely and effectively perform this inspection type, as defined by NBIS safety standards and NCDOT policy.

attributes.name: traffic_control_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether traffic control measures (lane closures, flaggers, work zone setup) are typically required to perform this inspection type safely.

attributes.name: reporting_format
attributes.description: Standard reporting format or template required for documenting results of this inspection type (e.g., NBI format for routine inspections, detailed narrative report for special inspections, NDE report for non-destructive evaluation).

attributes.name: nbi_submission_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Bridge Inventory (NBI) Submission Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether results from this inspection type must be submitted to the National Bridge Inventory database maintained by FHWA.

attributes.name: bms_integration_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether inspection results from this type are integrated into the NCDOT Bridge Management System for condition assessment, prioritization, and lifecycle planning.

attributes.name: cost_estimate_low
attributes.description: Lower bound of typical cost range in USD to perform this inspection type for an average bridge structure. Used for budgeting and resource allocation.

attributes.name: cost_estimate_high
attributes.description: Upper bound of typical cost range in USD to perform this inspection type for an average bridge structure. Used for budgeting and resource allocation.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification for scheduling and resource allocation: critical (immediate safety concern), high (regulatory deadline), medium (standard schedule), low (optional or deferred).

attributes.name: weather_dependent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inspection type is significantly dependent on favorable weather conditions (e.g., underwater inspections require calm water, detailed visual inspections require good visibility).

attributes.name: seasonal_restrictions
attributes.description: Description of any seasonal restrictions or preferred timing for this inspection type (e.g., underwater inspections best performed in summer, avoid winter for detailed inspections due to ice, environmental restrictions during nesting season).

attributes.name: safety_risk_level
attributes.description: Assessment of inherent safety risk to inspection personnel performing this inspection type: extreme (underwater, high elevation rope access), high (under-bridge access, confined spaces), moderate (traffic exposure), low (visual from ground).

attributes.name: permit_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether special permits are required to perform this inspection type (e.g., waterway work permits for underwater inspections, traffic control permits for lane closures, environmental permits for work in sensitive areas).

attributes.name: environmental_considerations
attributes.description: Description of environmental factors or restrictions that must be considered when performing this inspection type (e.g., protected species nesting periods, water quality concerns, noise restrictions, vegetation clearing limitations).

attributes.name: applicable_bridge_types
attributes.description: Types of bridge structures for which this inspection type is applicable or required (e.g., all bridges, fracture critical bridges only, movable bridges, suspension bridges, truss bridges, bridges over water).

attributes.name: applicable_material_types
attributes.description: Bridge construction material types for which this inspection type is applicable (e.g., steel, concrete, timber, composite). Some inspection types are material-specific (e.g., fracture critical inspections primarily for steel structures).

attributes.name: condition_rating_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether results from this inspection type directly impact the official NBI condition ratings (deck rating, superstructure rating, substructure rating, culvert rating).

attributes.name: load_rating_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether findings from this inspection type may trigger a load rating analysis or update to the bridge operating and inventory ratings.

attributes.name: closure_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inspection type has potential to identify conditions that could result in immediate bridge closure or load posting (typically true for damage inspections, special inspections, and fracture critical inspections).

attributes.name: follow_up_inspection_type
attributes.description: Type of follow-up inspection typically required or recommended based on findings from this inspection type (e.g., routine inspection may trigger special inspection, damage inspection may trigger in-depth inspection).

attributes.name: documentation_requirements
attributes.description: Specific documentation requirements for this inspection type beyond standard reporting (e.g., photographic documentation of all members, sketches of damage locations, NDE test results, underwater video footage, drone imagery).

attributes.name: photo_documentation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether photographic documentation is mandatory for this inspection type as part of the inspection record.

attributes.name: video_documentation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether video documentation is required for this inspection type (typically true for underwater inspections and some special inspections).

attributes.name: nde_methods_applicable
attributes.description: List of non-destructive evaluation methods that may be employed during this inspection type (e.g., ultrasonic testing, magnetic particle testing, dye penetrant testing, ground penetrating radar, acoustic emission testing).

attributes.name: quality_assurance_level
attributes.description: Level of quality assurance review required for inspection reports of this type: Level 1 (peer review), Level 2 (supervisory review), Level 3 (independent QA team review). Higher risk inspection types require higher QA levels.

attributes.name: review_approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether inspection reports of this type require formal review and approval by a qualified team leader or program manager before finalization.

attributes.name: fhwa_notification_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Highway Administration (FHWA) Notification Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether FHWA must be notified of inspection findings from this type (typically true for critical findings, bridge closures, or significant structural deficiencies).

attributes.name: public_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether public notification is required when this inspection type is performed or when certain findings are identified (e.g., lane closures, bridge closures, load restrictions).

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inspection type is currently active and available for use in inspection scheduling and planning. Inactive types are retained for historical reference but not used for new inspections.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this inspection type definition became effective and available for use in NCDOT bridge inspection program.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this inspection type definition was retired or superseded. Null if currently active.

attributes.name: superseded_by_inspection_type
attributes.description: Code or name of the inspection type that replaced this inspection type, if applicable. Used to track evolution of inspection standards and practices.

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: Primary regulatory authority or standard that defines or mandates this inspection type (e.g., FHWA NBIS, AASHTO Manual for Bridge Evaluation, NCDOT Bridge Inspection Manual, State Statute).

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: Date when this inspection type definition was last reviewed or updated in the system.

products.name: cost_item
products.description: Reference table of cost item codes used in budgeting and expense tracking for bridge projects, such as materials, labor, equipment, and indirect costs.
products.reference: Standard Cost Coding for Bridge Projects (CIP Cost Codes)

attributes.name: cost_item_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cost item code used in bridge project budgeting and expense tracking.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code representing the cost item in the financial system, used for budget classification and expense tracking.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the cost item as it appears in financial reports and budget documents.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the cost item, including its purpose, scope, and typical usage in bridge projects.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the cost item into major expense categories for bridge project budgeting.

attributes.name: subcategory
attributes.description: Secondary classification providing more granular categorization within the primary cost category.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit used to quantify and price the cost item in project estimates and invoices.

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Standard price per unit of measure for the cost item, used as baseline for project budgeting and cost estimation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the unit price, typically USD for NCDOT projects.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost item code indicating whether it is available for use in new projects.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the cost item code and its associated unit price became effective for use in project budgeting.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the cost item code is scheduled to expire or be replaced, after which it should not be used for new projects.

attributes.name: federal_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether expenses charged to this cost item are eligible for federal reimbursement under FHWA or FTA programs.

attributes.name: federal_participation_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of costs eligible for federal reimbursement when this cost item is used on federally-funded bridge projects.

attributes.name: account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code in the financial system where expenses for this cost item are recorded.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Organizational cost center responsible for managing and tracking expenses associated with this cost item.

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Program classification code linking the cost item to specific transportation programs such as HSIP, CMAQ, or STP.

attributes.name: project_phase
attributes.description: Typical project phase where this cost item is most commonly applied, such as Preliminary Engineering (PE), Right-of-Way (ROW), or Construction.

attributes.name: work_breakdown_structure_code
attributes.description: Hierarchical code representing the position of this cost item within the project work breakdown structure for detailed cost tracking.

attributes.name: specification_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the technical specification or standard that defines the requirements and quality criteria for this cost item.

attributes.name: material_type
attributes.description: Specific type of material associated with this cost item, applicable when the category is materials.

attributes.name: labor_classification
attributes.description: Classification of labor type for this cost item, such as skilled, semi-skilled, or professional, applicable when category is labor.

attributes.name: equipment_type
attributes.description: Type of equipment or machinery associated with this cost item, applicable when the category is equipment.

attributes.name: prevailing_wage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost item is subject to prevailing wage requirements under the Davis-Bacon Act for federally-funded projects.

attributes.name: dbe_goal_applicable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Disadvantaged Business Enterprise (DBE) Goal Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost item is included in the calculation of Disadvantaged Business Enterprise (DBE) participation goals.

attributes.name: environmental_category
attributes.description: Classification of environmental-related costs when this cost item pertains to environmental compliance, mitigation, or remediation activities.

attributes.name: inflation_index_type
attributes.description: Type of inflation index used to adjust the unit price of this cost item over time for multi-year projects.

attributes.name: escalation_rate
attributes.description: Annual percentage rate used to escalate the unit price for future year cost estimates in long-range planning.

attributes.name: tax_exempt_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether purchases of this cost item are exempt from state or local sales tax due to government procurement status.

attributes.name: capitalization_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether expenses for this cost item should be capitalized as part of the bridge asset value rather than expensed immediately.

attributes.name: depreciation_category
attributes.description: Asset category for depreciation purposes when this cost item is capitalized as part of a bridge or structure asset.

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Expected useful life in years for assets purchased or constructed using this cost item, used for depreciation calculations.

attributes.name: minimum_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity that must be ordered or used for this cost item to qualify for the stated unit price.

attributes.name: maximum_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum quantity allowed per project or contract for this cost item, if applicable.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Typical number of days required from order to delivery for materials or equipment associated with this cost item.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether special approval is required before this cost item can be used in project budgets or purchase orders.

attributes.name: approval_authority_level
attributes.description: Organizational level required to approve the use of this cost item in project budgets when approval is required.

attributes.name: historical_usage_count
attributes.description: Number of times this cost item has been used in completed bridge projects, providing insight into its frequency of application.

attributes.name: last_used_date
attributes.description: Most recent date when this cost item was applied to a bridge project budget or expense transaction.

attributes.name: replacement_cost_item_code
attributes.description: Code of the cost item that should be used as a replacement when this cost item is deprecated or becomes inactive.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when this cost item code was originally created in the reference system.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date when this cost item record was last updated or modified in the reference system.

attributes.name: price_last_updated_date
attributes.description: Date when the unit price for this cost item was last reviewed and updated.

attributes.name: nbis_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Bridge Inspection Standards (NBIS) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost item is applicable to bridge inspection activities that must comply with National Bridge Inspection Standards (NBIS).

attributes.name: bms_category_code
attributes.description: Classification code used in the Bridge Management System (BMS) to categorize this cost item for bridge lifecycle cost analysis.

attributes.name: stip_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: State Transportation Improvement Program (STIP) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost item is eligible for inclusion in State Transportation Improvement Program (STIP) project budgets.

attributes.name: project_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_budget. Business justification: Bridge repair and maintenance cost items are charged against specific project budgets. Finance department tracks expenditures by linking cost items to budget line items for fiscal accountability and r

attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rightofway.parcel. Business justification: Bridge construction costs often include land acquisition expenses. When cost items relate to property acquisition for bridge projects, linking to the specific parcel enables accurate project accountin

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Bridge maintenance and construction costs must be allocated to specific cost centers for financial tracking and departmental budgeting. Finance department uses this for cost accounting and budget vari

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Every bridge expenditure (materials, labor, inspections) must post to a specific general ledger account for financial reporting and compliance. Accounting uses this for monthly close and audit trails.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fund. Business justification: Bridge projects are funded from specific federal, state, or bond funds with strict tracking requirements. Finance uses this to ensure expenditures match funding source restrictions and availability.

attributes.name: accounts_payable_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.accounts_payable_invoice. Business justification: Bridge cost items originate from contractor invoices for work performed. Accounts payable processes these invoices for payment after matching to cost items and purchase orders.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.contract. Business justification: Bridge maintenance and repair cost items are executed under specific procurement contracts. Project managers track which contract covers each cost item for budget reconciliation and payment processing

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Each bridge repair/maintenance cost item is performed by a specific vendor. Finance and project teams need vendor reference for payment processing, performance tracking, and warranty claims.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Bridge work cost items must reference the authorizing purchase order for procurement compliance, budget tracking, and accounts payable processing. Required for financial audit trail.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.invoice. Business justification: Cost items link to vendor invoices for payment verification and reconciliation. Accounts payable matches cost items against invoices to validate charges before payment authorization.

attributes.name: estimated_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Cost estimates for bridge maintenance and repairs must be prepared by qualified engineers or estimators. NCDOT tracks estimator accountability for budget planning and variance analysis.

products.name: inspection_record
products.description: This product represents the comprehensive record of bridge inspection events, capturing the execution of specific inspection types on bridges throughout the NCDOT inventory. Each record documents when an inspection occurred, who performed it, detailed condition ratings across all bridge components (deck, superstructure, substructure, channel, culvert), observed defects and their severity, recommended actions, and when the next inspection is due. In NCDOT bridge asset management operations, each bridge undergoes multiple types of inspections throughout its lifecycle (routine, fracture-critical, underwater, special, post-event), with each inspection event carrying specific data about findings, structural evaluations, load ratings, scour conditions, and compliance with National Bridge Inspection Standards (NBIS). This product serves as the single source of truth for all bridge inspection findings, condition assessments, and recommended maintenance actions.

attributes.name: inspection_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each bridge inspection event record. This serves as the primary key for the inspection_record product and uniquely identifies each inspection occurrence.

attributes.name: bridge_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the bridge that was inspected. Establishes the relationship between the inspection event and the specific bridge asset in the NCDOT inventory.

attributes.name: inspection_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the type of inspection performed (routine, fracture-critical, underwater, special, post-event). References the inspection_type product to classify the inspection category.

attributes.name: inspection_date
attributes.description: The date on which the bridge or structure inspection was performed. This is the actual field inspection date when the bridge was physically examined.

attributes.name: inspection_type
attributes.description: The type or category of inspection performed (e.g., routine, fracture-critical, underwater, special, in-depth, damage). This is the descriptive text representation of the inspection classification.

attributes.name: inspection_frequency_months
attributes.description: The required frequency of inspection in months based on bridge condition, type, and regulatory requirements. Determines the inspection cycle for the bridge.

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the next inspection must be completed based on regulatory requirements, bridge condition, and inspection frequency. Calculated or assigned date for scheduling future inspections.

attributes.name: inspector_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Identifier of the lead inspector or inspection team leader who performed the inspection. Links to the employee record for the responsible inspector.

attributes.name: inspector_certification_number
attributes.description: The certification or license number of the lead inspector who performed the inspection. Validates inspector qualifications and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: inspector_certification_expiration_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the inspector's certification or license. Used to ensure inspector qualifications are current at the time of inspection.

attributes.name: inspection_team_members
attributes.description: Names of additional team members who participated in the inspection. Documents the full inspection team composition for accountability and quality assurance purposes.

attributes.name: inspection_organization
attributes.description: The name of the organization or contractor that performed the inspection. Identifies whether the inspection was conducted by NCDOT staff or an external contractor.

attributes.name: weather_conditions
attributes.description: Description of weather conditions at the time of inspection (e.g., clear, cloudy, rain, fog). Weather can affect inspection visibility and findings.

attributes.name: temperature_fahrenheit
attributes.description: Ambient temperature in degrees Fahrenheit at the time of inspection. Temperature conditions can affect material behavior and inspection observations.

attributes.name: deck_condition_rating
attributes.description: NBIS condition rating for the bridge deck on a scale of 0-9, where 9 is excellent condition and 0 is failed condition. Assesses the condition of the bridge deck surface and structural integrity.

attributes.name: superstructure_condition_rating
attributes.description: NBIS condition rating for the bridge superstructure on a scale of 0-9. Evaluates the condition of the main load-carrying members above the substructure.

attributes.name: substructure_condition_rating
attributes.description: NBIS condition rating for the bridge substructure on a scale of 0-9. Assesses the condition of piers, abutments, and other supporting elements below the superstructure.

attributes.name: channel_condition_rating
attributes.description: NBIS condition rating for the channel and channel protection on a scale of 0-9. Evaluates the condition of the waterway channel and erosion protection measures.

attributes.name: culvert_condition_rating
attributes.description: NBIS condition rating for culverts on a scale of 0-9. Assesses the structural and functional condition of culvert structures.

attributes.name: overall_condition_rating
attributes.description: Overall NBIS condition rating for the structure, typically the lowest rating among deck, superstructure, and substructure. Provides a summary assessment of overall bridge condition.

attributes.name: structural_evaluation
attributes.description: Detailed narrative evaluation of the structural condition, including assessment of load-carrying capacity, structural integrity, and any concerns identified during inspection.

attributes.name: deck_geometry_rating
attributes.description: NBIS rating for deck geometry adequacy on a scale of 0-9. Evaluates whether the deck width, alignment, and geometry meet current standards.

attributes.name: underclearance_vertical_feet
attributes.description: Minimum vertical clearance under the bridge in feet. Critical for determining whether vehicles or vessels can safely pass under the structure.

attributes.name: underclearance_horizontal_feet
attributes.description: Minimum horizontal clearance under the bridge in feet. Measures the width available for traffic or waterway passage beneath the bridge.

attributes.name: waterway_adequacy_rating
attributes.description: NBIS rating for waterway adequacy on a scale of 0-9. Assesses whether the waterway opening is sufficient to pass expected flood flows without causing excessive backwater.

attributes.name: approach_roadway_alignment_rating
attributes.description: NBIS rating for approach roadway alignment on a scale of 0-9. Evaluates the adequacy of roadway alignment leading to and from the bridge.

attributes.name: scour_critical_indicator
attributes.description: Indicator of scour criticality: Y (scour critical), N (not scour critical), U (unknown), or T (scour critical with temporary monitoring). Identifies bridges at risk of foundation failure due to scour.

attributes.name: scour_condition_rating
attributes.description: Rating of scour condition at bridge foundations on a scale of 0-9. Assesses the current state of scour at piers and abutments.

attributes.name: scour_vulnerability_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of scour vulnerability, observed scour conditions, and any countermeasures in place. Documents scour risk assessment and mitigation measures.

attributes.name: fracture_critical_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bridge contains fracture critical members (FCM) that require special inspection. True if the bridge has tension members whose failure would cause collapse.

attributes.name: fracture_critical_details
attributes.description: Detailed description of fracture critical members, their location, condition, and any findings from hands-on inspection of FCM components.

attributes.name: underwater_inspection_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether an underwater inspection was performed as part of this inspection event. True if submerged portions of the bridge were inspected.

attributes.name: underwater_inspection_method
attributes.description: Method used for underwater inspection (e.g., diver inspection, remote operated vehicle, sonar). Documents the technique used to inspect submerged bridge components.

attributes.name: underwater_findings
attributes.description: Detailed findings from underwater inspection, including condition of submerged piers, footings, scour conditions, and debris accumulation below the waterline.

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current posting status of the bridge based on load capacity analysis: open (no restrictions), posted (weight restrictions), or closed. Indicates whether load restrictions are in effect.

attributes.name: posted_load_limit_tons
attributes.description: Maximum vehicle weight limit in tons if the bridge is posted for load restrictions. Specifies the maximum safe vehicle weight allowed on the bridge.

attributes.name: operating_rating_tons
attributes.description: Maximum permissible live load to which the structure may be subjected for routine use. Represents the load level for normal traffic conditions.

attributes.name: inventory_rating_tons
attributes.description: Load level that can be safely supported for an indefinite period of time. Represents the load capacity for long-term structural integrity.

attributes.name: defect_code_primary
attributes.description: Primary defect code identifying the most significant defect observed during inspection. Uses standardized defect coding system for classification.

attributes.name: defect_code_secondary
attributes.description: Secondary defect code identifying additional significant defects observed during inspection. Captures the second most critical defect.

attributes.name: defect_location_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the location of observed defects on the bridge structure, including span number, member identification, and specific location details.

attributes.name: defect_severity
attributes.description: Severity classification of the primary defect: minor, moderate, severe, or critical. Indicates the urgency and impact of the identified defect.

attributes.name: defect_extent_description
attributes.description: Description of the extent or spread of the defect across the structure, including measurements, affected area, and progression since previous inspection.

attributes.name: corrosion_observed_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether corrosion was observed during the inspection on steel or reinforced concrete elements. True if corrosion is present.

attributes.name: corrosion_severity
attributes.description: Severity of observed corrosion: none, light, moderate, severe, or critical. Classifies the extent and impact of corrosion on structural members.

attributes.name: cracking_observed_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether cracking was observed in structural members during the inspection. True if cracks are present in concrete or steel components.

attributes.name: cracking_type
attributes.description: Type of cracking observed: flexural, shear, fatigue, thermal, shrinkage, or other. Classifies the crack type to determine cause and structural significance.

attributes.name: spalling_observed_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether concrete spalling was observed during the inspection. True if concrete surface deterioration with loss of material is present.

attributes.name: delamination_observed_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether concrete delamination was observed during the inspection. True if separation of concrete layers is detected.

attributes.name: settlement_observed_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether foundation or approach settlement was observed during the inspection. True if vertical displacement of foundations or approaches is detected.

attributes.name: settlement_measurement_inches
attributes.description: Measured settlement in inches, if applicable. Quantifies the amount of vertical displacement observed at foundations or approaches.

attributes.name: alignment_deviation_observed_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether structural alignment deviation was observed during the inspection. True if horizontal or vertical misalignment is detected.

attributes.name: debris_accumulation_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether debris accumulation was observed at the bridge, particularly at piers or in the waterway. True if debris is present.

attributes.name: debris_description
attributes.description: Description of debris accumulation, including location, type of debris, and potential impact on bridge hydraulics or structural integrity.

attributes.name: vegetation_growth_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether vegetation growth was observed on the bridge structure or approaches. True if vegetation is present that may affect drainage or structural integrity.

attributes.name: paint_coating_condition
attributes.description: Condition of protective paint or coating on steel members: excellent, good, fair, poor, or failed. Assesses the effectiveness of corrosion protection systems.

attributes.name: bearing_condition_rating
attributes.description: Condition rating for bridge bearings on a scale of 0-9. Evaluates the condition and functionality of bearing assemblies that support the superstructure.

attributes.name: expansion_joint_condition_rating
attributes.description: Condition rating for expansion joints on a scale of 0-9. Assesses the condition of joints that accommodate bridge movement due to temperature and loading.

attributes.name: railing_condition_rating
attributes.description: Condition rating for bridge railings on a scale of 0-9. Evaluates the condition and safety adequacy of bridge railings and barriers.

attributes.name: lighting_condition_rating
attributes.description: Condition rating for bridge lighting systems on a scale of 0-9. Assesses the condition and functionality of bridge lighting infrastructure.

attributes.name: drainage_condition_rating
attributes.description: Condition rating for bridge drainage systems on a scale of 0-9. Evaluates the condition and effectiveness of deck drainage and scupper systems.

attributes.name: recommended_action
attributes.description: Primary recommended action based on inspection findings: monitor, repair, rehabilitate, replace, or close. Specifies the recommended response to inspection findings.

attributes.name: recommended_action_priority
attributes.description: Priority level for the recommended action: low, medium, high, or critical. Indicates the urgency of implementing the recommended action.

attributes.name: recommended_action_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the recommended action, including scope of work, specific repairs needed, and justification based on inspection findings.

attributes.name: estimated_repair_cost
attributes.description: Estimated cost in dollars for recommended repairs or actions. Provides preliminary cost estimate for budgeting and prioritization purposes.

attributes.name: safety_concern_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether immediate safety concerns were identified during the inspection. True if conditions pose an immediate risk to public safety.

attributes.name: safety_concern_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of any immediate safety concerns identified during inspection, including nature of the hazard and recommended immediate actions.

attributes.name: emergency_notification_required_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether emergency notification to management or regulatory authorities is required based on critical findings. True if immediate escalation is needed.

attributes.name: load_restriction_recommended_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether load restrictions are recommended based on inspection findings and structural capacity analysis. True if posting is recommended.

attributes.name: closure_recommended_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether bridge closure is recommended based on critical structural deficiencies or safety concerns. True if closure is recommended.

attributes.name: inspection_notes
attributes.description: General notes and observations from the inspection that do not fit into other structured fields. Captures additional context and inspector observations.

attributes.name: findings_summary
attributes.description: Textual summary of key findings, deficiencies, or notable observations from the inspection. Provides an executive summary of inspection results.

attributes.name: photo_documentation_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether photographic documentation was captured during the inspection. True if photos were taken to document conditions.

attributes.name: photo_count
attributes.description: Number of photographs taken and associated with the inspection record. Quantifies the extent of photographic documentation.

attributes.name: inspection_report_number
attributes.description: Unique report number or document identifier for the formal inspection report. Links the database record to the official inspection report document.

attributes.name: inspection_report_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal inspection report was completed and finalized. May differ from the inspection date if report preparation takes time.

attributes.name: inspection_duration_hours
attributes.description: Total duration of the inspection in hours, from start to completion of field work. Used for resource planning and cost tracking.

attributes.name: inspection_method
attributes.description: Primary method used to conduct the inspection (e.g., visual, hands-on, instrumented, remote). Documents the inspection approach and techniques employed.

attributes.name: equipment_used
attributes.description: Description of specialized equipment used during the inspection (e.g., snooper truck, drone, ultrasonic testing equipment). Documents inspection tools and technology.

attributes.name: traffic_control_required_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether traffic control measures were required to safely conduct the inspection. True if lane closures or traffic management was needed.

attributes.name: traffic_control_type
attributes.description: Type of traffic control implemented during the inspection (e.g., lane closure, full closure, flagging, temporary signals). Documents traffic management approach.

attributes.name: inspection_compliance_status
attributes.description: Compliance status of the inspection relative to regulatory requirements and scheduled due dates: compliant, overdue, or early. Tracks adherence to inspection schedules.

attributes.name: previous_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the previous inspection for comparison and trend analysis. Enables tracking of condition changes over time.

attributes.name: condition_change_since_last_inspection
attributes.description: Assessment of condition change since the previous inspection: improved, unchanged, deteriorated, or significantly deteriorated. Tracks condition trends.

attributes.name: bms_data_entry_date
attributes.description: Date on which inspection data was entered into the Bridge Management System (BMS). Tracks data processing timeliness.

attributes.name: qa_review_required_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether quality assurance review of the inspection is required based on bridge criticality or inspection findings. True if QA review is needed.

attributes.name: qa_reviewer_name
attributes.description: Name of the quality assurance reviewer who reviewed the inspection report and findings. Documents QA accountability.

attributes.name: qa_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the quality assurance review was completed. Tracks QA process timeline.

attributes.name: qa_review_status
attributes.description: Status of the quality assurance review: approved, approved with comments, rejected, or pending revision. Indicates QA outcome.

attributes.name: qa_review_comments
attributes.description: Comments from the quality assurance reviewer regarding inspection quality, findings, or required corrections. Documents QA feedback.

attributes.name: nbi_submittal_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inspection data was submitted to the National Bridge Inventory (NBI) database. True if data was reported to FHWA.

attributes.name: nbi_submittal_date
attributes.description: Date on which inspection data was submitted to the National Bridge Inventory. Tracks federal reporting compliance.

attributes.name: federal_aid_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether repairs or actions recommended from this inspection are eligible for federal aid funding. True if federal funding may be available.

attributes.name: inspection_status
attributes.description: Current status of the inspection record: scheduled, in progress, completed, under review, or finalized. Tracks inspection workflow status.

attributes.name: feature_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gis.feature. Business justification: Links the inspection record to the geographic feature representation of the bridge for spatial analysis and mapping.

domains.name: traffic
domains.description: Traffic management and operations including signal systems, ITS infrastructure, ATMS, TMC operations, incident management (IMAP), and traffic control devices per MUTCD standards. Manages AADT, VMT, LOS metrics and traffic flow analytics.

products.name: signal
products.description: Master record for each traffic signal controller, covering location, hardware model, firmware version, and installed timing plans.

attributes.name: signal_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the traffic signal controller. Primary key for the signal master record.

attributes.name: controller_serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned serial number for the traffic signal controller hardware unit.

attributes.name: controller_model
attributes.description: Model designation of the traffic signal controller hardware (e.g., Econolite ASC/3, McCain ATC, Siemens M50).

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the company that manufactured the traffic signal controller hardware.

attributes.name: firmware_version
attributes.description: Current firmware version installed on the traffic signal controller, controlling operational logic and communication protocols.

attributes.name: firmware_update_date
attributes.description: Date when the controller firmware was last updated or installed.

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date when the traffic signal controller was originally installed at the intersection.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the traffic signal controller indicating whether it is functioning normally, in flash mode, dark (non-operational), under maintenance, failed, or in testing mode.

attributes.name: communication_status
attributes.description: Status of the communication link between the traffic signal controller and the Traffic Management Center (TMC) or Advanced Traffic Management System (ATMS).

attributes.name: communication_protocol
attributes.description: Network communication protocol used by the controller for data exchange with central systems (e.g., NTCIP, SNMP, Modbus).

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address assigned to the traffic signal controller for network communication with the ATMS or TMC.

attributes.name: mac_address
attributes.description: Hardware MAC address of the network interface on the traffic signal controller.

attributes.name: intersection_name
attributes.description: Common name or description of the intersection where the traffic signal is located (e.g., 'Main St at Elm Ave').

attributes.name: route_number
attributes.description: Primary route or highway number where the traffic signal is located (e.g., US-1, NC-54, I-40).
attributes.references: FHWA Route Numbering, NCDOT Highway System

attributes.name: cross_street_name
attributes.description: Name of the intersecting cross street at the signalized intersection.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the traffic signal controller location in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the traffic signal controller location in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: county_name
attributes.description: North Carolina county where the traffic signal is located.

attributes.name: municipality_name
attributes.description: City or town jurisdiction where the traffic signal is located.

attributes.name: division_number
attributes.description: NCDOT Division of Highways regional division number responsible for the traffic signal (1-14).

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Entity that owns and is responsible for the traffic signal infrastructure (NCDOT, municipal government, private entity, or other).

attributes.name: maintenance_responsibility
attributes.description: Entity responsible for performing maintenance on the traffic signal (NCDOT, municipal government, contracted vendor, or other).

attributes.name: timing_plan_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct timing plans programmed and available in the traffic signal controller for different traffic conditions (e.g., AM peak, PM peak, off-peak, weekend).

attributes.name: active_timing_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the timing plan currently active and controlling the signal phasing and intervals.

attributes.name: cycle_length_seconds
attributes.description: Total time in seconds for one complete cycle of all signal phases in the currently active timing plan.

attributes.name: coordination_pattern_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the coordination pattern used when the signal operates in coordinated mode with other signals along a corridor.

attributes.name: offset_seconds
attributes.description: Time offset in seconds from the system reference point used to coordinate signal timing with adjacent intersections for progressive traffic flow.

attributes.name: phase_count
attributes.description: Total number of signal phases configured in the controller (typically 2-8 phases depending on intersection complexity).

attributes.name: pedestrian_phases_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether pedestrian signal phases and walk intervals are configured and active at this intersection.

attributes.name: aps_installed
attributes.description: Indicates whether Accessible Pedestrian Signals (audible and tactile devices) are installed to assist visually impaired pedestrians.

attributes.name: preemption_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether emergency vehicle preemption or railroad preemption is enabled, allowing priority signal control for emergency vehicles or trains.

attributes.name: preemption_type
attributes.description: Type of preemption configured: none, emergency vehicle preemption (EVP), railroad preemption (RRP), or both.

attributes.name: transit_priority_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether Transit Signal Priority is enabled to provide preferential signal timing for public transit vehicles.

attributes.name: detection_type
attributes.description: Type of vehicle detection technology used at the intersection (e.g., inductive loop, video detection, radar, microwave, or multiple technologies).

attributes.name: detection_zone_count
attributes.description: Number of vehicle detection zones configured at the intersection for actuated signal control.

attributes.name: cabinet_type
attributes.description: Type or model of the traffic signal cabinet housing the controller and associated equipment (e.g., NEMA TS-1, TS-2, Type 170, Type 2070).

attributes.name: cabinet_serial_number
attributes.description: Serial number of the traffic signal cabinet housing the controller equipment.

attributes.name: power_source_type
attributes.description: Primary power source for the traffic signal controller (utility power, solar, battery backup, uninterruptible power supply, or hybrid).

attributes.name: ups_installed
attributes.description: Indicates whether an uninterruptible power supply (UPS) or battery backup system is installed to maintain signal operation during power outages.

attributes.name: conflict_monitor_model
attributes.description: Model designation of the conflict monitor unit that detects unsafe signal display conflicts and places the signal in flash mode if conflicts occur.

attributes.name: malfunction_management_unit_installed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Malfunction Management Unit is installed to monitor controller operation and log faults.

attributes.name: atms_integration_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advanced Traffic Management System (ATMS) Integration Enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the signal controller is integrated with the NCDOT Advanced Traffic Management System for centralized monitoring and control.

attributes.name: tmc_monitored
attributes.description: Indicates whether the signal controller is actively monitored by the NCDOT Traffic Management Center.

attributes.name: video_detection_camera_count
attributes.description: Number of video detection cameras installed at the intersection for vehicle detection and traffic monitoring.

attributes.name: cctv_camera_installed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a CCTV camera is installed at the intersection for traffic monitoring and incident detection by the TMC.

attributes.name: head_count
attributes.description: Total number of signal heads (traffic signal displays) installed at the intersection.

attributes.name: led_conversion_complete
attributes.description: Indicates whether all signal heads at the intersection have been converted from incandescent to LED technology.

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the manufacturer warranty for the traffic signal controller hardware expires.

attributes.name: asset_condition_rating
attributes.description: Overall condition assessment of the traffic signal controller and associated equipment based on inspection and maintenance records.

attributes.name: replacement_priority_score
attributes.description: Calculated priority score for controller replacement based on age, condition, technology obsolescence, and operational criticality.

attributes.name: annual_average_daily_traffic
attributes.description: Annual Average Daily Traffic volume passing through the signalized intersection, used for capacity analysis and signal timing optimization.

attributes.name: functional_classification
attributes.description: FHWA functional classification of the primary roadway at the signalized intersection.

attributes.name: nhs_designation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the intersection is located on a roadway designated as part of the National Highway System.

attributes.name: crash_history_3yr_count
attributes.description: Total number of reported traffic crashes at the intersection over the most recent 3-year period.
attributes.references: NCDOT Safety and Incident Management, HSIP

attributes.name: hsip_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the intersection qualifies for Highway Safety Improvement Program funding based on crash history and safety analysis.

attributes.name: last_timing_study_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent traffic signal timing study was conducted to optimize signal operations.

attributes.name: next_timing_study_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next traffic signal timing study based on NCDOT policy and operational changes.

attributes.name: project_number
attributes.description: NCDOT project number associated with the installation or most recent upgrade of the traffic signal.

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Primary funding source for the traffic signal installation or upgrade (e.g., HSIP, CMAQ, STP, State funds, Municipal funds).

attributes.name: installation_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost in US dollars for the installation of the traffic signal controller and associated infrastructure.

attributes.name: annual_maintenance_cost_amount
attributes.description: Estimated or actual annual maintenance cost in US dollars for the traffic signal controller and equipment.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special considerations regarding the traffic signal controller.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the signal controller record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the signal controller record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project. Business justification: Traffic signals are installed/upgraded through capital projects. NCDOT tracks which project installed or modified each signal for asset management, warranty, and maintenance planning purposes.

attributes.name: grade_crossing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rail.grade_crossing. Business justification: Traffic signals at highway-rail grade crossings must reference the specific crossing for coordinated safety operations. Traffic operations teams use this daily to manage signal preemption when trains

attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rightofway.parcel. Business justification: Traffic signals are installed on specific parcels requiring right-of-way documentation for maintenance access, utility coordination, and legal compliance. Asset management and field crews reference th

attributes.name: maintained_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Traffic signals require assigned maintenance personnel for routine inspections, repairs, and emergency response. Operations teams track which technician is responsible for each signal asset.

attributes.name: maintenance_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.contract. Business justification: Traffic signals require ongoing maintenance contracts with vendors. NCDOT traffic operations references active maintenance contracts daily for service scheduling, warranty claims, and vendor accountab

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Traffic signals are capital assets with ongoing maintenance and operational costs. Finance tracks expenses by cost center for budgeting, variance analysis, and departmental accountability across signa

attributes.name: corridor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to planning.corridor. Business justification: Traffic signals are physically located within transportation corridors. Planning teams use corridor assignments to analyze signal coordination, timing optimization, and corridor-level traffic manageme

attributes.name: atms_system_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to traffic.atms_system. Business justification: Traffic signals are monitored and controlled by ATMS (Advanced Traffic Management System) systems. This FK links signals to their controlling ATMS system for centralized traffic management and TMC ope

products.name: signal_timing_plan
products.description: Definition of a signal timing plan (phasing, cycle length, offsets, coordination) that can be applied to a signal controller.

attributes.name: signal_timing_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the signal timing plan record.

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name or label for the signal timing plan (e.g., AM Peak, PM Peak, Weekend, Free).

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Numeric identifier or code assigned to the timing plan within the traffic signal controller or ATMS.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the timing plan based on operational mode (e.g., time of day, traffic responsive, manual override, coordination, free operation, preemption, transition).

attributes.name: cycle_length_seconds
attributes.description: Total duration of one complete signal cycle in seconds, representing the time from the beginning of one green phase to the beginning of the next identical green phase.

attributes.name: offset_seconds
attributes.description: Time offset in seconds used for signal coordination, representing the time relationship between the start of the local cycle and a system reference point to create green wave progression.

attributes.name: phase_sequence
attributes.description: Ordered sequence of signal phases within the timing plan, typically represented as a comma-separated list of phase numbers (e.g., 2,6,4,8).

attributes.name: phase_1_green_time_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of green signal display for phase 1 in seconds.

attributes.name: phase_1_yellow_time_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of yellow signal display for phase 1 in seconds, providing clearance interval.

attributes.name: phase_1_red_clearance_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of all-red clearance interval for phase 1 in seconds, providing additional safety time before conflicting movements begin.

attributes.name: phase_2_green_time_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of green signal display for phase 2 in seconds.

attributes.name: phase_2_yellow_time_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of yellow signal display for phase 2 in seconds, providing clearance interval.

attributes.name: phase_2_red_clearance_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of all-red clearance interval for phase 2 in seconds, providing additional safety time before conflicting movements begin.

attributes.name: phase_3_green_time_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of green signal display for phase 3 in seconds.

attributes.name: phase_3_yellow_time_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of yellow signal display for phase 3 in seconds, providing clearance interval.

attributes.name: phase_3_red_clearance_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of all-red clearance interval for phase 3 in seconds, providing additional safety time before conflicting movements begin.

attributes.name: phase_4_green_time_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of green signal display for phase 4 in seconds.

attributes.name: phase_4_yellow_time_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of yellow signal display for phase 4 in seconds, providing clearance interval.

attributes.name: phase_4_red_clearance_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of all-red clearance interval for phase 4 in seconds, providing additional safety time before conflicting movements begin.

attributes.name: phase_5_green_time_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of green signal display for phase 5 in seconds.

attributes.name: phase_5_yellow_time_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of yellow signal display for phase 5 in seconds, providing clearance interval.

attributes.name: phase_5_red_clearance_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of all-red clearance interval for phase 5 in seconds, providing additional safety time before conflicting movements begin.

attributes.name: phase_6_green_time_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of green signal display for phase 6 in seconds.

attributes.name: phase_6_yellow_time_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of yellow signal display for phase 6 in seconds, providing clearance interval.

attributes.name: phase_6_red_clearance_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of all-red clearance interval for phase 6 in seconds, providing additional safety time before conflicting movements begin.

attributes.name: phase_7_green_time_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of green signal display for phase 7 in seconds.

attributes.name: phase_7_yellow_time_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of yellow signal display for phase 7 in seconds, providing clearance interval.

attributes.name: phase_7_red_clearance_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of all-red clearance interval for phase 7 in seconds, providing additional safety time before conflicting movements begin.

attributes.name: phase_8_green_time_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of green signal display for phase 8 in seconds.

attributes.name: phase_8_yellow_time_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of yellow signal display for phase 8 in seconds, providing clearance interval.

attributes.name: phase_8_red_clearance_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of all-red clearance interval for phase 8 in seconds, providing additional safety time before conflicting movements begin.

attributes.name: pedestrian_walk_time_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of the WALK signal display for pedestrian crossings in seconds.

attributes.name: pedestrian_clearance_time_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of the flashing DON'T WALK or countdown signal for pedestrian clearance in seconds.

attributes.name: minimum_green_time_seconds
attributes.description: Minimum duration that a green signal must be displayed for actuated phases in seconds.

attributes.name: maximum_green_time_seconds
attributes.description: Maximum duration that a green signal can be displayed for actuated phases in seconds before forcing a phase change.

attributes.name: vehicle_extension_seconds
attributes.description: Time increment in seconds by which the green phase is extended when a vehicle is detected during actuated operation.

attributes.name: time_before_reduction_seconds
attributes.description: Duration in seconds before the controller begins reducing the green extension time in volume-density actuated control.

attributes.name: time_to_reduce_seconds
attributes.description: Rate at which the vehicle extension time is reduced in seconds during gap reduction in actuated control.

attributes.name: minimum_gap_seconds
attributes.description: Minimum allowable gap time in seconds between vehicles during gap reduction in actuated signal control.

attributes.name: split_percentage_phase_1
attributes.description: Percentage of the total cycle length allocated to phase 1 green time in coordinated operation.

attributes.name: split_percentage_phase_2
attributes.description: Percentage of the total cycle length allocated to phase 2 green time in coordinated operation.

attributes.name: split_percentage_phase_3
attributes.description: Percentage of the total cycle length allocated to phase 3 green time in coordinated operation.

attributes.name: split_percentage_phase_4
attributes.description: Percentage of the total cycle length allocated to phase 4 green time in coordinated operation.

attributes.name: split_percentage_phase_5
attributes.description: Percentage of the total cycle length allocated to phase 5 green time in coordinated operation.

attributes.name: split_percentage_phase_6
attributes.description: Percentage of the total cycle length allocated to phase 6 green time in coordinated operation.

attributes.name: split_percentage_phase_7
attributes.description: Percentage of the total cycle length allocated to phase 7 green time in coordinated operation.

attributes.name: split_percentage_phase_8
attributes.description: Percentage of the total cycle length allocated to phase 8 green time in coordinated operation.

attributes.name: preemption_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether emergency vehicle or railroad preemption is enabled for this timing plan.

attributes.name: priority_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether transit signal priority is enabled for this timing plan.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this signal timing plan becomes active and operational.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this signal timing plan is no longer active or is superseded by another plan.

attributes.name: time_of_day_start
attributes.description: Time of day when this timing plan becomes active in HH:MM format (e.g., 07:00 for AM peak).

attributes.name: time_of_day_end
attributes.description: Time of day when this timing plan becomes inactive in HH:MM format (e.g., 09:00 for end of AM peak).

attributes.name: day_of_week
attributes.description: Day(s) of the week when this timing plan is applicable (e.g., weekday, weekend, specific day).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the signal timing plan (active, inactive, draft, approved, archived, testing).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the signal timing plan was officially approved for implementation by traffic engineering authority.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the traffic engineer or authority who approved the timing plan.

attributes.name: design_speed_mph
attributes.business_glossary_term: Design Speed in Miles Per Hour
attributes.description: Design speed in miles per hour used for calculating signal timing parameters such as yellow and clearance intervals.

attributes.name: approach_grade_percent
attributes.description: Grade or slope of the roadway approach in percentage, used for calculating stopping sight distance and clearance times.

attributes.name: intersection_width_feet
attributes.description: Width of the intersection in feet, used for calculating clearance intervals and pedestrian crossing times.

attributes.name: pedestrian_crossing_distance_feet
attributes.description: Distance in feet that pedestrians must traverse during the crossing phase, used to calculate pedestrian clearance time.

attributes.name: pedestrian_walking_speed_fps
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pedestrian Walking Speed in Feet Per Second
attributes.description: Assumed pedestrian walking speed in feet per second used for calculating pedestrian clearance intervals (typically 3.5 fps).

attributes.name: coordination_reference_point
attributes.description: Reference point in the signal cycle used for coordination timing (e.g., beginning of green, end of green, beginning of yellow, master clock).

attributes.name: force_off_point_seconds
attributes.description: Point in the cycle in seconds at which the green phase is forced to terminate in coordinated operation.

attributes.name: permissive_period_seconds
attributes.description: Duration in seconds during which the phase can be skipped or shortened if there is no demand in coordinated-actuated operation.

attributes.name: atms_system_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advanced Traffic Management System (ATMS) System Identifier
attributes.description: Identifier of the ATMS system that manages and monitors this signal timing plan.

attributes.name: tmc_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or district of the TMC responsible for managing this signal timing plan.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the signal timing plan, incremented with each revision or update.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when the signal timing plan record was originally created in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date when the signal timing plan was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the user or system that last modified the timing plan.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the signal timing plan, including its purpose, operational context, and special considerations.

attributes.name: los_target
attributes.description: Target Level of Service (LOS) rating (A through F) that this timing plan is designed to achieve based on traffic flow and delay metrics.

attributes.name: design_volume_vph
attributes.business_glossary_term: Design Volume in Vehicles Per Hour
attributes.description: Design traffic volume in vehicles per hour that this timing plan is intended to accommodate.

attributes.name: peak_hour_factor
attributes.description: Peak hour factor (PHF) representing the ratio of total hourly volume to the peak 15-minute flow rate, used in capacity analysis.

attributes.name: controller_type
attributes.description: Type or model of the traffic signal controller that implements this timing plan (e.g., NEMA, Type 170, ATC, Econolite).

attributes.name: firmware_version
attributes.description: Firmware version of the signal controller for which this timing plan is configured.

attributes.name: special_event_flag
