products.description: Transactional record of toll collections: vehicle identifier, toll plaza, lane, amount, payment method, and collection timestamp. Also consolidates: highway.toll_transaction, traffic.toll_transaction.

attributes.name: toll_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each toll transaction record. Primary key for the toll transaction entity.

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the toll transaction was recorded at the collection point.

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: Calendar date of the toll transaction, used for daily reporting and reconciliation.

attributes.name: vehicle_identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vehicle that passed through the toll point. May be license plate, transponder ID, or other vehicle identification method.

attributes.name: license_plate_number
attributes.description: Vehicle license plate number captured by automated license plate recognition system or manual entry.

attributes.name: license_plate_state
attributes.description: State or jurisdiction that issued the vehicle license plate.

attributes.name: transponder_equipment_id
attributes.description: Electronic toll collection transponder identifier (e.g., NC Quick Pass, E-ZPass) used for automated toll payment.

attributes.name: transponder_agency
attributes.description: Agency or toll authority that issued the electronic toll collection transponder.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the toll plaza or toll collection point where the transaction occurred.

attributes.name: toll_plaza_name
attributes.description: Business name or location description of the toll plaza.

attributes.name: toll_lane_id
attributes.description: Specific lane identifier within the toll plaza where the vehicle passed through.

attributes.name: lane_type
attributes.description: Type of toll collection lane (electronic, manual, mixed mode, express, or high-occupancy vehicle).

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Highway or roadway route identifier where the toll was collected.

attributes.name: route_name
attributes.description: Common name or designation of the toll route or facility.

attributes.name: milepost
attributes.description: Milepost location on the route where the toll transaction occurred.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Direction of travel when the toll was collected.

attributes.name: vehicle_class
attributes.description: Vehicle classification code used for toll rate determination (e.g., Class 1-9 based on axle count and vehicle type).

attributes.name: axle_count
attributes.description: Number of axles detected on the vehicle, used for classification and toll calculation.

attributes.name: vehicle_weight
attributes.description: Gross vehicle weight in pounds captured by weigh-in-motion sensors, if available.

attributes.name: toll_amount
attributes.description: Base toll amount charged for the transaction before any adjustments, discounts, or fees.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Discount applied to the base toll amount (e.g., frequent user discount, off-peak discount).

attributes.name: surcharge_amount
attributes.description: Additional surcharge applied to the transaction (e.g., video toll surcharge, administrative fee).

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: Total amount charged for the toll transaction including base toll, discounts, and surcharges.

attributes.name: payment_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when payment was processed or received for the toll transaction.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Customer toll account identifier linked to the transaction for prepaid or postpaid billing.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of toll transaction (revenue collection, violation, test transaction, adjustment, or reversal).

attributes.name: violation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transaction represents a toll violation (vehicle passed without valid payment).

attributes.name: violation_type
attributes.description: Type of toll violation if applicable (no transponder, insufficient funds, unreadable plate, etc.).

attributes.name: image_captured_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether photographic evidence was captured for the transaction (typically for video tolling or violations).

attributes.name: front_image_url
attributes.description: Storage location or URL for the front vehicle image captured during the transaction.

attributes.name: rear_image_url
attributes.description: Storage location or URL for the rear vehicle image (license plate) captured during the transaction.

attributes.name: vehicle_speed
attributes.description: Speed of the vehicle in miles per hour when passing through the toll point.

attributes.name: occupancy_count
attributes.description: Number of occupants detected in the vehicle, used for High-Occupancy Vehicle (HOV) lane enforcement.

attributes.name: hov_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vehicle met High-Occupancy Vehicle requirements for reduced or waived toll.

attributes.name: toll_rate_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the toll rate schedule applied to this transaction (may vary by time of day, vehicle class, etc.).

attributes.name: time_of_day_period
attributes.description: Time period classification for dynamic toll pricing (peak, off-peak, overnight, weekend).

attributes.name: dynamic_pricing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether dynamic or congestion-based pricing was applied to this transaction.

attributes.name: congestion_level
attributes.description: Traffic congestion level at the time of transaction, used for dynamic pricing decisions.

attributes.name: entry_plaza_location_id
attributes.description: Toll plaza identifier where the vehicle entered the toll facility (for distance-based tolling).

attributes.name: entry_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the vehicle entered the toll facility (for distance-based tolling).

attributes.name: exit_plaza_location_id
attributes.description: Toll plaza identifier where the vehicle exited the toll facility (for distance-based tolling).

attributes.name: exit_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the vehicle exited the toll facility (for distance-based tolling).

attributes.name: distance_traveled
attributes.description: Distance in miles traveled on the toll facility between entry and exit points.

attributes.name: trip_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Duration of the trip on the toll facility in minutes, calculated from entry to exit.

attributes.name: revenue_category
attributes.description: Revenue classification category for financial reporting and analysis.

attributes.name: exemption_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for toll exemption if applicable (emergency vehicle, government vehicle, etc.).

attributes.name: exemption_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vehicle was exempt from toll payment.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Date by which payment is due for invoiced toll transactions.

attributes.name: collection_status
attributes.description: Current status of collection efforts for unpaid toll transactions.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the toll transaction has been disputed by the customer.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided by the customer for disputing the toll transaction.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_date
attributes.description: Date when the dispute was resolved or closed.

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: Amount refunded to the customer if the transaction was reversed or adjusted.

attributes.name: refund_date
attributes.description: Date when the refund was processed.

attributes.name: posted_date
attributes.description: Date when the transaction was posted to the customer account or financial system.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the toll transaction occurred for financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year for financial reporting.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: Date when the toll revenue was recognized in the financial system per GASB standards.

attributes.name: equipment_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the toll collection equipment that processed the transaction (reader, camera, etc.).

attributes.name: equipment_status
attributes.description: Operational status of the toll collection equipment at the time of transaction.

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of data quality for the transaction record (valid, suspect, invalid, or corrected).

attributes.name: correction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transaction record has been manually corrected or adjusted.

attributes.name: correction_reason
attributes.description: Reason for manual correction or adjustment of the transaction record.

attributes.name: original_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original transaction identifier if this record is a correction or reversal.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the transaction for operational or customer service purposes.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Source system or application that generated the toll transaction record.

attributes.name: batch_id
attributes.description: Batch identifier for grouped transaction processing and reconciliation.

attributes.name: registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to dmv.registration. Business justification: Toll transactions should reference the active vehicle registration (not just vehicle) to validate registration status at transaction time. Ensures tolls are charged to currently registered vehicles wi

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Toll collection systems are operated by contracted vendors (e.g., transponder providers, payment processors). Each transaction must reference the vendor for reconciliation, revenue sharing, and perfor

attributes.name: accounts_receivable_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.accounts_receivable_invoice. Business justification: Toll transactions generate revenue that must be invoiced and tracked in accounts receivable. Finance department reconciles toll revenue against AR invoices daily for revenue recognition and collection

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.payment. Business justification: Each toll transaction represents a payment collected. Finance reconciles toll payments against bank deposits and payment processor records to ensure accurate revenue accounting and detect discrepancie

products.name: toll_rate
products.description: Reference table defining toll rates by vehicle class, time of day, and location for use in toll transaction processing.

attributes.name: toll_rate_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the toll rate record. Primary key for the toll rate reference table.

attributes.name: rate_code
attributes.description: Unique business code identifying the toll rate configuration. Used for operational reference and reporting.

attributes.name: rate_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name for the toll rate configuration (e.g., 'Peak Hour Class 2 Rate', 'Weekend Discount Rate').

attributes.name: rate_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the toll rate including applicability conditions, special provisions, and business rules.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Direction of travel for which this toll rate applies.
attributes.references: MUTCD (Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices)

attributes.name: vehicle_class_code
attributes.description: Code representing the vehicle classification (e.g., Class 1 for 2-axle vehicles, Class 2 for 3-axle vehicles) per FHWA vehicle classification standards.

attributes.name: vehicle_class_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the vehicle class (e.g., 'Passenger Cars', 'Two-Axle Six-Tire Single Unit Trucks', 'Multi-Trailer Trucks').

attributes.name: axle_count
attributes.description: Number of axles on the vehicle for which this rate applies. Used for vehicle classification and toll calculation.

attributes.name: rate_amount
attributes.description: The toll charge amount in US dollars for this rate configuration.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the toll rate amount. Typically USD for NCDOT operations.

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the toll rate based on pricing strategy (base rate, time-of-day pricing, dynamic pricing, etc.).

attributes.name: time_of_day_period
attributes.description: Time period classification for time-of-day pricing (e.g., AM peak, PM peak, off-peak).

attributes.name: start_time
attributes.description: Start time of day when this toll rate becomes effective (HH:MM:SS format, 24-hour clock).

attributes.name: end_time
attributes.description: End time of day when this toll rate expires (HH:MM:SS format, 24-hour clock).

attributes.name: day_of_week
attributes.description: Day(s) of the week when this toll rate is applicable.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this toll rate becomes effective and can be applied to toll transactions.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this toll rate expires and is no longer valid for toll transactions. Null indicates no expiration.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the toll rate record.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Payment method for which this rate applies (e.g., electronic transponder, video toll/license plate recognition, cash).

attributes.name: transponder_type
attributes.description: Type of electronic toll collection transponder for which this rate applies (e.g., NC Quick Pass, E-ZPass).

attributes.name: discount_type
attributes.description: Type of discount program associated with this toll rate (e.g., frequent user, senior citizen, military, carpool/HOV).

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to the base toll rate for eligible users. Null if no discount applies.

attributes.name: minimum_rate_amount
attributes.description: Minimum toll charge amount that can be applied, regardless of discounts or dynamic pricing adjustments.

attributes.name: maximum_rate_amount
attributes.description: Maximum toll charge amount that can be applied, used as a cap for dynamic pricing scenarios.

attributes.name: dynamic_pricing_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate is subject to dynamic pricing adjustments based on traffic conditions or demand.

attributes.name: congestion_threshold_los
attributes.description: Level of Service (LOS) threshold that triggers dynamic pricing adjustments. LOS ranges from A (free flow) to F (forced flow).

attributes.name: holiday_schedule_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the holiday schedule that determines when special holiday rates apply.

attributes.name: special_event_code
attributes.description: Code identifying special events (e.g., major sporting events, festivals) that trigger special toll rates.

attributes.name: rate_schedule_version
attributes.description: Version number of the toll rate schedule to track rate changes over time.

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: Name of the authority or governing body that approved this toll rate (e.g., NCDOT Board of Transportation, NC Turnpike Authority).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this toll rate was officially approved by the governing authority.

attributes.name: approval_resolution_number
attributes.description: Official resolution or ordinance number documenting the approval of this toll rate.

attributes.name: public_notice_date
attributes.description: Date when public notice of this toll rate change was published, as required by state regulations.

attributes.name: revenue_allocation_code
attributes.description: Code indicating how toll revenue from this rate is allocated (e.g., debt service, maintenance, operations).

attributes.name: fund_code
attributes.description: Financial fund code to which toll revenue from this rate is credited.

attributes.name: account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code for revenue recognition from this toll rate.

attributes.name: rate_calculation_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate the toll charge (e.g., flat rate per passage, distance-based, zone-based, time-of-day based, dynamic algorithm).

attributes.name: distance_miles
attributes.description: Length of the toll segment in miles for distance-based toll calculations.
attributes.references: AASHTO (American Association of State Highway and Transportation Officials)

attributes.name: rate_per_mile
attributes.description: Toll charge per mile for distance-based toll calculations.

attributes.name: zone_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the toll zone for zone-based toll calculations.

attributes.name: entry_point_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the entry point on the toll facility for distance-based or zone-based tolling.

attributes.name: exit_point_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the exit point on the toll facility for distance-based or zone-based tolling.

attributes.name: interoperability_agency_code
attributes.description: Code identifying partner toll agencies for interoperable toll collection (e.g., E-ZPass network members).

attributes.name: reciprocity_agreement_code
attributes.description: Code referencing reciprocity agreements with other toll agencies for rate harmonization.

attributes.name: violation_penalty_amount
attributes.description: Additional penalty amount charged for toll violations (e.g., unpaid tolls, invalid transponder) associated with this rate.

attributes.name: administrative_fee_amount
attributes.description: Administrative processing fee charged for certain payment methods or violation processing.

attributes.name: tax_exempt_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this toll rate is exempt from state or local taxes.

attributes.name: environmental_surcharge_amount
attributes.description: Additional environmental surcharge amount included in the toll rate to fund environmental mitigation programs.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to this toll rate configuration.

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: Date when this toll rate record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: toll_route_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to traffic.toll_route. Business justification: Toll rates are defined for specific toll routes and vary by route, vehicle class, and time of day. This FK links rates to their toll route, normalizing facility and plaza identifiers that are route-sp

products.name: alert
products.description: Transactional record of real‑time traffic alerts (congestion, incidents, roadwork) sent to the public via mobile apps, variable message signs, and web portals.

attributes.name: alert_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each traffic alert record generated by the Traffic Management Center (TMC) or Advanced Traffic Management System (ATMS).

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Assessment of the traffic impact severity ranging from low (minimal delay) to critical (major disruption or safety hazard).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the traffic alert indicating whether it is actively affecting traffic or has been resolved.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Brief headline or summary of the traffic alert displayed to the public on mobile apps, web portals, and Dynamic Message Signs (DMS).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the traffic alert providing comprehensive information about the incident, location, and expected impact.

attributes.name: route_name
attributes.description: Name or designation of the roadway where the alert is located (e.g., I-40, US-1, NC-55).
attributes.references: AASHTO Route Numbering, NCDOT Road Inventory

attributes.name: route_number
attributes.description: Numeric identifier of the route as designated by state or federal highway systems.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Direction of travel affected by the traffic alert on the roadway.

attributes.name: mile_marker
attributes.description: Linear reference mile marker location on the route where the alert is positioned, used for precise geographic identification.

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: North Carolina county where the traffic alert is located.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality nearest to the traffic alert location.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate (WGS84) of the traffic alert location for mapping and spatial analysis.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate (WGS84) of the traffic alert location for mapping and spatial analysis.

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the traffic alert was first detected or reported, marking the beginning of the incident.

attributes.name: end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the traffic alert was cleared or resolved, marking the end of the incident impact.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the alert record was created in the system by TMC operators or automated detection systems.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent update or modification to the alert record.

attributes.name: expected_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Estimated duration in minutes that the traffic alert condition is expected to persist, used for traveler information.

attributes.name: lanes_affected
attributes.description: Description of which travel lanes are impacted by the alert (e.g., left lane, right two lanes, all lanes, shoulder).

attributes.name: lanes_closed_count
attributes.description: Count of travel lanes that are completely closed due to the traffic alert condition.

attributes.name: delay_minutes
attributes.description: Estimated travel delay in minutes caused by the traffic alert for motorists traversing the affected segment.

attributes.name: speed_limit_mph
attributes.business_glossary_term: Posted Speed Limit in Miles Per Hour
attributes.description: Posted speed limit in miles per hour on the affected roadway segment under normal conditions.

attributes.name: current_speed_mph
attributes.business_glossary_term: Current Traffic Speed in Miles Per Hour
attributes.description: Current average traffic speed in miles per hour on the affected segment during the alert, measured by ITS sensors or probe data.

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: Origin or reporting source of the traffic alert (e.g., TMC operator, IMAP patrol, automated detection system, law enforcement).
attributes.references: NCDOT Incident Management Assistance Patrol (IMAP) Program

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the traffic alert has been confirmed by TMC operators or field personnel versus automated or unverified reports.

attributes.name: published_to_mobile_app
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the alert has been disseminated to the public via NCDOT mobile applications.

attributes.name: published_to_web_portal
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the alert has been published to NCDOT public web portals and traveler information websites.

attributes.name: published_to_dms
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the alert has been displayed on roadside Dynamic Message Signs (DMS) for real-time traveler notification.

attributes.name: dms_message_text
attributes.description: Abbreviated message text displayed on Dynamic Message Signs, formatted according to MUTCD character and line limitations.

attributes.name: published_to_511
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the alert has been disseminated through the NC 511 telephone and web-based traveler information system.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the alert for TMC operator attention and public dissemination urgency.

attributes.name: incident_number
attributes.description: Unique incident tracking number assigned by TMC or law enforcement for cross-system reference and reporting.

attributes.name: responding_agency
attributes.description: Primary agency or organization responding to the incident (e.g., NCDOT Maintenance, State Highway Patrol, local fire department).

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Prevailing weather condition at the time and location of the alert, relevant for weather-related incidents.

attributes.name: road_surface_condition
attributes.description: Condition of the road surface at the alert location affecting vehicle traction and safety.
attributes.references: AASHTO Road Weather Information System Standards

attributes.name: detour_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether an alternate route or detour is available and recommended for motorists to bypass the affected area.

attributes.name: detour_route
attributes.description: Description of the recommended detour route for motorists to avoid the traffic alert location.

attributes.name: aadt
attributes.description: Annual Average Daily Traffic volume on the affected roadway segment, used to assess the magnitude of impact.

attributes.name: functional_class
attributes.description: FHWA functional classification of the roadway (e.g., Interstate, Principal Arterial) indicating its role in the transportation network.

attributes.name: nhs_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the affected roadway is part of the National Highway System, which has federal reporting requirements.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number for public inquiries or additional information about the traffic alert, typically the TMC or public information line.

attributes.name: clearance_method
attributes.description: Method or resource used to clear the incident and restore normal traffic flow.

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project. Business justification: Active construction projects generate traffic alerts for lane closures, detours, and work zones. Operations center links alerts to projects to coordinate public messaging and traffic management during

attributes.name: grade_crossing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rail.grade_crossing. Business justification: Traffic alerts for blocked crossings, malfunctioning gates, or train delays must reference the specific grade crossing. Traffic management centers issue real-time alerts to motorists about crossing cl

attributes.name: terminal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ferry.terminal. Business justification: Traffic alerts must reference ferry terminals for congestion/delays at terminal access roads. Traffic operations center issues alerts affecting terminal access daily for passenger notification.

attributes.name: issued_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Traffic alerts (road closures, hazards, delays) are issued by authorized traffic management center operators. System must track which employee issued each alert for accountability and audit compliance

attributes.name: routing_result_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gis.routing_result. Business justification: When traffic alerts create road closures, NCDOT generates alternate routing recommendations. Routing result stores the calculated detour path that traffic management broadcasts to travelers and naviga

attributes.name: incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.incident. Business justification: Traffic alerts are issued for safety incidents blocking lanes or creating hazards. Traffic management center references incident details to broadcast accurate real-time alerts to motorists.

attributes.name: incident_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to traffic.incident_type. Business justification: Traffic alerts are triggered by specific incident types (crash, stalled vehicle, debris, weather). This FK links alerts to the standardized incident type reference table, normalizing type and subtype

products.name: toll_route

attributes.description: Primary key for toll_route

attributes.name: route_number

attributes.name: route_name
attributes.description: Common or official name of the toll route (e.g., Triangle Expressway, Monroe Expressway).

attributes.name: route_type
attributes.description: Classification of the toll route based on functional class and jurisdiction.

attributes.name: status

attributes.name: total_length_miles

attributes.name: number_of_lanes

attributes.name: direction

attributes.name: toll_collection_method
attributes.description: Primary method used for collecting tolls on the route.

attributes.name: transponder_system

attributes.name: design_speed_mph

attributes.name: construction_start_date

attributes.name: opening_date

attributes.name: concession_start_date

attributes.name: maintenance_responsibility

attributes.name: pavement_type

attributes.name: pavement_condition_rating

attributes.name: bridge_count

attributes.name: tunnel_count

attributes.name: interchange_count
attributes.description: Total number of interchanges providing access to and from the toll route.

attributes.name: toll_plaza_count
attributes.description: Total number of toll collection plazas along the route.

attributes.name: its_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the toll route is equipped with intelligent transportation systems infrastructure for traffic management and monitoring.

attributes.name: atms_integrated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the toll route is integrated with the statewide or regional advanced traffic management system.

attributes.name: tmc_monitored
attributes.description: Indicates whether the toll route is actively monitored by a transportation management center.

attributes.name: incident_management_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether the toll route is covered by incident management programs such as IMAP (Incident Management Assistance Patrol).

attributes.name: dynamic_pricing_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the toll route uses dynamic or congestion-based pricing that varies by time of day or traffic conditions.

attributes.name: hov_lanes_present
attributes.description: Indicates whether the toll route includes dedicated high occupancy vehicle lanes.

attributes.name: truck_restrictions
attributes.description: Description of any weight, size, or operational restrictions applicable to commercial trucks on the toll route.

attributes.name: hazmat_restrictions
attributes.description: Description of any restrictions on the transport of hazardous materials on the toll route.

attributes.name: environmental_mitigation_features
attributes.description: Description of environmental protection or mitigation features implemented along the toll route (e.g., wildlife crossings, stormwater management).

attributes.name: level_of_service

attributes.name: last_inspection_date

attributes.name: next_scheduled_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date when the next comprehensive inspection of the toll route infrastructure is scheduled.

attributes.name: gis_route_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier used in the geographic information system for spatial referencing and mapping of the toll route.

attributes.name: mutcd_compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status of traffic control devices on the toll route with MUTCD standards.

attributes.name: ada_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the toll route facilities and infrastructure meet ADA accessibility requirements.

attributes.name: emergency_access_points
attributes.description: Number of designated emergency vehicle access points along the toll route.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the toll route record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: account_holder_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the individual or organization that owns the toll account.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the toll account based on the account holder type. Determines billing rules and discount eligibility.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the toll account. Determines whether the account can be used for toll transactions.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for account communications, billing notifications, and account alerts.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the toll account holder. Used for account notifications and customer service.

attributes.name: mailing_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the mailing address for billing statements and official correspondence.

attributes.name: mailing_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the mailing address for apartment, suite, or unit information.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City name for the toll account mailing address.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state abbreviation for the mailing address. Typically NC for North Carolina residents.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Five or nine-digit ZIP code for the mailing address.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the mailing address.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Primary payment instrument used for toll charges and account replenishment.

attributes.name: auto_replenishment_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account is configured to automatically replenish the prepaid balance when it falls below the threshold.

attributes.name: replenishment_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Minimum account balance in USD that triggers automatic replenishment when auto-replenishment is enabled.

attributes.name: replenishment_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount in USD added to the account balance when auto-replenishment is triggered.

attributes.name: current_balance
attributes.description: Current prepaid balance in USD available in the toll account for toll transactions.

attributes.name: low_balance_threshold
attributes.description: Balance amount in USD that triggers a low balance notification to the account holder.

attributes.name: discount_plan_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the discount or pricing plan applied to the toll account. Determines toll rates and promotional discounts.

attributes.name: transponder_count
attributes.description: Number of active transponders or toll tags associated with this toll account.

attributes.name: vehicle_count
attributes.description: Number of vehicles registered to this toll account for toll billing purposes.

attributes.name: opened_date
attributes.description: Date when the toll account was originally opened and activated.

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: Date when the toll account was permanently closed. Null if account is still open.

attributes.name: last_transaction_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent toll transaction or account activity.

attributes.name: last_replenishment_date
attributes.description: Date when the account balance was last replenished either manually or automatically.

attributes.name: billing_cycle_day
attributes.description: Day of the month when the billing cycle closes and statements are generated for post-paid accounts.

attributes.name: statement_delivery_method
attributes.description: Preferred method for delivering billing statements and account summaries to the account holder.

attributes.name: paperless_billing_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account holder has opted for paperless billing and electronic statements only.

attributes.name: notification_preferences
attributes.description: Account holder preferences for receiving account alerts, low balance warnings, and transaction notifications.

attributes.name: business_tax_id
attributes.description: Federal Employer Identification Number for business or government toll accounts. Used for tax reporting and business verification.

attributes.name: customer_service_notes
attributes.description: Internal notes and comments from customer service interactions regarding account issues, disputes, or special handling requirements.

attributes.name: violation_count
attributes.description: Total number of toll violations associated with this account due to insufficient balance or transponder issues.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the toll account record was last updated or modified.

products.name: atms_system
products.description: Master reference table for atms_system. Referenced by atms_system_id.

attributes.name: atms_system_id
attributes.description: Primary key for atms_system

attributes.name: system_name
attributes.description: Official name or designation of the ATMS system installation.

attributes.name: system_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the ATMS system for operational reference and integration purposes.

attributes.name: system_type
attributes.description: Classification of the ATMS system based on its primary function within the traffic management infrastructure.

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Name of the manufacturer or vendor that supplied the ATMS system hardware and software.

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer's model number or designation for the ATMS system equipment.

attributes.name: software_version
attributes.description: Current version of the operating software or firmware installed on the ATMS system.

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date when the ATMS system was originally installed and commissioned for operational use.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the ATMS system indicating its availability and readiness for traffic management operations.

attributes.name: tmc_location
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the Traffic Management Center responsible for monitoring and controlling this ATMS system.

attributes.name: communication_protocol
attributes.description: Network communication protocol used by the ATMS system for data exchange with the central management system.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: Internet Protocol address assigned to the ATMS system for network connectivity and remote management.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the ATMS system installation location in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the ATMS system installation location in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the roadway route where the ATMS system is installed, following NCDOT route numbering conventions.

attributes.name: milepost
attributes.description: Linear reference milepost location along the route where the ATMS system is positioned.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Travel direction or orientation of the roadway served by the ATMS system.

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: North Carolina county where the ATMS system is geographically located.

attributes.name: division
attributes.description: NCDOT highway division number (1-14) responsible for maintenance and operations of the ATMS system.

attributes.name: maintenance_responsibility
attributes.description: Entity responsible for performing maintenance and repairs on the ATMS system.

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent scheduled or corrective maintenance was performed on the ATMS system.

attributes.name: next_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next planned maintenance activity on the ATMS system.

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the manufacturer's warranty coverage for the ATMS system expires.

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Total cost incurred for procuring and installing the ATMS system, including hardware, software, and installation expenses.

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Source of funding used to acquire the ATMS system, such as federal grants, state funds, or local contributions.

attributes.name: integration_status
attributes.description: Level of integration between the ATMS system and the central traffic management platform or other ITS systems.

attributes.name: mutcd_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the ATMS system installation and operation complies with MUTCD standards and requirements.

attributes.name: power_source
attributes.description: Primary electrical power source supplying the ATMS system equipment.

attributes.name: backup_power_available
attributes.description: Indicator of whether backup power capability exists to maintain ATMS system operation during primary power outages.

attributes.name: imap_enabled
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the ATMS system is configured to support IMAP incident detection and response operations.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the ATMS system including its capabilities, coverage area, and operational characteristics.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional operational notes, special considerations, or historical information relevant to the ATMS system.

attributes.name: decommission_date
attributes.description: Date when the ATMS system was or is planned to be removed from service and decommissioned.

products.name: atms_station
products.description: Master reference table for atms_station. Referenced by atms_station_id.

attributes.name: atms_station_id
attributes.description: Primary key for atms_station

attributes.name: station_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the ATMS station for identification and reference purposes.

attributes.name: station_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the ATMS station for system identification and reporting.

attributes.name: station_type
attributes.description: Classification of the ATMS station based on its primary function within the traffic management system.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the ATMS station indicating availability and readiness for traffic management operations.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the ATMS station location in decimal degrees format.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the ATMS station location in decimal degrees format.

attributes.name: route_number
attributes.description: Highway or roadway route number where the ATMS station is located (e.g., I-40, US-1, NC-55).

attributes.name: milepost
attributes.description: Linear reference milepost location of the ATMS station along the route for precise positioning.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Direction of traffic flow monitored or controlled by the ATMS station.

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: North Carolina county where the ATMS station is physically located.

attributes.name: division
attributes.description: NCDOT Division number (1-14) responsible for maintenance and operations of the ATMS station.

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date when the ATMS station was originally installed and commissioned for operational use.

attributes.name: manufacturer
attributes.description: Name of the manufacturer or vendor that produced the ATMS station equipment.

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer model number or designation of the ATMS station equipment for maintenance and parts reference.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number assigned by the manufacturer to the ATMS station equipment for tracking and warranty purposes.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: Network IP address assigned to the ATMS station for communication with the central traffic management system.

attributes.name: communication_protocol
attributes.description: Network communication protocol used by the ATMS station to exchange data with the central system.

attributes.name: power_source
attributes.description: Primary electrical power source type supplying energy to the ATMS station equipment.

attributes.name: ownership
attributes.description: Entity that owns the ATMS station asset and is responsible for capital investment and replacement.

attributes.name: maintenance_responsibility
attributes.description: Entity responsible for ongoing maintenance, repair, and operational support of the ATMS station.

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent scheduled or corrective maintenance was performed on the ATMS station.

attributes.name: next_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the next scheduled preventive maintenance activity on the ATMS station.

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the manufacturer warranty coverage for the ATMS station equipment expires.

attributes.name: operational_hours
attributes.description: Schedule or pattern defining when the ATMS station is actively operating and monitoring traffic.

attributes.name: data_collection_interval_seconds
attributes.description: Frequency in seconds at which the ATMS station collects and transmits traffic data to the central system.

attributes.name: mutcd_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the ATMS station installation and operation complies with MUTCD standards and requirements.

attributes.name: ada_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the ATMS station meets ADA accessibility requirements where applicable.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional information, special conditions, or operational notes about the ATMS station.

attributes.name: atms_system_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to traffic.atms_system. Business justification: ATMS stations are components of larger ATMS systems and report to centralized TMC operations. This FK links stations to their parent ATMS system for hierarchical system management.

products.name: coordination_pattern
products.description: Master reference table for coordination_pattern. Referenced by coordination_pattern_id.

attributes.name: coordination_pattern_id
attributes.description: Primary key for coordination_pattern

attributes.name: pattern_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code used to identify the coordination pattern in traffic management systems and field operations.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the coordination pattern (e.g., AM Peak, PM Peak, Weekend, Special Event).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the coordination pattern including its purpose, traffic conditions it addresses, and operational characteristics.

attributes.name: pattern_type
attributes.description: Classification of the coordination pattern based on its triggering mechanism and operational context.

attributes.name: cycle_length_seconds
attributes.description: Total duration of one complete signal cycle in seconds for this coordination pattern, typically ranging from 60 to 180 seconds.

attributes.name: offset_reference_seconds
attributes.description: Time offset in seconds from the master reference point used to synchronize signals along the coordinated corridor.

attributes.name: coordination_mode
attributes.description: Operating mode that defines how traffic signals interact within this pattern (free-running, coordinated progression, actuated response, etc.).

attributes.name: priority_direction
attributes.description: Primary traffic flow direction that receives coordination priority and optimized green wave progression in this pattern.

attributes.name: target_speed_mph
attributes.description: Design speed in miles per hour used to calculate signal timing offsets for optimal vehicle progression through the corridor.

attributes.name: time_of_day_start
attributes.description: Start time in HH:MM format (24-hour clock) when this coordination pattern becomes active during scheduled operations.

attributes.name: time_of_day_end
attributes.description: End time in HH:MM format (24-hour clock) when this coordination pattern is scheduled to terminate.

attributes.name: days_of_week
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of days when this pattern is active (e.g., Monday,Tuesday,Wednesday,Thursday,Friday for weekday patterns).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the coordination pattern indicating whether it is available for deployment in the traffic management system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this coordination pattern was first implemented or became effective for traffic operations.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this coordination pattern is scheduled to be retired or replaced, if applicable.

attributes.name: atms_system_id
attributes.description: Identifier used by the ATMS platform to reference and activate this coordination pattern in the traffic control infrastructure.

attributes.name: tmc_approval_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether TMC operator approval is required before this pattern can be activated.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking (1=highest) used to resolve conflicts when multiple patterns are eligible for activation simultaneously.

attributes.name: incident_response_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pattern is designed for incident management and can be triggered by IMAP (Incident Management Assistance Patrol) events.

attributes.name: special_event_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pattern is designed for special events such as sporting events, concerts, or planned road closures.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date when the coordination pattern configuration was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for the coordination pattern configuration, incremented with each modification to maintain change history.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional operational notes, implementation guidance, or special instructions for traffic engineers and TMC operators.

domains.name: project
domains.description: Transportation project management including STIP/TIP programming, project delivery, preliminary engineering (PE), construction engineering (CE), and project lifecycle tracking through SAP PS and HiCAMS systems.

products.name: project
products.description: Master record for each transportation project, including identifiers, title, description, sponsor, status, and overall lifecycle information.

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the transportation project. Primary key for the project master record.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Business-assigned unique project number used for identification and tracking across NCDOT systems, including SAP PS and HiCAMS.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: SAP Project System Work Breakdown Structure element identifier for hierarchical project organization and cost tracking.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Official title or name of the transportation project as it appears in STIP/TIP documentation and public communications.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the project scope, objectives, and deliverables.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the project by primary transportation mode or functional category.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the project indicating its phase in the delivery process.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the project for resource allocation and scheduling decisions.

attributes.name: sponsor_division
attributes.description: NCDOT division or organizational unit sponsoring and responsible for the project (e.g., Division of Highways, Division of Motor Vehicles).

attributes.name: sponsor_unit
attributes.description: Specific organizational unit or office within the sponsor division responsible for project delivery.

attributes.name: highway_division_number
attributes.description: NCDOT Division of Highways regional division number (1-14) where the project is geographically located.

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: Primary North Carolina county where the project is located.

attributes.name: municipality
attributes.description: City or town where the project is located, if applicable.

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Highway route identifier (e.g., I-40, US-1, NC-55) for roadway projects.

attributes.name: begin_milepost
attributes.description: Starting milepost location for linear roadway projects, measured in miles.

attributes.name: end_milepost
attributes.description: Ending milepost location for linear roadway projects, measured in miles.

attributes.name: length_miles
attributes.description: Total length of the project corridor in miles for linear projects.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the project centroid or primary location in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the project centroid or primary location in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: stip_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned to the project in the North Carolina State Transportation Improvement Program.

attributes.name: tip_number
attributes.description: Metropolitan Planning Organization or Rural Planning Organization TIP identifier for the project, if applicable.

attributes.name: federal_aid_project_number
attributes.description: Federal Highway Administration assigned project number for federally funded projects.

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Primary source of project funding (federal, state, local, private, or mixed).

attributes.name: federal_funding_program
attributes.description: Specific federal funding program supporting the project (e.g., National Highway System, Surface Transportation Program, Highway Safety Improvement Program).

attributes.name: estimated_total_cost
attributes.description: Total estimated cost of the project across all phases and funding sources, in US dollars.

attributes.name: federal_funds_amount
attributes.description: Total federal funding allocated or obligated to the project, in US dollars.

attributes.name: state_funds_amount
attributes.description: Total state funding allocated to the project, in US dollars.

attributes.name: local_funds_amount
attributes.description: Total local government funding allocated to the project, in US dollars.

attributes.name: planning_start_date
attributes.description: Date when project planning activities commenced.

attributes.name: planning_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when project planning phase was completed.

attributes.name: pe_start_date
attributes.description: Date when preliminary engineering phase activities commenced.

attributes.name: pe_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when preliminary engineering phase was completed.

attributes.name: environmental_start_date
attributes.description: Date when environmental review and NEPA compliance activities commenced.

attributes.name: environmental_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when environmental review and NEPA documentation was completed.

attributes.name: nepa_class
attributes.description: NEPA environmental review classification: Categorical Exclusion (CE), Environmental Assessment (EA), Environmental Impact Statement (EIS), or not required.

attributes.name: nepa_document_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA) Document Number
attributes.description: Official document number for the NEPA environmental review (FONSI, EIS, CE documentation).

attributes.name: row_start_date
attributes.description: Date when right-of-way acquisition activities commenced.

attributes.name: row_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when all required right-of-way was acquired and cleared for construction.

attributes.name: design_start_date
attributes.description: Date when final design and construction engineering activities commenced.

attributes.name: design_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when final design plans were completed and approved for letting.

attributes.name: letting_date
attributes.description: Date when the project was advertised for competitive bidding (letting).

attributes.name: award_date
attributes.description: Date when the construction contract was awarded to the selected contractor.

attributes.name: ntp_date
attributes.description: Date when the contractor received official notice to proceed with construction activities.

attributes.name: construction_start_date
attributes.description: Date when physical construction activities commenced on site.

attributes.name: scheduled_completion_date
attributes.description: Contractually scheduled date for project completion as specified in the construction contract.

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date when construction was completed and the project was accepted.

attributes.name: closeout_date
attributes.description: Date when all project administrative closeout activities were completed, including final payments and documentation.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Official contract number for the primary construction contract.

attributes.name: contractor_name
attributes.description: Name of the prime contractor awarded the construction contract.

attributes.name: contract_amount
attributes.description: Original contract award amount in US dollars for the construction contract.

attributes.name: bid_amount
attributes.description: Lowest responsive bid amount received during the letting process, in US dollars.

attributes.name: engineer_estimate
attributes.description: NCDOT engineer's pre-bid cost estimate for the construction work, in US dollars.

attributes.name: number_of_bidders
attributes.description: Total number of contractors who submitted bids during the letting process.

attributes.name: dbe_goal_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage goal for Disadvantaged Business Enterprise participation on the project.

attributes.name: dbe_actual_percentage
attributes.description: Actual percentage of contract value awarded to Disadvantaged Business Enterprises.

attributes.name: mpo_name
attributes.description: Name of the Metropolitan Planning Organization with jurisdiction over the project area, if applicable.

attributes.name: rpo_name
attributes.description: Name of the Rural Planning Organization with jurisdiction over the project area, if applicable.

attributes.name: functional_class
attributes.description: FHWA functional classification of the roadway (interstate, arterial, collector, local).

attributes.name: nhs_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the project is on the National Highway System.

attributes.name: aadt
attributes.description: Annual Average Daily Traffic volume on the project corridor, measured in vehicles per day.

attributes.name: truck_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of total traffic volume consisting of trucks and commercial vehicles.

attributes.name: safety_project_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the project is designated as a highway safety improvement project under HSIP.

attributes.name: crash_rate_before
attributes.description: Crash rate per million vehicle miles traveled (VMT) in the project corridor before project implementation.

attributes.name: environmental_mitigation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether environmental mitigation measures are required as part of project approval.

attributes.name: wetland_impact_acres
attributes.description: Total acreage of wetlands impacted by the project requiring mitigation under Clean Water Act Section 404.

attributes.name: stream_impact_linear_feet
attributes.description: Total linear feet of stream impacts requiring mitigation under Clean Water Act Section 404.

attributes.name: historic_properties_affected
attributes.description: Indicates whether the project affects properties listed or eligible for the National Register of Historic Places.
attributes.references: National Historic Preservation Act Section 106 (54 USC 306108)

attributes.name: section_106_consultation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether Section 106 consultation with State Historic Preservation Office (SHPO) is required.
attributes.references: National Historic Preservation Act Section 106 (54 USC 306108)

attributes.name: public_involvement_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal public involvement activities (hearings, meetings) are required for the project.

attributes.name: public_hearing_date
attributes.description: Date of the official public hearing held for the project, if applicable.

attributes.name: ffy_programmed
attributes.description: Federal fiscal year in which the project is programmed in the STIP for funding obligation.

attributes.name: sfy_programmed
attributes.description: State fiscal year in which the project is programmed for state funding allocation.

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: Contracting method used for project delivery (design-bid-build, design-build, construction manager at risk, public-private partnership).

attributes.name: pavement_type
attributes.description: Type of pavement surface being constructed or rehabilitated (asphalt, concrete, composite).

attributes.name: number_of_lanes
attributes.description: Total number of travel lanes in the project corridor after project completion.

attributes.name: bridge_count
attributes.description: Number of bridges included in the project scope (new construction, replacement, or rehabilitation).

attributes.name: culvert_count
attributes.description: Number of culverts included in the project scope.

attributes.name: signal_count
attributes.description: Number of traffic signals included in the project scope (new installation, upgrade, or replacement).
attributes.references: MUTCD (Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices)

attributes.name: its_components_included
attributes.business_glossary_term: Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) Components Included Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the project includes Intelligent Transportation Systems components (DMS, CCTV, detection).

attributes.name: ada_compliance_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Compliance Required Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the project must comply with ADA accessibility requirements for pedestrian facilities.

attributes.name: bicycle_facilities_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether the project includes dedicated bicycle facilities (lanes, paths, shared-use paths).
attributes.references: AASHTO Guide for Development of Bicycle Facilities

attributes.name: pedestrian_facilities_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether the project includes pedestrian facilities (sidewalks, crosswalks, pedestrian signals).
attributes.references: AASHTO Guide for Planning, Design, and Operation of Pedestrian Facilities

attributes.name: transit_facilities_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether the project includes public transit facilities (bus stops, shelters, park-and-ride).

attributes.name: utility_relocation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether utility relocations are required as part of the project.

attributes.name: railroad_coordination_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether coordination with railroad companies is required for the project (grade crossings, bridges over rail).

attributes.name: emergency_project_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the project is designated as an emergency project due to natural disaster or critical infrastructure failure.

attributes.name: fema_disaster_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) Disaster Number
attributes.description: FEMA disaster declaration number if the project is related to federally declared disaster recovery.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the project record was initially created in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the project record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Every NCDOT project requires an assigned project manager. Essential for accountability, communication, and project oversight across all transportation initiatives.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Transportation projects are assigned to cost centers for financial tracking and departmental budget accountability. Project managers reference this daily for expenditure authorization and reporting.

products.name: phase
products.description: Reference list of standard project phases (e.g., Planning, Preliminary Engineering, Design, Construction, Closeout) used to categorize project activities.

attributes.name: phase_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the project phase reference record. Primary key for the project phase reference list.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the project phase (e.g., PE, CE, ROW, CONST). Used for system integration and reporting.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the project phase (e.g., Preliminary Engineering, Construction Engineering, Right-of-Way Acquisition, Construction, Closeout).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the project phase including typical activities, deliverables, and objectives associated with this phase.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: High-level category grouping for the project phase used for reporting and analysis (e.g., Planning, Design, Environmental, Acquisition, Construction, Closeout, Maintenance).

attributes.name: sap_ps_phase_code
attributes.description: Corresponding phase code used in SAP PS (Project System) module for project structure and work breakdown structure (WBS) element mapping.

attributes.name: hicams_phase_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Highway Construction and Materials System (HiCAMS) Phase Code
attributes.description: Corresponding phase code used in HiCAMS (Highway Construction and Materials System) for construction project tracking and materials management.

attributes.name: stip_phase_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: State Transportation Improvement Program (STIP) Phase Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this phase is reportable in the State Transportation Improvement Program (STIP) for federal and state compliance.

attributes.name: tip_phase_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this phase is reportable in the Transportation Improvement Program (TIP) for Metropolitan Planning Organization (MPO) and Rural Planning Organization (RPO) compliance.

attributes.name: fhwa_reportable_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this phase requires reporting to the Federal Highway Administration (FHWA) for federal-aid project compliance and oversight.

attributes.name: funding_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this phase is eligible for federal, state, or other funding sources under transportation funding programs.

attributes.name: federal_participation_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether federal funding participation is allowed for this project phase under FHWA regulations.

attributes.name: nepa_phase_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA) Phase Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this phase involves National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA) environmental review and documentation requirements.

attributes.name: environmental_clearance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether environmental clearance (CE, EA, EIS, or FONSI) is required before this phase can proceed.
attributes.references: 23 CFR 771 - Environmental Impact and Related Procedures

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Numeric sequence indicating the typical order of this phase in the project lifecycle. Lower numbers indicate earlier phases.

attributes.name: typical_duration_months
attributes.description: Typical or average duration in months for completing this project phase, used for project scheduling and planning estimates.

attributes.name: minimum_duration_months
attributes.description: Minimum feasible duration in months for completing this project phase under optimal conditions.

attributes.name: maximum_duration_months
attributes.description: Maximum expected duration in months for completing this project phase, used for risk planning and schedule contingency.

attributes.name: predecessor_phase_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of phase codes that typically must be completed before this phase can begin, defining phase dependencies.

attributes.name: successor_phase_codes

attributes.name: deliverable_requirements

attributes.name: approval_authority

attributes.name: responsible_division
attributes.description: Primary NCDOT division responsible for managing and executing this project phase (e.g., Division of Highways (DOH), Division of Central Highways (DCH)).

attributes.name: cost_estimate_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal cost estimate is required for this project phase for budgeting and funding allocation.

attributes.name: typical_cost_percentage
attributes.description: Typical percentage of total project cost allocated to this phase, used for preliminary budgeting and cost estimation (e.g., PE typically 10-15% of total project cost).

attributes.name: quality_assurance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) procedures and documentation are required for this project phase.

attributes.name: public_involvement_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether public involvement activities (public hearings, stakeholder meetings, comment periods) are required during this project phase.

attributes.name: right_of_way_phase_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this phase involves Right-of-Way (ROW) acquisition, property appraisal, relocation assistance, or related activities.

attributes.name: utilities_coordination_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether coordination with utility companies for relocation or adjustment of utilities is required during this project phase.

attributes.name: railroad_coordination_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether coordination with railroad companies and Federal Railroad Administration (FRA) is required during this project phase for grade crossings or railroad right-of-way.

attributes.name: design_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal design approval from NCDOT State Roadway Design Unit or FHWA is required for this project phase.

attributes.name: letting_phase_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this phase involves a formal letting (bidding) process for contractor selection and award.

attributes.name: construction_phase_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this phase involves physical construction activities in the field.

attributes.name: inspection_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal inspection activities and documentation are required during this project phase.

attributes.name: materials_testing_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether materials testing and quality control testing are required during this project phase, typically tracked in HiCAMS.

attributes.name: traffic_control_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether Maintenance of Traffic (MOT) plans and traffic control measures are required during this project phase.
attributes.references: MUTCD - Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices

attributes.name: safety_compliance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal safety compliance procedures and OSHA safety requirements must be followed during this project phase.

attributes.name: dbe_participation_tracked
attributes.description: Indicates whether Disadvantaged Business Enterprise (DBE), Minority Business Enterprise (MBE), Women Business Enterprise (WBE), or Historically Underutilized Business (HUB) participation is tracked and reported for this phase.

attributes.name: federal_fiscal_year_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether Federal Fiscal Year (FFY) tracking and obligation deadlines apply to this project phase for federal funding compliance.

attributes.name: obligation_authority_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether federal obligation authority must be secured before this project phase can proceed with federal funding.

attributes.name: status

attributes.name: effective_start_date

attributes.name: effective_end_date

attributes.name: last_updated_date
