products.name: schedule
products.description: Transactional schedule entries for a project, capturing work package, start/end dates, duration, and critical path information.

attributes.name: schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the project schedule entry. Primary key for the project schedule transactional record.

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the parent transportation project. Links schedule entry to the project in SAP PS or HiCAMS.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: Work Breakdown Structure element code representing the hierarchical decomposition of project work. Used in SAP PS for cost and schedule tracking.

attributes.name: work_package_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the work package within the project schedule. Represents a discrete unit of work to be completed.

attributes.name: work_package_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the work package or task within the project schedule.

attributes.name: work_package_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the work package scope, deliverables, and activities to be performed.

attributes.name: activity_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the schedule activity within the work package. Used for detailed task-level tracking.

attributes.name: activity_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific activity or task within the work package.

attributes.name: activity_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the activity scope and expected outcomes.

attributes.name: phase_code
attributes.description: Code representing the project phase. PE=Preliminary Engineering, CE=Construction Engineering, ROW=Right-of-Way acquisition, DESIGN=Design phase, CONSTRUCTION=Construction phase, CLOSEOUT=Project closeout.

attributes.name: milestone_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule entry represents a project milestone (true) or a regular activity (false).

attributes.name: scheduled_start_date
attributes.description: Planned start date for the work package or activity as originally scheduled.

attributes.name: scheduled_finish_date
attributes.description: Planned finish date for the work package or activity as originally scheduled.

attributes.name: baseline_start_date
attributes.description: Baseline start date established at project approval or contract award. Used for variance analysis.

attributes.name: baseline_finish_date
attributes.description: Baseline finish date established at project approval or contract award. Used for variance analysis.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: Actual date when work on the activity or work package commenced.

attributes.name: actual_finish_date
attributes.description: Actual date when work on the activity or work package was completed.

attributes.name: forecast_start_date
attributes.description: Current forecast or projected start date based on latest project status and conditions.

attributes.name: forecast_finish_date
attributes.description: Current forecast or projected finish date based on latest project status and conditions.

attributes.name: early_start_date
attributes.description: Earliest possible start date calculated by critical path method (CPM) scheduling analysis.

attributes.name: early_finish_date
attributes.description: Earliest possible finish date calculated by critical path method (CPM) scheduling analysis.

attributes.name: late_start_date
attributes.description: Latest allowable start date without delaying project completion, calculated by CPM analysis.

attributes.name: late_finish_date
attributes.description: Latest allowable finish date without delaying project completion, calculated by CPM analysis.

attributes.name: duration_days
attributes.description: Planned duration of the work package or activity measured in calendar days.

attributes.name: original_duration_days
attributes.description: Original planned duration at project baseline, measured in calendar days.

attributes.name: remaining_duration_days
attributes.description: Estimated remaining duration to complete the activity, measured in calendar days.

attributes.name: actual_duration_days
attributes.description: Actual duration from start to finish of the completed activity, measured in calendar days.

attributes.name: percent_complete
attributes.description: Percentage of work completed for the activity or work package, ranging from 0.00 to 100.00.

attributes.name: physical_percent_complete
attributes.description: Physical completion percentage based on actual work performed, ranging from 0.00 to 100.00.

attributes.name: critical_path_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this activity is on the project critical path (true) or not (false). Critical path activities directly impact project completion date.

attributes.name: total_float_days
attributes.description: Total float or slack time available for the activity without delaying project completion, measured in days.

attributes.name: free_float_days
attributes.description: Free float time available without delaying any successor activities, measured in days.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the schedule entry. Values: NOT_STARTED, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, ON_HOLD, CANCELLED, DELAYED.

attributes.name: constraint_type
attributes.description: Type of scheduling constraint applied. ASAP=As Soon As Possible, ALAP=As Late As Possible, SNET=Start No Earlier Than, SNLT=Start No Later Than, FNET=Finish No Earlier Than, FNLT=Finish No Later Than, MSO=Mandatory Start On, MFO=Mandatory Finish On.

attributes.name: constraint_date
attributes.description: Date associated with the schedule constraint, if applicable.

attributes.name: calendar_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the work calendar applied to this activity, defining working days and holidays.

attributes.name: calendar_name
attributes.description: Name of the work calendar (e.g., Standard 5-Day Week, 7-Day Construction Calendar).

attributes.name: responsible_organization
attributes.description: NCDOT division or external organization responsible for executing this work package or activity.

attributes.name: responsible_person_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual responsible for managing or executing this schedule activity.

attributes.name: responsible_person_email
attributes.description: Email address of the individual responsible for this schedule activity.

attributes.name: contractor_name
attributes.description: Name of the contractor or vendor assigned to perform this work package, if applicable.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Contract number associated with this work package or activity, if performed under contract.

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Primary funding source for this work package. Values include FEDERAL, STATE, LOCAL, GARVEE, BUILD, INFRA, RAISE, TIFIA, OTHER.

attributes.name: federal_fiscal_year
attributes.description: Federal fiscal year in which this work is programmed or funded.

attributes.name: state_fiscal_year
attributes.description: State fiscal year in which this work is programmed or funded.

attributes.name: stip_number
attributes.description: STIP project number linking this schedule to the statewide transportation improvement program.

attributes.name: tip_number
attributes.description: TIP project number for metropolitan planning organization programming, if applicable.

attributes.name: budgeted_cost
attributes.description: Budgeted cost allocated to this work package or activity in US dollars.

attributes.name: estimated_cost
attributes.description: Current estimated cost to complete this work package or activity in US dollars.

attributes.name: actual_cost
attributes.description: Actual cost incurred for this work package or activity to date, in US dollars.

attributes.name: cost_variance
attributes.description: Variance between budgeted and actual cost, calculated as budgeted minus actual, in US dollars.

attributes.name: variance_days
attributes.description: Variance between planned and actual schedule, measured in days. Positive values indicate ahead of schedule, negative values indicate delays.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numerical priority ranking of this activity within the project schedule. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Risk level associated with this schedule activity. Values: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL.

attributes.name: weather_dependent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this activity is weather-dependent (true) or can proceed regardless of weather conditions (false).

attributes.name: permit_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether regulatory permits are required before this activity can commence (true) or not (false).

attributes.name: permit_type
attributes.description: Type of permit required. Values include NEPA (environmental), 404 (wetlands), NPDES (stormwater), AIR (air quality), SHPO (historic preservation), OTHER.

attributes.name: permit_status
attributes.description: Current status of required permits. Values: NOT_REQUIRED, PENDING, APPROVED, DENIED, EXPIRED.

attributes.name: environmental_clearance_date
attributes.description: Date when environmental clearance (NEPA, Section 404, etc.) was obtained for this activity.

attributes.name: row_acquisition_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether right-of-way acquisition is required before this activity can proceed (true) or not (false).

attributes.name: utility_relocation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether utility relocation is required before this activity can proceed (true) or not (false).

attributes.name: traffic_control_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether traffic control measures (MOT/TCP) are required during this activity (true) or not (false).
attributes.references: MUTCD Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices

attributes.name: lane_closure_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether lane closures are required during this activity (true) or not (false).
attributes.references: MUTCD Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to this schedule entry, including issues, risks, or special considerations.

attributes.name: predecessor_activities
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of predecessor activity IDs that must be completed before this activity can start.

attributes.name: successor_activities
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of successor activity IDs that depend on the completion of this activity.

attributes.name: relationship_type
attributes.description: Type of dependency relationship with predecessor activities. FS=Finish-to-Start, SS=Start-to-Start, FF=Finish-to-Finish, SF=Start-to-Finish.

attributes.name: lag_days
attributes.description: Number of lag days (delay) between predecessor completion and successor start, measured in days.

attributes.name: lead_days
attributes.description: Number of lead days (overlap) allowing successor to start before predecessor completes, measured in days.

attributes.name: baseline_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the schedule baseline used for comparison and variance analysis.

attributes.name: update_date
attributes.description: Date when this schedule entry was last updated with current progress and forecast information.

attributes.name: data_date
attributes.description: As-of date for schedule status and progress reporting. Also known as status date or time-now date.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Source system from which this schedule data originated. Values: SAP_PS, HICAMS, PRIMAVERA, MS_PROJECT, OTHER.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this schedule record was created in the source system.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this schedule record was last updated in the source system.

attributes.name: phase_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_phase. Business justification: Schedule activities occur within project phases. The project_phase_id FK links to the reference table defining phase characteristics. The phase_name can be retrieved from project_phase via JOIN.

attributes.name: milestone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project_milestone. Business justification: Schedule entries can reference milestone types when milestone_flag is true. The project_milestone_id FK links to the reference table defining milestone characteristics. The milestone_type can be retri

products.name: change_order

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the project change order record.

products.description: Reference list of milestone types (e.g., Permit Received, Groundbreaking, Substantial Completion) used to track key project events.

attributes.name: milestone_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the project milestone record. Primary key for the project milestone reference table.

attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the milestone type. Used for system integration and reporting (e.g., PERMIT_REC, GROUNDBREAK, SUBST_COMP).

attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the milestone type (e.g., Permit Received, Groundbreaking, Substantial Completion, Final Acceptance).

attributes.description: Indicates whether this milestone is required for all projects or only applicable to specific project types. True if mandatory for all projects.

attributes.name: is_reportable_to_fhwa

attributes.description: Indicates whether this milestone is tracked and reported in the State Transportation Improvement Program. True if included in STIP reporting.

attributes.name: typical_duration_days
attributes.description: The typical or average number of days required to complete this milestone, used for project scheduling and planning purposes.

attributes.name: sequence_order
attributes.description: Numeric value indicating the typical sequential order of this milestone within the project lifecycle. Lower numbers occur earlier in the project.

products.name: risk
products.description: Transactional record of identified project risks, probability, impact, mitigation actions, and status.

attributes.name: risk_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the project risk record. Primary key for the project risk entity.

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the transportation project to which this risk is associated. Links to the parent project in SAP PS or HiCAMS.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Human-readable unique risk number or code assigned to this risk for tracking and reference purposes.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Brief descriptive title or name of the identified risk.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the risk event, including potential causes, conditions, and circumstances that could trigger the risk.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: Classification of the risk by type or domain area (e.g., technical, schedule, cost, environmental, regulatory, safety, ROW, utility, weather, resource, stakeholder).

attributes.name: subcategory
attributes.description: More granular classification within the risk category to provide additional context for risk analysis and reporting.

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: Origin or source of the risk identification (e.g., risk workshop, project team, stakeholder input, historical data, audit finding).

attributes.name: identified_date
attributes.description: Date when the risk was first identified and documented in the risk register.

attributes.name: identified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or team who identified the risk.

attributes.name: probability
attributes.description: Likelihood or probability that the risk event will occur, typically expressed as a qualitative rating (very low, low, medium, high, very high).

attributes.name: probability_score
attributes.description: Numerical probability score representing the likelihood of risk occurrence, typically on a scale (e.g., 0.0 to 1.0 or 1 to 10).

attributes.name: impact
attributes.description: Severity or magnitude of the consequence if the risk event occurs, typically expressed as a qualitative rating (very low, low, medium, high, very high).

attributes.name: impact_score
attributes.description: Numerical impact score representing the severity of consequences if the risk occurs, typically on a scale (e.g., 1 to 10).

attributes.name: score
attributes.description: Overall risk score calculated from probability and impact (typically probability_score × impact_score) to prioritize risks.

attributes.name: rating
attributes.description: Qualitative risk rating derived from the risk score, used for prioritization and escalation (e.g., low, medium, high, critical).

attributes.name: schedule_impact_days
attributes.description: Estimated number of days the project schedule could be delayed if this risk materializes.

attributes.name: cost_impact_amount
attributes.description: Estimated financial impact or additional cost to the project if this risk materializes, expressed in US dollars.

attributes.name: scope_impact_description
attributes.description: Description of how the risk could affect project scope, deliverables, or quality if it occurs.

attributes.name: owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or organizational unit responsible for monitoring and managing this risk.

attributes.name: owner_email
attributes.description: Email address of the risk owner for communication and escalation purposes.

attributes.name: owner_phone
attributes.description: Contact phone number of the risk owner for urgent communication regarding the risk.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the risk (e.g., identified, assessed, active, mitigated, closed, accepted, transferred, escalated, monitoring).

attributes.name: response_strategy
attributes.description: Planned risk response strategy (e.g., avoid, mitigate, transfer, accept, escalate for threats; exploit, share, enhance for opportunities).

attributes.name: mitigation_plan
attributes.description: Detailed description of the actions, strategies, or controls planned or implemented to reduce the probability or impact of the risk.

attributes.name: mitigation_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or team responsible for executing the mitigation plan.

attributes.name: mitigation_start_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual start date for implementing the risk mitigation actions.

attributes.name: mitigation_target_date
attributes.description: Target or planned completion date for the risk mitigation actions.

attributes.name: mitigation_actual_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the risk mitigation actions were completed.

attributes.name: mitigation_cost
attributes.description: Estimated or actual cost of implementing the risk mitigation actions, expressed in US dollars.

attributes.name: mitigation_effectiveness
attributes.description: Assessment of how effective the mitigation actions have been in reducing the risk (e.g., not started, in progress, effective, partially effective, ineffective).

attributes.name: contingency_plan
attributes.description: Contingency or fallback plan to be executed if the risk occurs despite mitigation efforts.

attributes.name: contingency_trigger
attributes.description: Specific conditions, events, or indicators that would trigger activation of the contingency plan.

attributes.name: contingency_budget
attributes.description: Budget amount allocated or reserved for implementing the contingency plan if the risk materializes, expressed in US dollars.

attributes.name: residual_probability
attributes.description: Expected probability of the risk occurring after mitigation actions have been implemented.

attributes.name: residual_impact
attributes.description: Expected impact severity of the risk after mitigation actions have been implemented.

attributes.name: residual_risk_score
attributes.description: Calculated risk score after mitigation, representing the remaining risk exposure.

attributes.name: occurred_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the risk event has actually occurred (true) or remains a potential risk (false).

attributes.name: occurrence_date
attributes.description: Date when the risk event actually occurred, if applicable.

attributes.name: actual_impact_description
attributes.description: Description of the actual impact and consequences experienced when the risk occurred.

attributes.name: actual_cost_impact
attributes.description: Actual financial impact incurred when the risk occurred, expressed in US dollars.

attributes.name: actual_schedule_impact_days
attributes.description: Actual number of days the project schedule was delayed when the risk occurred.

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date when the risk was formally closed, either because it was successfully mitigated, no longer applicable, or the risk event passed.

attributes.name: closure_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or justification for closing the risk record.

attributes.name: escalation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the risk requires escalation to senior management or executive leadership.

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: Date when the risk was escalated to higher management levels.

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: Management level or authority to which the risk has been escalated (e.g., project manager, division head, executive leadership).

attributes.description: Date when the risk was last reviewed and assessed by the project team or risk owner.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next risk review and reassessment.

attributes.description: Unique identifier of the risk record in the source system for traceability and reconciliation.

products.name: stakeholder_engagement
products.description: This association product represents the formal engagement relationship between a transportation project and a stakeholder entity. It captures the stakeholder's role, engagement requirements, notification obligations, and approval authority for each specific project. Each record links one project to one stakeholder with attributes that exist only in the context of this project-stakeholder relationship.. Existence Justification: In NCDOT transportation project delivery, projects routinely engage multiple stakeholders (MPOs, RPOs, local governments, utilities, property owners, regulatory agencies, community groups), and each stakeholder entity participates in multiple projects across their jurisdiction or area of interest. Public involvement coordinators and project managers actively manage these engagement relationships, tracking each stakeholder's specific role, required engagement level, notification obligations, and approval authority on a per-project basis for regulatory compliance (NEPA, SEPA, federal aid requirements) and coordination purposes.

products.name: activity
products.description: Master reference table for activity. Referenced by activity_id.

attributes.name: activity_id
attributes.description: Primary key for activity

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Standard alphanumeric code representing the activity type in project management systems. Used for classification and reporting across STIP/TIP programming and project delivery phases.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the transportation project activity. Human-readable identifier used in project schedules and reporting.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the activity scope, purpose, and deliverables within the transportation project lifecycle.

attributes.name: duration_days

attributes.name: effort_hours

attributes.name: is_critical_path

attributes.name: requires_approval

attributes.name: approval_authority

attributes.name: environmental_review_required

attributes.name: deliverable_type

attributes.name: predecessor_dependency_type

attributes.name: status

attributes.name: effective_end_date

products.name: calendar

attributes.name: fiscal_year

domains.name: ferry

products.name: vessel

attributes.name: vessel_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each ferry vessel in the NCDOT fleet. Primary key for vessel master records.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Official name of the ferry vessel as registered with maritime authorities.

attributes.name: hull_number
attributes.description: Unique hull identification number assigned by the manufacturer or maritime authority for vessel identification and tracking.

attributes.description: Official vessel documentation number issued by the US Coast Guard for federally documented vessels.

attributes.name: official_number
attributes.description: Official number permanently assigned to the vessel by the Coast Guard upon initial documentation.

attributes.name: call_sign

attributes.description: Seven-digit ship identification number assigned by the International Maritime Organization for vessels engaged in international voyages.

attributes.name: mmsi
attributes.description: Nine-digit number used by maritime digital selective calling, automatic identification systems, and other radio applications.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the ferry vessel based on its design and operational purpose.

attributes.name: class
attributes.description: Specific class designation of the vessel based on design specifications and operational characteristics.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the ferry vessel indicating its availability for service.

attributes.name: port_of_registry
attributes.description: Official port where the vessel is registered with maritime authorities.

attributes.name: home_port
attributes.description: Primary port or terminal where the vessel is based for operational purposes.

attributes.name: builder_name
attributes.description: Name of the shipyard or manufacturer that constructed the vessel.

attributes.name: builder_location

attributes.name: build_year
attributes.description: Calendar year in which the vessel construction was completed.

attributes.name: keel_laid_date

attributes.name: launch_date

attributes.name: beam_ft

attributes.name: draft_ft

attributes.name: net_tonnage
attributes.description: Measure of the useful internal volume of the vessel available for cargo and passengers expressed in register tons.

attributes.name: displacement_tons

attributes.name: deadweight_tonnage
attributes.description: Maximum weight of cargo, fuel, passengers, and supplies that the vessel can safely carry, measured in tons.

attributes.name: vehicle_deck_lanes

attributes.name: crew_capacity

attributes.name: hull_material

attributes.name: hull_configuration

attributes.name: main_engine_model

attributes.name: main_engine_count

attributes.name: total_horsepower

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: Type of fuel used by the vessel propulsion and auxiliary systems.

attributes.name: fuel_capacity_gallons

attributes.name: max_speed_knots
attributes.description: Maximum operational speed the vessel can achieve measured in nautical miles per hour (knots).

attributes.name: service_speed_knots

attributes.description: Indicates whether the vessel is equipped with bow thruster for enhanced maneuverability.

attributes.name: stern_thruster_installed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vessel is equipped with stern thruster for enhanced maneuverability.

attributes.name: ada_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vessel meets ADA accessibility requirements for passengers with disabilities.

attributes.name: elevator_installed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vessel is equipped with an elevator for passenger accessibility between decks.

attributes.name: restroom_count
attributes.description: Total number of passenger restroom facilities available on the vessel.

attributes.name: ada_restroom_count
attributes.description: Number of restroom facilities that meet ADA accessibility standards.

attributes.name: passenger_deck_count
attributes.description: Number of decks available for passenger accommodation and movement.

attributes.name: enclosed_passenger_area_sqft

attributes.description: Type of climate control system installed for passenger comfort.

attributes.name: fire_suppression_system
attributes.description: Type of fire detection and suppression system installed on the vessel.

attributes.name: lifeboat_count
attributes.description: Number of lifeboats carried on the vessel for emergency evacuation.

attributes.name: life_raft_count
attributes.description: Number of inflatable life rafts carried on the vessel for emergency evacuation.

attributes.name: life_jacket_capacity
attributes.description: Total number of life jackets stored on the vessel for passenger and crew safety.
attributes.references: CFR Title 46 Subchapter Q - Lifesaving Equipment

attributes.name: radar_system_installed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vessel is equipped with marine radar for navigation and collision avoidance.

attributes.name: gps_system_installed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vessel is equipped with GPS navigation system.

attributes.name: ais_system_installed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vessel is equipped with AIS for vessel tracking and collision avoidance.

attributes.name: vhf_radio_installed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vessel is equipped with VHF marine radio for communication.

attributes.name: epirb_installed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Emergency Position Indicating Radio Beacon (EPIRB) Installed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vessel is equipped with EPIRB for emergency distress signaling.

attributes.name: cctv_system_installed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vessel is equipped with CCTV cameras for security and monitoring.

attributes.name: wifi_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vessel provides wireless internet connectivity for passengers.

attributes.name: concession_area_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vessel has a designated area for food and beverage concessions.

attributes.name: inspection_certificate_number

attributes.name: inspection_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the current Coast Guard inspection certificate expires and renewal is required.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date

attributes.name: last_drydock_date

attributes.name: last_major_refit_date

attributes.name: insurance_value

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number

attributes.name: insurance_expiration_date

attributes.name: useful_life_years

attributes.name: condition_rating

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_tier

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: vehicle_registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to dmv.registration. Business justification: Ferry vessels are motor vehicles requiring DMV registration under NC law. DMV tracks vessel registration, title, and compliance. Ferry operations verify current registration status daily for regulator

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to dmv.vehicle. Business justification: Ferry vessels are classified as vehicles in DMV system with VIN, make, model, year. DMV maintains master vehicle record. Ferry domain references DMV vehicle data for inspections and regulatory reporti

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project. Business justification: Ferry vessels undergo capital improvement projects (engine overhauls, hull repairs, refurbishments). Each vessel maintenance/upgrade project must track which vessel is being worked on for scheduling a

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to environmental.permit. Business justification: Ferry vessels require environmental permits (ballast water discharge, air emissions, oil spill prevention) to operate legally. Operations division verifies permit compliance before vessel deployment.

attributes.name: grant_award_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grant.award. Business justification: Ferry vessels are often acquired or upgraded using federal/state transportation grants (FTA, BUILD, INFRA). NCDOT tracks which grant funded each vessel for compliance reporting and asset management.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Each ferry vessel operates as a distinct cost center for tracking operational expenses (fuel, maintenance, crew). Finance department uses this for budget allocation and performance reporting.

attributes.name: maintenance_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.contract. Business justification: Ferry vessels require ongoing maintenance contracts with specialized marine service vendors. Operations teams reference active maintenance contracts for scheduled dry-dock repairs, engine overhauls, a

attributes.name: captain_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Every ferry vessel has an assigned captain who is an NCDOT employee. Operations and safety regulations require tracking the responsible captain for each vessel.

attributes.name: feature_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gis.feature. Business justification: Vessel tracking requires real-time geospatial positioning. Operations center monitors vessel locations on GIS maps for safety, scheduling, and customer information systems showing live ferry positions

attributes.name: check_in_timestamp

attributes.name: cancellation_reason

attributes.name: special_needs_flag

attributes.name: special_needs_description

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vehicle is carrying hazardous materials requiring special handling.

attributes.name: hazmat_class

attributes.name: commercial_account_number
attributes.description: Account number for commercial customers with billing arrangements.

attributes.name: discount_code

attributes.name: discount_amount

attributes.name: refund_amount

attributes.name: refund_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the refund was processed.

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: priority_boarding_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reservation qualifies for priority boarding privileges.

attributes.name: waitlist_position
attributes.description: Position in the waitlist queue if the sailing was fully booked at time of reservation.

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: passenger_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the registered customer account if the passenger has an account in the system.

attributes.name: group_reservation_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking this reservation to a group booking if part of a larger party.

attributes.name: vessel_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific ferry vessel assigned to the sailing at time of reservation.

attributes.name: space_allocation_type
attributes.description: Type of space allocated on the vessel for this reservation.

attributes.name: loyalty_program_number

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone

attributes.name: driver_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to dmv.driver. Business justification: Vehicle reservations on ferries require valid NC driver's license for vehicle operator. Ferry staff verify driver license status at check-in. DMV driver record provides authoritative identity and lice

attributes.name: connecting_trip_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to transit.trip. Business justification: Passengers book ferry reservations with connecting transit trips for seamless multimodal journeys. Trip planning systems use this to coordinate ferry-to-bus/rail transfers at terminals.

attributes.name: accounts_receivable_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.accounts_receivable_invoice. Business justification: Paid ferry reservations generate accounts receivable invoices for revenue recognition. Finance department reconciles reservation payments against AR invoices daily for revenue accounting.

products.name: group_reservation
products.description: Master reference table for group_reservation. Referenced by group_reservation_id.

attributes.name: group_reservation_id
attributes.description: Primary key for group_reservation

attributes.name: reservation_number
attributes.description: Human-readable unique reservation number assigned to the group booking. Format: GR followed by 8 digits.

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: Name of the organization, school, church, or group making the reservation.

attributes.name: contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary contact person responsible for the group reservation.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for the group reservation contact person.

attributes.name: contact_email
