attributes.name: alternate_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the secondary contact person for the group reservation.

attributes.name: alternate_contact_phone
attributes.description: Secondary phone number for the alternate group reservation contact.

attributes.name: route_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific ferry route for this group reservation (e.g., HAT for Hatteras, OCR for Ocracoke).

attributes.name: departure_terminal
attributes.description: Name of the ferry terminal where the group will board the vessel.

attributes.name: arrival_terminal
attributes.description: Name of the ferry terminal where the group will disembark from the vessel.

attributes.name: scheduled_departure_date
attributes.description: Date when the group is scheduled to depart on the ferry. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: scheduled_departure_time
attributes.description: Time when the group is scheduled to depart on the ferry. Format: HH:mm (24-hour).

attributes.name: scheduled_return_date
attributes.description: Date when the group is scheduled to return on the ferry (for round-trip reservations). Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: scheduled_return_time
attributes.description: Time when the group is scheduled to return on the ferry (for round-trip reservations). Format: HH:mm (24-hour).

attributes.name: trip_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the group reservation is for a one-way or round-trip journey.

attributes.name: passenger_count
attributes.description: Total number of passengers in the group reservation.

attributes.name: vehicle_count
attributes.description: Total number of vehicles included in the group reservation.

attributes.name: vehicle_type
attributes.description: Primary type of vehicles in the group reservation (bus for school/tour buses, van for passenger vans, mixed for multiple types).

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Category of the group making the reservation (e.g., school field trip, church group, corporate event, tour operator).

attributes.name: reservation_date
attributes.description: Date when the group reservation was created or booked. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: reservation_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the group reservation was created. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the group reservation (pending approval, confirmed, cancelled by customer, completed successfully, or no-show).

attributes.name: confirmation_number
attributes.description: Unique confirmation code provided to the group upon reservation approval.

attributes.name: confirmation_date
attributes.description: Date when the group reservation was confirmed by ferry operations staff. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date when the group reservation was cancelled. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or reason provided for cancelling the group reservation.

attributes.name: special_requirements
attributes.description: Any special accommodations or requirements for the group (e.g., wheelchair accessibility, oversized vehicles, special assistance).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments about the group reservation from staff or the customer.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Status of payment for the group reservation (many group reservations may be free or require advance payment).

attributes.name: total_fare_amount
attributes.description: Total fare amount charged for the group reservation in US dollars.

attributes.name: discount_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether a discount was applied to the group reservation fare.

attributes.name: discount_type
attributes.description: Type of discount applied to the group reservation (e.g., school group discount, government rate, military discount).

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name of the ferry operations staff member who approved the group reservation.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the group reservation was approved by ferry operations staff. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: vessel_assigned
attributes.description: Name of the specific ferry vessel assigned to transport the group.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the group reservation (standard for regular groups, high for government/emergency services, emergency for critical transport needs).

attributes.name: billing_address
attributes.description: Mailing address for billing purposes related to the group reservation.

attributes.name: organization_tax_id
attributes.description: Federal tax identification number (EIN) for the organization making the group reservation, if applicable.

attributes.name: advance_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days in advance the group reservation was made before the scheduled departure date.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: System or channel through which the group reservation was created (web portal, phone reservation, email request, walk-in at terminal, or partner booking system).

products.name: route
products.description: Master reference table for route. Referenced by route_id.

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Primary key for route

attributes.name: route_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code used to identify the ferry route in operational systems and schedules.

attributes.name: route_name
attributes.description: Official name of the ferry route, typically indicating the origin and destination terminals.

attributes.name: origin_terminal_name
attributes.description: Name of the terminal where the ferry route begins.

attributes.name: destination_terminal_name
attributes.description: Name of the terminal where the ferry route ends.

attributes.name: route_type
attributes.description: Classification of the ferry route based on the type of waterway traversed.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the ferry route.

attributes.name: distance_nautical_miles
attributes.description: Total distance of the ferry route measured in nautical miles from origin to destination terminal.

attributes.name: estimated_crossing_time_minutes
attributes.description: Standard estimated time in minutes for a ferry to complete the route under normal operating conditions.

attributes.name: service_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency pattern of ferry service on this route.

attributes.name: seasonal_start_date
attributes.description: Start date for seasonal ferry routes. Null for year-round routes.

attributes.name: seasonal_end_date
attributes.description: End date for seasonal ferry routes. Null for year-round routes.

attributes.name: maximum_vessel_capacity_vehicles
attributes.description: Maximum number of vehicles that can be accommodated on the largest vessel assigned to this route.

attributes.name: maximum_vessel_capacity_passengers
attributes.description: Maximum number of passengers that can be accommodated on the largest vessel assigned to this route.

attributes.name: toll_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a toll or fare is required for passengers or vehicles using this route.

attributes.name: reservation_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether advance reservations are available for this ferry route.

attributes.name: ada_accessible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the route is served by vessels that are fully accessible to passengers with disabilities in compliance with ADA requirements.

attributes.name: hazmat_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether vehicles carrying hazardous materials are permitted on this route.

attributes.name: commercial_vehicle_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether commercial vehicles such as trucks and buses are permitted on this route.

attributes.name: oversized_vehicle_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether oversized vehicles exceeding standard dimensions are permitted on this route.

attributes.name: maximum_vehicle_length_feet
attributes.description: Maximum length in feet for vehicles permitted on this route.

attributes.name: maximum_vehicle_weight_tons
attributes.description: Maximum weight in tons for vehicles permitted on this route.

attributes.name: weather_dependent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the route is subject to cancellations or delays due to weather conditions such as high winds, fog, or rough seas.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification of the route for resource allocation and emergency response purposes.

attributes.name: alternate_route_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether an alternate land or ferry route is available if this route is suspended.

attributes.name: service_start_date
attributes.description: Date when ferry service on this route was first established.

attributes.name: service_end_date
attributes.description: Date when ferry service on this route was permanently discontinued. Null for active routes.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the ferry route including notable features, landmarks, and operational considerations.

attributes.name: operating_authority
attributes.description: Name of the division or authority within NCDOT responsible for operating this ferry route.

attributes.name: coast_guard_approval_number
attributes.description: US Coast Guard approval or certification number for the ferry route if required for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: environmental_restrictions
attributes.description: Description of any environmental restrictions or protected areas that impact route operations, such as marine sanctuaries or wildlife protection zones.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent safety or operational inspection of the route and its terminals.

attributes.name: next_inspection_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next safety or operational inspection of the route and its terminals.

domains.name: transit
domains.description: Public transit coordination, funding administration, and multimodal transportation services. Manages FTA grant programs, transit system support, and coordination with MPO/RPO planning organizations for statewide transit service.

products.name: route
products.description: Master record for each transit route, including route identifier, short and long names, type (bus, rail, ferry), and operational attributes. Also consolidates: ferry.route, transit.route.

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the transit route. Primary key for the route entity.

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Short public-facing name or number for the route (e.g., '40', 'Blue Line'). Used on signage and schedules.

attributes.name: long_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the route including origin and destination (e.g., 'Downtown to Airport Express').

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the route including service characteristics, major stops, and operational notes.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Type of transit service provided on this route (bus, rail, ferry, etc.). Aligns with GTFS route type classifications.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: Hexadecimal color code used to represent the route on maps and signage (e.g., 'FF0000' for red).

attributes.name: text_color
attributes.description: Hexadecimal color code for text displayed on route color background to ensure readability.

attributes.name: url
attributes.description: Web URL providing detailed information about the specific route for public access.

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Numeric value used to order routes for display in schedules and public information systems.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the route indicating whether it is in service, temporarily suspended, or permanently discontinued.

attributes.name: service_level
attributes.description: Classification of service level indicating stop frequency and speed (local stops at all stations, express skips stops, etc.).

attributes.name: operator_name
attributes.description: Name of the transit agency or contractor operating this route.

attributes.name: operator_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the transit operator for reporting and coordination purposes.

attributes.name: mpo_name
attributes.description: Name of the MPO responsible for transportation planning in the region where this route operates.

attributes.name: rpo_name
attributes.description: Name of the RPO responsible for transportation planning in rural areas where this route operates.

attributes.name: service_area
attributes.description: Geographic description of the area served by this route (e.g., 'Wake County', 'Triangle Region').

attributes.name: origin_location
attributes.description: Name or description of the starting point/terminal for the route.

attributes.name: destination_location
attributes.description: Name or description of the ending point/terminal for the route.

attributes.name: length_miles
attributes.description: Total length of the route in miles from origin to destination.

attributes.name: average_trip_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Average time in minutes for a complete trip from origin to destination under normal operating conditions.

attributes.name: number_of_stops
attributes.description: Total count of designated stops along the route where passengers can board or alight.

attributes.name: bidirectional_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the route operates in both directions (true) or is unidirectional (false).

attributes.name: wheelchair_accessible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the route is fully wheelchair accessible in compliance with ADA requirements.

attributes.name: bike_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether bicycles are permitted on vehicles operating this route.

attributes.name: fare_type
attributes.description: Type of fare structure applied to this route (flat rate, zone-based, distance-based, etc.).

attributes.name: base_fare_amount
attributes.description: Standard base fare amount in US dollars for a single trip on this route.

attributes.name: peak_fare_amount
attributes.description: Fare amount in US dollars charged during peak travel periods if differential pricing applies.

attributes.name: service_frequency_peak_minutes
attributes.description: Average time interval in minutes between vehicle departures during peak service hours.

attributes.name: service_frequency_offpeak_minutes
attributes.description: Average time interval in minutes between vehicle departures during off-peak service hours.

attributes.name: weekday_service_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the route operates on weekdays (Monday through Friday).

attributes.name: saturday_service_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the route operates on Saturdays.

attributes.name: sunday_service_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the route operates on Sundays.

attributes.name: holiday_service_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the route operates on designated public holidays.

attributes.name: seasonal_service_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the route operates only during specific seasons (e.g., summer tourist routes).

attributes.name: service_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the route first began operation or current service configuration started.

attributes.name: service_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the route service ended or is scheduled to end (null for ongoing routes).

attributes.name: first_departure_time
attributes.description: Time of the first scheduled departure from the origin terminal in HH:MM format.

attributes.name: last_departure_time
attributes.description: Time of the last scheduled departure from the origin terminal in HH:MM format.

attributes.name: vehicle_capacity
attributes.description: Standard passenger capacity of vehicles typically assigned to this route.

attributes.name: vehicle_type
attributes.description: Type of vehicle typically used to operate this route.

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: Primary fuel type used by vehicles operating on this route.

attributes.name: ada_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the route fully complies with Americans with Disabilities Act accessibility requirements.

attributes.name: real_time_tracking_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether vehicles on this route are equipped with GPS/AVL for real-time passenger information.

attributes.name: fta_grant_funded_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route receives Federal Transit Administration grant funding.

attributes.name: fta_grant_program
attributes.description: Name of the specific FTA grant program funding this route (e.g., Section 5307, Section 5311).

attributes.name: annual_operating_cost
attributes.description: Total annual operating cost in US dollars for maintaining service on this route.

attributes.name: annual_ridership
attributes.description: Total number of passenger boardings on this route during the most recent fiscal year.

attributes.name: average_daily_ridership
attributes.description: Average number of passenger boardings per service day on this route.

attributes.name: on_time_performance_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of trips completing service within the defined on-time window (typically within 5 minutes of schedule).

attributes.name: safety_incident_count_annual
attributes.description: Total number of reportable safety incidents on this route during the most recent fiscal year.

attributes.name: environmental_justice_route_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route primarily serves environmental justice communities as defined by federal guidelines.

attributes.name: title_vi_protected_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route is subject to Title VI civil rights protections due to service to minority populations.

attributes.name: contract_operator_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route is operated by a contracted third-party provider rather than directly by NCDOT.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Reference number for the contract governing operation of this route if operated by a contractor.

attributes.name: contract_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the current operating contract for this route expires.

attributes.name: ncdot_division
attributes.description: NCDOT organizational division responsible for oversight of this route (e.g., Division of Public Transportation).

attributes.name: manager_name
attributes.description: Name of the NCDOT staff member or contractor responsible for managing this route.

attributes.name: manager_email
attributes.description: Email address of the route manager for operational coordination and communication.

attributes.name: manager_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the route manager for operational coordination and emergency contact.

attributes.name: gtfs_route_id
attributes.description: Unique route identifier used in General Transit Feed Specification (GTFS) data feeds for public consumption.

attributes.name: ntd_route_id
attributes.description: Route identifier used for reporting to the Federal Transit Administration National Transit Database.

attributes.name: last_service_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent comprehensive service review or performance evaluation for this route.

attributes.name: next_service_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next comprehensive service review or performance evaluation.

attributes.name: public_comment_period_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route is currently subject to a public comment period for proposed service changes.

attributes.name: major_service_change_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route has undergone or is planned for a major service change requiring Title VI analysis.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the current route configuration or service parameters became effective.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date when the route record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: operator_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rail.rail_operator. Business justification: Transit routes operated by rail operators (commuter rail, light rail) must reference the rail operator entity. NCDOT manages both bus and rail transit services, requiring this link for operational ove

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Each transit route operates as a distinct cost center for budgeting and expense tracking. Finance allocates operational costs (fuel, maintenance, labor) by route for performance analysis.

attributes.name: map_layer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gis.map_layer. Business justification: Transit routes are visualized on specific GIS map layers for public-facing route maps, planning analysis, and operational dashboards. Transportation planners use this daily to display route networks s

attributes.name: grant_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grant.program. Business justification: Transit routes are funded by specific grant programs (FTA 5307, 5311). Operations staff track which grant program funds each route for compliance reporting and budget allocation.

products.name: stop
products.description: Master record for every transit stop or station, with location coordinates, stop name, accessibility features, and parent agency.

attributes.name: stop_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the transit stop or station. Primary key for the stop entity.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short text or number that uniquely identifies the stop for riders. Often displayed on signage or used in rider-facing applications.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the transit stop or station as displayed to riders. This is the primary identifier used in schedules and announcements.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Additional descriptive information about the stop location, such as cross streets, landmarks, or other helpful details for riders.

attributes.name: zone_id
attributes.description: Identifies the fare zone for the stop. Used to calculate fare requirements for trips that cross zone boundaries.

attributes.name: url
attributes.description: URL of a web page providing additional information about the specific stop, such as real-time arrival information or amenities.

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Indicates the type of location: stop (default boarding location), station (physical structure containing stops), entrance/exit, generic node, or boarding area.

attributes.name: parent_station_id
attributes.description: For stops located within a station, this identifies the parent station. Used to group multiple platforms or boarding areas under a single station.

attributes.name: timezone
attributes.description: Timezone in which the stop is located. Inherits from agency timezone if not specified. Uses IANA timezone database format.
attributes.references: GTFS (General Transit Feed Specification), IANA Time Zone Database

attributes.name: wheelchair_boarding
attributes.description: Indicates whether wheelchair boarding is possible at this stop. Supports ADA compliance tracking and rider accessibility planning.
attributes.references: GTFS (General Transit Feed Specification), ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act)

attributes.name: level_id
attributes.description: Identifies the level of the stop within a station (e.g., mezzanine, platform). Used for multi-level stations to help riders navigate.

attributes.name: platform_code
attributes.description: Platform identifier for stops located at a station. Displayed to riders to help them find the correct boarding location.

attributes.name: street_address
attributes.description: The physical street address of the transit stop, including street number and name.

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: Two-letter state abbreviation for the transit stop location. For NCDOT, typically NC.

attributes.name: zip_code
attributes.description: The postal ZIP code for the transit stop location. Supports demographic analysis and service area planning.

attributes.name: stakeholder_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the MPO jurisdiction in which the stop is located. Used for coordinating transit planning with regional transportation planning organizations.
attributes.references: FTA (Federal Transit Administration), FHWA (Federal Highway Administration)

attributes.name: rpo_stakeholder_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the RPO jurisdiction in which the stop is located. Used for coordinating transit planning in rural areas.
attributes.references: FTA (Federal Transit Administration), FHWA (Federal Highway Administration)

attributes.name: transit_agency_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the transit agency or operator responsible for service at this stop. Links stop to the operating agency.
attributes.references: FTA (Federal Transit Administration), GTFS (General Transit Feed Specification)

attributes.name: transit_agency_name
attributes.description: Name of the transit agency or operator responsible for service at this stop.

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Indicates the ownership of the transit stop infrastructure (NCDOT-owned, locally-owned, privately-owned, or shared).

attributes.name: shelter_present
attributes.description: Indicates whether a shelter or covered waiting area is present at the stop. Important for rider comfort and ADA compliance.

attributes.name: bench_present
attributes.description: Indicates whether seating (bench) is available at the stop. Supports accessibility and rider comfort.

attributes.name: lighting_present
attributes.description: Indicates whether lighting is installed at the stop for safety and visibility during evening and night service.
attributes.references: AASHTO (American Association of State Highway and Transportation Officials)

attributes.name: trash_receptacle_present
attributes.description: Indicates whether a trash receptacle is available at the stop for rider convenience and cleanliness.

attributes.name: bike_rack_present
attributes.description: Indicates whether bicycle parking facilities are available at the stop. Supports multimodal transportation integration.

attributes.name: bike_rack_capacity
attributes.description: Number of bicycles that can be accommodated at the bike rack facility. Used for capacity planning and multimodal integration.

attributes.name: real_time_display_present
attributes.description: Indicates whether a real-time arrival information display is installed at the stop. Enhances rider experience and service transparency.

attributes.name: ada_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Compliance Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stop meets ADA accessibility requirements, including accessible paths, boarding areas, and signage.
attributes.references: ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act), CFR Title 49 Part 37

attributes.name: sidewalk_connection
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stop has a connected sidewalk providing safe pedestrian access. Critical for ADA compliance and pedestrian safety.
attributes.references: ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act), MUTCD (Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices)

attributes.name: crosswalk_present
attributes.description: Indicates whether a marked crosswalk is present near the stop for safe pedestrian crossing.
attributes.references: MUTCD (Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices)

attributes.name: parking_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether parking facilities are available at or near the stop for park-and-ride service.

attributes.name: parking_capacity
attributes.description: Number of parking spaces available at the stop for park-and-ride service. Used for capacity planning and demand management.

attributes.name: signage_type
attributes.description: Type of signage installed at the stop (standard pole sign, enhanced wayfinding, digital display, or none).
attributes.references: MUTCD (Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices)

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date when the transit stop was originally installed and put into service.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent inspection of the stop infrastructure and amenities. Used for maintenance tracking and compliance.

attributes.name: next_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date when the next inspection of the stop is scheduled. Supports proactive maintenance planning.

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date when maintenance was last performed on the stop infrastructure or amenities.

attributes.name: condition_rating
attributes.description: Overall condition assessment of the stop infrastructure and amenities. Used for prioritizing maintenance and capital improvements.
attributes.references: FTA (Federal Transit Administration) State of Good Repair

attributes.name: ridership_category
attributes.description: Classification of the stop based on ridership volume (high, medium, or low). Used for service planning and amenity prioritization.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Type of transit service provided at this stop (fixed route, demand response, commuter, express, or local).
attributes.references: FTA (Federal Transit Administration), GTFS (General Transit Feed Specification)

attributes.name: route_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct transit routes that serve this stop. Indicates the connectivity and importance of the stop in the network.

attributes.name: transfer_point
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stop serves as a designated transfer point between routes or services.

attributes.name: park_and_ride
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stop is designated as a park-and-ride facility with parking for commuters.

attributes.name: fta_asset_id
attributes.description: FTA-assigned identifier for the transit stop asset. Used for federal reporting and grant compliance tracking.
attributes.references: FTA (Federal Transit Administration) National Transit Database

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Primary funding source used for the construction or improvement of the stop (e.g., FTA Section 5307, STIP, local funds).
attributes.references: FTA (Federal Transit Administration), NCGS (North Carolina General Statutes)

attributes.name: grant_program
attributes.description: Specific federal grant program that funded the stop construction or improvement (e.g., Section 5307, Section 5310, CMAQ).
attributes.references: FTA (Federal Transit Administration), FHWA (Federal Highway Administration)

attributes.name: project_number
attributes.description: NCDOT project number associated with the construction or improvement of the transit stop. Links to STIP and project management systems.

attributes.name: gis_feature_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the stop in the NCDOT GIS system. Used for spatial analysis and mapping integration.

attributes.name: census_tract
attributes.description: Census tract in which the stop is located. Used for demographic analysis and Title VI compliance reporting.
attributes.references: US Census Bureau, FTA Title VI Requirements

attributes.name: census_block_group
attributes.description: Census block group in which the stop is located. Provides finer geographic resolution for demographic analysis.

attributes.name: environmental_justice_area
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stop is located in an environmental justice area (low-income or minority population). Used for Title VI and equity analysis.
attributes.references: FTA Title VI Requirements, NEPA (National Environmental Policy Act)

attributes.name: title_vi_protected
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stop serves a Title VI protected population. Used for civil rights compliance and equity monitoring.
attributes.references: FTA Title VI Requirements, Civil Rights Act of 1964

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when the stop record was created in the system.

attributes.name: modified_date
attributes.description: Date when the stop record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the current stop information became effective. Supports historical tracking and temporal analysis.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the current stop information expires or is superseded. Used for managing historical records and planned changes.

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to highway.segment. Business justification: Transit stops are physically located along highway segments. NCDOT needs this to coordinate road construction impacts on transit operations, plan bus pullouts, and manage right-of-way access for publi

attributes.name: signal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to traffic.signal. Business justification: Transit stops at major intersections are coordinated with traffic signals for pedestrian crossings and bus priority timing. Traffic operations uses this to implement transit signal priority (TSP) syst

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project. Business justification: Transit stops/shelters are built through infrastructure projects (ADA upgrades, new shelter installations, stop relocations). Maintenance and capital planning departments track which project created o

attributes.name: grade_crossing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rail.grade_crossing. Business justification: Transit stops at rail grade crossings require coordination for safety and scheduling. NCDOT transit operations must reference specific grade crossings where buses cross active rail lines for safety pr

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.location. Business justification: Transit stops are physical infrastructure at specific locations. Asset management tracks stop shelters, benches, and signage at these locations for maintenance, inspection, and capital planning.

attributes.name: feature_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gis.feature. Business justification: Each transit stop is a geographic feature with precise spatial coordinates. GIS feature stores authoritative location data, eliminating redundant coordinate storage. Used for stop location mapping and

attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rightofway.parcel. Business justification: Transit stops are physically located on specific right-of-way parcels. Facilities management requires this link to verify legal access, coordinate maintenance, manage property improvements, and ensure

products.name: transit_schedule
products.description: Definition of scheduled service times for a route, including headway, service days, and calendar exceptions.

attributes.name: transit_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the transit schedule record. Primary key for the transit schedule entity.

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the transit route to which this schedule applies. Links schedule to specific route definition.

attributes.name: route_name
attributes.description: Public-facing name or number of the transit route (e.g., Route 15, Blue Line Express).

attributes.name: service_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the service pattern (e.g., weekday, weekend, holiday) that defines when this schedule is active.

attributes.name: service_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name for the service pattern (e.g., Weekday Service, Saturday Service, Holiday Service).

attributes.name: trip_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for a specific trip within the schedule. A trip represents one vehicle traveling along a route.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Direction of travel for the trip (e.g., inbound, outbound, northbound).

attributes.name: block_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the block of trips that a single vehicle operates. Used for vehicle and operator scheduling.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when this schedule becomes effective and service begins.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when this schedule expires and service ends.

attributes.name: monday_service_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether service operates on Mondays under this schedule.

attributes.name: tuesday_service_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether service operates on Tuesdays under this schedule.

attributes.name: wednesday_service_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether service operates on Wednesdays under this schedule.

attributes.name: thursday_service_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether service operates on Thursdays under this schedule.

attributes.name: friday_service_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether service operates on Fridays under this schedule.

attributes.name: saturday_service_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether service operates on Saturdays under this schedule.

attributes.name: sunday_service_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether service operates on Sundays under this schedule.

attributes.name: headway_minutes
attributes.description: Time interval in minutes between consecutive vehicle departures on the route during scheduled service.

attributes.name: peak_headway_minutes
attributes.description: Time interval in minutes between consecutive vehicle departures during peak service hours.

attributes.name: off_peak_headway_minutes
attributes.description: Time interval in minutes between consecutive vehicle departures during off-peak service hours.

attributes.name: first_departure_time
attributes.description: Time of the first scheduled departure for the service day in HH:MM:SS format.

attributes.name: last_departure_time
attributes.description: Time of the last scheduled departure for the service day in HH:MM:SS format.

attributes.name: peak_start_time
attributes.description: Time when peak service period begins in HH:MM:SS format.

attributes.name: peak_end_time
attributes.description: Time when peak service period ends in HH:MM:SS format.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Type of transit service provided (e.g., fixed route, demand response, express).

attributes.name: frequency_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether service operates on exact scheduled times or frequency-based intervals.

attributes.name: wheelchair_accessible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the scheduled trip is wheelchair accessible per ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) requirements.

attributes.name: bikes_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether bicycles are allowed on the scheduled trip.

attributes.name: calendar_exception_date
attributes.description: Specific date when service differs from the regular schedule (e.g., holidays, special events).

attributes.name: exception_type
attributes.description: Type of exception applied on the calendar exception date (service added, removed, or modified).

attributes.name: operator_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the transit operator or agency providing the scheduled service.

attributes.name: operator_name
attributes.description: Name of the transit operator or agency providing the scheduled service.

attributes.name: vehicle_type
attributes.description: Type of vehicle used for the scheduled service.

attributes.name: vehicle_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum passenger capacity of the vehicle assigned to the scheduled trip.

attributes.name: fare_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the fare structure applicable to this scheduled service.

attributes.name: fare_amount
attributes.description: Base fare amount charged for the scheduled trip.

attributes.name: fare_currency
attributes.description: Currency code for the fare amount (ISO 4217 standard).

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Primary funding source for the scheduled transit service (federal, state, local, or fare revenue).

attributes.name: fta_grant_program
attributes.description: Specific FTA (Federal Transit Administration) grant program funding this scheduled service (e.g., Section 5307, 5311, 5339).

attributes.name: stakeholder_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the MPO (Metropolitan Planning Organization) jurisdiction where the scheduled service operates.
attributes.references: FHWA (Federal Highway Administration) MPO (Metropolitan Planning Organization) Standards

attributes.name: rpo_stakeholder_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the RPO (Rural Planning Organization) jurisdiction where the scheduled service operates.

attributes.name: service_area
attributes.description: Geographic classification of the service area (urban, rural, suburban, or regional).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number or identifier for the schedule publication, used to track schedule changes over time.

attributes.name: publication_date
attributes.description: Date when the schedule was published and made available to the public.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the schedule (active, inactive, suspended, planned, or cancelled).

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason for schedule cancellation or suspension (e.g., weather, maintenance, low ridership).

attributes.name: real_time_updates_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether real-time service updates are available for this schedule.

attributes.name: gtfs_feed_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: GTFS (General Transit Feed Specification) Feed Identifier
attributes.description: Identifier for the GTFS (General Transit Feed Specification) data feed containing this schedule information.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments about the schedule, including special instructions or service alerts.

attributes.name: ada_compliance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) Compliance Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the scheduled service meets ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) compliance requirements.

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the scheduled service meets environmental compliance requirements under NEPA (National Environmental Policy Act) and state regulations.

attributes.name: coordination_with_other_services
attributes.description: Description of coordination with other transit services, including transfer points and connecting routes.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the schedule was officially approved by the transit authority or governing body.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or authority who approved the schedule.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date when the schedule record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number for schedule inquiries and customer service.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Email address for schedule inquiries and customer service.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: Schedule Information Website URL (Uniform Resource Locator)
attributes.description: Website URL (Uniform Resource Locator) where schedule information is published for public access.

products.name: trip
products.description: Instance of a vehicle operating on a specific route at a scheduled time, linking route, schedule, and assigned vehicle.

attributes.name: trip_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for a specific transit trip instance. Primary key for the trip entity.

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the transit route on which this trip operates. Links to the route master data.

attributes.name: service_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the service calendar pattern (weekday, weekend, holiday schedule) under which this trip operates.

attributes.name: headsign
attributes.description: Text displayed on the vehicle headsign to identify the trip destination to passengers.

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Public-facing short identifier for the trip, used in schedules and passenger information.

attributes.name: direction_id
attributes.description: Indicates the direction of travel for the trip. 0 = outbound/one direction, 1 = inbound/opposite direction.

attributes.name: direction_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name for the direction of travel (e.g., 'Northbound', 'To Downtown', 'Eastbound').

attributes.name: block_id
attributes.description: Identifies the block of sequential trips assigned to the same vehicle and operator during a service period.

attributes.name: feature_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the geographic path/alignment that the vehicle follows for this trip.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: Planned departure time from the first stop of the trip according to the published schedule.

attributes.name: scheduled_end_time
attributes.description: Planned arrival time at the final stop of the trip according to the published schedule.

attributes.name: actual_start_time
attributes.description: Actual departure time from the first stop of the trip as recorded by AVL (Automatic Vehicle Location) or operator.

attributes.name: actual_end_time
attributes.description: Actual arrival time at the final stop of the trip as recorded by AVL (Automatic Vehicle Location) or operator.

attributes.name: scheduled_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Planned duration of the trip in minutes from first stop departure to last stop arrival.

attributes.name: actual_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Actual duration of the trip in minutes from first stop departure to last stop arrival.

attributes.name: service_date
attributes.description: Operating date for which this trip is scheduled, following transit day convention (service day may extend past midnight).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the trip indicating whether it is scheduled, active, completed, or disrupted.

attributes.name: wheelchair_accessible
attributes.description: Indicates wheelchair accessibility for this trip. 0 = no information, 1 = accessible, 2 = not accessible.

attributes.name: bikes_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether bicycles are allowed on this trip. 0 = no information, 1 = allowed, 2 = not allowed.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the trip service type indicating stop pattern and service characteristics.

attributes.name: peak_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this trip operates during peak commute hours (true) or off-peak hours (false).
attributes.references: FTA Transit Capacity and Quality of Service Manual

attributes.name: fare_class
attributes.description: Fare category or pricing tier applicable to this trip (e.g., 'standard', 'express', 'premium').

attributes.name: passenger_count
attributes.description: Total number of passengers who boarded during this trip, as recorded by automatic passenger counters or manual counts.

attributes.name: boarding_count
attributes.description: Total number of passenger boardings across all stops during this trip.

attributes.name: alighting_count
attributes.description: Total number of passenger alightings (exits) across all stops during this trip.

attributes.name: max_load
attributes.description: Maximum number of passengers on board the vehicle at any point during the trip (peak load point).
attributes.references: FTA Transit Capacity and Quality of Service Manual

attributes.name: vehicle_capacity
attributes.description: Total passenger capacity of the vehicle assigned to this trip, including seated and standing capacity.
attributes.references: FTA Transit Capacity and Quality of Service Manual

attributes.name: seated_capacity
attributes.description: Number of seated passenger positions available on the vehicle for this trip.
attributes.references: FTA Transit Capacity and Quality of Service Manual

attributes.name: revenue_miles
attributes.description: Miles traveled while the vehicle is in revenue service (available to passengers) during this trip.

attributes.name: deadhead_miles
attributes.description: Miles traveled while the vehicle is not in revenue service (e.g., traveling to/from garage, repositioning).

attributes.name: revenue_hours
attributes.description: Hours the vehicle was in revenue service (available to passengers) during this trip.

attributes.name: on_time_performance_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the trip met on-time performance standards based on schedule adherence thresholds.

attributes.name: delay_minutes
attributes.description: Number of minutes the trip was delayed relative to the scheduled time. Negative values indicate early arrival.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description explaining why the trip was cancelled, if applicable.

attributes.name: diversion_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description explaining why the trip was diverted from its normal route, if applicable.

attributes.name: incident_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any safety or operational incident occurred during this trip.

attributes.name: incident_type
attributes.description: Classification of the incident that occurred during the trip (e.g., 'accident', 'breakdown', 'passenger injury').

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Prevailing weather conditions during the trip that may have affected operations.

attributes.name: traffic_condition
attributes.description: General traffic conditions encountered during the trip that may have affected schedule adherence.

attributes.name: transit_agency_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the transit agency or operator responsible for providing this trip service.

attributes.name: transit_agency_name
attributes.description: Name of the transit agency or operator providing this trip service.

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Primary funding source category for this trip service (FTA grant, state appropriation, local funding, etc.).

attributes.name: fta_grant_number
attributes.description: FTA grant number under which this trip service is funded, if applicable.

attributes.name: stakeholder_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the MPO jurisdiction in which this trip operates, if applicable.

attributes.name: rpo_stakeholder_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the RPO jurisdiction in which this trip operates, if applicable.

attributes.name: service_area_type
attributes.description: Classification of the geographic service area in which this trip operates.

attributes.name: fare_revenue
attributes.description: Total fare revenue collected from passengers during this trip.

attributes.name: operating_cost
attributes.description: Estimated or allocated operating cost for this trip, including labor, fuel, and maintenance.

attributes.name: fuel_consumed_gallons
attributes.description: Amount of fuel consumed by the vehicle during this trip, measured in gallons.

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: Type of fuel or energy source used by the vehicle for this trip.

attributes.name: emissions_co2_kg
attributes.description: Estimated carbon dioxide emissions produced during this trip, measured in kilograms.

attributes.name: avl_tracking_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether AVL tracking was active and recording location data for this trip.

attributes.name: real_time_data_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether real-time passenger information was available and published for this trip.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes or comments recorded by operators or dispatchers about this trip.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the trip record was initially created in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the trip record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: routing_result_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gis.routing_result. Business justification: Planned trip paths are calculated using GIS routing engines to determine optimal routes considering road networks, traffic, and constraints. Operations uses this for trip planning and schedule optimiz

attributes.name: driver_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Transit trips require assigned drivers who are NCDOT employees. Operations dispatch uses this daily to track which employee operated each trip for payroll, compliance, and incident management.

products.name: fare
products.description: Reference data defining fare structures, zones, rider categories, discounts, and transfer rules for the transit system. Also consolidates: ferry.fare, transit.fare.

attributes.name: fare_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fare structure record. Primary key for the fare reference data.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Business-assigned unique code identifying the fare type or structure. Used for operational reference and reporting.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the fare structure (e.g., 'Adult Single Ride', 'Senior Monthly Pass', 'Student Discount Fare').

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the fare structure, including eligibility criteria, usage restrictions, and applicable conditions.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the fare structure based on usage pattern and validity period.

attributes.name: rider_category
attributes.description: Classification of eligible riders for this fare structure based on demographic or eligibility criteria.

attributes.name: base_fare_amount
attributes.description: The standard fare amount in US dollars before any discounts, surcharges, or zone adjustments are applied.

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to the base fare for eligible rider categories (e.g., 50% for seniors, 25% for students).

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount discount applied to the base fare for eligible riders.

attributes.name: final_fare_amount
attributes.description: The actual fare amount charged to the rider after all discounts and adjustments are applied.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for fare amounts. Typically USD for North Carolina transit systems.

attributes.name: zone_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the fare zone or geographic area where this fare structure applies. Used for zone-based pricing models.

attributes.name: origin_zone
attributes.description: Starting zone for zone-to-zone fare structures. Used in distance-based or multi-zone pricing models.

attributes.name: destination_zone
attributes.description: Ending zone for zone-to-zone fare structures. Used in distance-based or multi-zone pricing models.

attributes.name: transfer_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fare structure permits transfers to other routes or modes within the transit system.

attributes.name: transfer_count_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of transfers permitted under this fare structure within the transfer validity window.

attributes.name: transfer_time_limit_minutes
attributes.description: Time window in minutes during which transfers are valid after initial fare payment.

attributes.name: transfer_fee_amount
attributes.description: Additional fee charged for each transfer, if applicable. Zero indicates free transfers.

attributes.name: validity_period_days
attributes.description: Number of consecutive days the fare is valid from the date of purchase or first use (e.g., 1 for day pass, 30 for monthly pass).

attributes.name: validity_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this fare structure becomes effective and available for use.

attributes.name: validity_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this fare structure expires and is no longer available for purchase or use. Null indicates indefinite validity.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Type of transit service to which this fare structure applies.

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Specific route identifier if this fare structure applies to a particular route. Null indicates system-wide applicability.

attributes.name: route_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific route if this fare structure is route-specific.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Accepted payment instrument or method for purchasing this fare type.

attributes.name: purchase_channel
attributes.description: Distribution channel or location where this fare can be purchased.

attributes.name: media_type
attributes.description: Physical or digital medium used to store and validate the fare.

attributes.name: refundable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether unused or partially used fares of this type can be refunded to the customer.

attributes.name: transferable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fare can be transferred or shared between different riders.

attributes.name: peak_period_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fare structure applies during peak travel periods (typically weekday rush hours).

attributes.name: off_peak_period_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fare structure applies during off-peak travel periods.

attributes.name: weekend_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fare structure is valid for weekend travel (Saturday and Sunday).

attributes.name: holiday_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fare structure applies on designated holidays.

attributes.name: minimum_age
attributes.description: Minimum age in years required for eligibility to use this fare structure.

attributes.name: maximum_age
attributes.description: Maximum age in years for eligibility to use this fare structure (e.g., youth fares typically end at age 18).

attributes.name: eligibility_documentation_required
attributes.description: Description of documentation required to prove eligibility for this fare category (e.g., 'Valid student ID', 'Medicare card', 'Disability certification').

attributes.name: cap_daily_amount
attributes.description: Maximum total fare amount a rider will pay in a single day, after which additional trips are free. Null indicates no daily cap.

attributes.name: cap_weekly_amount
attributes.description: Maximum total fare amount a rider will pay in a single week, after which additional trips are free. Null indicates no weekly cap.

attributes.name: cap_monthly_amount
attributes.description: Maximum total fare amount a rider will pay in a single month, after which additional trips are free. Null indicates no monthly cap.

attributes.name: distance_minimum_miles
attributes.description: Minimum trip distance in miles for distance-based fare structures. Trips shorter than this distance use the base fare.

attributes.name: distance_maximum_miles
attributes.description: Maximum trip distance in miles covered by this fare structure. Longer trips may require additional fare payment.

attributes.name: distance_rate_per_mile
attributes.description: Fare rate charged per mile of travel for distance-based pricing models.

attributes.name: bulk_purchase_quantity
attributes.description: Number of rides or passes included in a bulk purchase package (e.g., 10-ride ticket book).

attributes.name: bulk_purchase_discount_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied when purchasing multiple rides or passes in bulk.

attributes.name: promotional_code
attributes.description: Special code associated with promotional or limited-time fare offerings.

attributes.name: promotional_start_date
attributes.description: Start date for promotional fare offerings or special pricing periods.

attributes.name: promotional_end_date
attributes.description: End date for promotional fare offerings or special pricing periods.

attributes.name: fta_fare_category_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Transit Administration (FTA) Fare Category Code
attributes.description: Standardized FTA fare category code used for National Transit Database reporting and federal grant compliance.

attributes.name: revenue_allocation_code
attributes.description: Accounting code used to allocate fare revenue to appropriate cost centers, funding sources, or financial accounts.

attributes.name: subsidy_source
attributes.description: Source of subsidy funding that reduces the fare amount for eligible riders (e.g., FTA grants, state transit assistance, employer programs).

attributes.name: subsidy_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the fare amount covered by subsidy funding rather than rider payment.

attributes.name: ada_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fare structure complies with ADA requirements for accessible transportation services.

attributes.name: title_vi_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fare structure has been reviewed and approved for compliance with Title VI Civil Rights Act requirements prohibiting discrimination.

attributes.name: equity_analysis_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent fare equity analysis was conducted for Title VI compliance review.

attributes.name: public_hearing_date
attributes.description: Date when public hearing was held for fare structure changes, as required by FTA regulations.

attributes.name: board_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the fare structure was officially approved by the transit agency governing board.

attributes.name: last_revision_date
attributes.description: Date when this fare structure was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the fare structure within the transit system.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Fare collection systems and ticketing equipment provided by vendors. Finance and operations teams track vendor for maintenance contracts, system upgrades, and technical support of fare collection infr

attributes.name: accounts_receivable_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.accounts_receivable_invoice. Business justification: Fare revenue collected from transit riders must be invoiced and recorded in accounts receivable. Finance department uses this to track transit service revenue and reconcile collections daily.

attributes.name: grant_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grant.program. Business justification: Fare structures are often dictated by grant program requirements (e.g., reduced fares for elderly/disabled under FTA programs). Finance tracks program-specific fare policies for compliance audits.

products.name: ticket
products.description: Transactional record of a ticket purchase or validation, capturing rider, fare applied, payment method, and timestamp. Also consolidates: ferry.ticket, transit.ticket.

attributes.name: ticket_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the ticket transaction record. Primary key for the ticket entity.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Human-readable ticket number displayed to riders and used for customer service reference. May include alphanumeric formatting specific to transit system or ferry service.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the ticket product purchased, indicating fare category and validity period. Includes both transit and ferry ticket types as this product consolidates ferry.ticket and transit.ticket.

attributes.name: fare_type
attributes.description: Pricing category applied to the ticket, indicating whether full fare, reduced fare, or special pricing was applied.

attributes.name: fare_amount
attributes.description: Base fare amount charged for the ticket before any discounts, taxes, or fees. Denominated in US dollars.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount applied to the base fare amount, including promotional discounts, senior/student reductions, or subsidy programs. Denominated in US dollars.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applied to the ticket transaction. Denominated in US dollars.

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: Additional fees charged for the ticket transaction, such as processing fees, convenience fees, or service charges. Denominated in US dollars.

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: Total amount paid for the ticket including base fare, taxes, fees, and after discounts. Denominated in US dollars.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the transaction. Typically USD for NCDOT operations.

attributes.name: payment_channel
attributes.description: Interface or location where the ticket was purchased, indicating the customer touchpoint used for the transaction.

attributes.name: transaction_reference_number
attributes.description: External payment processor or financial system reference number for the transaction, used for reconciliation and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: purchase_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the ticket was purchased or issued, in format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: validation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the ticket was first validated or activated for use, in format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. May be null for unused tickets.

attributes.name: expiration_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the ticket expires and is no longer valid for use, in format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Start date of the ticket validity period, in format yyyy-MM-dd. For passes and multi-day tickets.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: End date of the ticket validity period, in format yyyy-MM-dd. For passes and multi-day tickets.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ticket, indicating whether it is available for use, has been used, or is no longer valid.

attributes.name: origin_location
attributes.description: Starting location or station for the trip associated with the ticket. For ferry tickets, this is the departure terminal. For transit, this is the boarding stop or station.

attributes.name: destination_location
attributes.description: Ending location or station for the trip associated with the ticket. For ferry tickets, this is the arrival terminal. For transit, this is the alighting stop or station.

attributes.name: route_number
attributes.description: Transit route number or ferry route identifier associated with the ticket. May be null for system-wide passes.

attributes.name: route_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the transit route or ferry service associated with the ticket.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Mode of transportation service provided by the ticket, indicating the type of transit or ferry service.

attributes.name: trip_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date of travel for the ticket, in format yyyy-MM-dd. For single-ride tickets with specific trip reservations.

attributes.name: trip_time
attributes.description: Scheduled departure time for the trip. For ferry reservations and scheduled transit services.

products.name: route_stop_schedule
products.description: This association product represents the scheduled service relationship between transit routes and stops. It captures the operational schedule defining which stops are served by which routes, in what sequence, and at what times. Each record links one route to one stop with scheduling attributes that exist only in the context of this specific route-stop pairing. This is the foundational data structure for trip planning, schedule adherence monitoring, and service coverage analysis.. Existence Justification: In transit operations, routes serve multiple stops and stops are served by multiple routes. This is the fundamental operational relationship in public transportation, explicitly managed through schedule planning processes. Transit planners actively create, update, and delete route-stop assignments during service planning cycles, and each assignment carries critical scheduling data (sequence, arrival/departure times, pickup/drop-off rules) that belongs to neither the route nor the stop alone.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the transit route that serves this stop

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the transit stop that is served by this route

attributes.name: stop_sequence
attributes.description: The order in which this stop is visited along the route. Critical for trip planning and schedule display. Lower numbers indicate earlier stops in the route sequence.

attributes.name: arrival_time
attributes.description: The scheduled time when the transit vehicle arrives at this stop on this route. Format HH:MM:SS. Used for passenger information and schedule adherence monitoring.

attributes.name: departure_time
attributes.description: The scheduled time when the transit vehicle departs from this stop on this route. Format HH:MM:SS. May differ from arrival_time for timing points where vehicles wait.

attributes.name: timepoint_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stop is a designated timepoint where the vehicle must adhere to exact scheduled times (true) or an approximate stop (false). Critical for operations and schedule adherence reporting.

attributes.name: pickup_type
attributes.description: Indicates pickup availability at this stop for this route: 0=regularly scheduled, 1=no pickup available, 2=must phone agency, 3=must coordinate with driver. Route-stop specific operational rule.

attributes.name: drop_off_type
attributes.description: Indicates drop-off availability at this stop for this route: 0=regularly scheduled, 1=no drop-off available, 2=must phone agency, 3=must coordinate with driver. Route-stop specific operational rule.

attributes.name: shape_dist_traveled
attributes.description: The distance traveled along the route shape from the origin to this stop, measured in miles or kilometers. Used for accurate map rendering and distance-based fare calculation for this specific route-stop combination.
