attributes.description: Classification of the transit zone based on geographic and demographic characteristics. Determines applicable funding programs and service requirements.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the transit zone. Active zones are eligible for service and funding allocation.

attributes.name: service_area_square_miles
attributes.description: Total geographic area covered by the transit zone measured in square miles. Used for service planning and resource allocation.

attributes.name: population
attributes.description: Total population residing within the transit zone boundaries. Used for service demand forecasting and funding formula calculations.

attributes.name: population_density_per_square_mile
attributes.description: Average number of residents per square mile within the zone. Key metric for determining service type and frequency requirements.

attributes.name: mpo_rpo_affiliation
attributes.description: Name of the MPO or RPO responsible for transportation planning coordination within this zone. Critical for grant coordination and regional planning alignment.

attributes.name: fta_funding_eligibility
attributes.description: Primary FTA grant program(s) for which this zone qualifies. Determines available federal funding sources for transit services.

attributes.name: county_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of North Carolina counties included within the transit zone boundaries. Used for jurisdictional coordination and reporting.

attributes.name: primary_transit_provider
attributes.description: Name of the primary transit agency or operator providing service within this zone. May be a public transit authority, county government, or contracted operator.

attributes.name: service_mode
attributes.description: Primary type of transit service operating within the zone. Determines operational requirements and performance metrics.

attributes.name: fare_structure_type
attributes.description: Pricing model used for transit services within the zone. Impacts revenue forecasting and equity analysis.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the zone definition became or will become active for service planning and funding allocation purposes.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the zone definition is scheduled to expire or be reviewed. Null indicates no planned expiration.

attributes.name: boundary_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the geographic boundaries defining the zone. Includes major roads, natural features, or jurisdictional limits used as boundaries.

attributes.name: coordination_requirements
attributes.description: Special coordination requirements or agreements with adjacent zones, regional authorities, or state agencies. Documents inter-jurisdictional service arrangements.

attributes.name: ada_compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status with ADA accessibility requirements for transit services within the zone. Critical for federal funding eligibility.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional operational notes, special considerations, or historical context relevant to the zone definition and management.

products.name: level
products.description: Master reference table for level. Referenced by level_id.

attributes.name: level_id
attributes.description: Primary key for level

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the transit service level. Used for system integration and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the transit service level (e.g., Local Service, Express Service, Regional Service).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the transit service level, including service characteristics, coverage area, and operational parameters.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: Classification of the transit service level by operational category as defined by FTA service type taxonomy.

attributes.name: tier
attributes.description: Hierarchical tier classification indicating the priority or funding level of the transit service (Tier 1 being highest priority).

attributes.name: funding_eligibility
attributes.description: Indicates which FTA grant programs this service level is eligible for, including Section 5307 (Urbanized Area), 5310 (Elderly/Disabled), 5311 (Rural), and 5339 (Bus and Bus Facilities).

attributes.name: service_frequency_min
attributes.description: Minimum service frequency in minutes between transit vehicles for this service level (e.g., 15 minutes for high-frequency service).

attributes.name: service_frequency_max
attributes.description: Maximum service frequency in minutes between transit vehicles for this service level (e.g., 60 minutes for standard service).

attributes.name: coverage_area_type
attributes.description: Geographic classification of the service coverage area for this transit level.

attributes.name: mpo_rpo_coordination_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether coordination with MPO or RPO planning organizations is required for this service level.

attributes.name: ada_compliance_level
attributes.description: Level of ADA compliance required for this transit service level, including accessibility standards for vehicles and facilities.

attributes.name: fare_structure_type
attributes.description: Type of fare structure applicable to this service level, determining how passenger fares are calculated and collected.

attributes.name: priority_ranking
attributes.description: Numerical ranking indicating the priority of this service level for funding allocation and service planning (1 being highest priority).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the transit service level within the NCDOT transit system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this service level classification became or will become effective for transit operations and funding.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this service level classification expires or is scheduled for review and potential discontinuation.

attributes.name: reporting_category
attributes.description: FTA National Transit Database reporting category code: MB (Motor Bus), DR (Demand Response), VP (Vanpool), CB (Commuter Bus), RB (Bus Rapid Transit), LR (Light Rail), SR (Streetcar), Other.

attributes.name: vehicle_type_requirement
attributes.description: Specification of vehicle types required or recommended for this service level (e.g., standard bus, articulated bus, cutaway van, minibus).

attributes.name: minimum_service_hours_per_day
attributes.description: Minimum number of service hours per day required for this transit service level to maintain operational standards.

products.name: direction
products.description: Master reference table for direction. Referenced by direction_id.

attributes.name: direction_id
attributes.description: Primary key for direction

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Standard abbreviated code representing the direction (e.g., N, S, E, W, NE, NW, SE, SW, NB, SB, EB, WB). Used for compact representation in transit route and schedule systems.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the direction (e.g., Northbound, Southbound, Eastbound, Westbound, Inbound, Outbound). Used for display in public-facing transit schedules and route maps.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the direction including context for transit operations, such as 'Toward downtown' or 'Away from city center'. Provides additional clarity for route planning and passenger information.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the direction type. Cardinal (N/S/E/W), Ordinal (NE/NW/SE/SW), Inbound/Outbound (relative to central point), Loop (circular route), or Circular (continuous circuit).

attributes.name: compass_bearing
attributes.description: Numeric compass bearing in degrees (0-360) representing the direction. 0/360 = North, 90 = East, 180 = South, 270 = West. Used for precise geographic orientation in GIS and route planning systems.

attributes.name: gtfs_direction_id
attributes.description: GTFS-compliant direction identifier used in transit feed specifications. Binary value where 0 typically represents one direction (e.g., outbound) and 1 represents the opposite direction (e.g., inbound). Required for GTFS data exchange with trip planning applications.

attributes.name: display_order
attributes.description: Numeric sequence used to control the display order of directions in user interfaces, reports, and public transit information systems. Lower numbers appear first.

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is a primary direction for route planning. Primary directions (e.g., Northbound, Southbound) are typically used for major route designations, while secondary directions may be used for branches or variants.

attributes.name: opposite_direction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the direction_id of the opposite or return direction. For example, if this record is Northbound, this field would reference the direction_id for Southbound. Used for bidirectional route planning and schedule coordination.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the direction reference value. Active directions are in use for current transit operations, inactive are temporarily not in use, and deprecated are retained for historical reference only.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this direction reference became effective and available for use in transit route and schedule planning. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this direction reference expires or is no longer valid for use in active transit operations. Null indicates no expiration. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the direction. May include usage guidelines, regional variations, or coordination requirements with Metropolitan Planning Organization (MPO) or Regional Planning Organization (RPO) partners.

domains.name: aviation
domains.description: Aviation regulation, airport facilities management, airport system planning, and safety oversight. Provides regulatory oversight and funding coordination for public airports across North Carolina in alignment with FAA standards.

products.name: airport
products.description: Master record for each public airport in North Carolina, including location, ownership, and facility details.

attributes.name: airport_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each public airport in North Carolina. Primary key for the airport master record.

attributes.name: faa_site_number
attributes.description: Unique FAA-assigned site identifier for the airport. Standard format is state code followed by facility code (e.g., 12-NC).

attributes.name: locid
attributes.description: Three or four-character airport location identifier assigned by FAA. Used for flight planning and air traffic control.

attributes.name: iata_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for commercial service airports. Used in airline ticketing and baggage handling systems.

attributes.name: icao_code
attributes.description: Four-letter ICAO airport code used internationally for flight operations and weather reporting.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Official name of the airport as registered with FAA and used in public communications.

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the aviation facility based on the type of aircraft operations supported.

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the airport is publicly owned, privately owned, or military controlled.

attributes.name: use_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the airport is open to the public or restricted to private use.

attributes.name: owner_name
attributes.description: Name of the entity that owns the airport (e.g., county, municipality, private organization).

attributes.name: owner_address
attributes.description: Mailing address of the airport owner for official correspondence and legal notices.

attributes.name: owner_city
attributes.description: City where the airport owner is located.

attributes.name: owner_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code where the airport owner is located.

attributes.name: owner_zip_code
attributes.description: ZIP code of the airport owner's address.

attributes.name: owner_phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the airport owner.

attributes.name: manager_name
attributes.description: Name of the airport manager or primary operational contact responsible for day-to-day operations.

attributes.name: manager_phone
attributes.description: Direct phone number for the airport manager for operational coordination and emergency contact.

attributes.name: manager_email
attributes.description: Email address of the airport manager for official communications and notifications.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the airport reference point in decimal degrees. Positive values indicate north of the equator.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the airport reference point in decimal degrees. Negative values indicate west of the prime meridian.

attributes.name: elevation_feet
attributes.description: Airport elevation above mean sea level in feet. Critical for aircraft performance calculations and approach procedures.

attributes.name: magnetic_variation
attributes.description: Magnetic declination at the airport location expressed in degrees east or west (e.g., 08W). Used for runway heading calculations.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: Standard time zone in which the airport is located for scheduling and operational coordination.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: Primary city or municipality served by the airport.

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: County in which the airport is physically located.

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code where the airport is located. For North Carolina airports, this will be NC.

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: FAA regional office jurisdiction responsible for regulatory oversight of the airport.

attributes.name: district
attributes.description: NCDOT Aviation Division district responsible for state-level coordination and support.

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date when the airport was officially opened and activated for aviation operations.

attributes.name: npias_role
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Plan of Integrated Airport Systems (NPIAS) Role
attributes.description: Airport classification within the FAA National Plan of Integrated Airport Systems, determining eligibility for federal funding.

attributes.name: npias_hub_type
attributes.description: Hub classification for commercial service airports based on percentage of annual passenger boardings.

attributes.name: faa_region_code
attributes.description: Three-letter code identifying the FAA regional office with jurisdiction over the airport.

attributes.name: ado_office
attributes.description: FAA Airports District Office responsible for certification and compliance oversight.

attributes.name: control_tower
attributes.description: Indicates whether the airport has an FAA air traffic control tower.

attributes.name: tower_type
attributes.description: Type of air traffic control tower operation: FAA-staffed, contract tower, or no tower.

attributes.name: unicom_frequency
attributes.description: Radio frequency for pilot-to-pilot and pilot-to-FBO communications at non-towered airports.

attributes.name: ctaf_frequency
attributes.description: Radio frequency designated for airport advisory communications and traffic coordination.

attributes.name: weather_reporting
attributes.description: Type of automated weather observation system available at the airport (AWOS, ASOS, AWSS, or none).

attributes.name: notam_facility
attributes.description: Identifier used for issuing NOTAMs (Notices to Airmen) for the airport.

attributes.name: fuel_types_available
attributes.description: Types of aviation fuel available at the airport (e.g., 100LL, Jet A, Mogas). Pipe-separated list.

attributes.name: landing_fee_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the airport charges landing fees for aircraft operations.

attributes.name: customs_service
attributes.description: Indicates whether U.S. Customs and Border Protection services are available for international arrivals.

attributes.name: military_joint_use
attributes.description: Indicates whether the airport is jointly used by civilian and military operations.

attributes.name: based_aircraft_count
attributes.description: Number of aircraft permanently based at the airport. Used for planning and funding calculations.

attributes.name: single_engine_aircraft
attributes.description: Number of single-engine aircraft based at the airport.

attributes.name: multi_engine_aircraft
attributes.description: Number of multi-engine aircraft based at the airport.

attributes.name: jet_aircraft
attributes.description: Number of jet aircraft based at the airport.

attributes.name: helicopter_aircraft
attributes.description: Number of helicopters based at the airport.

attributes.name: glider_aircraft
attributes.description: Number of gliders based at the airport.

attributes.name: ultralight_aircraft
attributes.description: Number of ultralight aircraft based at the airport.

attributes.name: annual_operations
attributes.description: Total number of aircraft takeoffs and landings at the airport per year. Used for capacity planning and funding.

attributes.name: annual_commercial_operations
attributes.description: Number of commercial airline operations (takeoffs and landings) per year.

attributes.name: annual_enplanements
attributes.description: Number of passengers boarding commercial flights at the airport annually. Key metric for NPIAS classification.

attributes.name: pattern_altitude
attributes.description: Standard altitude in feet above ground level for aircraft flying the traffic pattern.

attributes.name: beacon
attributes.description: Indicates whether the airport has a rotating beacon for visual identification at night.

attributes.name: lighting_schedule
attributes.description: Operating schedule for airport lighting systems.

attributes.name: segmented_circle
attributes.description: Indicates whether the airport has a segmented circle visual aid for wind direction and traffic pattern information.

attributes.name: emergency_services
attributes.description: Description of emergency response capabilities available at or near the airport (fire, medical, rescue).

attributes.name: arff_index
attributes.business_glossary_term: Aircraft Rescue and Fire Fighting (ARFF) Index
attributes.description: FAA certification level for aircraft rescue and firefighting capabilities based on aircraft size and operations.

attributes.name: part_139_certificate
attributes.description: Indicates whether the airport holds an FAA Part 139 operating certificate required for scheduled commercial service.

attributes.name: certificate_class
attributes.description: FAA Part 139 certificate class based on type of air carrier operations served.

attributes.name: noise_abatement_program
attributes.description: Indicates whether the airport has an active noise abatement program to minimize community impact.

attributes.name: wildlife_hazard_plan
attributes.description: Indicates whether the airport has a wildlife hazard management plan to reduce aircraft-wildlife strikes.

attributes.name: master_plan_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent FAA-approved airport master plan document.

attributes.name: layout_plan_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent FAA-approved Airport Layout Plan showing existing and planned facilities.

attributes.name: federal_funding_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the airport is eligible for federal Airport Improvement Program (AIP) grants.

attributes.name: state_funding_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the airport is eligible for NCDOT Aviation Division state grant funding.

attributes.name: economic_impact_jobs
attributes.description: Estimated number of jobs supported by airport operations and related economic activity.

attributes.name: economic_impact_payroll
attributes.description: Estimated annual payroll in dollars generated by airport-related employment.

attributes.name: economic_impact_output
attributes.description: Estimated total annual economic output in dollars generated by the airport and related activities.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Official website URL for the airport providing public information and services.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Additional notes, operational information, or special conditions relevant to the airport.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent FAA or NCDOT safety and compliance inspection.

attributes.name: next_inspection_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next regulatory safety and compliance inspection.

attributes.name: record_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the current airport record information became effective.

attributes.name: record_last_updated
attributes.description: Timestamp when the airport master record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project. Business justification: Airport construction, expansion, and renovation projects (runway extensions, terminal upgrades) are capital projects tracked by NCDOT. Each airport facility improvement ties to a specific infrastructu

attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rightofway.parcel. Business justification: Airports are constructed on specific land parcels. NCDOT must track which parcel each airport facility occupies for property management, tax assessment, and legal documentation purposes.

attributes.name: funding_source_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to planning.funding_source. Business justification: Airport infrastructure projects require tracking funding sources (FAA grants, state funds, local bonds). Finance and planning departments must identify which funding mechanism supports each airport fa

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset. Business justification: Airports are major capital assets requiring tracking for depreciation, valuation, and financial reporting. Asset management uses this to manage airport facilities as organizational assets.

attributes.name: boundary_feature_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gis.feature. Business justification: Airport boundaries are spatial features managed in GIS. Aviation planners and safety officers use GIS features daily to define airspace restrictions, noise contours, and property boundaries for regula

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Each airport operates as a distinct cost center for tracking operational expenses, maintenance costs, and capital improvements. Finance department uses this for budget allocation and expense reporting

products.name: runway
products.description: Physical characteristics of each runway (length, width, surface type, lighting, thresholds).

attributes.name: runway_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the runway within the NCDOT aviation system.

attributes.name: airport_id
attributes.description: The FAA Location Identifier (LID) or ICAO code for the airport where this runway is located.

attributes.name: designation
attributes.description: The runway identifier based on magnetic heading rounded to nearest 10 degrees, with optional parallel runway designator (L/R/C). Example: 18L, 36R, 09.

attributes.name: length_ft
attributes.description: The total physical length of the runway measured in feet from threshold to threshold.

attributes.name: width_ft
attributes.description: The physical width of the runway pavement measured in feet.

attributes.name: surface_type
attributes.description: The primary material composition of the runway surface.

attributes.name: surface_condition
attributes.description: The current assessed condition of the runway surface based on inspection and maintenance records.
attributes.references: FAA Advisory Circular 150/5380-6 Guidelines and Procedures for Maintenance of Airport Pavements

attributes.name: pci_score
attributes.description: Numerical rating of pavement condition on a scale of 0-100, where 100 represents excellent condition. Based on ASTM D6433 standard.
attributes.references: ASTM D6433 Standard Practice for Roads and Parking Lots Pavement Condition Index Surveys

attributes.name: surface_treatment
attributes.description: Special surface treatment applied to enhance friction, drainage, or performance characteristics.
attributes.references: FAA Advisory Circular 150/5320-12 Measurement, Construction, and Maintenance of Skid-Resistant Airport Pavement Surfaces

attributes.name: pavement_classification_number
attributes.description: The bearing strength of the runway pavement expressed using the Aircraft Classification Number/Pavement Classification Number (ACN/PCN) method.

attributes.name: base_end_designation
attributes.description: The designation of the lower-numbered runway end (e.g., 09 in a 09/27 runway).

attributes.name: base_end_latitude
attributes.description: The geographic latitude coordinate of the base end threshold in decimal degrees.
attributes.references: FAA Order 8260.19 Flight Procedures and Airspace

attributes.name: base_end_longitude
attributes.description: The geographic longitude coordinate of the base end threshold in decimal degrees.
attributes.references: FAA Order 8260.19 Flight Procedures and Airspace

attributes.name: base_end_elevation_ft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Base End Elevation in Feet Mean Sea Level (MSL)
attributes.description: The elevation of the base end threshold above mean sea level measured in feet.

attributes.name: base_end_displaced_threshold_ft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Base End Displaced Threshold Distance in Feet
attributes.description: The distance in feet that the landing threshold is displaced from the physical runway end at the base end. Zero if no displacement.

attributes.name: base_end_gradient_percent
attributes.description: The effective gradient (slope) of the runway from the base end perspective, expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: reciprocal_end_designation
attributes.description: The designation of the higher-numbered runway end (e.g., 27 in a 09/27 runway).

attributes.name: reciprocal_end_latitude
attributes.description: The geographic latitude coordinate of the reciprocal end threshold in decimal degrees.
attributes.references: FAA Order 8260.19 Flight Procedures and Airspace

attributes.name: reciprocal_end_longitude
attributes.description: The geographic longitude coordinate of the reciprocal end threshold in decimal degrees.
attributes.references: FAA Order 8260.19 Flight Procedures and Airspace

attributes.name: reciprocal_end_elevation_ft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Reciprocal End Elevation in Feet Mean Sea Level (MSL)
attributes.description: The elevation of the reciprocal end threshold above mean sea level measured in feet.

attributes.name: reciprocal_end_displaced_threshold_ft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Reciprocal End Displaced Threshold Distance in Feet
attributes.description: The distance in feet that the landing threshold is displaced from the physical runway end at the reciprocal end. Zero if no displacement.

attributes.name: reciprocal_end_gradient_percent
attributes.description: The effective gradient (slope) of the runway from the reciprocal end perspective, expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: magnetic_bearing_base_end
attributes.business_glossary_term: Magnetic Bearing Base End in Degrees
attributes.description: The magnetic azimuth bearing of the base end runway centerline in degrees (0-360).
attributes.references: FAA Order 8260.19 Flight Procedures and Airspace

attributes.name: magnetic_bearing_reciprocal_end
attributes.business_glossary_term: Magnetic Bearing Reciprocal End in Degrees
attributes.description: The magnetic azimuth bearing of the reciprocal end runway centerline in degrees (0-360).
attributes.references: FAA Order 8260.19 Flight Procedures and Airspace

attributes.name: true_bearing_base_end
attributes.business_glossary_term: True Bearing Base End in Degrees
attributes.description: The true (geographic) azimuth bearing of the base end runway centerline in degrees (0-360).
attributes.references: FAA Order 8260.19 Flight Procedures and Airspace

attributes.name: true_bearing_reciprocal_end
attributes.business_glossary_term: True Bearing Reciprocal End in Degrees
attributes.description: The true (geographic) azimuth bearing of the reciprocal end runway centerline in degrees (0-360).
attributes.references: FAA Order 8260.19 Flight Procedures and Airspace

attributes.name: edge_lighting_type
attributes.description: The intensity classification of the runway edge lighting system installed along the runway sides.
attributes.references: FAA Advisory Circular 150/5340-30 Design and Installation Details for Airport Visual Aids

attributes.name: centerline_lighting
attributes.description: Indicates whether the runway is equipped with centerline lighting for low-visibility operations.
attributes.references: FAA Advisory Circular 150/5340-30 Design and Installation Details for Airport Visual Aids

attributes.name: touchdown_zone_lighting
attributes.description: Indicates whether the runway is equipped with touchdown zone lighting to enhance visibility during approach and landing.
attributes.references: FAA Advisory Circular 150/5340-30 Design and Installation Details for Airport Visual Aids

attributes.name: approach_lighting_system_base_end
attributes.business_glossary_term: Approach Lighting System Base End Type
attributes.description: The type of approach lighting system installed at the base end of the runway to aid pilots during approach.
attributes.references: FAA Advisory Circular 150/5340-30 Design and Installation Details for Airport Visual Aids

attributes.name: approach_lighting_system_reciprocal_end
attributes.business_glossary_term: Approach Lighting System Reciprocal End Type
attributes.description: The type of approach lighting system installed at the reciprocal end of the runway to aid pilots during approach.
attributes.references: FAA Advisory Circular 150/5340-30 Design and Installation Details for Airport Visual Aids

attributes.name: visual_glide_slope_indicator_base_end
attributes.business_glossary_term: Visual Glide Slope Indicator Base End Type
attributes.description: The type of visual approach slope indicator system installed at the base end (e.g., VASI, PAPI).
attributes.references: FAA Advisory Circular 150/5340-30 Design and Installation Details for Airport Visual Aids

attributes.name: visual_glide_slope_indicator_reciprocal_end
attributes.business_glossary_term: Visual Glide Slope Indicator Reciprocal End Type
attributes.description: The type of visual approach slope indicator system installed at the reciprocal end (e.g., VASI, PAPI).
attributes.references: FAA Advisory Circular 150/5340-30 Design and Installation Details for Airport Visual Aids

attributes.name: end_identifier_lights
attributes.description: Indicates whether the runway is equipped with Runway End Identifier Lights (REIL) to provide rapid identification of the runway end.
attributes.references: FAA Advisory Circular 150/5340-30 Design and Installation Details for Airport Visual Aids

attributes.name: marking_type
attributes.description: The classification of runway markings based on the type of instrument approach available (precision, non-precision, basic, visual).
attributes.references: FAA Advisory Circular 150/5340-1 Standards for Airport Markings

attributes.name: marking_condition
attributes.description: The current assessed condition of the runway markings based on visibility and maintenance standards.
attributes.references: FAA Advisory Circular 150/5340-1 Standards for Airport Markings

attributes.name: instrument_approach_base_end
attributes.business_glossary_term: Instrument Approach Procedure Base End Type
attributes.description: The type of published instrument approach procedure available for the base end of the runway.
attributes.references: FAA Order 8260.3 United States Standard for Terminal Instrument Procedures (TERPS)

attributes.name: instrument_approach_reciprocal_end
attributes.business_glossary_term: Instrument Approach Procedure Reciprocal End Type
attributes.description: The type of published instrument approach procedure available for the reciprocal end of the runway.
attributes.references: FAA Order 8260.3 United States Standard for Terminal Instrument Procedures (TERPS)

attributes.name: ils_category_base_end
attributes.business_glossary_term: Instrument Landing System (ILS) Category Base End
attributes.description: The precision approach category of the ILS system at the base end, indicating minimum visibility and decision height capabilities.

attributes.name: ils_category_reciprocal_end
attributes.business_glossary_term: Instrument Landing System (ILS) Category Reciprocal End
attributes.description: The precision approach category of the ILS system at the reciprocal end, indicating minimum visibility and decision height capabilities.

attributes.name: visibility_value_base_end_ft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Runway Visibility Value (RVV) Base End in Feet
attributes.description: The minimum visibility in feet required for operations at the base end under instrument meteorological conditions.
attributes.references: FAA Order 8260.3 United States Standard for Terminal Instrument Procedures (TERPS)

attributes.name: visibility_value_reciprocal_end_ft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Runway Visibility Value (RVV) Reciprocal End in Feet
attributes.description: The minimum visibility in feet required for operations at the reciprocal end under instrument meteorological conditions.
attributes.references: FAA Order 8260.3 United States Standard for Terminal Instrument Procedures (TERPS)

attributes.name: decision_height_base_end_ft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Decision Height Base End in Feet Above Ground Level (AGL)
attributes.description: The decision height for precision approaches at the base end, measured in feet above ground level.
attributes.references: FAA Order 8260.3 United States Standard for Terminal Instrument Procedures (TERPS)

attributes.name: decision_height_reciprocal_end_ft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Decision Height Reciprocal End in Feet Above Ground Level (AGL)
attributes.description: The decision height for precision approaches at the reciprocal end, measured in feet above ground level.
attributes.references: FAA Order 8260.3 United States Standard for Terminal Instrument Procedures (TERPS)

attributes.name: protection_zone_base_end_acres
attributes.business_glossary_term: Runway Protection Zone (RPZ) Base End Area in Acres
attributes.description: The area of the Runway Protection Zone at the base end, measured in acres, which is a trapezoidal area intended to enhance safety.

attributes.name: protection_zone_reciprocal_end_acres
attributes.business_glossary_term: Runway Protection Zone (RPZ) Reciprocal End Area in Acres
attributes.description: The area of the Runway Protection Zone at the reciprocal end, measured in acres, which is a trapezoidal area intended to enhance safety.

attributes.name: object_free_area_width_ft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Object Free Area (OFA) Width in Feet
attributes.description: The width of the Object Free Area centered on the runway, which must be clear of objects that could endanger aircraft.

attributes.name: safety_area_width_ft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Runway Safety Area (RSA) Width in Feet
attributes.description: The width of the Runway Safety Area, a defined surface surrounding the runway prepared to reduce risk of damage to aircraft in case of undershoot, overshoot, or excursion.

attributes.name: safety_area_length_base_end_ft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Runway Safety Area (RSA) Length Base End in Feet
attributes.description: The length of the Runway Safety Area extending beyond the base end threshold.

attributes.name: safety_area_length_reciprocal_end_ft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Runway Safety Area (RSA) Length Reciprocal End in Feet
attributes.description: The length of the Runway Safety Area extending beyond the reciprocal end threshold.

attributes.name: blast_pad_base_end_length_ft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Blast Pad Base End Length in Feet
attributes.description: The length of the blast pad (also called stopway or overrun) at the base end, designed to prevent erosion from jet blast.

attributes.name: blast_pad_reciprocal_end_length_ft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Blast Pad Reciprocal End Length in Feet
attributes.description: The length of the blast pad (also called stopway or overrun) at the reciprocal end, designed to prevent erosion from jet blast.

attributes.name: declared_distance_tora_base_end_ft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Take-Off Run Available (TORA) Base End in Feet
attributes.description: The length of runway declared available and suitable for the ground run of an aircraft taking off from the base end.

attributes.name: declared_distance_tora_reciprocal_end_ft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Take-Off Run Available (TORA) Reciprocal End in Feet
attributes.description: The length of runway declared available and suitable for the ground run of an aircraft taking off from the reciprocal end.

attributes.name: declared_distance_toda_base_end_ft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Take-Off Distance Available (TODA) Base End in Feet
attributes.description: The length of the take-off run available plus the length of the clearway, if provided, from the base end.

attributes.name: declared_distance_toda_reciprocal_end_ft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Take-Off Distance Available (TODA) Reciprocal End in Feet
attributes.description: The length of the take-off run available plus the length of the clearway, if provided, from the reciprocal end.

attributes.name: declared_distance_asda_base_end_ft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Accelerate-Stop Distance Available (ASDA) Base End in Feet
attributes.description: The length of the take-off run available plus the length of the stopway, if provided, from the base end.

attributes.name: declared_distance_asda_reciprocal_end_ft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Accelerate-Stop Distance Available (ASDA) Reciprocal End in Feet
attributes.description: The length of the take-off run available plus the length of the stopway, if provided, from the reciprocal end.

attributes.name: declared_distance_lda_base_end_ft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Landing Distance Available (LDA) Base End in Feet
attributes.description: The length of runway declared available and suitable for landing from the base end.

attributes.name: declared_distance_lda_reciprocal_end_ft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Landing Distance Available (LDA) Reciprocal End in Feet
attributes.description: The length of runway declared available and suitable for landing from the reciprocal end.

attributes.name: weight_bearing_capacity_single_wheel_lbs
attributes.business_glossary_term: Weight Bearing Capacity Single Wheel in Pounds
attributes.description: The maximum weight in pounds that the runway pavement can support for aircraft with single wheel landing gear configuration.
attributes.references: FAA Advisory Circular 150/5320-6 Airport Pavement Design and Evaluation

attributes.name: weight_bearing_capacity_dual_wheel_lbs
attributes.business_glossary_term: Weight Bearing Capacity Dual Wheel in Pounds
attributes.description: The maximum weight in pounds that the runway pavement can support for aircraft with dual wheel landing gear configuration.
attributes.references: FAA Advisory Circular 150/5320-6 Airport Pavement Design and Evaluation

attributes.name: weight_bearing_capacity_dual_tandem_lbs
attributes.business_glossary_term: Weight Bearing Capacity Dual Tandem in Pounds
attributes.description: The maximum weight in pounds that the runway pavement can support for aircraft with dual tandem landing gear configuration.
attributes.references: FAA Advisory Circular 150/5320-6 Airport Pavement Design and Evaluation

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: The current operational status of the runway indicating availability for aircraft operations.

attributes.name: closure_reason
attributes.description: The reason for runway closure or restriction if the operational status is not open.

attributes.name: closure_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the runway closure or restriction period begins, formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: closure_end_date
attributes.description: The anticipated date when the runway closure or restriction period ends, formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: construction_year
attributes.description: The year when the runway was originally constructed.

attributes.name: last_major_rehabilitation_year
attributes.description: The year when the runway last underwent major rehabilitation or reconstruction work.
attributes.references: FAA Advisory Circular 150/5380-6 Guidelines and Procedures for Maintenance of Airport Pavements

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent formal runway inspection, formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: FAA Advisory Circular 150/5200-18 Airport Safety Self-Inspection

attributes.name: next_scheduled_inspection_date
attributes.description: The date when the next formal runway inspection is scheduled, formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: FAA Advisory Circular 150/5200-18 Airport Safety Self-Inspection

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: The ownership classification of the runway facility.

attributes.name: faa_airport_reference_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) Airport Reference Code (ARC)
attributes.description: The FAA Airport Reference Code indicating the design aircraft category and approach speed (e.g., B-II, C-III, D-V).

attributes.name: design_aircraft_type
attributes.description: The specific aircraft type or family that the runway was designed to accommodate (e.g., Boeing 737, Cessna 172).

attributes.name: critical_aircraft_wingspan_ft
attributes.description: The wingspan of the critical design aircraft that determines runway and taxiway separation standards.

attributes.name: friction_coefficient
attributes.description: The measured friction coefficient of the runway surface, indicating skid resistance and braking performance.
attributes.references: FAA Advisory Circular 150/5320-12 Measurement, Construction, and Maintenance of Skid-Resistant Airport Pavement Surfaces

attributes.name: friction_test_date
attributes.description: The date when the runway friction coefficient was last measured, formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: FAA Advisory Circular 150/5320-12 Measurement, Construction, and Maintenance of Skid-Resistant Airport Pavement Surfaces

attributes.name: snow_removal_equipment_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether dedicated snow removal equipment is available for this runway.
attributes.references: FAA Advisory Circular 150/5200-30 Airport Winter Safety and Operations

attributes.name: deicing_capability
attributes.description: Indicates whether the runway has deicing or anti-icing treatment capability.
attributes.references: FAA Advisory Circular 150/5200-30 Airport Winter Safety and Operations

attributes.name: wildlife_hazard_mitigation
attributes.description: Indicates whether a wildlife hazard mitigation program is in place for this runway.
attributes.references: FAA Advisory Circular 150/5200-36 Wildlife Hazard Mitigation

attributes.name: noise_abatement_procedure
attributes.description: Indicates whether noise abatement procedures are established for operations on this runway.
attributes.references: FAA Order 1050.1 Environmental Impacts: Policies and Procedures

attributes.name: environmental_assessment_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent environmental assessment conducted for the runway, formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: obstruction_clearance_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the runway meets FAA obstruction clearance standards for approach and departure surfaces.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special information about the runway not captured in other fields.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when this runway record became effective or was last updated in the system, formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project. Business justification: Runway construction, resurfacing, and rehabilitation are major capital projects. NCDOT tracks each runway improvement as a distinct project with budget, schedule, and contractor management requirement

attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rightofway.parcel. Business justification: Runways often span multiple parcels or specific land acquisitions. Right-of-way department tracks which parcel each runway occupies for expansion planning, maintenance jurisdiction, and property bound

attributes.name: nepa_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to environmental.nepa_document. Business justification: Runway construction/expansion requires NEPA environmental review (EA or EIS). Aviation planners reference NEPA documents for project approval and federal funding eligibility.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset. Business justification: Runways are critical infrastructure assets requiring lifecycle management, condition tracking, and capital planning. Asset management tracks runway value, depreciation, and replacement schedules.

attributes.name: centerline_feature_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gis.feature. Business justification: Runway centerlines are precision spatial features in GIS. Airport engineers and surveyors reference these daily for maintenance planning, obstruction analysis, and FAA compliance reporting requiring e

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Runway maintenance, resurfacing, and lighting costs are tracked separately as distinct cost centers for capital project management and operational budgeting.

products.name: navigation_aid
products.description: Details of navigation aids (VOR, NDB, ILS, GPS waypoints) supporting airspace operations.

attributes.name: navigation_aid_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the navigation aid facility. Primary key for the navigation aid entity.
attributes.references: FAA Order 7400.2 - Procedures for Handling Airspace Matters

attributes.name: facility_identifier
attributes.description: The official FAA-assigned identifier code for the navigation aid facility, typically 2-5 alphanumeric characters used in aeronautical charts and flight planning.

attributes.name: facility_name
attributes.description: The official name of the navigation aid facility, typically named after the nearest city, airport, or geographic landmark.
attributes.references: FAA Order 7400.2 - Procedures for Handling Airspace Matters

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: The type classification of the navigation aid facility indicating the technology and service provided (e.g., VOR for VHF Omnidirectional Range, NDB for Non-Directional Beacon, ILS for Instrument Landing System).
attributes.references: FAA Aeronautical Information Manual (AIM) Chapter 1 Section 1

attributes.name: facility_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the navigation aid facility indicating availability for use in air navigation.
attributes.value_regex: Operational|Out of Service|Decommissioned|Under Construction|Testing|Temporarily Closed|Restricted Use
attributes.references: FAA Order 6050.32 - National Airspace System (NAS) Equipment Operational Status

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.description: The radio frequency in kilohertz (kHz) or megahertz (MHz) on which the navigation aid transmits signals. VOR/ILS typically operate in VHF band (108-118 MHz), NDB in LF/MF band (190-535 kHz).

attributes.name: frequency_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the transmission frequency (kilohertz or megahertz).

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The TACAN or DME channel number used for distance measuring equipment, typically a 1-3 digit number optionally followed by X or Y designation.
attributes.references: FAA Order 6050.32 - National Airspace System Equipment

attributes.name: morse_code_identifier
attributes.description: The 1-4 character Morse code identifier transmitted by the navigation aid for positive identification by pilots, typically matching the facility identifier.
attributes.references: FAA Aeronautical Information Manual (AIM) Chapter 1 Section 1

attributes.name: elevation_feet
attributes.description: The elevation of the navigation aid antenna above mean sea level (MSL) measured in feet.
attributes.references: FAA Order 8260.3 - United States Standard for Terminal Instrument Procedures (TERPS)

attributes.name: magnetic_variation
attributes.description: The magnetic variation (declination) at the navigation aid location in degrees, representing the angular difference between true north and magnetic north. Positive values indicate easterly variation, negative indicate westerly.
attributes.references: National Geophysical Data Center (NGDC) World Magnetic Model

attributes.name: service_volume_class
attributes.description: The FAA-designated service volume class indicating the intended operational range and altitude coverage of the navigation aid (e.g., Terminal for airport vicinity, Low Altitude up to 18,000 feet, High Altitude above 18,000 feet).
attributes.value_regex: Terminal|Low Altitude|High Altitude|Compass Locator|Outer Marker|Middle Marker|Inner Marker
attributes.references: FAA Aeronautical Information Manual (AIM) Chapter 1 Section 1-1

attributes.name: service_range_nautical_miles
attributes.description: The maximum operational range of the navigation aid in nautical miles within which reliable signal reception is expected under normal conditions.
attributes.references: FAA Order 6050.32 - National Airspace System Equipment

attributes.name: power_output_watts
attributes.description: The radio frequency power output of the navigation aid transmitter measured in watts.

attributes.name: associated_airport_code
attributes.description: The ICAO or FAA location identifier of the airport with which this navigation aid is primarily associated, if applicable.

attributes.name: associated_runway
attributes.description: The runway designation (e.g., 18L, 27, 09R) that this navigation aid serves, particularly relevant for ILS, localizer, and approach lighting systems.
attributes.references: FAA Order 8260.3 - United States Standard for Terminal Instrument Procedures

attributes.name: owner_type
attributes.description: The type of entity that owns the navigation aid facility.
attributes.references: FAA National Flight Data Center (NFDC) Data Dictionary

attributes.name: owner_name
attributes.description: The name of the organization or entity that owns the navigation aid facility.
attributes.references: FAA National Flight Data Center (NFDC) Data Dictionary

attributes.name: operator_name
attributes.description: The name of the organization or entity responsible for operating and maintaining the navigation aid facility.
attributes.references: FAA Order 6050.32 - National Airspace System Equipment

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: The date when the navigation aid facility was officially commissioned and placed into operational service.
attributes.references: FAA Order 6050.32 - National Airspace System Equipment

attributes.name: decommissioning_date
attributes.description: The date when the navigation aid facility was officially decommissioned and removed from operational service, if applicable.
attributes.references: FAA Order 6050.32 - National Airspace System Equipment

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent FAA or authorized inspection of the navigation aid facility.
attributes.references: FAA Order 6050.32 - National Airspace System Equipment

attributes.name: next_scheduled_inspection_date
attributes.description: The date when the next scheduled inspection of the navigation aid facility is planned.
attributes.references: FAA Order 6050.32 - National Airspace System Equipment

attributes.name: inspection_frequency_days
attributes.description: The required frequency of inspections for the navigation aid facility measured in days between inspections.
attributes.references: FAA Order 6050.32 - National Airspace System Equipment

attributes.name: manufacturer
attributes.description: The name of the manufacturer of the navigation aid equipment.
attributes.references: FAA Order 6050.32 - National Airspace System Equipment

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: The manufacturer's model number or designation for the navigation aid equipment.
attributes.references: FAA Order 6050.32 - National Airspace System Equipment

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: The unique serial number assigned by the manufacturer to the navigation aid equipment unit.
attributes.references: FAA Order 6050.32 - National Airspace System Equipment

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: The date when the current navigation aid equipment was physically installed at the facility location.
attributes.references: FAA Order 6050.32 - National Airspace System Equipment

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date when the manufacturer's warranty for the navigation aid equipment expires.

attributes.name: expected_service_life_years
attributes.description: The expected operational service life of the navigation aid equipment measured in years from installation.

attributes.name: replacement_cost_amount
attributes.description: The estimated cost in US dollars to replace the navigation aid equipment with equivalent new equipment.

attributes.name: annual_maintenance_cost_amount
attributes.description: The estimated annual cost in US dollars for routine maintenance and upkeep of the navigation aid facility.

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: The primary source of funding for the navigation aid facility acquisition and maintenance.

attributes.name: faa_facility_number
attributes.description: The unique facility number assigned by the FAA for administrative and tracking purposes in the National Flight Data Center database.
attributes.references: FAA National Flight Data Center (NFDC) Data Dictionary

attributes.name: notam_accountability_code
attributes.description: The code used to identify this navigation aid in NOTAM (Notice to Airmen) publications when reporting status changes or outages.

attributes.name: monitoring_category
attributes.description: The FAA-designated monitoring category indicating the level of automated monitoring and alarm capability for the navigation aid facility.
attributes.references: FAA Order 6050.32 - National Airspace System Equipment

attributes.name: backup_power_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the navigation aid facility has backup power capability (generator or battery) to maintain operations during primary power outages.
attributes.references: FAA Order 6050.32 - National Airspace System Equipment

attributes.name: backup_power_duration_hours
attributes.description: The number of hours the navigation aid can operate on backup power before requiring refueling or recharging.
attributes.references: FAA Order 6050.32 - National Airspace System Equipment

attributes.name: remote_monitoring_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the navigation aid facility is equipped with remote monitoring capability allowing real-time status monitoring from a central facility.
attributes.references: FAA Order 6050.32 - National Airspace System Equipment

attributes.name: site_address
attributes.description: The physical street address or location description of the navigation aid facility site.

attributes.name: site_city
attributes.description: The city or municipality where the navigation aid facility is located.

attributes.name: site_county
attributes.description: The county in North Carolina where the navigation aid facility is located.

attributes.name: site_state
attributes.description: The two-letter state code where the navigation aid facility is located (typically NC for North Carolina).

attributes.name: site_zip_code
attributes.description: The US Postal Service ZIP code for the navigation aid facility location.

attributes.name: artcc_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Air Route Traffic Control Center (ARTCC) Code
attributes.description: The three-letter code identifying the Air Route Traffic Control Center responsible for the airspace where this navigation aid operates.
attributes.references: FAA Order 7400.2 - Procedures for Handling Airspace Matters

attributes.name: approach_procedure_published
attributes.description: Indicates whether there is a published instrument approach procedure that utilizes this navigation aid.
attributes.references: FAA Order 8260.3 - United States Standard for Terminal Instrument Procedures

attributes.name: chart_supplement_page
attributes.description: The page reference in the FAA Chart Supplement (formerly Airport/Facility Directory) where this navigation aid is documented.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field containing additional operational information, limitations, or special notes about the navigation aid facility.
attributes.references: FAA National Flight Data Center (NFDC) Data Dictionary

attributes.name: environmental_assessment_date
attributes.description: The date when the most recent environmental assessment or environmental impact statement was completed for the navigation aid facility in compliance with NEPA requirements.

attributes.name: environmental_clearance_status
attributes.description: The current status of environmental clearance for the navigation aid facility under NEPA requirements.
attributes.value_regex: Categorical Exclusion|Finding of No Significant Impact|Environmental Impact Statement|Pending|Not Required

attributes.name: historical_preservation_status
attributes.description: The status of Section 106 historical preservation review for the navigation aid facility site.
attributes.value_regex: Not Evaluated|No Historic Properties Affected|Historic Property Present|Section 106 Complete|Pending Review

attributes.name: ada_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Compliance Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the navigation aid facility site meets ADA accessibility requirements for maintenance personnel access.

attributes.name: cybersecurity_assessment_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent cybersecurity assessment or audit of the navigation aid facility systems and controls.

attributes.name: cybersecurity_risk_level
attributes.description: The assessed cybersecurity risk level for the navigation aid facility based on NIST framework evaluation.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: The name of the operational system from which this navigation aid record was sourced (e.g., FAA NFDC, NCDOT Aviation Database, ArcGIS Enterprise).

attributes.name: record_effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this navigation aid record information is considered effective and accurate.

attributes.name: record_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date after which this navigation aid record information is no longer considered current, used for historical tracking.

attributes.name: record_last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this navigation aid record was last updated in the source system.

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project. Business justification: Installation and upgrade of navigation aids (ILS, VOR, lighting systems) are infrastructure projects requiring engineering, procurement, and FAA coordination. Each installation is tracked as a capital

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset. Business justification: Navigation aids (ILS, VOR, radar) are equipment assets requiring procurement tracking, warranty management, and depreciation. Asset management maintains inventory and replacement planning for these sy

attributes.name: location_feature_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gis.feature. Business justification: Navigation aids (VOR, ILS, NDB) are point features in GIS with precise surveyed locations. Aviation technicians use GIS coordinates for installation, maintenance, and FAA charting requirements.

products.name: aircraft
products.description: Master list of aircraft registered for operation within North Carolina, including type, owner, and airworthiness status.

attributes.name: aircraft_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the aircraft record in the NCDOT aviation registry.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: The unique serial number assigned by the aircraft manufacturer during production.

attributes.name: make
attributes.description: The name of the company that manufactured the aircraft (e.g., Cessna, Piper, Boeing).

attributes.name: model
attributes.description: The specific model designation of the aircraft as assigned by the manufacturer (e.g., 172, PA-28, 737-800).

attributes.name: type_certificate_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) Type Certificate Number
attributes.description: The FAA type certificate number that approves the aircraft design for production and operation.
attributes.references: 14 CFR Part 21 - Certification Procedures for Products and Articles

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: The broad category classification of the aircraft based on its operational characteristics and design.

attributes.name: class
attributes.description: The specific class within the aircraft category, defining operational and design characteristics.

attributes.name: engine_type
attributes.description: The type of propulsion system installed on the aircraft.

attributes.name: number_of_engines
attributes.description: The total count of engines installed on the aircraft.

attributes.name: number_of_seats
attributes.description: The total number of seats available for occupants including pilot and passengers.

attributes.name: maximum_gross_weight_lbs
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Gross Takeoff Weight in Pounds
attributes.description: The maximum certificated takeoff weight of the aircraft in pounds as specified by the manufacturer and approved by the FAA.

attributes.name: year_manufactured
attributes.description: The calendar year in which the aircraft was manufactured and completed.

attributes.name: owner_type
attributes.description: The legal classification of the aircraft owner entity.

attributes.name: owner_address_line_1
attributes.description: The first line of the owner's registered mailing address including street number and name.

attributes.name: owner_address_line_2
attributes.description: The second line of the owner's registered mailing address including apartment, suite, or unit number.

attributes.name: owner_city
attributes.description: The city name of the owner's registered mailing address.

attributes.name: owner_state
attributes.description: The two-letter state code of the owner's registered mailing address.

attributes.name: owner_zip_code
attributes.description: The ZIP code of the owner's registered mailing address.

attributes.name: owner_country_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO country code of the owner's registered mailing address.

attributes.name: owner_phone_number
attributes.description: The primary contact phone number for the aircraft owner.

attributes.name: owner_email_address
attributes.description: The primary email address for communication with the aircraft owner.

attributes.name: operator_name
attributes.description: The name of the individual or organization that operates the aircraft, if different from the owner.
attributes.references: 14 CFR Part 91 - General Operating and Flight Rules

attributes.name: base_airport_code
attributes.description: The FAA location identifier or ICAO code of the airport where the aircraft is primarily based.

attributes.name: base_airport_name
attributes.description: The full name of the airport where the aircraft is primarily based.

attributes.name: registration_status
attributes.description: The current status of the aircraft's FAA registration.

attributes.name: registration_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current aircraft registration expires and must be renewed.

attributes.name: airworthiness_certificate_number
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the FAA airworthiness certificate issued for this aircraft.
attributes.references: 14 CFR Part 21 - Certification Procedures for Products and Articles

attributes.name: airworthiness_status
attributes.description: The current status and classification of the aircraft's airworthiness certificate.
attributes.references: 14 CFR Part 21 - Certification Procedures for Products and Articles

attributes.name: airworthiness_issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current airworthiness certificate was issued by the FAA.
attributes.references: 14 CFR Part 21 - Certification Procedures for Products and Articles

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent annual or 100-hour inspection performed on the aircraft.

attributes.name: last_inspection_type
attributes.description: The type of the most recent inspection performed on the aircraft.

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the next required inspection must be completed to maintain airworthiness.

attributes.name: total_airframe_hours
attributes.description: The cumulative total flight hours logged by the aircraft airframe since manufacture.

attributes.name: total_engine_hours
attributes.description: The cumulative total operating hours logged by the aircraft engine(s) since manufacture or overhaul.

attributes.name: hours_since_last_overhaul
attributes.description: The number of flight hours accumulated since the last major engine or airframe overhaul.

attributes.name: usage_type
attributes.description: The primary operational purpose for which the aircraft is used.
attributes.references: 14 CFR Part 91 - General Operating and Flight Rules

attributes.name: operation_type
attributes.description: The specific FAA regulatory part under which the aircraft primarily operates.

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: The policy number of the current aircraft liability insurance coverage.
attributes.references: 14 CFR Part 91.203 - Civil Aircraft: Certifications Required

attributes.name: insurance_carrier_name
attributes.description: The name of the insurance company providing aircraft liability coverage.

attributes.name: insurance_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current aircraft insurance policy expires.

attributes.name: liability_coverage_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of liability coverage provided by the aircraft insurance policy.

attributes.name: hull_coverage_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of physical damage (hull) coverage provided by the aircraft insurance policy.

attributes.name: nc_based_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the aircraft is primarily based at a North Carolina airport.

attributes.name: nc_registered_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the aircraft owner is a North Carolina resident or entity.

attributes.name: public_use_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the aircraft is operated for public use purposes such as government or emergency services.

attributes.name: commercial_operation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the aircraft is used for commercial operations requiring FAA certification.
attributes.references: 14 CFR Part 119 - Certification: Air Carriers and Commercial Operators

attributes.name: transponder_code
attributes.description: The four-digit octal code assigned to the aircraft transponder for air traffic control identification.
attributes.references: 14 CFR Part 91.215 - ATC Transponder and Altitude Reporting Equipment

attributes.name: mode_s_code
attributes.description: The unique 24-bit ICAO address assigned to the aircraft for Mode S transponder operations.

attributes.name: ads_b_equipped_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the aircraft is equipped with ADS-B Out capability for enhanced surveillance.
attributes.references: 14 CFR Part 91.225 - Automatic Dependent Surveillance-Broadcast (ADS-B) Out Equipment

attributes.name: elt_type
attributes.description: The type of emergency locator transmitter installed on the aircraft.

attributes.name: elt_expiration_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Emergency Locator Transmitter (ELT) Battery Expiration Date
attributes.description: The date on which the ELT battery expires and must be replaced.

attributes.name: avionics_package
attributes.description: A description of the avionics and navigation equipment installed in the aircraft.

attributes.name: ifr_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the aircraft is certified and equipped for instrument flight rules operations.
attributes.references: 14 CFR Part 91.205 - Powered Civil Aircraft with Standard Category U.S. Airworthiness Certificates

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: The type of fuel required for aircraft operations.

attributes.name: fuel_capacity_gallons
attributes.description: The total fuel capacity of the aircraft in U.S. gallons.

attributes.name: cruise_speed_knots
attributes.description: The typical cruise speed of the aircraft in knots.

attributes.name: range_nautical_miles
attributes.description: The maximum range of the aircraft in nautical miles under standard conditions.

attributes.name: service_ceiling_feet
attributes.description: The maximum altitude at which the aircraft can maintain a specified rate of climb, measured in feet above sea level.

attributes.name: paint_scheme_description
attributes.description: A description of the aircraft's exterior paint colors and markings for identification purposes.

attributes.name: special_equipment_codes
attributes.description: ICAO flight plan equipment codes indicating special navigation and communication equipment installed.

attributes.name: noise_certification_level
attributes.description: The FAA noise certification stage level assigned to the aircraft.
attributes.references: 14 CFR Part 36 - Noise Standards: Aircraft Type and Airworthiness Certification

attributes.name: hangar_location
