attributes.name: segment_length_miles
attributes.description: Total length of the track segment measured in miles, calculated as the difference between end and start mileposts.

attributes.name: subdivision_name
attributes.description: Name of the railroad subdivision or district to which the track segment belongs for operational management purposes.

attributes.name: line_name
attributes.description: Name of the railroad line or route that contains the track segment.

attributes.name: track_number
attributes.description: Numeric or alphanumeric designation for the specific track within a multi-track corridor (e.g., Track 1, Track 2, Main 1).

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Primary direction of train movement authorized on the track segment.

attributes.name: track_gauge_inches
attributes.description: Distance between the inner faces of the two rails, measured in inches. Standard gauge in North America is 56.5 inches (4 feet 8.5 inches).

attributes.name: rail_weight_lbs_per_yard
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rail Weight in Pounds per Yard
attributes.description: Weight of the rail per yard of length, measured in pounds. Common weights include 115, 132, 136, and 141 lbs/yd.

attributes.name: rail_type
attributes.description: Specification or profile type of the rail (e.g., RE, AREA, BS, UIC standards).

attributes.name: rail_manufacturer
attributes.description: Name of the company that manufactured the rail installed on the track segment.

attributes.name: rail_installation_date
attributes.description: Date when the current rail was installed on the track segment.

attributes.name: tie_type
attributes.description: Material type of the railroad ties (crossties) supporting the rails on the track segment.

attributes.name: tie_spacing_inches
attributes.description: Average distance between railroad ties, measured center-to-center in inches.

attributes.name: ballast_type
attributes.description: Type of material used for track ballast that provides drainage and distributes load from ties to subgrade.

attributes.name: ballast_depth_inches
attributes.description: Depth of ballast material beneath the ties, measured in inches.

attributes.name: maximum_speed_freight_mph
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Speed for Freight Trains in Miles per Hour
attributes.description: Maximum authorized speed for freight trains on the track segment, measured in miles per hour.

attributes.name: maximum_speed_passenger_mph
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Speed for Passenger Trains in Miles per Hour
attributes.description: Maximum authorized speed for passenger trains on the track segment, measured in miles per hour.

attributes.name: maximum_axle_load_tons
attributes.description: Maximum weight per axle that the track segment is designed to support, measured in tons.

attributes.name: curvature_degree
attributes.description: Degree of curvature of the track segment, measured as the central angle subtended by a 100-foot chord.

attributes.name: superelevation_inches
attributes.description: Amount of banking or cant applied to curved track, measured as the elevation difference between outer and inner rails in inches.

attributes.name: grade_percent
attributes.description: Average gradient or slope of the track segment, expressed as a percentage (positive for uphill, negative for downhill).

attributes.name: signal_system_type
attributes.description: Type of train control and signaling system in use on the track segment.
attributes.references: 49 CFR Part 236 - Rules, Standards, and Instructions Governing the Installation, Inspection, Maintenance, and Repair of Signal and Train Control Systems

attributes.name: positive_train_control_equipped
attributes.description: Indicates whether the track segment is equipped with Positive Train Control technology as required by federal mandate.

attributes.name: electrification_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the track segment has overhead catenary or third rail electrification for electric train operations.

attributes.name: electrification_voltage
attributes.description: Voltage of the electrical system if the track is electrified, measured in volts.

attributes.name: crossing_count
attributes.description: Number of highway-rail grade crossings located within the track segment.

attributes.name: bridge_count
attributes.description: Number of railroad bridges located within the track segment.

attributes.name: tunnel_count
attributes.description: Number of railroad tunnels located within the track segment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the track segment.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Type of rail service provided on the track segment.

attributes.name: annual_traffic_density_mgt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Annual Traffic Density in Million Gross Tons (MGT)
attributes.description: Total annual tonnage of freight and passenger trains passing over the track segment, measured in million gross tons.

attributes.name: daily_train_count
attributes.description: Average number of trains operating on the track segment per day.

attributes.name: hazmat_route
attributes.description: Indicates whether the track segment is designated as a route for transporting hazardous materials.
attributes.references: 49 CFR Part 172 - Hazardous Materials Table, Special Provisions, Hazardous Materials Communications

attributes.name: key_route
attributes.description: Indicates whether the track segment is designated as a key route for strategic military or economic transportation purposes.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent FRA-compliant track inspection performed on the segment.

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next required track inspection based on FRA inspection frequency requirements.

attributes.name: inspection_frequency_days
attributes.description: Required frequency of track inspections measured in days, based on track class and traffic density.

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent maintenance activity performed on the track segment.

attributes.name: maintenance_responsibility
attributes.description: Entity responsible for maintaining the track segment.

attributes.name: geometry_wkt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Track Segment Geometry in Well-Known Text (WKT) Format
attributes.description: Spatial geometry of the track segment centerline represented in Well-Known Text format for GIS applications.

attributes.name: start_latitude
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of the track segment starting point in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: start_longitude
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the track segment starting point in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: end_latitude
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of the track segment ending point in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: end_longitude
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the track segment ending point in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: county_name
attributes.description: Name of the North Carolina county in which the track segment is primarily located.

attributes.name: municipality_name
attributes.description: Name of the city or town in which the track segment is located, if applicable.

attributes.name: mpo_name
attributes.description: Name of the Metropolitan Planning Organization with jurisdiction over the area containing the track segment, if applicable.

attributes.name: rpo_name
attributes.description: Name of the Rural Planning Organization with jurisdiction over the area containing the track segment, if applicable.

attributes.name: ncdot_division
attributes.business_glossary_term: North Carolina Department of Transportation (NCDOT) Division
attributes.description: NCDOT highway division number in which the track segment is located for administrative coordination purposes.

attributes.name: fra_region
attributes.description: FRA regional office with regulatory oversight jurisdiction over the track segment.

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Classification of ownership structure for the track segment.

attributes.name: right_of_way_width_feet
attributes.description: Width of the railroad right-of-way corridor measured in feet.

attributes.name: clearance_height_feet
attributes.description: Minimum vertical clearance above the rail for overhead structures, measured in feet.

attributes.name: clearance_width_feet
attributes.description: Minimum horizontal clearance from track centerline to adjacent structures, measured in feet.

attributes.name: drainage_adequacy
attributes.description: Assessment of the adequacy of drainage infrastructure along the track segment.

attributes.name: vegetation_control_status
attributes.description: Current status of vegetation management along the track right-of-way.

attributes.name: environmental_sensitivity
attributes.description: Level of environmental sensitivity of the area surrounding the track segment, considering wetlands, endangered species habitat, and other environmental factors.

attributes.name: historic_designation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the track segment or associated structures have historic preservation designation.

attributes.name: construction_year
attributes.description: Year when the track segment was originally constructed.

attributes.name: last_rehabilitation_year
attributes.description: Year when the track segment last underwent major rehabilitation or reconstruction.

attributes.name: estimated_remaining_life_years
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Remaining Service Life in Years
attributes.description: Estimated number of years remaining before the track segment will require major rehabilitation or replacement.

attributes.name: replacement_cost_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated cost to completely replace the track segment with equivalent new infrastructure, measured in US dollars.

attributes.name: condition_rating
attributes.description: Overall condition assessment of the track segment based on inspection findings and performance metrics.

attributes.name: defect_count
attributes.description: Number of track defects identified during the most recent inspection that require monitoring or remediation.

attributes.name: critical_defect_count
attributes.description: Number of critical track defects requiring immediate remediation or speed restrictions.

attributes.name: speed_restriction_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether temporary speed restrictions are currently in effect on the track segment due to track conditions or maintenance activities.

attributes.name: restricted_speed_mph
attributes.business_glossary_term: Restricted Speed in Miles per Hour
attributes.description: Temporary reduced speed limit in effect on the track segment, measured in miles per hour.

attributes.name: noise_sensitive_area
attributes.description: Indicates whether the track segment passes through an area designated as noise-sensitive, requiring special operational considerations.

attributes.name: quiet_zone
attributes.description: Indicates whether the track segment is within an FRA-approved quiet zone where routine train horn sounding is prohibited.
attributes.references: 49 CFR Part 222 - Use of Locomotive Horns at Highway-Rail Grade Crossings

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary contact person for emergency situations involving the track segment.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: 24-hour emergency contact phone number for incidents involving the track segment.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special considerations related to the track segment.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Source system or database from which the track segment record was obtained or last updated.

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: Date when the track segment record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the current track segment configuration or status became effective.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the current track segment record or authorization expires, if applicable.

products.name: track_inspection
products.description: This association product represents the Event of a safety inspection being performed on a specific track segment. It captures the inspection findings, compliance status, and defects identified for each track segment during each inspection. Each record links one track segment to one safety inspection with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific inspection-segment relationship.. Existence Justification: In rail operations, track segments undergo multiple safety inspections over time (geometry checks, rail condition assessments, tie inspections), and each safety inspection event typically covers multiple contiguous track segments along a line or subdivision. The business actively manages inspection-segment pairings as operational records, tracking specific findings, compliance status, and defect counts for each segment during each inspection. This is a true operational M:N relationship where the inspection-segment pairing carries meaningful data.

attributes.name: replacement_cost
attributes.description: Estimated current cost to replace the asset with a similar new asset, in US dollars.

attributes.name: salvage_value
attributes.description: Estimated residual value of the asset at the end of its useful life, in US dollars.

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Type of ownership or control NCDOT has over the asset.

attributes.name: responsible_organization
attributes.description: Organizational unit or department within NCDOT responsible for managing and maintaining the asset.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: SAP cost center code to which asset-related expenses are charged for financial tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: SAP Project System WBS element associated with the asset for project-based cost tracking and capital project management.

attributes.name: tag
attributes.description: Physical tag or barcode number affixed to the asset for inventory control and field identification.

attributes.name: barcode
attributes.description: Barcode value used for scanning and automated tracking of the asset in inventory systems.

attributes.name: rfid_tag
attributes.description: RFID tag identifier for automated tracking and location monitoring of mobile assets.

attributes.name: warranty_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the manufacturer or vendor warranty coverage begins for the asset.

attributes.name: warranty_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the manufacturer or vendor warranty coverage expires for the asset.

attributes.name: warranty_type
attributes.description: Type of warranty coverage in effect for the asset.

attributes.name: maintenance_plan
attributes.description: Identifier for the preventive maintenance plan or schedule assigned to the asset in SAP PM.

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent maintenance activity was completed on the asset.

attributes.name: next_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date when the next scheduled preventive maintenance is due for the asset.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent formal inspection was conducted on the asset.

attributes.name: next_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date when the next required inspection is due for the asset per regulatory or policy requirements.

attributes.name: inspection_frequency_months
attributes.description: Required frequency for formal inspections of the asset, expressed in months between inspections.

attributes.name: odometer_reading
attributes.description: Current odometer reading for vehicle assets, measured in miles.

attributes.name: engine_hours
attributes.description: Total accumulated engine operating hours for equipment and vehicle assets.

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: Type of fuel or energy source used to power the asset.

attributes.name: fuel_capacity_gallons
attributes.description: Maximum fuel tank capacity for the asset, measured in gallons.

attributes.name: weight_pounds
attributes.description: Total weight of the asset, measured in pounds.

attributes.name: capacity
attributes.description: Operational capacity specification for the asset, such as passenger capacity, load capacity, or processing capacity with units.

attributes.name: dimensions
attributes.description: Physical dimensions of the asset including length, width, and height with units.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: Primary color or paint scheme of the asset for identification purposes.

attributes.name: criticality_rating
attributes.description: Business criticality classification indicating the importance of the asset to NCDOT operations and service delivery.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Calculated risk score for the asset based on probability of failure and consequence of failure, used for prioritization.

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Insurance policy number covering the asset for liability, damage, or loss.

attributes.name: insurance_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the current insurance coverage expires for the asset.

attributes.name: title_number
attributes.description: Official title or deed number for assets requiring legal title documentation such as vehicles and real property.

attributes.name: title_holder
attributes.description: Legal entity holding title to the asset, typically NCDOT or the State of North Carolina.

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Name of the vendor or supplier from whom the asset was purchased or who provides maintenance services.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: SAP purchase order number used to acquire the asset.

attributes.name: grant_number
attributes.description: Federal or state grant number if the asset was acquired using grant funding.

attributes.name: grant_program
attributes.description: Name of the grant program that funded the asset acquisition, such as HSIP, CMAQ, BUILD, or INFRA.

attributes.name: federal_participation_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of asset cost funded by federal sources, used for grant compliance and reporting.

attributes.name: disposal_date
attributes.description: Date when the asset was disposed of, sold, transferred, or retired from service.

attributes.name: disposal_method
attributes.description: Method used to dispose of the asset at end of life.

attributes.name: disposal_proceeds
attributes.description: Amount received from the sale or disposal of the asset, in US dollars.

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the asset meets current environmental compliance standards and regulations.

attributes.name: ada_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the asset meets ADA accessibility requirements.

attributes.name: safety_certification
attributes.description: Safety certification or compliance standard met by the asset, such as OSHA, FMCSA, or MUTCD standards.

attributes.name: safety_certification_date
attributes.description: Date when the asset received its current safety certification.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when the asset master record was created in the system.

attributes.name: modified_date
attributes.description: Date when the asset master record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.location. Business justification: Asset must reference its physical location. Location table provides comprehensive location data including functional location, organizational hierarchy (division/district/county), geographic coordinat

attributes.name: dmv_office_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to dmv.office. Business justification: NCDOT assets (computers, furniture, kiosks, signage) are physically located at specific DMV offices. Asset management tracks which office holds each asset for inventory, maintenance scheduling, and pr

attributes.name: originating_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project. Business justification: New assets (bridges, roads, signals) are created through capital projects. Asset management tracks which construction project built each asset for warranty, as-built documentation, and lifecycle histo

attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rightofway.parcel. Business justification: Transportation assets (signs, guardrails, signals) are physically located on specific right-of-way parcels. Asset management requires tracking which parcel each asset occupies for maintenance access,

attributes.name: assigned_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Assets like vehicles, laptops, and equipment are assigned to specific employees for custody and accountability. Asset management tracks who currently holds each asset for inventory control and respons

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Assets are assigned to cost centers for budget tracking and departmental accountability. Finance uses this to allocate maintenance costs and capital expenditures to responsible divisions like highway,

attributes.name: type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.type. Business justification: Asset must reference its type classification to inherit capitalization threshold, depreciation method, useful life, and maintenance strategy. Normalizes asset_class, category, depreciation_method, use

products.name: type
products.description: Reference list of asset categories and sub‑categories (e.g., vehicle, bridge, building, heavy equipment).

attributes.name: type_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the asset type record. Primary key for the asset type reference table.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the asset type for system integration and reporting purposes. Used in SAP PM and ATLAS systems for asset classification.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the asset type (e.g., Bridge, Highway Pavement, Ferry Vessel, Heavy Equipment, Building).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the asset type including characteristics, typical use cases, and classification criteria.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: High-level category grouping for the asset type (e.g., Infrastructure, Equipment, Vehicle, Facility, Technology, Land).

attributes.name: subcategory
attributes.description: Secondary classification level providing more granular categorization within the primary category (e.g., Bridge, Pavement, Traffic Signal under Infrastructure).

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: SAP PM asset class designation used for financial accounting, depreciation calculation, and lifecycle management integration.

attributes.name: capitalization_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Minimum dollar value required for an asset of this type to be capitalized rather than expensed, per GASB standards and NCDOT policy.

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Standard expected useful life in years for assets of this type, used for depreciation calculation and lifecycle planning.

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Standard depreciation method applied to assets of this type for financial reporting (e.g., Straight Line, Declining Balance, Units of Production).

attributes.name: salvage_value_percentage
attributes.description: Expected residual value as a percentage of original cost at end of useful life for assets of this type.

attributes.name: maintenance_strategy
attributes.description: Standard maintenance approach for assets of this type (e.g., Preventive, Predictive, Reactive, Condition-Based, Time-Based, Risk-Based).

attributes.name: inspection_frequency_days
attributes.description: Standard interval in days between required inspections for assets of this type, based on regulatory requirements and NCDOT policy.

attributes.name: requires_federal_reporting
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets of this type must be reported to federal agencies such as FHWA, FTA, FAA, or FRA.
attributes.references: 23 CFR Part 490 - National Performance Management Measures

attributes.name: federal_reporting_system
attributes.description: Federal reporting system where assets of this type must be reported (e.g., HPMS for highways, NBI for bridges, FTA NTD for transit, FAA 5010 for airports).

attributes.name: is_mobile
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets of this type are mobile (vehicles, equipment) or fixed (infrastructure, buildings).

attributes.name: requires_operator_certification
attributes.description: Indicates whether operation of assets of this type requires specific operator certification or licensing (e.g., CDL for commercial vehicles, specialized equipment certifications).

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets of this type are subject to environmental compliance monitoring and reporting requirements.
attributes.references: NEPA, Clean Water Act, Endangered Species Act

attributes.name: gis_layer_name
attributes.description: Name of the GIS layer in ArcGIS Enterprise where assets of this type are spatially represented and managed.

attributes.name: requires_gps_tracking
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Positioning System (GPS) Tracking Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets of this type require GPS tracking for location monitoring and fleet management (typically mobile assets).

attributes.name: insurance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets of this type must carry insurance coverage per NCDOT risk management policy.

attributes.name: insurance_type
attributes.description: Type of insurance coverage required for assets of this type (e.g., Liability, Comprehensive, Collision, Property).

attributes.name: condition_rating_system
attributes.description: Standard condition assessment system used for assets of this type (e.g., PCI for pavement, NBI for bridges, IRI for roughness, custom rating scales).

attributes.name: performance_measurement_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets of this type are subject to performance measurement and reporting under federal or state performance management programs.
attributes.references: 23 CFR Part 490 - National Performance Management Measures

attributes.name: criticality_level
attributes.description: Default criticality classification for assets of this type based on impact to transportation network, public safety, and operational continuity.

attributes.name: replacement_cycle_years
attributes.description: Standard replacement cycle in years for assets of this type based on lifecycle analysis and NCDOT capital planning.

attributes.name: warranty_period_months
attributes.description: Typical manufacturer or contractor warranty period in months for new assets of this type.

attributes.name: requires_safety_inspection
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets of this type require periodic safety inspections per OSHA, FMCSA, or NCDOT safety standards.

attributes.name: safety_inspection_frequency_days
attributes.description: Required interval in days between safety inspections for assets of this type.

attributes.name: disposal_method
attributes.description: Standard method for disposing of assets of this type at end of useful life (e.g., Auction, Trade-In, Scrap, Demolition, Transfer, Donation).

attributes.name: requires_environmental_assessment
attributes.description: Indicates whether disposal or major modification of assets of this type requires environmental assessment per NEPA or state environmental regulations.

attributes.name: barcode_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets of this type must be tagged with barcodes for inventory tracking in ATLAS or SAP PM systems.

attributes.name: rfid_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) Tagging Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets of this type must be tagged with RFID for automated tracking and inventory management.

attributes.name: historical_preservation_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets of this type may be subject to historical preservation review under Section 106 of the National Historic Preservation Act.

attributes.name: ada_compliance_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Compliance Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets of this type must comply with ADA accessibility standards.

attributes.name: mutcd_compliance_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices (MUTCD) Compliance Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets of this type must comply with MUTCD standards for traffic control devices.

attributes.name: aashto_standards_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: American Association of State Highway and Transportation Officials (AASHTO) Standards Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets of this type must be designed, constructed, or maintained according to AASHTO standards.

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: Primary fuel or energy source for mobile assets of this type (e.g., Gasoline, Diesel, Electric, Hybrid, Propane, CNG, Hydrogen).

attributes.name: emissions_tier
attributes.description: EPA emissions tier classification for mobile assets of this type, indicating compliance with federal emissions standards.

attributes.name: procurement_method
attributes.description: Typical procurement method used for acquiring assets of this type (e.g., Competitive Bid, Sole Source, Cooperative Purchase, State Contract).

attributes.name: requires_dbe_participation
attributes.business_glossary_term: Disadvantaged Business Enterprise (DBE) Participation Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether procurement of assets of this type requires DBE participation goals per federal regulations.

attributes.name: stip_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: State Transportation Improvement Program (STIP) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets of this type are eligible for funding through the State Transportation Improvement Program.

attributes.name: federal_funding_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets of this type are eligible for federal transportation funding (FHWA, FTA, FAA, FRA programs).

attributes.name: federal_funding_category
attributes.description: Primary federal funding program category applicable to assets of this type (e.g., NHS, STP, HSIP, CMAQ, BUILD, INFRA, RAISE, FTA programs).

attributes.name: cost_center_default
attributes.description: Default SAP cost center for financial tracking of assets of this type.

attributes.name: gl_account_default
attributes.description: Default general ledger account code in SAP FI for capitalizing assets of this type.
attributes.references: GASB 34, SAP FI Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the asset type in the reference system (Active, Inactive, Deprecated, Under Review).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this asset type classification became effective for use in asset management systems.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this asset type classification is scheduled to expire or be deprecated, if applicable.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when this asset type record was created in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date when this asset type record was last modified.

products.name: location
products.description: Standardized locations where assets are situated, such as depots, mileposts, sites, or GIS coordinates.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the asset location record. Primary key for the location entity.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Business-assigned unique code for the location, used for operational reference and reporting.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the asset location (e.g., 'Raleigh District Maintenance Depot', 'I-40 Milepost 125.3').

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the location type indicating its primary function or purpose within NCDOT operations.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the location indicating availability and usability for asset placement.

attributes.name: functional_location
attributes.description: SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) functional location identifier representing the hierarchical structure of the location within the asset management system.

attributes.name: planning_plant
attributes.description: SAP planning plant code associated with the location for maintenance planning and scheduling purposes.

attributes.name: maintenance_plant
attributes.description: SAP maintenance plant code responsible for maintenance activities at this location.

attributes.name: work_center
attributes.description: SAP work center identifier associated with the location for capacity planning and work assignment.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Financial cost center code to which expenses related to this location are charged.

attributes.name: division
attributes.description: NCDOT division responsible for the location (e.g., Division of Highways, Division of Motor Vehicles).

attributes.name: district
attributes.description: NCDOT district or regional office responsible for managing the location.

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: North Carolina county in which the location is situated.

attributes.name: municipality
attributes.description: City or town name where the location is situated, if applicable.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the location.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for suite, building, or unit information.

attributes.name: zip_code
attributes.description: United States Postal Service ZIP code for the location.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum) for the location.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum) for the location.

attributes.name: elevation
attributes.description: Elevation above sea level in feet for the location.

attributes.name: coordinate_system
attributes.description: Geographic coordinate reference system used for latitude and longitude values.

attributes.name: spatial_accuracy
attributes.description: Classification of the spatial coordinate accuracy indicating the method and precision of location determination.

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Highway or route identifier if the location is associated with a specific roadway (e.g., 'I-40', 'US-1', 'NC-54').

attributes.name: milepost
attributes.description: Linear reference milepost value along the route indicating the precise location on the roadway.

attributes.name: offset_distance
attributes.description: Perpendicular offset distance in feet from the route centerline to the location.

attributes.name: offset_direction
attributes.description: Direction of the offset from the route centerline (e.g., left, right, or cardinal direction).

attributes.name: direction_of_travel
attributes.description: Direction of travel associated with the location if on a directional roadway.

attributes.name: lrs_route_id
attributes.description: Linear Referencing System route identifier used in NCDOT GIS and asset management systems.

attributes.name: lrs_measure
attributes.description: Linear Referencing System measure value representing the location along the LRS route.

attributes.name: facility_size
attributes.description: Total size of the facility in square feet, applicable for fixed facilities such as depots and offices.

attributes.name: capacity
attributes.description: Maximum capacity of the location for asset storage or personnel, expressed in appropriate units (vehicles, equipment units, or persons).

attributes.name: capacity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the location capacity value.

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Type of ownership or control NCDOT has over the location.

attributes.name: owner_name
attributes.description: Name of the legal owner of the location property if not owned by NCDOT.

attributes.name: lease_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the lease agreement for the location expires, if applicable.

attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: County tax parcel identification number for the location property.

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date on which NCDOT acquired ownership or control of the location.

attributes.name: construction_year
attributes.description: Year in which the facility at the location was originally constructed.

attributes.name: last_renovation_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent major renovation or improvement to the facility.

attributes.name: condition_rating
attributes.description: Overall condition assessment rating for the facility at the location.

attributes.name: condition_assessment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent condition assessment for the facility.

attributes.name: accessibility_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accessibility Compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the location meets ADA accessibility requirements.

attributes.name: environmental_designation
attributes.description: Special environmental designation or constraint applicable to the location.

attributes.name: flood_zone
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) Flood Zone
attributes.description: FEMA flood zone designation for the location indicating flood risk.

attributes.name: security_level
attributes.description: Security classification level for the location indicating access control requirements.

attributes.name: access_restrictions
attributes.description: Description of any access restrictions or special requirements for entering the location.

attributes.name: operating_hours
attributes.description: Standard operating hours for the location (e.g., '24/7', 'Monday-Friday 8:00-17:00').

attributes.name: contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary contact person responsible for the location.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for contacting the location manager or responsible party.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for contacting the location manager or responsible party.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the emergency contact person for the location.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: Emergency phone number for the location.

attributes.name: hazmat_storage_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the location is permitted for hazardous materials storage.

attributes.name: fuel_storage_capacity
attributes.description: Total fuel storage capacity at the location in gallons, if applicable.

attributes.name: utilities_available
attributes.description: List of utilities available at the location (e.g., 'electricity, water, sewer, natural gas').

attributes.name: parking_spaces
attributes.description: Total number of parking spaces available at the location.

attributes.name: ada_parking_spaces
attributes.business_glossary_term: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accessible Parking Spaces
attributes.description: Number of ADA-compliant accessible parking spaces at the location.

attributes.name: building_count
attributes.description: Total number of buildings or structures at the location.

attributes.name: atlas_location_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Asset Tracking and Lifecycle Analysis System (ATLAS) Location Identifier
attributes.description: Unique location identifier in the NCDOT ATLAS asset management system.

attributes.name: gis_feature_id
attributes.description: Unique feature identifier in the NCDOT ArcGIS Enterprise system for spatial reference.

attributes.name: tims_location_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Transportation Information Management System (TIMS) Location Identifier
attributes.description: Location identifier in the NCDOT TIMS system for incident management and traffic operations.

attributes.name: parent_location_code
attributes.description: Location code of the parent location in a hierarchical location structure (e.g., a depot within a district).

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level in the location hierarchy (e.g., 1=Division, 2=District, 3=Facility).

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the location.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which the location record is effective and valid for use.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the location record ceases to be effective, supporting temporal data management.

attributes.name: is_current
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the current active record for the location in a slowly changing dimension model.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the location for additional context or special considerations.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which the location record originated.

attributes.name: source_system_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the location in the source system.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the location record in the source system.

products.name: condition
products.description: Standard condition codes used to rate asset health (e.g., excellent, good, fair, poor) based on IRI, PCI, etc.

attributes.name: condition_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the asset condition rating record. Primary key for the condition data product.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the condition rating level (e.g., EXC, GOOD, FAIR, POOR, FAIL). Used across asset management systems for consistent condition classification.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the condition rating (e.g., Excellent, Good, Fair, Poor, Failed).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of what the condition rating represents, including criteria and characteristics that define this condition level.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: The category of asset to which this condition rating applies (e.g., pavement, bridge, structure, facility, equipment, vehicle).

attributes.name: numeric_rating
attributes.description: Numeric representation of the condition rating on a standardized scale. Enables quantitative analysis and trending of asset condition over time.

attributes.name: rating_scale_min
attributes.description: Minimum value of the rating scale used for this condition type (e.g., 0 for a 0-100 scale, 1 for a 1-10 scale).

attributes.name: rating_scale_max
attributes.description: Maximum value of the rating scale used for this condition type (e.g., 100 for a 0-100 scale, 10 for a 1-10 scale).

attributes.name: threshold_lower
attributes.description: Lower boundary threshold value that defines the minimum numeric rating for this condition level. Assets with ratings at or above this value fall into this condition category.

attributes.name: threshold_upper
attributes.description: Upper boundary threshold value that defines the maximum numeric rating for this condition level. Assets with ratings below or at this value fall into this condition category.

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Severity classification indicating the urgency of maintenance or replacement needs associated with this condition rating.

attributes.name: action_required
attributes.description: Type of maintenance or management action typically required when an asset is rated at this condition level.

attributes.name: action_timeframe_days
attributes.description: Recommended timeframe in days within which maintenance action should be taken for assets at this condition level.

attributes.name: iri_min
attributes.description: Minimum International Roughness Index value (inches per mile) associated with this pavement condition rating. IRI measures pavement surface roughness and ride quality.

attributes.name: iri_max
attributes.description: Maximum International Roughness Index value (inches per mile) associated with this pavement condition rating. IRI measures pavement surface roughness and ride quality.

attributes.name: pci_min
attributes.description: Minimum Pavement Condition Index value (0-100 scale) associated with this pavement condition rating. PCI is a numerical rating of pavement surface condition.
attributes.references: ASTM D6433 Standard Practice for Roads and Parking Lots Pavement Condition Index Surveys

attributes.name: pci_max
attributes.description: Maximum Pavement Condition Index value (0-100 scale) associated with this pavement condition rating. PCI is a numerical rating of pavement surface surface condition.
attributes.references: ASTM D6433 Standard Practice for Roads and Parking Lots Pavement Condition Index Surveys

attributes.name: psi_min
attributes.description: Minimum Present Serviceability Index value (0-5 scale) associated with this pavement condition rating. PSI measures the ability of pavement to serve traffic.
attributes.references: AASHTO Guide for Design of Pavement Structures

attributes.name: psi_max
attributes.description: Maximum Present Serviceability Index value (0-5 scale) associated with this pavement condition rating. PSI measures the ability of pavement to serve traffic.
attributes.references: AASHTO Guide for Design of Pavement Structures

attributes.name: nbi_rating
attributes.description: National Bridge Inventory condition rating code (0-9 or N) for bridge components. Used for federal bridge condition reporting.
attributes.references: FHWA Recording and Coding Guide for the Structure Inventory and Appraisal of the Nations Bridges

attributes.name: sufficiency_rating_min
attributes.description: Minimum bridge sufficiency rating (0-100 scale) associated with this condition level. Sufficiency rating evaluates bridge adequacy and safety.
attributes.references: FHWA Recording and Coding Guide for the Structure Inventory and Appraisal of the Nations Bridges

attributes.name: sufficiency_rating_max
attributes.description: Maximum bridge sufficiency rating (0-100 scale) associated with this condition level. Sufficiency rating evaluates bridge adequacy and safety.
attributes.references: FHWA Recording and Coding Guide for the Structure Inventory and Appraisal of the Nations Bridges

attributes.name: color_code
attributes.description: Hexadecimal color code used for visual representation of this condition rating in dashboards, maps, and reports (e.g., #00FF00 for green/good condition).

attributes.name: icon_name
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the icon used to represent this condition rating in user interfaces and mapping applications.

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Numeric value used to control the display order of condition ratings in user interfaces, reports, and dropdown lists. Lower values appear first.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this condition rating is currently active and available for use in asset assessments. Inactive ratings are retained for historical reference.

attributes.name: is_default
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the default condition rating to be applied when no specific assessment has been performed.

attributes.name: requires_inspection
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets at this condition level require formal inspection or assessment by qualified personnel.

attributes.name: triggers_work_order
attributes.description: Indicates whether assignment of this condition rating automatically triggers creation of a maintenance work order in SAP PM or ATLAS.

attributes.name: funding_priority
attributes.description: Priority level (1-10) for funding allocation to assets at this condition level. Lower numbers indicate higher priority for capital investment.

attributes.name: estimated_remaining_life_years
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Remaining Service Life in Years
attributes.description: Typical estimated remaining service life in years for assets at this condition level, used for lifecycle planning and replacement forecasting.

attributes.name: replacement_threshold
attributes.description: Indicates whether this condition level represents the threshold at which asset replacement should be considered rather than continued maintenance.

attributes.name: safety_concern
attributes.description: Indicates whether this condition level represents a safety concern requiring immediate attention or public notification.

attributes.name: public_notification_required

products.name: disposal

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the asset being disposed, linking to the asset master record in SAP PM or ATLAS.

attributes.name: date
attributes.description: The date on which the asset disposal transaction was completed and the asset was removed from active inventory.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the disposal transaction was recorded in the system.

attributes.name: method
attributes.description: The method by which the asset was disposed, indicating the disposition channel used.

attributes.name: reason

attributes.name: status

attributes.name: type

attributes.name: disposition_proceeds_amount

attributes.name: disposition_proceeds_currency
attributes.description: Currency code for the proceeds amount, typically USD for NCDOT transactions.

attributes.name: net_book_value
attributes.description: The net book value (original cost minus accumulated depreciation) of the asset at the time of disposal.

attributes.name: original_acquisition_cost

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation

attributes.name: gain_loss_amount

attributes.name: buyer_type

attributes.name: scrap_material_type

attributes.name: approver_name

attributes.name: data_source_system

Finance department tracks these to record proceeds from surplus equipment sales and ensure proper revenue r

products.name: warranty

attributes.name: provider_contact_name

attributes.description: Date when the warranty coverage becomes effective and begins providing protection for the asset.

attributes.name: end_date

attributes.name: renewable_flag

attributes.name: prorated_flag

attributes.name: parts_covered_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether replacement parts are covered under the warranty.

attributes.name: labor_covered_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether labor costs for repairs are covered under the warranty.

attributes.name: travel_covered_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether travel costs for service technicians are covered under the warranty.

attributes.name: mileage_limit
attributes.description: Maximum mileage or usage limit for vehicle or equipment warranties, beyond which coverage may be voided or reduced.

attributes.name: hours_limit

attributes.name: maintenance_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether regular maintenance is required to keep the warranty valid and enforceable.

attributes.description: Required frequency of maintenance to maintain warranty validity, such as monthly, quarterly, annually, or per usage interval.

products.name: compensation_payment

attributes.description: The amount withheld from the compensation payment for federal or state tax obligations.

attributes.name: net_payment_amount
attributes.description: The net compensation amount disbursed to the payee after all deductions, withholdings, and adjustments.

attributes.name: payment_notes

attributes.name: void_reason
attributes.description: The reason or explanation for voiding or cancelling the compensation payment transaction.

attributes.name: void_date
attributes.description: The date on which the compensation payment was voided or cancelled in the financial system.

attributes.name: reissue_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this payment is a reissued payment replacing a previous voided or returned payment.

attributes.name: original_payment_number
attributes.description: The payment number of the original transaction when this payment is a reissue or replacement.

attributes.name: sap_document_number
attributes.description: The unique SAP financial document number assigned to the compensation payment transaction in the SAP FI module.

attributes.name: sap_posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting posting date in SAP when the compensation payment transaction was recorded to the general ledger.

attributes.name: sap_company_code
attributes.description: The SAP company code representing the legal entity responsible for the compensation payment.

attributes.name: audit_trail_reference
attributes.description: A reference identifier linking the compensation payment to audit documentation and compliance records.

attributes.name: compliance_review_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this compensation payment has undergone federal or state compliance review.
attributes.references: FHWA Compliance Review, OMB Uniform Guidance

attributes.name: compliance_review_date
attributes.description: The date on which the compensation payment underwent compliance review for federal or state requirements.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the compensation payment record was last modified or updated in the system.

attributes.name: landowner_id
