attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rightofway.parcel. Business justification: Compensation payments are made FOR specific parcels that were acquired or impacted. This 1:N relationship (one parcel can have multiple payments - initial acquisition payment, damages payment, supplem

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Landowner compensation payments are processed through registered vendors in the procurement system. Finance department requires vendor validation for all disbursements to ensure proper tax reporting a

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.invoice. Business justification: Each compensation payment to landowners must reference a formal invoice for accounting reconciliation. Accounts payable uses this to match payments to invoices and track payment status in the financia

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Compensation payments to landowners require approval by authorized NCDOT supervisors/managers. This tracks financial accountability and ensures proper authorization chain for public fund disbursement

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.payment. Business justification: Compensation payments to landowners for right-of-way acquisitions are processed through finance's payment system. Finance tracks actual disbursement while rightofway tracks acquisition context. Used d

attributes.name: accounts_payable_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.accounts_payable_invoice. Business justification: Each landowner compensation requires an AP invoice for financial processing and audit trail. Finance generates invoices that rightofway references for acquisition payment tracking and reconciliation.

products.name: acquisition_status
products.description: Reference table of standardized status codes used throughout the right‑of‑way acquisition lifecycle (e.g., pending, approved, in‑survey, closed, cancelled).

attributes.name: acquisition_status_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the acquisition status code. Primary key for the acquisition status reference table.

attributes.name: status_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the acquisition status (e.g., PEND, APPR, SURV, CLSD, CANC). Used as a business key for system integration and reporting.

attributes.name: status_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the acquisition status (e.g., Pending, Approved, In Survey, Closed, Cancelled). Human-readable label for business users.

attributes.name: status_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of what the acquisition status represents, including business rules and conditions that trigger this status.

attributes.name: status_category
attributes.description: High-level grouping of the acquisition status for reporting and filtering purposes. Categorizes statuses into broader lifecycle phases.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status code is currently active and available for use in new acquisitions. Inactive statuses are retained for historical reference only.

attributes.name: is_terminal
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status represents a final state in the acquisition lifecycle (e.g., Closed, Cancelled) from which no further transitions are expected.

attributes.name: requires_approval
attributes.description: Indicates whether transitioning to this status requires formal approval from authorized personnel or management.

attributes.name: approval_level
attributes.description: The organizational level required to approve transition to this status. Defines the authority level needed for status changes.

attributes.name: requires_documentation
attributes.description: Indicates whether supporting documentation must be attached or referenced when an acquisition reaches this status.

attributes.name: document_types_required
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of document types that must be provided when an acquisition reaches this status (e.g., appraisal, title report, environmental clearance).

attributes.name: triggers_notification
attributes.description: Indicates whether reaching this status automatically triggers notifications to stakeholders, property owners, or other parties.

attributes.name: notification_recipients
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of recipient roles or groups that should be notified when an acquisition reaches this status (e.g., property_owner, project_manager, legal_counsel).

attributes.name: allows_payment
attributes.description: Indicates whether payment to property owners can be processed when an acquisition is in this status. Controls financial transaction authorization.

attributes.name: requires_legal_review
attributes.description: Indicates whether legal counsel review is required before or during this status. Ensures compliance with legal requirements.

attributes.name: requires_environmental_clearance
attributes.description: Indicates whether environmental clearance or assessment must be completed before reaching this status. Ensures NEPA compliance.

attributes.name: display_order
attributes.description: Numeric value controlling the sort order for displaying status codes in user interfaces and reports. Lower numbers appear first.

attributes.name: display_color_code
attributes.description: Hexadecimal color code used for visual representation of this status in dashboards and reports (e.g., #00FF00 for approved, #FF0000 for cancelled).

attributes.name: icon_name
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the icon used to represent this status in user interfaces. References standard icon library.

attributes.name: sla_days
attributes.description: Target number of calendar days an acquisition should remain in this status before progressing to the next stage. Used for performance monitoring.

attributes.name: escalation_days
attributes.description: Number of days after which an acquisition in this status should be escalated to management attention if not progressed. Supports proactive management.

attributes.name: federal_reporting_code
attributes.description: Code used for reporting acquisition status to federal agencies such as FHWA. Maps internal status to federal reporting requirements.

attributes.name: stip_status_mapping
attributes.business_glossary_term: State Transportation Improvement Program (STIP) Status Mapping
attributes.description: Corresponding status code used in the State Transportation Improvement Program reporting. Enables cross-system status reconciliation.

attributes.name: impacts_project_schedule
attributes.description: Indicates whether acquisitions in this status are considered critical path items that could impact overall project schedule if delayed.

attributes.name: allows_modification
attributes.description: Indicates whether acquisition details can be modified when in this status. Controls data editing permissions based on lifecycle stage.

attributes.name: requires_survey
attributes.description: Indicates whether a property survey must be completed before or during this status. Ensures accurate property boundary definition.

attributes.name: requires_appraisal
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal property appraisal must be completed before reaching this status. Ensures fair market value determination.
attributes.references: Uniform Relocation Assistance and Real Property Acquisition Policies Act

attributes.name: requires_title_review
attributes.description: Indicates whether title examination and clearance must be completed before or during this status. Ensures clear property ownership.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this status code became active and available for use in the system. Supports temporal tracking of reference data changes.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this status code was or will be retired from active use. Null indicates the status is currently active with no planned retirement.

attributes.name: retirement_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why this status code was retired or made inactive. Provides historical context for reference data changes.

attributes.name: replacement_status_code
attributes.description: Code of the status that replaced this one if it was retired. Supports data migration and historical analysis.

attributes.name: usage_count
attributes.description: Number of active acquisitions currently assigned to this status. Provides operational visibility into status distribution.

attributes.name: last_used_date
attributes.description: Most recent date when this status was assigned to an acquisition. Helps identify obsolete or rarely used status codes.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when this status code record was originally created in the system. Supports audit trail and historical tracking.

attributes.name: modified_date
attributes.description: Date when this status code record was last modified. Supports change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-form notes or comments about this status code, including special handling instructions or business context.

products.name: route
products.description: Master reference table for route. Referenced by route_id.

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Primary key for route

attributes.name: route_number
attributes.description: Official route designation number assigned by NCDOT (e.g., I-40, US-1, NC-55). This is the public-facing route identifier used on signage and maps.

attributes.name: route_name
attributes.description: Common or official name of the route (e.g., 'Blue Ridge Parkway', 'Capital Boulevard'). May be null for routes without designated names.

attributes.name: route_type
attributes.description: Classification of the route based on jurisdictional and functional hierarchy (Interstate, US Highway, State Highway, Secondary Road, Local Road, Toll Road, Scenic Byway).

attributes.name: route_class
attributes.description: Functional classification of the route indicating its role in the transportation network (Primary, Secondary, Tertiary, Collector, Local).

attributes.name: route_direction
attributes.description: Primary directional orientation of the route (North, South, East, West, or combinations for diagonal routes, Bidirectional for routes without specific direction, Loop for circular routes).

attributes.name: route_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the route indicating whether it is active, under construction, planned for future development, decommissioned, or temporarily closed.

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: Governmental or organizational entity responsible for maintenance and management of the route (State, Federal, County, Municipal, Private).

attributes.name: maintenance_division
attributes.description: NCDOT Division responsible for maintenance of this route. North Carolina is divided into 14 highway divisions for maintenance purposes.

attributes.name: begin_milepost
attributes.description: Starting milepost marker for the route segment. Used for linear referencing and asset location.

attributes.name: end_milepost
attributes.description: Ending milepost marker for the route segment. Used for linear referencing and asset location.

attributes.name: total_length_miles
attributes.description: Total length of the route measured in miles. Calculated as the difference between end and begin mileposts.

attributes.name: surface_type
attributes.description: Primary surface material of the route (Asphalt, Concrete, Gravel, Unpaved, Composite). Critical for maintenance planning and asset management.

attributes.name: number_of_lanes
attributes.description: Total number of travel lanes on the route (both directions combined). Used for capacity analysis and traffic planning.

attributes.name: median_type
attributes.description: Type of median separation between opposing traffic directions (None, Painted, Raised, Barrier, Grass, Variable). Important for safety analysis.

attributes.name: speed_limit_mph
attributes.description: Posted speed limit for the route in miles per hour. May vary by segment; this represents the primary or most common speed limit.

attributes.name: truck_route_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the route is designated for commercial truck traffic. True if designated truck route, false otherwise.

attributes.name: emergency_route_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the route is designated as an emergency evacuation or response route. Critical for emergency management planning.

attributes.name: scenic_byway_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the route is designated as a scenic byway with special aesthetic, cultural, or recreational significance.

attributes.name: toll_facility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the route includes toll collection facilities. True if tolled, false if free.

attributes.name: right_of_way_width_feet
attributes.description: Standard width of the right-of-way corridor in feet. Critical for ROW acquisition, property management, and encroachment management.

attributes.name: acquisition_status
attributes.description: Status of right-of-way acquisition for the route. Indicates whether ROW has been fully acquired, is in progress, planned, not required, or partially complete.

attributes.name: sap_re_module_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this route to the SAP Real Estate module for property management, appraisals, and ROW transactions.

attributes.name: county_code
attributes.description: Primary county code where the route is located. For routes spanning multiple counties, this represents the primary or starting county.

attributes.name: urban_rural_designation
attributes.description: Classification of the route environment as urban, rural, suburban, or transitional. Used for funding allocation and planning purposes.

attributes.name: national_highway_system_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the route is part of the National Highway System, which includes roadways important to the nation's economy, defense, and mobility.

attributes.name: functional_class_code
attributes.description: Numeric code representing the functional classification of the route according to FHWA standards (1=Interstate, 2=Principal Arterial, etc.).

attributes.name: pavement_condition_index
attributes.description: Numeric rating of pavement condition on a scale of 0-100, where 100 represents excellent condition. Used for maintenance prioritization and asset management.

attributes.name: last_resurfacing_date
attributes.description: Date when the route was last resurfaced or underwent major pavement rehabilitation. Used for maintenance scheduling and lifecycle analysis.

attributes.name: average_daily_traffic
attributes.description: Average number of vehicles per day traveling on the route. Key metric for capacity planning, safety analysis, and funding allocation.

attributes.name: traffic_count_year
attributes.description: Year when the average daily traffic count was last measured or estimated. Ensures traffic data currency and reliability.

attributes.name: bridge_count
attributes.description: Number of bridges located along the route. Important for maintenance planning and structural asset management.

attributes.name: established_date
attributes.description: Date when the route was officially established or designated in the NCDOT system. Historical reference for route lifecycle management.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date when the route record was last updated in the system. Used for data quality and change tracking.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special conditions, or contextual information about the route that does not fit in structured fields.

domains.name: environmental
domains.description: Environmental compliance and permitting for transportation projects including NEPA documentation (EIS, EA, CE, FONSI), Section 404 Clean Water Act permits, and coordination with SHPO, USACE, NCDEQ for environmental stewardship.

products.name: permit
products.description: Master record for environmental permits issued for transportation projects, including permit type, status, effective and expiration dates, and associated regulatory conditions. Also consolidates: environmental.permit, rail.rail_permit.

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the environmental permit record.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Official permit number assigned by the issuing regulatory agency.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the environmental permit based on regulatory requirement and environmental resource protected.
attributes.references: Clean Water Act Section 404, NEPA, National Historic Preservation Act Section 106

attributes.name: subtype
attributes.description: Detailed subcategory of the permit type providing additional classification granularity.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the environmental permit.

attributes.name: application_date
attributes.description: Date when the permit application was submitted to the regulatory agency.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date when the permit was officially issued by the regulatory agency.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the permit becomes legally effective and work may commence under its authority.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the permit expires and is no longer valid unless renewed.

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: Date when the permit was renewed or extended beyond its original expiration date.

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date when the permit was officially closed after all conditions were satisfied and final inspections completed.

attributes.name: issuing_agency
attributes.description: Regulatory agency or governmental body that issued the environmental permit.

attributes.name: issuing_agency_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the regulatory agency that issued the permit.

attributes.name: issuing_office
attributes.description: Specific office or district within the issuing agency responsible for the permit.

attributes.name: issuing_officer_name
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory official who signed and issued the permit.

attributes.name: issuing_officer_title
attributes.description: Official title of the regulatory officer who issued the permit.

attributes.name: issuing_officer_contact
attributes.description: Contact information for the regulatory officer who issued the permit.

attributes.name: project_location
attributes.description: Geographic location description of the project site covered by the permit.

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: North Carolina county where the permitted project is located.

attributes.name: division
attributes.description: NCDOT highway division responsible for the project covered by the permit.

attributes.name: begin_milepost
attributes.description: Starting milepost location along the route where the permitted work begins.

attributes.name: end_milepost
attributes.description: Ending milepost location along the route where the permitted work ends.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of the primary project location in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the primary project location in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: nepa_approval_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA) Approval Date
attributes.description: Date when the NEPA environmental document was approved or finalized.

attributes.name: impact_type
attributes.description: Type of environmental resource or impact addressed by the permit.
attributes.references: NEPA, Clean Water Act, Endangered Species Act

attributes.name: impact_area_acres
attributes.description: Total area of environmental impact in acres covered by the permit.

attributes.name: impact_area_square_feet
attributes.description: Total area of environmental impact in square feet covered by the permit.

attributes.name: wetland_impact_acres
attributes.description: Total acreage of wetland impacts authorized by the permit.

attributes.name: stream_impact_linear_feet
attributes.description: Total linear feet of stream impacts authorized by the permit.

attributes.name: mitigation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether environmental mitigation is required as a condition of the permit.
attributes.references: Clean Water Act, NEPA Mitigation Requirements

attributes.name: mitigation_type
attributes.description: Type of environmental mitigation required to offset project impacts.
attributes.references: USACE Mitigation Rule, Clean Water Act

attributes.name: mitigation_ratio
attributes.description: Required ratio of mitigation to impact (e.g., 2:1 means 2 acres of mitigation for 1 acre of impact).

attributes.name: mitigation_area_acres
attributes.description: Total acreage of environmental mitigation required by the permit.

attributes.name: mitigation_bank_name
attributes.description: Name of the mitigation bank used to satisfy mitigation requirements.

attributes.name: mitigation_credits_purchased
attributes.description: Number of mitigation credits purchased to satisfy permit requirements.

attributes.name: special_conditions
attributes.description: Specific regulatory conditions, restrictions, or requirements imposed by the permit.

attributes.name: monitoring_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether ongoing environmental monitoring is required as a permit condition.

attributes.name: monitoring_frequency
attributes.description: Required frequency of environmental monitoring activities under the permit.

attributes.name: monitoring_duration_years
attributes.description: Number of years that environmental monitoring is required under the permit.

attributes.name: reporting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether periodic compliance reporting to the regulatory agency is required.

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: Required frequency of compliance reports to the regulatory agency.

attributes.name: inspection_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether regulatory inspections are required as a permit condition.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent regulatory inspection conducted for permit compliance.

attributes.name: next_inspection_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next regulatory inspection for permit compliance.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current status of compliance with permit conditions and regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: violation_count
attributes.description: Total number of permit violations or non-compliance incidents recorded.

attributes.name: last_violation_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent permit violation or non-compliance incident.

attributes.name: enforcement_action_taken
attributes.description: Type of regulatory enforcement action taken in response to permit violations.

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: Monetary penalty assessed for permit violations or non-compliance.

attributes.name: appeal_filed
attributes.description: Indicates whether an appeal has been filed regarding the permit decision or conditions.

attributes.name: appeal_date
attributes.description: Date when an appeal was filed regarding the permit decision or conditions.

attributes.name: appeal_status
attributes.description: Current status of any appeal filed regarding the permit.

attributes.name: public_notice_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether public notice was required for the permit application.

attributes.name: public_notice_date
attributes.description: Date when public notice of the permit application was published.

attributes.name: public_comment_period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the public comment period for the permit application.

attributes.name: public_comments_received
attributes.description: Total number of public comments received during the comment period.

attributes.name: consultation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether consultation with other agencies was required for the permit.

attributes.name: consulting_agencies
attributes.description: List of agencies consulted during the permit review process.

attributes.name: endangered_species_consultation
attributes.description: Indicates whether Endangered Species Act Section 7 consultation was required.

attributes.name: biological_opinion_issued
attributes.description: Indicates whether a biological opinion was issued by USFWS or NOAA for the project.

attributes.name: historic_preservation_consultation
attributes.description: Indicates whether Section 106 historic preservation consultation was required.

attributes.name: shpo_concurrence_received
attributes.business_glossary_term: State Historic Preservation Office (SHPO) Concurrence Received Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether concurrence was received from the State Historic Preservation Office.

attributes.name: tribal_consultation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether consultation with Native American tribes was required.
attributes.references: National Historic Preservation Act Section 106, NEPA

attributes.name: water_quality_certification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether Section 401 Water Quality Certification was required.

attributes.name: water_quality_certification_number
attributes.description: Reference number for the Section 401 Water Quality Certification.

attributes.name: coastal_zone_consistency_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether coastal zone management consistency determination was required.

attributes.name: stormwater_permit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a separate stormwater management permit was required.

attributes.name: erosion_control_plan_approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether the erosion and sediment control plan was approved.

attributes.name: bond_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a performance or financial assurance bond is required for the permit.

attributes.name: bond_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the performance or financial assurance bond required.

attributes.name: bond_status
attributes.description: Current status of the performance or financial assurance bond.

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: Total fee charged by the regulatory agency for processing and issuing the permit.

attributes.name: fee_payment_date
attributes.description: Date when the permit fee was paid to the regulatory agency.

attributes.name: applicant_name
attributes.description: Name of the organization or individual who applied for the permit.

attributes.name: applicant_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary contact person for the permit applicant.

attributes.name: applicant_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary contact person for the permit applicant.

attributes.name: applicant_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact person for the permit applicant.

attributes.name: consultant_name
attributes.description: Name of the environmental consulting firm that prepared the permit application.

attributes.name: consultant_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary contact person at the environmental consulting firm.

attributes.name: ncdot_project_manager
attributes.description: Name of the NCDOT project manager responsible for the permitted project.

attributes.name: ncdot_environmental_coordinator
attributes.description: Name of the NCDOT environmental coordinator responsible for permit compliance.

attributes.name: document_file_path
attributes.description: File system path or URL to the electronic copy of the permit document.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the permit.

attributes.name: bridge_id

attributes.name: grade_crossing_id

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset. Business justification: Environmental permits are issued for specific transportation assets (bridges, culverts, facilities). Compliance tracking requires linking permits to the physical asset they regulate. Used daily by env

attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rightofway.parcel. Business justification: Environmental permits are issued for specific land parcels. Regulatory compliance requires tracking which parcel each permit applies to - used daily by environmental compliance staff for site inspecti

attributes.name: planned_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to planning.planned_project. Business justification: Environmental permits (wetland, stormwater, air quality) are issued for specific planned transportation projects. Permit tracking systems reference the project to manage compliance timelines and const

attributes.name: responsible_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Environmental permits require a designated NCDOT employee responsible for compliance oversight and regulatory coordination. Environmental division uses this to track accountability and contact points

attributes.name: project_boundary_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gis.project_boundary. Business justification: Environmental permits must define spatial boundaries for regulated activities (wetland impacts, stormwater areas). Permitting staff reference project boundaries daily to determine jurisdiction and imp

attributes.name: nepa_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to environmental.nepa_document. Business justification: Permits are issued based on NEPA environmental review documentation. Normalizing nepa_document_type and nepa_document_number strings to FK provides link to authoritative NEPA document with full detail

products.name: nepa_document

attributes.name: document_type

attributes.name: document_number

attributes.name: document_title

attributes.name: preparation_date

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date when the NEPA document was officially submitted to the reviewing authority.

attributes.name: approval_date

attributes.name: approval_status

attributes.name: public_comment_start_date

attributes.name: consultant_firm_name

attributes.name: project_location_description

attributes.name: division

attributes.name: route_number

attributes.name: begin_milepost

attributes.description: Ending milepost location of the project on the affected route.

attributes.name: project_length_miles

attributes.name: environmental_classification

attributes.name: purpose_and_need_statement
attributes.description: Statement describing the purpose of and need for the proposed transportation project.

attributes.name: alternatives_considered_count

products.name: mitigation_plan
products.description: Master record describing mitigation measures required to offset identified environmental impacts, including actions, responsible parties, schedule, and monitoring criteria.

attributes.name: mitigation_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the mitigation plan record. Primary key for the mitigation plan entity.

attributes.name: plan_number

attributes.name: plan_title
attributes.description: Descriptive title of the mitigation plan identifying the primary environmental impact being addressed.

attributes.name: plan_description
attributes.description: Comprehensive description of the mitigation plan including objectives, scope, and overall approach to offsetting environmental impacts.

attributes.name: project_number
attributes.description: NCDOT project identifier for the transportation project requiring this mitigation plan.

attributes.name: impact_type
attributes.description: Category of environmental impact being mitigated (e.g., wetland loss, stream disturbance, endangered species habitat, historic site disturbance).

attributes.name: impact_magnitude

attributes.name: impact_area_acres
attributes.description: Total area of environmental impact measured in acres (e.g., acres of wetland affected, acres of habitat disturbed).

attributes.name: impact_linear_feet
attributes.description: Linear measurement of environmental impact in feet (e.g., feet of stream affected, feet of right-of-way disturbance).

attributes.name: mitigation_type
attributes.description: Primary mitigation strategy employed: avoidance (preventing impact), minimization (reducing impact), rectification (repairing impact), reduction (limiting impact over time), compensation (offsetting impact), restoration (returning to original condition), creation (establishing new resource), enhancement (improving existing resource), preservation (protecting existing resource), or monitoring (tracking impact).

attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of the mitigation site location in decimal degrees.

attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the mitigation site location in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: mitigation_area_acres
attributes.description: Total area of mitigation activity measured in acres (e.g., acres of wetland created, acres of habitat restored).

attributes.name: mitigation_linear_feet
attributes.description: Linear measurement of mitigation activity in feet (e.g., feet of stream restored, feet of buffer established).

attributes.description: Ratio of mitigation area to impact area (e.g., 2:1 ratio means 2 acres of mitigation for every 1 acre of impact).

products.name: monitoring_event
products.description: Transactional record of field monitoring activities (water quality, air quality, species surveys, noise), capturing date, location, observed values, and compliance status.

attributes.name: monitoring_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the environmental monitoring event record.

attributes.name: event_date
attributes.description: The date on which the environmental monitoring event occurred.

attributes.name: event_time
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the environmental monitoring event was conducted.

attributes.name: monitoring_type
attributes.description: The category of environmental monitoring activity conducted (e.g., water quality, air quality, species surveys, noise monitoring).
attributes.references: NEPA, Clean Water Act Section 404, Endangered Species Act

attributes.name: project_number
attributes.description: The unique identifier for the transportation project associated with this monitoring event.

attributes.name: location_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the monitoring location including landmarks, mile markers, or other identifying features.

attributes.description: The geographic latitude coordinate of the monitoring location in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: The geographic longitude coordinate of the monitoring location in decimal degrees.

attributes.description: The North Carolina county where the monitoring event took place.

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: The highway or roadway route identifier where monitoring occurred.

attributes.name: milepost
attributes.description: The milepost location along the route where the monitoring event occurred.

attributes.description: The specific environmental parameter or indicator being measured (e.g., pH, dissolved oxygen, particulate matter, decibels, species count).

attributes.name: measured_value
attributes.description: The numeric value observed or measured during the monitoring event.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measurement for the observed value (e.g., mg/L, ppm, dB, degrees Celsius, count).

attributes.name: threshold_value
attributes.description: The regulatory or permit threshold value that the measured parameter must comply with.
attributes.references: Clean Water Act Section 404, NCDEQ Permit Requirements

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the measured value meets regulatory or permit compliance requirements.
attributes.references: NEPA, Clean Water Act, NCDEQ Regulations

attributes.description: The environmental permit number associated with the monitoring requirement.

attributes.name: permit_type
attributes.description: The category of environmental permit governing the monitoring requirement.
attributes.references: Clean Water Act, NCDEQ Permit Classifications

attributes.name: monitoring_frequency
attributes.description: The required frequency of monitoring as specified in permits or environmental commitments.

attributes.name: sample_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the physical sample collected during the monitoring event, if applicable.

attributes.name: sample_collection_method
attributes.description: The standardized method or protocol used to collect the environmental sample.

attributes.name: laboratory_name
attributes.description: The name of the certified laboratory that analyzed the sample, if applicable.

attributes.name: laboratory_certification_number
attributes.description: The certification number of the laboratory that performed the analysis.

attributes.name: analysis_date
attributes.description: The date when the laboratory analysis was completed.

attributes.name: inspector_name
attributes.description: The full name of the environmental inspector or monitor who conducted the field observation.

attributes.name: inspector_certification
attributes.description: The professional certification or qualification held by the inspector (e.g., CPESC, CPSWQ).

attributes.name: contractor_name
attributes.description: The name of the contractor responsible for environmental compliance at the project site.

attributes.name: weather_conditions
attributes.description: Description of weather conditions at the time of monitoring (e.g., clear, rainy, windy) that may affect measurements.

attributes.name: temperature
attributes.description: Ambient or water temperature at the time of monitoring, measured in degrees Celsius.

attributes.name: flow_rate
attributes.description: The flow rate of water at the monitoring location, typically measured in cubic feet per second or liters per second.

attributes.name: water_body_name
attributes.description: The name of the stream, river, lake, or wetland being monitored.

attributes.name: water_body_classification
attributes.description: The regulatory classification of the water body (e.g., Class C, trout waters, outstanding resource waters).

attributes.name: species_observed

attributes.name: species_count
attributes.description: The number of individual organisms of a species observed during the monitoring event.

attributes.name: habitat_type

attributes.name: mitigation_measure

attributes.name: mitigation_status
attributes.description: The implementation status of the environmental mitigation measure.

attributes.name: agency_coordination
attributes.description: The regulatory agency with which coordination or reporting is required for this monitoring event.

attributes.name: photo_reference

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of the quality or reliability of the monitoring data.

attributes.name: monitoring_phase

attributes.description: Description of the construction activity occurring at the time of monitoring that may impact environmental conditions.

attributes.name: best_management_practice

attributes.name: bmp_condition

attributes.name: record_status

attributes.name: terminal_id

attributes.name: track_segment_id

attributes.name: asset_id

attributes.name: parcel_id

attributes.name: work_order_id

products.name: permit_application
products.description: Transactional record of applications submitted by project owners for environmental permits, containing applicant details, project description, required permits, submission date, and review status. Also consolidates: environmental.permit_application, highway.permit_application.

attributes.name: permit_application_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the environmental permit application record.

attributes.name: application_number
attributes.description: Human-readable unique application number assigned to the permit application for tracking and reference purposes.

attributes.name: application_type
attributes.description: Type of permit application being submitted (new application, renewal of existing permit, modification, transfer, or amendment).

attributes.name: permit_type
attributes.description: Category of environmental permit being requested (Section 404 Clean Water Act, air quality, stormwater, erosion control, wetland impact, stream impact, endangered species, historic preservation, noise, hazardous materials, or other).
attributes.references: Clean Water Act Section 404, NEPA, National Historic Preservation Act Section 106

attributes.name: project_name
attributes.description: Official name of the transportation project for which the environmental permit is being requested.

attributes.name: project_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the transportation project scope, activities, and environmental impacts that necessitate the permit application.

attributes.name: stip_number
attributes.description: STIP project identifier linking the permit application to the state transportation improvement program.

attributes.name: tip_number
attributes.description: TIP project identifier for metropolitan planning organization projects requiring environmental permits.

attributes.name: project_county
attributes.description: North Carolina county where the project and associated environmental impacts are located.

attributes.name: project_division
attributes.description: NCDOT highway division responsible for the project (Division 1 through Division 14).

attributes.name: project_route
attributes.description: Highway route number or designation where the project is located (e.g., I-40, US-1, NC-55).

attributes.name: project_begin_milepost
attributes.description: Starting milepost location of the project along the route.

attributes.name: project_end_milepost
attributes.description: Ending milepost location of the project along the route.

attributes.name: project_length_miles
attributes.description: Total length of the project corridor in miles.

attributes.name: project_latitude
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of the project centroid or primary location in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: project_longitude
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the project centroid or primary location in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: applicant_name
attributes.description: Name of the organization or individual submitting the permit application (typically NCDOT division or contractor).

attributes.name: applicant_organization
attributes.description: Organization name of the permit applicant (e.g., NCDOT Division of Highways, contractor firm).

attributes.name: applicant_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary contact person for the permit application.

attributes.name: applicant_contact_title
attributes.description: Job title or role of the primary contact person for the permit application.

attributes.name: applicant_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact person for permit application correspondence.

attributes.name: applicant_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary contact person for permit application inquiries.

attributes.name: applicant_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the applicant's mailing address.

attributes.name: applicant_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the applicant's mailing address (suite, building, etc.).

attributes.name: applicant_city
attributes.description: City of the applicant's mailing address.

attributes.name: applicant_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code of the applicant's mailing address.

attributes.name: applicant_zip_code
attributes.description: ZIP code of the applicant's mailing address.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date when the permit application was officially submitted to the regulatory agency.

attributes.name: submission_method
attributes.description: Method by which the permit application was submitted (online portal, mail, email, in-person, or fax).

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: Date when the permit application was received and logged by the regulatory agency.

attributes.name: application_status
attributes.description: Current status of the permit application in the review and approval process.

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: Current stage of the regulatory review process for the permit application.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification of the permit application based on project urgency and importance.

attributes.name: regulatory_agency
attributes.description: Primary regulatory agency responsible for reviewing and approving the permit application (USACE, NCDEQ, EPA, SHPO, USFWS, NOAA, FAA, FRA, or other).

attributes.name: usace_district
attributes.business_glossary_term: United States Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) District
attributes.description: USACE district office with jurisdiction over the permit application (Wilmington, Charleston, Norfolk, or not applicable).

attributes.name: ncdeq_regional_office
attributes.business_glossary_term: North Carolina Department of Environmental Quality (NCDEQ) Regional Office
attributes.description: NCDEQ regional office with jurisdiction over the permit application.

attributes.name: permit_number
attributes.description: Official permit number issued by the regulatory agency upon approval (populated after approval).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the permit application was officially approved by the regulatory agency.

attributes.name: denial_date
attributes.description: Date when the permit application was officially denied by the regulatory agency.

attributes.name: denial_reason
attributes.description: Explanation provided by the regulatory agency for denying the permit application.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the approved permit expires and requires renewal or extension.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the approved permit becomes effective and construction activities may commence.

attributes.name: estimated_review_duration_days
attributes.description: Estimated number of days required for the regulatory agency to complete the permit review process.

attributes.name: actual_review_duration_days
attributes.description: Actual number of days taken by the regulatory agency to complete the permit review process.

attributes.name: public_comment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the permit application requires a public comment period as part of the review process.

attributes.name: public_comment_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the public comment period begins for the permit application.

attributes.name: public_comment_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the public comment period ends for the permit application.

attributes.name: public_hearing_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a public hearing is required as part of the permit application review process.

attributes.name: public_hearing_date
attributes.description: Date when the public hearing is scheduled or was held for the permit application.

attributes.name: environmental_impact_area_acres
attributes.description: Total area in acres that will be impacted by the project activities covered by the permit application.

attributes.name: wetland_impact_acres
attributes.description: Total wetland area in acres that will be impacted by the project activities.

attributes.name: stream_impact_linear_feet
attributes.description: Total length of stream in linear feet that will be impacted by the project activities.

attributes.name: mitigation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether environmental mitigation measures are required as a condition of permit approval.

attributes.name: mitigation_type
attributes.description: Type of environmental mitigation required to offset project impacts (wetland restoration, stream restoration, conservation easement, mitigation bank credits, payment in lieu, other, or not applicable).
attributes.references: NEPA Mitigation Requirements, Clean Water Act

attributes.name: mitigation_area_acres
attributes.description: Total area in acres designated for environmental mitigation activities.

attributes.name: mitigation_cost_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated cost in US dollars for implementing required environmental mitigation measures.

attributes.name: endangered_species_present
attributes.description: Indicates whether federally listed endangered or threatened species are present in the project area.

attributes.name: endangered_species_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of endangered or threatened species identified in the project area.
attributes.references: Endangered Species Act, USFWS Species List

attributes.name: historic_properties_present
attributes.description: Indicates whether historic properties or archaeological sites are present in the project area requiring Section 106 review.

attributes.name: shpo_consultation_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: State Historic Preservation Office (SHPO) Consultation Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether consultation with the State Historic Preservation Office is required for the permit application.

attributes.name: shpo_consultation_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: State Historic Preservation Office (SHPO) Consultation Date
attributes.description: Date when consultation with SHPO was initiated or completed.

attributes.name: tribal_consultation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether consultation with federally recognized tribes is required for the permit application.
attributes.references: National Historic Preservation Act Section 106, NEPA

attributes.name: water_quality_certification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Section 401 Water Quality Certification is required from the state for the permit application.

attributes.name: water_quality_certification_number
attributes.description: Official certification number issued by NCDEQ for Section 401 Water Quality Certification.

attributes.name: coastal_zone_consistency_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a coastal zone management consistency determination is required for projects in coastal areas.

attributes.name: stormwater_permit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a stormwater management permit is required for the project.

attributes.name: erosion_control_plan_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether an erosion and sediment control plan is required as part of the permit application.

attributes.name: air_quality_permit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether an air quality permit is required for the project activities.

attributes.name: noise_impact_assessment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a noise impact assessment is required for the project.
attributes.references: FHWA Highway Traffic Noise Regulations, 23 CFR 772

attributes.name: hazardous_materials_present
attributes.description: Indicates whether hazardous materials or contaminated sites are present in the project area.

attributes.name: application_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee amount in US dollars required to be paid for processing the permit application.

attributes.name: application_fee_paid
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required application fee has been paid.

attributes.name: application_fee_payment_date
attributes.description: Date when the application fee was paid.

attributes.name: consultant_firm_name
attributes.description: Name of the environmental consulting firm that prepared the permit application on behalf of the applicant.

attributes.name: consultant_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary contact person at the consulting firm for the permit application.

attributes.name: consultant_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact person at the consulting firm.

attributes.name: consultant_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary contact person at the consulting firm.

attributes.name: assigned_reviewer_name
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory agency staff member assigned to review the permit application.

attributes.name: assigned_reviewer_email
attributes.description: Email address of the regulatory agency staff member assigned to review the permit application.

attributes.name: additional_information_requested_date
attributes.description: Date when the regulatory agency requested additional information or clarification from the applicant.

attributes.name: additional_information_submitted_date
attributes.description: Date when the applicant submitted the requested additional information to the regulatory agency.

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: Date when the permit application was withdrawn by the applicant.

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason
attributes.description: Explanation provided by the applicant for withdrawing the permit application.

attributes.name: appeal_filed
attributes.description: Indicates whether an appeal has been filed in response to a permit denial or conditions.

attributes.name: appeal_date
attributes.description: Date when an appeal was filed in response to a permit denial or conditions.

attributes.name: special_conditions
attributes.description: Special conditions or requirements imposed by the regulatory agency as part of the permit approval.

attributes.name: monitoring_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether ongoing environmental monitoring is required as a condition of the permit.

attributes.name: monitoring_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which environmental monitoring must be conducted as a permit condition.

attributes.name: compliance_inspection_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether compliance inspections by the regulatory agency are required during project construction.

attributes.name: document_repository_url
attributes.description: URL link to the document repository (SharePoint, ProjectWise) where permit application documents are stored.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or observations related to the permit application process.

attributes.name: airport_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to aviation.airport. Business justification: Environmental permit applications are submitted for specific airport facilities (fuel storage, deicing operations). Environmental staff tracks which airport each application pertains to for processing

attributes.name: grant_award_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grant.award. Business justification: Environmental permits for federally-funded transportation projects require grant award tracking for compliance. NEPA documentation must reference specific grant funding sources for environmental revie

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Environmental permit applications are often prepared by external consulting vendors. NCDOT tracks which vendor submitted each application for quality control and vendor performance evaluation.

attributes.name: submitted_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Permit applications track which NCDOT employee submitted the application to regulatory agencies. Essential for correspondence routing, follow-up coordination, and internal accountability tracking.

attributes.name: project_boundary_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gis.project_boundary. Business justification: Permit applications require defined project limits to assess environmental impacts and regulatory jurisdiction. Application reviewers use boundaries to determine which permits are needed based on spat

attributes.name: nepa_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to environmental.nepa_document. Business justification: Applications reference the NEPA documentation that supports the permit request. Normalizing nepa_document_type STRING to FK links application to the authoritative NEPA document record.

products.name: permit_fee
products.description: Reference data defining fees associated with each permit type, including fee amount, cost basis, applicable statutes, and periodic updates.

attributes.name: permit_fee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the permit fee record. Primary key for the permit fee reference data.

attributes.name: permit_type_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the type of environmental permit (e.g., CWA404 for Clean Water Act Section 404, NEPA-EIS for Environmental Impact Statement, NEPA-EA for Environmental Assessment, NEPA-CE for Categorical Exclusion).
attributes.references: NEPA, Clean Water Act Section 404, CFR Title 23

attributes.name: permit_type_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the environmental permit type (e.g., Section 404 Wetlands Permit, Environmental Impact Statement, Environmental Assessment).
attributes.references: NEPA, Clean Water Act, NCDEQ Standards

attributes.name: permit_category
attributes.description: Jurisdictional category of the permit indicating the level of government authority (federal, state, local, or joint jurisdiction).

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: The monetary fee amount charged for the specific permit type, expressed in US dollars.

attributes.name: fee_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the fee amount. Typically USD for NCDOT operations.

attributes.name: fee_basis
attributes.description: The calculation basis or methodology for determining the permit fee (e.g., flat rate, per acre of impact, per linear foot of disturbance, percentage of project cost).

attributes.name: minimum_fee_amount
attributes.description: The minimum fee amount that must be charged regardless of the fee basis calculation, ensuring a floor for permit processing costs.

attributes.name: maximum_fee_amount
attributes.description: The maximum fee amount that can be charged, providing a ceiling for permit fees regardless of project scale.

attributes.name: fee_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure used when the fee basis is quantity-based (e.g., acres for wetland impacts, linear feet for stream crossings, cubic yards for fill material).

attributes.name: applicable_statute_code
attributes.description: The legal statute code or citation that authorizes and governs the permit fee (e.g., NCGS 136-44.2, CFR 23 Part 771).

attributes.name: applicable_statute_name
attributes.description: The full name or title of the statute, regulation, or ordinance that establishes the legal authority for the permit fee.
attributes.references: NCGS, NEPA, Clean Water Act, Endangered Species Act

attributes.name: regulatory_agency_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the primary regulatory agency responsible for administering the permit and collecting the fee (e.g., USACE for US Army Corps of Engineers, NCDEQ for NC Department of Environmental Quality, SHPO for State Historic Preservation Office).
attributes.references: NEPA, Clean Water Act, National Historic Preservation Act

attributes.name: regulatory_agency_name
attributes.description: Full name of the regulatory agency responsible for the permit (e.g., United States Army Corps of Engineers, North Carolina Department of Environmental Quality).
attributes.references: NEPA, Clean Water Act, NCDEQ Standards

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this permit fee amount and structure became effective and applicable to new permit applications.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this permit fee amount and structure ceased to be effective, replaced by a new fee schedule. Null indicates currently active fee.

attributes.name: fee_status
attributes.description: Current status of the permit fee record indicating whether it is actively in use, has been superseded by a newer fee schedule, or is pending approval.

attributes.name: fee_revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number tracking revisions to the fee structure for this permit type, supporting historical fee analysis.

attributes.name: fee_revision_date
attributes.description: The date when this fee revision was officially approved and documented, supporting audit trails and compliance verification.

attributes.name: fee_approval_authority
attributes.description: The name or title of the authority (e.g., NC Legislature, NCDEQ Director, USACE District Commander) that approved the fee schedule.

attributes.name: fee_approval_date
attributes.description: The official date when the fee schedule was approved by the governing authority.

attributes.name: fee_approval_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the official document (e.g., legislative bill number, agency order number) that approved the fee schedule.

attributes.name: payment_due_timing
attributes.description: Specifies when the permit fee payment is due in the permit lifecycle (e.g., upon application submission, upon permit approval, upon permit issuance).

attributes.name: refund_policy
attributes.description: Policy governing whether and under what conditions permit fees may be refunded (e.g., non-refundable, partial refund if application withdrawn, full refund if permit denied).

attributes.name: waiver_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this permit fee is eligible for waiver or reduction under certain circumstances (e.g., public benefit projects, non-profit applicants, emergency situations).

attributes.name: waiver_criteria
attributes.description: Description of the criteria or conditions under which the permit fee may be waived or reduced (e.g., public infrastructure projects, demonstrated financial hardship, emergency response).

attributes.name: expedited_processing_fee
attributes.description: Additional fee amount charged for expedited or priority processing of the permit application, if available.

attributes.name: late_payment_penalty_rate
attributes.description: Percentage rate applied as a penalty for late payment of permit fees, expressed as a percentage of the original fee amount.

attributes.name: annual_adjustment_method
attributes.description: Method used for periodic adjustment of permit fees (e.g., Consumer Price Index indexing, fixed percentage increase, legislative review).

attributes.name: annual_adjustment_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage rate used for annual fee adjustments when a fixed percentage method is applied.

attributes.name: cost_recovery_basis
attributes.description: Indicates the cost recovery philosophy for the fee (e.g., full cost recovery to cover all administrative costs, partial recovery, subsidized by general funds).

attributes.name: revenue_account_code
attributes.description: The general ledger account code where permit fee revenue is recorded in the financial system.

attributes.name: fund_code
attributes.description: The fund code identifying the specific fund (e.g., Highway Fund, Highway Trust Fund, Special Revenue Fund) where permit fee revenue is deposited.

attributes.name: project_type_applicability
attributes.description: Description of the types of transportation projects to which this permit fee applies (e.g., highway construction, bridge replacement, ferry terminal expansion, rail crossing improvements).
attributes.references: NEPA, STIP, NCDOT Project Management Standards

attributes.name: environmental_impact_threshold
attributes.description: Description of the environmental impact thresholds that trigger this permit requirement and associated fee (e.g., wetland impacts exceeding 0.5 acres, stream crossings, endangered species habitat disturbance).
attributes.references: NEPA, Clean Water Act, Endangered Species Act

attributes.name: nepa_document_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA) Document Type
attributes.description: The type of NEPA documentation associated with this permit (EIS for Environmental Impact Statement, EA for Environmental Assessment, CE for Categorical Exclusion, FONSI for Finding of No Significant Impact, ROD for Record of Decision).

attributes.name: consultation_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this permit type requires formal consultation with other agencies (e.g., SHPO for historic preservation, FWS for endangered species, USACE for wetlands).
attributes.references: NEPA, National Historic Preservation Act Section 106, Endangered Species Act Section 7

attributes.name: consultation_agencies
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of agencies that must be consulted as part of the permit process (e.g., SHPO, USACE, FWS, NMFS, EPA).
attributes.references: NEPA, National Historic Preservation Act, Endangered Species Act

attributes.name: public_notice_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether public notice and comment period are required as part of the permit application process.

attributes.name: public_comment_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days allocated for public comment on the permit application, if public notice is required.

attributes.name: standard_processing_time_days
attributes.description: The typical or standard number of days required for the regulatory agency to process and issue a decision on the permit application.

attributes.name: expedited_processing_time_days
attributes.description: The reduced number of days for permit processing when expedited processing is requested and the additional fee is paid.

attributes.name: permit_duration_years
attributes.description: The standard duration in years for which the permit is valid once issued, before renewal is required.

attributes.name: renewal_fee_amount
attributes.description: The fee amount charged for renewing an expired or expiring permit, which may differ from the initial application fee.

attributes.name: modification_fee_amount
attributes.description: The fee amount charged for modifying an existing permit (e.g., scope changes, timeline extensions, impact area adjustments).

attributes.name: transfer_fee_amount
attributes.description: The fee amount charged for transferring a permit from one permit holder to another (e.g., when project ownership changes).

attributes.name: appeal_fee_amount
attributes.description: The fee amount charged for filing an administrative appeal of a permit decision (denial, conditions, or other adverse determination).

attributes.name: mitigation_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether environmental mitigation (e.g., wetland mitigation, stream restoration, habitat compensation) is typically required for projects under this permit type.

attributes.name: mitigation_ratio
attributes.description: The typical mitigation ratio required (e.g., 2:1 meaning two acres of mitigation for every one acre of impact), if applicable to this permit type.
attributes.references: Clean Water Act Section 404, USACE Regulations

attributes.name: bond_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a performance bond or financial assurance is required as part of the permit conditions to ensure compliance and completion of mitigation.

attributes.name: bond_amount_basis
attributes.description: Description of how the required bond amount is calculated (e.g., percentage of project cost, fixed amount per acre of impact, estimated mitigation cost plus contingency).

attributes.name: inspection_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether periodic inspections by the regulatory agency are required as part of permit compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: inspection_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which compliance inspections are required (e.g., one-time pre-construction, annual during construction, quarterly post-construction).

attributes.name: reporting_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether periodic compliance reporting to the regulatory agency is required as a condition of the permit.

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which compliance reports must be submitted to the regulatory agency (e.g., annual monitoring reports, quarterly construction progress reports).

attributes.name: violation_penalty_structure
attributes.description: Description of the penalty structure for permit violations (e.g., per-day fines, fixed penalties, graduated penalties based on severity).
attributes.references: NCGS, Clean Water Act, NCDEQ Regulations

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, clarifications, or special conditions related to the permit fee structure, applicability, or administration.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: The date when this permit fee record was last reviewed for accuracy and currency, supporting data quality management.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next review of this permit fee record to ensure continued accuracy and compliance with current regulations.

attributes.name: accounts_receivable_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.accounts_receivable_invoice. Business justification: Environmental permit fees generate receivable invoices that must be tracked in the financial system for revenue recognition and collection. Finance department processes these daily for permit applican

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.payment. Business justification: Permit fees are paid through the finance system. Each fee payment must reference the actual payment transaction for reconciliation and audit purposes.

products.name: sample
products.description: Master reference table for sample. Referenced by sample_id.

attributes.name: sample_id
attributes.description: Primary key for sample

attributes.name: sample_number
attributes.description: Human-readable unique sample number assigned by field personnel or laboratory for tracking and reference purposes.

attributes.name: project_number
attributes.description: NCDOT project identifier for the transportation project associated with this environmental sample collection.

attributes.name: sample_type
attributes.description: Category of environmental sample collected indicating the medium or material being tested.

attributes.name: sample_matrix
attributes.description: Specific environmental matrix or substrate from which the sample was collected, providing detailed context for the sample type.

attributes.name: collection_date
attributes.description: Date when the environmental sample was physically collected from the field location.

attributes.name: collection_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the sample was collected, critical for time-sensitive analyses and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: collection_method
attributes.description: Technique or procedure used to collect the environmental sample from the field location.

attributes.name: collection_location_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the physical location where the sample was collected, including landmarks and access information.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the sample collection location in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the sample collection location in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: North Carolina county where the sample was collected.

attributes.name: route_number
attributes.description: Highway or roadway route number where the sample collection occurred, if applicable to transportation corridor.

attributes.name: milepost
attributes.description: Linear reference milepost location along the transportation route where sample was collected.

attributes.name: depth_feet
attributes.description: Depth below ground surface or water surface at which the sample was collected, measured in feet.

attributes.name: collector_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or organization responsible for collecting the environmental sample.

attributes.name: collector_organization
attributes.description: Organization or agency that collected the sample, such as NCDOT, consultant firm, or regulatory agency.

attributes.name: laboratory_name
attributes.description: Name of the analytical laboratory where the sample was or will be analyzed.

attributes.name: laboratory_sample_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned by the analytical laboratory for internal tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: chain_of_custody_number
attributes.description: Unique tracking number for the chain of custody documentation that accompanies the sample from collection through analysis.

attributes.name: analysis_requested
attributes.description: Description of the analytical tests or parameters requested for this sample, such as heavy metals, VOCs, or biological indicators.

attributes.name: regulatory_program
attributes.description: Federal or state environmental regulatory program under which the sample is being collected, such as NEPA, Clean Water Act Section 404, or NPDES.

attributes.name: sample_purpose

attributes.name: sample_status

attributes.name: preservation_method

attributes.name: container_type

attributes.name: sample_volume

attributes.name: sample_weight_grams

attributes.name: field_observations
attributes.description: Notes and observations recorded by field personnel at the time of sample collection, including weather, site conditions, and anomalies.

attributes.name: weather_conditions
attributes.description: Weather conditions at the time of sample collection, which may affect sample quality or interpretation.

attributes.name: temperature_celsius

attributes.name: ph_level

attributes.name: received_by_lab_date
attributes.description: Date when the sample was received by the analytical laboratory.

attributes.name: analysis_start_date

attributes.name: analysis_complete_date
attributes.description: Date when all requested laboratory analyses were completed for this sample.

attributes.name: holding_time_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sample was analyzed within the required holding time period specified by EPA methods.

attributes.name: quality_control_level
attributes.description: Level of quality control and quality assurance applied to the sample collection and analysis process.

attributes.name: duplicate_sample_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this sample is a field duplicate collected for quality control purposes.

attributes.name: blank_sample_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a blank sample (field blank, trip blank, or equipment blank) used for quality control.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional comments, notes, or special instructions related to the sample collection, handling, or analysis.

attributes.name: coordinating_agency
attributes.description: Primary federal or state agency coordinating the environmental review or permitting process for which this sample was collected, such as USACE, NCDEQ, or SHPO.

attributes.name: data_usability
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the sample data meets quality standards and is suitable for its intended regulatory or decision-making purpose.

attributes.name: permit_id

attributes.name: nepa_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to environmental.nepa_document. Business justification: Samples may be collected during NEPA studies (baseline environmental conditions, impact assessment).
