domains.name: safety
domains.description: Safety and incident management including emergency response, IMAP operations, crash data analysis, HSIP program administration, and coordination with GHSP for highway safety initiatives and traffic incident management.

products.name: crash_report
products.description: Record of each roadway crash event including location, time, vehicles involved, severity, and contributing factors.

attributes.name: crash_report_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each crash report record in the system.

attributes.name: crash_number
attributes.description: Official crash report number assigned by law enforcement or NCDOT for tracking and reference purposes.

attributes.name: crash_date
attributes.description: The date on which the crash occurred.

attributes.name: crash_time
attributes.description: The time of day when the crash occurred, in 24-hour format.

attributes.name: crash_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp combining date and time when the crash occurred.

attributes.name: crash_severity
attributes.description: Classification of crash severity based on the most severe injury sustained by any person involved.

attributes.name: fatality_count
attributes.description: Total number of fatalities resulting from the crash.

attributes.name: injury_count
attributes.description: Total number of persons injured in the crash, regardless of injury severity.

attributes.name: vehicle_count
attributes.description: Total number of vehicles involved in the crash.

attributes.name: person_count
attributes.description: Total number of persons involved in the crash, including drivers, passengers, pedestrians, and cyclists.

attributes.name: crash_type
attributes.description: General classification of the crash based on the entities involved.

attributes.name: collision_type
attributes.description: Manner of collision describing how vehicles came into contact.

attributes.name: first_harmful_event
attributes.description: The first injury or damage-producing event of the crash.

attributes.name: most_harmful_event
attributes.description: The event that resulted in the most severe injury or, if no injury, the greatest property damage.

attributes.name: manner_of_collision
attributes.description: Describes the orientation of vehicles and the direction of force at the moment of impact.

attributes.name: road_name
attributes.description: Name of the road or highway where the crash occurred.

attributes.name: route_number
attributes.description: Official route number designation (e.g., US-1, NC-55, I-40) for the roadway where the crash occurred.

attributes.name: milepost
attributes.description: Linear reference milepost location along the route where the crash occurred.

attributes.name: county_code
attributes.description: Three-digit FIPS code identifying the North Carolina county where the crash occurred.

attributes.name: county_name
attributes.description: Name of the North Carolina county where the crash occurred.

attributes.name: city_name
attributes.description: Name of the city or municipality where the crash occurred, if applicable.

attributes.name: location_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the crash location, including landmarks, intersections, or other identifying features.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the crash location in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the crash location in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the roadway location where the crash occurred.

attributes.name: intersection_type
attributes.description: Type of intersection where the crash occurred, if applicable.

attributes.name: distance_from_intersection
attributes.description: Distance in feet from the nearest intersection to the crash location.

attributes.name: traffic_control_device
attributes.description: Type of traffic control device present at the crash location.

attributes.name: traffic_control_functioning
attributes.description: Operational status of the traffic control device at the time of the crash.

attributes.name: roadway_alignment
attributes.description: Horizontal alignment of the roadway at the crash location.

attributes.name: roadway_grade
attributes.description: Vertical grade or slope of the roadway at the crash location.

attributes.name: roadway_surface_type
attributes.description: Type of material comprising the roadway surface at the crash location.

attributes.name: roadway_surface_condition
attributes.description: Condition of the roadway surface at the time of the crash.

attributes.name: roadway_character
attributes.description: Physical character of the roadway describing traffic flow direction and separation.

attributes.name: number_of_lanes
attributes.description: Total number of through traffic lanes at the crash location.

attributes.name: lane_of_crash
attributes.description: Specific lane where the crash occurred or initiated.

attributes.name: speed_limit
attributes.description: Posted speed limit in miles per hour at the crash location.

attributes.name: light_condition
attributes.description: Ambient light conditions at the time of the crash.

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Prevailing weather conditions at the time of the crash.

attributes.name: work_zone_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the crash occurred within or was related to a highway work zone.
attributes.references: MUTCD Part 6, FHWA Work Zone Safety

attributes.name: work_zone_type
attributes.description: Type of work zone activity if the crash occurred in a work zone.

attributes.name: school_zone_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the crash occurred within a designated school zone.

attributes.name: railroad_crossing_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the crash occurred at or near a railroad crossing.

attributes.name: bridge_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the crash occurred on a bridge structure.

attributes.name: tunnel_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the crash occurred within a tunnel.

attributes.name: contributing_factor_primary
attributes.description: The primary factor that contributed to the crash occurrence.

attributes.name: contributing_factor_secondary
attributes.description: Additional contributing factor that played a role in the crash.

attributes.name: driver_distraction_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether driver distraction was a contributing factor in the crash.

attributes.name: alcohol_involved_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether alcohol use by any person was a contributing factor in the crash.

attributes.name: drug_involved_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether drug use by any person was a contributing factor in the crash.

attributes.name: speeding_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether speeding was a contributing factor in the crash.

attributes.name: aggressive_driving_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether aggressive driving behavior was a contributing factor in the crash.

attributes.name: hit_and_run_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the crash involved a hit-and-run where a driver left the scene.

attributes.name: commercial_vehicle_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a commercial motor vehicle was involved in the crash.

attributes.name: hazmat_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether hazardous materials were involved in the crash.

attributes.name: emergency_vehicle_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether an emergency vehicle was involved in the crash.

attributes.name: pedestrian_involved_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a pedestrian was involved in the crash.

attributes.name: bicycle_involved_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a bicycle was involved in the crash.

attributes.name: motorcycle_involved_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a motorcycle was involved in the crash.

attributes.name: reporting_agency
attributes.description: Name of the law enforcement agency that investigated and reported the crash.

attributes.name: reporting_officer_badge
attributes.description: Badge or identification number of the law enforcement officer who completed the crash report.

attributes.name: report_date
attributes.description: Date when the crash report was officially filed or completed.

attributes.name: report_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the crash report was filed in the system.

attributes.name: narrative
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the crash circumstances, sequence of events, and findings from the investigating officer.

attributes.name: diagram_available_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a crash diagram or sketch is available for this report.

attributes.name: photos_available_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether photographs of the crash scene are available.

attributes.name: estimated_property_damage
attributes.description: Estimated total property damage in US dollars resulting from the crash.

attributes.name: towed_vehicle_count
attributes.description: Number of vehicles that required towing from the crash scene.

attributes.name: road_closure_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the crash resulted in a temporary road closure.

attributes.name: road_closure_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Duration in minutes that the roadway was closed due to the crash.

attributes.name: imap_response_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Incident Management Assistance Patrol (IMAP) Response Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether NCDOT IMAP units responded to the crash scene.

attributes.name: hsip_eligible_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Highway Safety Improvement Program (HSIP) Eligible Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the crash location or characteristics make it eligible for HSIP funding consideration.

attributes.name: nhs_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the crash occurred on a roadway that is part of the National Highway System.

attributes.name: functional_class
attributes.description: Functional classification of the roadway where the crash occurred.

attributes.name: aadt
attributes.description: Annual Average Daily Traffic volume for the roadway segment where the crash occurred.

attributes.name: crash_location_verified_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the crash location coordinates have been verified and geocoded accurately.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Source system or database from which the crash report data originated.

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the crash report record.

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: Date when the crash report record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the crash report record was last modified.

attributes.name: bridge_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to bridge.bridge. Business justification: Crash reports must reference specific bridge when accident occurs on/near bridge structure. Traffic safety analysts use this daily to identify high-risk bridge locations for corrective action.

attributes.name: flow_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to traffic.traffic_flow. Business justification: Crash reports must reference traffic flow conditions at time/location of crash. Safety analysts use this daily to identify high-risk flow patterns and justify engineering countermeasures.

attributes.name: signal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to traffic.signal. Business justification: Crash reports at signalized intersections must reference the specific signal. Traffic safety engineers analyze signal-related crashes to determine if timing/design modifications are needed.

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project. Business justification: Work zone crashes occurring within active construction/maintenance project areas must link to the project for safety analysis, work zone design evaluation, and potential liability documentation used b

attributes.name: vessel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ferry.vessel. Business justification: Vehicle crashes at ferry terminals or involving ferry operations must link to the vessel for investigation, liability determination, and safety analysis. Critical for legal and insurance processes.

attributes.name: airport_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to aviation.airport. Business justification: Aircraft crashes at airports require crash reports linked to specific airport locations. Safety investigators and airport operations use this daily for incident tracking and FAA compliance reporting.

attributes.name: aircraft_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to aviation.aircraft. Business justification: Aviation crash reports must identify the specific aircraft involved. NTSB reporting requirements and insurance claims processing require linking crash reports to registered aircraft records.

attributes.name: grade_crossing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rail.grade_crossing. Business justification: Vehicle-train crashes at grade crossings require linking crash reports to specific crossing infrastructure. Safety analysts use this daily to identify high-risk crossings and prioritize safety improve

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset. Business justification: Crash reports must reference the specific highway asset (guardrail, sign, bridge) damaged in the collision. Used daily by safety analysts and maintenance planners to assess repair needs and costs.

attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rightofway.parcel. Business justification: Crash reports must reference the specific parcel/right-of-way location where the incident occurred for accurate spatial analysis, liability determination, and infrastructure safety improvements. Used

attributes.name: geocode_request_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gis.geocode_request. Business justification: Crash reports require precise location geocoding for mapping and spatial analysis. DMV and safety analysts use geocoded crash locations daily for hotspot identification and safety program targeting.

attributes.name: map_layer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gis.map_layer. Business justification: Crash reports are visualized on specific map layers (e.g., 'Fatal Crashes 2024', 'Pedestrian Incidents') for public safety dashboards and internal analysis tools used by traffic safety engineers.

products.name: response_action
products.description: Actions taken by emergency responders and NCDOT personnel in response to a safety incident, including dispatch, resources used, and timestamps.

attributes.name: response_action_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the response action taken in response to a safety incident.

attributes.name: incident_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the safety incident to which this response action is associated.

attributes.name: action_type
attributes.description: The type or category of response action taken by emergency responders or NCDOT personnel.

attributes.name: action_status
attributes.description: Current status of the response action in its lifecycle.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the response action based on incident severity and impact.

attributes.name: dispatch_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the response action was dispatched or initiated.

attributes.name: en_route_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the responder began traveling to the incident location.

attributes.name: arrival_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the responder arrived at the incident scene.

attributes.name: action_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the response action work actually began on scene.

attributes.name: action_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the response action work was completed.

attributes.name: departure_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the responder departed from the incident scene.

attributes.name: response_time_minutes
attributes.description: Total time in minutes from dispatch to arrival on scene.

attributes.name: clearance_time_minutes
attributes.description: Total time in minutes from arrival to incident clearance and departure.

attributes.name: responding_agency
attributes.description: The primary agency or organization responsible for this response action.

attributes.name: crew_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific unit, vehicle, or team that responded (e.g., IMAP truck number, patrol unit number).

attributes.name: responder_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary responder or team leader who executed the response action.

attributes.name: responder_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the NCDOT personnel who responded, if applicable.

attributes.name: responder_contact_number
attributes.description: Contact phone number of the responder for coordination purposes.

attributes.name: dispatch_source
attributes.description: The source or method by which the response action was initiated or dispatched.

attributes.name: resource_type
attributes.description: Type of resource or equipment deployed for the response action.

attributes.name: resource_count
attributes.description: Number of resources or units deployed for this response action.

attributes.name: personnel_count
attributes.description: Number of personnel involved in executing the response action.

attributes.name: action_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the response action taken and activities performed.

attributes.name: traffic_control_method
attributes.description: Method of traffic control implemented during the response action.

attributes.name: lanes_closed_count
attributes.description: Number of traffic lanes closed as part of the response action.

attributes.name: road_closure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a full road closure was required for the response action.

attributes.name: detour_route_description
attributes.description: Description of the detour route established if road closure was necessary.

attributes.name: equipment_used
attributes.description: List or description of specialized equipment used during the response action.

attributes.name: materials_used
attributes.description: Description of materials consumed or deployed during the response (e.g., absorbent, cones, signs).

attributes.name: estimated_cost_amount
attributes.description: Estimated cost of the response action including labor, equipment, and materials.

attributes.name: actual_cost_amount
attributes.description: Actual cost incurred for the response action after completion.

attributes.name: cost_recovery_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether costs for this response action are eligible for recovery from responsible parties.

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Weather conditions present during the response action execution.

attributes.name: visibility_condition
attributes.description: Lighting and visibility conditions at the time of the response action.

attributes.name: hazmat_involved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether hazardous materials were involved requiring specialized response.

attributes.name: hazmat_material_type
attributes.description: Type or classification of hazardous material involved in the incident response.

attributes.name: injury_reported_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether injuries were reported during the incident requiring medical response.

attributes.name: fatality_reported_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether fatalities were reported during the incident.

attributes.name: secondary_incident_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a secondary incident occurred during the response action.

attributes.name: coordination_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether coordination with multiple agencies was required for the response.

attributes.name: coordinating_agencies
attributes.description: List of agencies involved in coordinated response efforts.

attributes.name: incident_commander_name
attributes.description: Name of the incident commander who coordinated the overall response effort.

attributes.name: tmc_notified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Traffic Management Center was notified of the response action.

attributes.name: tmc_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the TMC was notified of the incident and response.

attributes.name: public_notification_method
attributes.description: Method used to notify the public about the incident and response actions.

attributes.name: dms_message_posted
attributes.description: Content of the message posted on Dynamic Message Signs to inform motorists.

attributes.name: media_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the incident and response received media coverage.

attributes.name: route_number
attributes.description: Highway or route number where the response action took place.

attributes.name: milepost
attributes.description: Milepost location on the route where the response action occurred.

attributes.name: county_name
attributes.description: North Carolina county where the response action took place.

attributes.name: division_number
attributes.description: NCDOT division number responsible for the geographic area of the response.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of the response action location.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the response action location.

attributes.name: direction_of_travel
attributes.description: Direction of travel on the roadway where the response action occurred.

attributes.name: roadway_type
attributes.description: Classification of the roadway where the response action took place.

attributes.name: traffic_volume_impact
attributes.description: Estimated impact of the incident and response on traffic volume and flow.

attributes.name: estimated_delay_minutes
attributes.description: Estimated average delay to motorists caused by the incident and response actions.

attributes.name: queue_length_miles
attributes.description: Maximum length of traffic queue in miles resulting from the incident.

attributes.name: response_effectiveness_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative rating of the effectiveness of the response action.

attributes.name: lessons_learned
attributes.description: Documentation of lessons learned or improvement opportunities identified from the response.

attributes.name: after_action_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal after-action review was conducted for this response.

attributes.name: after_action_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the after-action review was conducted.

attributes.name: hsip_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Highway Safety Improvement Program (HSIP) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the incident location is eligible for HSIP safety improvements.

attributes.name: ghsp_notification_flag

attributes.description: Indicates whether GHSP was notified for coordination on highway safety initiatives.

attributes.name: special_event_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the response was related to a special event or planned activity.

attributes.name: emergency_declaration_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a state or federal emergency declaration was in effect during the response.

attributes.name: federal_funding_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the response costs are eligible for federal emergency funding reimbursement.

attributes.name: documentation_complete_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all required documentation for the response action has been completed.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether supervisory or management approval is required for this response action.

attributes.name: approved_by_name
attributes.description: Name of the supervisor or manager who approved the response action.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the response action was approved.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments regarding the response action.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Source system from which the response action data was captured.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the response action record was created in the system.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the response action record was last updated.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Emergency response actions must be charged to specific cost centers for budget tracking. Finance department requires this for operational expense allocation and departmental accountability.

products.name: program
products.description: Master record of HSIP safety programs, including program ID, funding allocation, target safety measures, start/end dates, and responsible divisions.

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Highway Safety Improvement Program (HSIP) safety program record.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Official name or title of the safety program initiative.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the safety program for tracking and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the safety program based on its focus area and methodology (e.g., HSIP infrastructure, GHSP behavioral, systemic safety).
attributes.references: FHWA HSIP and GHSP Program Guidelines

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the safety program in its lifecycle.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority ranking assigned to the safety program based on crash severity, frequency, and potential impact.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Official start date of the safety program implementation.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual completion date of the safety program.

attributes.name: responsible_division
attributes.description: NCDOT division or unit responsible for administering and executing the safety program (e.g., Division of Highways, Traffic Safety Unit).

attributes.name: manager_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual assigned as the program manager responsible for overseeing the safety program.

attributes.name: manager_email
attributes.description: Email address of the program manager for official communication.

attributes.name: manager_phone
attributes.description: Contact phone number of the program manager.

attributes.name: target_crash_reduction_percentage
attributes.description: Target percentage reduction in crashes expected from the safety program implementation.

attributes.name: target_fatality_reduction
attributes.description: Target number of fatalities expected to be prevented through the safety program.

attributes.name: target_serious_injury_reduction
attributes.description: Target number of serious injuries (KABCO A-level) expected to be prevented through the safety program.

attributes.name: target_pdo_crash_reduction
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Property Damage Only (PDO) Crash Reduction Count
attributes.description: Target number of property damage only crashes expected to be prevented.

attributes.name: performance_measure
attributes.description: Primary performance measure used to evaluate program effectiveness (e.g., crash rate reduction, fatality rate, serious injury rate).
attributes.references: 23 CFR Part 490 National Performance Management Measures

attributes.name: baseline_crash_count
attributes.description: Number of crashes recorded in the target area during the baseline period before program implementation.

attributes.name: baseline_fatality_count
attributes.description: Number of fatalities recorded in the target area during the baseline period.

attributes.name: baseline_serious_injury_count
attributes.description: Number of serious injuries recorded in the target area during the baseline period.

attributes.name: baseline_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the baseline period used for crash data analysis.

attributes.name: baseline_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the baseline period used for crash data analysis.

attributes.name: target_population
attributes.description: Specific population or user group targeted by the safety program (e.g., pedestrians, bicyclists, commercial vehicle drivers, teen drivers).

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic coverage area of the safety program (e.g., statewide, regional, specific corridor, intersection).

attributes.name: county_name
attributes.description: Name of the county where the safety program is implemented, if applicable.

attributes.name: municipality_name
attributes.description: Name of the city or town where the safety program is implemented, if applicable.

attributes.name: route_number
attributes.description: Highway or route number where the safety program is implemented (e.g., I-40, US-1, NC-55).

attributes.name: milepost_begin
attributes.description: Starting milepost location for corridor or roadway segment safety programs.

attributes.name: milepost_end
attributes.description: Ending milepost location for corridor or roadway segment safety programs.

attributes.name: crash_type_targeted
attributes.description: Specific crash type or pattern the program aims to address (e.g., rear-end, angle, head-on, roadway departure, pedestrian-involved).

attributes.name: countermeasure_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the safety countermeasure or intervention being implemented (e.g., rumble strips, high-friction surface treatment, signal upgrades, pedestrian refuge islands).

attributes.name: countermeasure_type
attributes.description: Classification of the safety countermeasure by implementation approach.

attributes.name: crash_modification_factor
attributes.description: Crash Modification Factor representing the expected effectiveness of the countermeasure in reducing crashes (e.g., 0.75 indicates 25% reduction).

attributes.name: benefit_cost_ratio
attributes.description: Calculated benefit-cost ratio for the safety program, comparing expected safety benefits to program costs.

attributes.name: nepa_status
attributes.description: Status of NEPA environmental review process: Categorical Exclusion (CE), Environmental Assessment (EA), Environmental Impact Statement (EIS), Finding of No Significant Impact (FONSI), Record of Decision (ROD).

attributes.name: stip_number
attributes.description: STIP project number if the safety program is included in the State Transportation Improvement Program.

attributes.name: tip_number
attributes.description: TIP project number if the safety program is included in a Metropolitan Planning Organization Transportation Improvement Program.

attributes.name: mpo_name
attributes.description: Name of the MPO coordinating the safety program, if applicable.

attributes.name: rpo_name
attributes.description: Name of the RPO coordinating the safety program, if applicable.

attributes.name: coordination_agency
attributes.description: External agency or organization coordinating with NCDOT on the safety program (e.g., GHSP, local law enforcement, FHWA, NHTSA).

attributes.name: implementation_phase
attributes.description: Current phase of program implementation in the project lifecycle.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the safety program was officially approved for implementation.

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: Individual or body that approved the safety program (e.g., NCDOT Secretary, Division Engineer, FHWA Division Administrator).

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Contract number for procurement or construction services related to the safety program.

attributes.name: contractor_name
attributes.description: Name of the contractor or vendor executing the safety program work.

attributes.name: let_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract was let for bidding or awarded.

attributes.name: ntp_date
attributes.description: Date when the contractor received Notice to Proceed to begin work.

attributes.name: substantial_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the safety program reached substantial completion and became operational.

attributes.name: final_acceptance_date
attributes.description: Date when the safety program was formally accepted and closed out.

attributes.name: evaluation_status
attributes.description: Status of the post-implementation safety effectiveness evaluation.

attributes.name: evaluation_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the post-implementation evaluation was completed.

attributes.name: actual_crash_reduction_percentage
attributes.description: Actual percentage reduction in crashes achieved after program implementation, based on evaluation data.

attributes.name: actual_fatality_reduction
attributes.description: Actual number of fatalities prevented based on post-implementation evaluation.

attributes.name: actual_serious_injury_reduction
attributes.description: Actual number of serious injuries prevented based on post-implementation evaluation.

attributes.name: lessons_learned
attributes.description: Key lessons learned and best practices identified during program implementation and evaluation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or contextual information about the safety program.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the safety program record was created in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the safety program record was last modified.

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_budget. Business justification: Safety programs operate under approved budgets. Each program is allocated specific funding that must be tracked against a formal budget for compliance and financial reporting.

products.name: public_alert
products.description: Public safety alerts issued to motorists and citizens (e.g., road closures, hazardous conditions, weather impacts) with alert type, message, effective period, and dissemination channels.

attributes.name: public_alert_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the public safety alert record.

attributes.name: alert_number
attributes.description: Human-readable unique alert number assigned to the public safety alert for reference and tracking purposes.

attributes.name: alert_type
attributes.description: Classification of the public safety alert indicating the nature of the hazard or condition being communicated to the public.
attributes.references: MUTCD (Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices)

attributes.name: alert_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the alert for prioritization and filtering purposes.

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Indicates the urgency and potential impact of the alert on public safety and transportation operations.
attributes.references: FHWA (Federal Highway Administration) Incident Management Guidelines

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking for alert dissemination and display (1=highest, 5=lowest).

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Brief headline or title summarizing the alert for quick identification by motorists and citizens.
attributes.references: MUTCD (Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices)

attributes.name: message
attributes.description: Detailed message content describing the safety alert, hazardous condition, or public notification being communicated.
attributes.references: MUTCD (Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices)

attributes.name: short_message
attributes.description: Abbreviated version of the alert message suitable for display on Dynamic Message Signs (DMS) and mobile notifications with character limitations.
attributes.references: MUTCD (Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices)

attributes.name: effective_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the public alert becomes active and should be disseminated to the public.

attributes.name: effective_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the public alert expires and should no longer be displayed or disseminated.

attributes.name: issued_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the alert was officially issued by NCDOT or authorized personnel.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the alert was last modified or updated with new information.

attributes.name: cancelled_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the alert was cancelled or withdrawn before its scheduled expiration.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the public alert indicating whether it is being drafted, actively disseminated, expired, or cancelled.

attributes.name: location_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the geographic location or area affected by the alert (e.g., I-40 westbound near Exit 123, US-70 between Raleigh and Durham).
attributes.references: MUTCD (Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices)

attributes.name: route_number
attributes.description: Highway or route number affected by the alert (e.g., I-40, US-70, NC-54).
attributes.references: AASHTO (American Association of State Highway and Transportation Officials) Route Numbering

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Direction of travel affected by the alert on the roadway.
attributes.references: MUTCD (Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices)

attributes.name: mile_marker_start
attributes.description: Beginning mile marker location where the alert condition starts on the roadway.
attributes.references: AASHTO (American Association of State Highway and Transportation Officials) Linear Referencing

attributes.name: mile_marker_end
attributes.description: Ending mile marker location where the alert condition ends on the roadway.
attributes.references: AASHTO (American Association of State Highway and Transportation Officials) Linear Referencing

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: North Carolina county where the alert is applicable.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the alert is applicable.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the alert location in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the alert location in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: geospatial_boundary
attributes.description: Well-Known Text (WKT) representation of the geographic area or polygon affected by the alert.

attributes.name: dissemination_channels
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of channels through which the alert is being disseminated (e.g., DMS, website, mobile app, social media, 511, email, SMS).

attributes.name: dms_displayed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the alert is being displayed on Dynamic Message Signs along the roadway.
attributes.references: MUTCD (Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices)

attributes.name: website_published
attributes.description: Indicates whether the alert has been published to the NCDOT public website.

attributes.name: mobile_app_published
attributes.description: Indicates whether the alert has been published to the NCDOT mobile application.

attributes.name: social_media_published
attributes.description: Indicates whether the alert has been published to NCDOT social media channels.

attributes.name: five_one_one_published
attributes.description: Indicates whether the alert has been published to the 511 traveler information system.

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Weather condition associated with or causing the alert situation.

attributes.name: road_condition
attributes.description: Current condition of the roadway surface or infrastructure related to the alert.
attributes.references: MUTCD (Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices)

attributes.name: lanes_affected
attributes.description: Description of which lanes are affected by the alert (e.g., left lane, right two lanes, all lanes, shoulder).
attributes.references: MUTCD (Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices)

attributes.name: number_of_lanes_closed
attributes.description: Count of travel lanes closed due to the alert condition.
attributes.references: MUTCD (Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices)

attributes.name: detour_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether an official detour route is available for motorists to bypass the affected area.
attributes.references: MUTCD (Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices)

attributes.name: detour_description
attributes.description: Description of the detour route and directions for motorists to follow.
attributes.references: MUTCD (Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices)

attributes.name: estimated_delay_minutes
attributes.description: Estimated travel delay in minutes that motorists may experience due to the alert condition.
attributes.references: FHWA (Federal Highway Administration) Traffic Operations Standards

attributes.name: expected_clearance_timestamp
attributes.description: Estimated date and time when the alert condition is expected to be cleared or resolved.

attributes.name: actual_clearance_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the alert condition was cleared or resolved.

attributes.name: issuing_organization
attributes.description: Name of the NCDOT division or external organization that issued the alert (e.g., DOH, DMV, IMAP, TMC, National Weather Service).

attributes.name: issuing_division
attributes.description: NCDOT division code responsible for issuing the alert.

attributes.name: contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the NCDOT personnel or contact person responsible for the alert.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number for the contact person or organization responsible for the alert.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Email address for the contact person or organization responsible for the alert.

attributes.name: related_incident_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the traffic incident or emergency event that triggered the alert.

attributes.name: related_project_number
attributes.description: NCDOT project number if the alert is related to construction or maintenance activities.

attributes.name: imap_involved
attributes.description: Indicates whether IMAP units are responding to or involved in the incident related to this alert.

attributes.name: emergency_response_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether emergency response services (police, fire, EMS) are required or involved.

attributes.name: hazmat_involved
attributes.description: Indicates whether hazardous materials are involved in the incident related to the alert.
attributes.references: CFR Title 49 (Code of Federal Regulations - Transportation)

attributes.name: evacuation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether evacuation of the area is required due to the alert condition.

attributes.name: bridge_involved
attributes.description: Indicates whether a bridge structure is involved in or affected by the alert.

attributes.name: bridge_number
attributes.description: NCDOT bridge identification number if a bridge is involved in the alert.

attributes.name: ferry_route_affected
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the ferry route affected by the alert.

attributes.name: public_transit_impact
attributes.description: Indicates whether public transit services are impacted by the alert condition.

attributes.name: special_event_name
attributes.description: Name of the special event if the alert is related to a planned event affecting traffic.

attributes.name: construction_activity
attributes.description: Description of construction or maintenance activity related to the alert.
attributes.references: MUTCD (Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices)

attributes.name: work_zone_type
attributes.description: Classification of the work zone if the alert is related to construction or maintenance activities.
attributes.references: MUTCD (Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices)

attributes.name: traffic_control_plan_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the approved traffic control plan for work zone activities.
attributes.references: MUTCD (Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices)

attributes.name: mot_plan_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the maintenance of traffic plan for the alert area.
attributes.references: MUTCD (Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices)

attributes.name: alert_language
attributes.description: Language code for the alert message (en=English, es=Spanish, fr=French).

attributes.name: accessibility_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the alert meets accessibility standards for individuals with disabilities.

attributes.name: alert_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the system or application that originated the alert (e.g., TIMS, ATMS, TMC, IMAP).

attributes.name: alert_version
attributes.description: Version number of the alert indicating how many times it has been updated or revised.

attributes.name: approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the alert requires supervisory or management approval before dissemination.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person who approved the alert for dissemination.

attributes.name: audience_type
attributes.description: Target audience for the alert message.

attributes.name: impact_area_square_miles
attributes.description: Estimated geographic area in square miles affected by the alert condition.

attributes.name: estimated_affected_vehicles
attributes.description: Estimated number of vehicles that may be affected by the alert condition based on AADT (Annual Average Daily Traffic) data.

attributes.name: alert_url
attributes.description: Web URL where additional information about the alert can be accessed by the public.

attributes.name: media_attachments
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of URLs or file paths to images, videos, or documents associated with the alert.

attributes.name: cctv_camera_ids
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of CCTV camera IDs that provide visual coverage of the alert location.

attributes.name: dms_device_ids
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of DMS device IDs where the alert message is being displayed.

attributes.name: alert_recurrence_pattern
attributes.description: Indicates if the alert is a one-time event or follows a recurring pattern (e.g., daily construction activities).

attributes.name: legal_restriction
attributes.description: Description of any legal restrictions or regulatory requirements associated with the alert (e.g., mandatory detour, road closure order).

attributes.name: enforcement_agency
attributes.description: Name of the law enforcement agency responsible for enforcing restrictions related to the alert.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments about the alert for internal NCDOT use.

attributes.name: bridge_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to bridge.bridge. Business justification: Public alerts for bridge closures, weight restrictions, or hazards must reference specific bridge. Public information office issues these alerts based on inspection findings or incidents.

attributes.name: alert_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to traffic.traffic_alert. Business justification: Public safety alerts often reference underlying traffic alerts for hazardous conditions. Public information office coordinates with traffic operations to ensure consistent messaging across channels.

attributes.name: terminal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ferry.terminal. Business justification: Safety alerts for weather, hazards, or service disruptions at ferry terminals must reference the specific terminal for targeted public notification and emergency response coordination.

attributes.name: grade_crossing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rail.grade_crossing. Business justification: Public safety alerts for grade crossing closures, malfunctions, or hazards must reference the specific crossing so motorists and emergency services know the exact location affected.

attributes.name: feature_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gis.feature. Business justification: Public safety alerts (road closures, hazards, weather warnings) reference specific geographic features (road segments, bridges, intersections) for precise citizen notification and emergency response r

products.name: corrective_action
products.description: Corrective actions generated from safety inspections or incident investigations, tracking action ID, description, responsible party, due date, status, and closure details.

attributes.name: corrective_action_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the corrective action record. Primary key for tracking corrective actions generated from safety inspections or incident investigations.

attributes.name: action_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the corrective action, typically formatted as CA-YYYY-NNNNNN for tracking and reference purposes.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Brief descriptive title or summary of the corrective action for quick identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the corrective action to be taken, including specific steps, procedures, or remediation activities required to address the identified safety issue or incident finding.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the corrective action based on timing and nature of the response required.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the corrective action based on severity of the safety issue, potential risk, and urgency of remediation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the corrective action in its lifecycle from identification through closure.

attributes.name: source_type
attributes.description: Type of source event or activity that generated the corrective action requirement.

attributes.name: source_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference identifier of the originating inspection, incident, audit, or other source event that generated this corrective action.

attributes.name: finding_description
attributes.description: Description of the specific finding, deficiency, or safety issue identified during the inspection or investigation that necessitated this corrective action.

attributes.name: root_cause
attributes.description: Identified root cause of the safety issue or incident that the corrective action is designed to address, based on investigation findings.

attributes.name: responsible_party_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual, team, or organizational unit assigned responsibility for implementing and completing the corrective action.

attributes.name: responsible_party_email
attributes.description: Email address of the responsible party for communication and notification regarding the corrective action.

attributes.name: responsible_party_phone
attributes.description: Contact phone number for the responsible party assigned to the corrective action.

attributes.name: responsible_division
attributes.description: NCDOT division or organizational unit responsible for implementing the corrective action (e.g., DOH, DMV, Ferry Division, Aviation Division).

attributes.name: responsible_unit
attributes.description: Specific unit, section, or work group within the responsible division assigned to execute the corrective action.

attributes.name: assigned_date
attributes.description: Date when the corrective action was formally assigned to the responsible party.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Target completion date by which the corrective action must be implemented and completed.

attributes.name: extended_due_date
attributes.description: Revised due date if an extension was granted for completing the corrective action.

attributes.name: extension_reason
attributes.description: Justification or explanation for granting an extension to the original due date.

attributes.name: completed_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the corrective action was completed and implemented by the responsible party.

attributes.name: verified_date
attributes.description: Date when the completed corrective action was verified and validated as effective by the reviewing authority.

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: Date when the corrective action was formally closed after verification and acceptance of completion.

attributes.name: completion_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes documenting the actions taken, methods used, and results achieved in completing the corrective action.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify and validate that the corrective action was properly implemented and effective.

attributes.name: verification_notes
attributes.description: Notes documenting the verification process, findings, and confirmation that the corrective action adequately addressed the identified issue.

attributes.name: verified_by_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual who performed the verification and validation of the completed corrective action.

attributes.name: effectiveness_rating
attributes.description: Assessment of how effective the corrective action was in addressing and resolving the identified safety issue.

attributes.name: recurrence_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the safety issue recurred after the corrective action was implemented, suggesting the action may not have been fully effective.

attributes.name: estimated_cost
attributes.description: Estimated financial cost in US dollars to implement the corrective action, including labor, materials, and equipment.

attributes.name: actual_cost
attributes.description: Actual financial cost in US dollars incurred to implement the corrective action.

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Source of funding used to implement the corrective action (e.g., operational budget, HSIP, federal grant, state appropriation).

attributes.name: location_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the physical location where the corrective action is to be implemented.

attributes.name: route_number
attributes.description: Highway or route number where the corrective action is to be implemented, if applicable to roadway infrastructure.

attributes.name: milepost
attributes.description: Milepost location on the route where the corrective action is to be implemented, measured in miles.

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: North Carolina county where the corrective action is to be implemented.

attributes.name: division_number
attributes.description: NCDOT highway division number (1-14) responsible for the geographic area where the corrective action is to be implemented.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the corrective action location in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the corrective action location in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement
attributes.description: Specific regulatory requirement, standard, or code that mandates or drives the corrective action (e.g., OSHA regulation, FHWA standard, MUTCD requirement).

attributes.name: regulatory_citation
attributes.description: Specific citation or reference to the regulatory code, standard, or requirement (e.g., 29 CFR 1926.501, MUTCD Section 6E.01).

attributes.name: hsip_eligible
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the corrective action is eligible for funding under the Highway Safety Improvement Program.

attributes.name: ghsp_related
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the corrective action is related to or coordinated with the Governors Highway Safety Program initiatives.

attributes.name: imap_related
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the corrective action is related to IMAP operations or incident management activities.

attributes.name: crash_related
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the corrective action is related to or resulted from crash data analysis or a specific crash incident.

attributes.name: crash_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the crash incident that generated or is related to this corrective action, if applicable.

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Severity level of the safety issue or hazard that the corrective action addresses, based on potential consequences.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Quantitative risk score (1-100) assigned to the safety issue based on likelihood and severity, used for prioritization.

attributes.name: preventive_action
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this is a preventive action taken to avoid potential future issues rather than correcting an existing deficiency.

attributes.name: interim_action
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this is an interim or temporary corrective action pending implementation of a permanent solution.

attributes.name: interim_action_description
attributes.description: Description of interim measures taken while the permanent corrective action is being planned or implemented.

attributes.name: permanent_action_required
attributes.description: Indicator of whether a permanent corrective action is required following an interim action.

attributes.name: follow_up_required
attributes.description: Indicator of whether follow-up monitoring or additional actions are required after initial implementation.

attributes.name: follow_up_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for follow-up inspection or monitoring to assess ongoing effectiveness of the corrective action.

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: Level of management escalation required or applied for overdue or high-priority corrective actions.

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: Date when the corrective action was escalated to higher management due to delays or criticality.

attributes.name: notification_sent
attributes.description: Indicator of whether formal notification was sent to the responsible party regarding the corrective action assignment.

attributes.name: notification_date
attributes.description: Date when notification was sent to the responsible party regarding the corrective action.

attributes.name: attachment_count
attributes.description: Number of supporting documents, photos, or files attached to the corrective action record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the corrective action record was initially created in the system.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the corrective action record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: bridge_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to bridge.bridge. Business justification: Corrective actions resulting from safety inspections or incidents must reference the bridge requiring remediation. Maintenance planning and budget allocation depend on this linkage.

attributes.name: signal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to traffic.signal. Business justification: Corrective actions from crash pattern analysis often target specific signals for retiming or upgrades. Safety engineers track which signals received safety-driven modifications for effectiveness evalu

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project. Business justification: Corrective actions addressing safety deficiencies found during project inspections or after incidents must link to the project for tracking remediation, contractor accountability, and ensuring project

attributes.name: vessel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ferry.vessel. Business justification: Corrective actions from safety inspections or incidents must link to the vessel for tracking remediation, ensuring compliance, and maintaining operational certification before return to service.

attributes.name: airport_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to aviation.airport. Business justification: Corrective actions from safety inspections or incidents must be tracked by airport. Airport managers and NCDOT aviation staff use this to monitor remediation completion and maintain safety certificati

attributes.name: grade_crossing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rail.grade_crossing. Business justification: Corrective actions (install gates, improve signage, vegetation clearing) resulting from inspections or incidents must reference the specific grade crossing where work is performed for tracking complet

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset. Business justification: Corrective actions resulting from safety inspections must reference the specific asset requiring remediation. Used by maintenance teams to prioritize and execute safety-driven repairs.

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to environmental.permit. Business justification: When safety inspections identify environmental permit violations (stormwater, erosion control), corrective actions must reference the specific permit requiring compliance remediation. Used by complian

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.contract. Business justification: Corrective actions for safety deficiencies (guardrails, signage, pavement repairs) are executed under maintenance/construction contracts. Safety inspectors reference the contract performing the remedi

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Corrective actions from inspections incur costs (repairs, materials, labor) that must be charged to the responsible department's cost center for budget management and accountability.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.work_order. Business justification: Safety inspections identify hazards requiring corrective actions implemented through maintenance work orders. Safety officers track which work order addresses each corrective action for compliance clo

attributes.name: safety_inspection_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.safety_inspection. Business justification: Corrective actions originate from safety inspections that identify deficiencies. Each corrective action must reference its source inspection for regulatory compliance, tracking remediation of specific

attributes.name: project_boundary_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gis.project_boundary. Business justification: Corrective actions (safety improvements, signage upgrades, guardrail installations) are scoped within defined project boundaries for construction planning, environmental review, and budget allocation

products.name: incident

Also includes: Documented rail incidents and accidents, with details on date, location, involved equipment, cause c... attributes.name: incident_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the incident record across all transportation modes (highway, aviation, rail, ferry).

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Human-readable incident reference number assigned by the reporting system or agency for tracking and communication purposes.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the incident based on the nature of the event (crash, hazmat spill, debris, disabled vehicle, rail derailment, aviation accident, etc.).
attributes.references: MUTCD, FHWA Traffic Incident Management Handbook

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Assessment of the incident severity based on impact to safety, operations, and infrastructure.
attributes.references: FHWA Traffic Incident Management, NTSB Severity Classification

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the incident from initial report through closure.

attributes.name: reported_date
attributes.description: Date when the incident was first reported to NCDOT or relevant authority.

attributes.name: reported_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the incident was first reported to NCDOT or relevant authority.

attributes.name: occurred_date
attributes.description: Date when the incident actually occurred (may differ from reported date).

attributes.name: occurred_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the incident actually occurred.

attributes.name: detected_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the incident was first detected by automated systems, IMAP patrol, or other monitoring mechanisms.

attributes.name: dispatch_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when emergency response or IMAP units were dispatched to the incident scene.

attributes.name: arrival_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when first responders or IMAP units arrived at the incident scene.

attributes.name: cleared_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the incident was cleared and normal operations resumed.

attributes.name: closed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the incident record was officially closed after all follow-up activities completed.

attributes.name: location_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the incident location including landmarks, mile markers, or facility names.

attributes.name: route_number
attributes.description: Highway route number where the incident occurred (e.g., I-40, US-1, NC-55).
attributes.references: AASHTO Route Numbering, NCDOT Highway System

attributes.name: route_type
attributes.description: Classification of the route where the incident occurred (interstate, US highway, state highway, secondary road, etc.).
attributes.references: FHWA Functional Classification, NCDOT Highway System

attributes.name: mile_marker
attributes.description: Mile marker or milepost location on the route where the incident occurred.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Direction of travel or roadway direction where the incident occurred.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the incident location in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the incident location in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: county_name
attributes.description: North Carolina county where the incident occurred.

attributes.name: city_name
attributes.description: City or municipality where the incident occurred.

attributes.name: division_number
attributes.description: NCDOT highway division number responsible for the geographic area where the incident occurred.

attributes.name: railroad_name
attributes.description: Name of the railroad company or line involved in rail incidents.

attributes.name: ferry_route_name
attributes.description: Name of the ferry route where the incident occurred.

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Weather conditions at the time of the incident.

attributes.name: road_surface_condition
attributes.description: Condition of the road surface at the time of the incident.

attributes.name: light_condition
attributes.description: Lighting conditions at the time of the incident.

attributes.name: traffic_volume_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of the impact on traffic flow and volume caused by the incident.

attributes.name: lanes_blocked_count
attributes.description: Number of travel lanes blocked or closed due to the incident.

attributes.name: lanes_total_count
attributes.description: Total number of travel lanes at the incident location.

attributes.name: shoulder_blocked_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether the roadway shoulder was blocked by the incident.

attributes.name: detour_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether a traffic detour was required due to the incident.

attributes.name: detour_route_description
attributes.description: Description of the detour route established for traffic diversion.

attributes.name: fatality_count
attributes.description: Number of fatalities resulting from the incident.
attributes.references: FHWA Highway Safety Manual, NHTSA FARS

attributes.name: injury_count
attributes.description: Total number of injuries resulting from the incident.
attributes.references: FHWA Highway Safety Manual, NHTSA CRSS

attributes.name: serious_injury_count
attributes.description: Number of serious injuries (incapacitating) resulting from the incident.

attributes.name: minor_injury_count
attributes.description: Number of minor injuries (non-incapacitating) resulting from the incident.

attributes.name: vehicle_count
attributes.description: Total number of vehicles involved in the incident.

attributes.name: commercial_vehicle_involved_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether a commercial motor vehicle was involved in the incident.

attributes.name: hazmat_involved_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether hazardous materials were involved in the incident.

attributes.name: hazmat_material_name
attributes.description: Name or description of the hazardous material involved in the incident.

attributes.name: hazmat_un_number
attributes.description: UN identification number for the hazardous material involved.

attributes.name: hazmat_placard_number
attributes.description: Placard identification number displayed on the vehicle carrying hazardous materials.
