domains.name: planning
domains.description: Statewide transportation planning including LRTP, CTP development, transportation modeling, mobility strategy, and coordination with MPO/RPO organizations for long-range multimodal transportation planning and programming.

products.name: plan
products.description: Master record for each approved transportation plan, including LRTP, CTP, and other strategic planning documents with attributes such as plan name, description, effective dates, horizon years, and overall objectives.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the transportation plan record. Primary key for the plan entity.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Official name of the transportation plan as approved by NCDOT and relevant planning organizations.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the transportation plan. LRTP (Long Range Transportation Plan), CTP (Comprehensive Transportation Plan), STIP (State Transportation Improvement Program), TIP (Transportation Improvement Program), MPO (Metropolitan Planning Organization) Plan, RPO (Rural Planning Organization) Plan.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Comprehensive description of the transportation plan including scope, objectives, and strategic focus areas.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic coverage area of the transportation plan indicating the spatial extent of planning jurisdiction.

attributes.name: geographic_area_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the geographic area covered by the plan including counties, municipalities, or specific boundaries.

attributes.name: modal_scope
attributes.description: Transportation modes addressed in the plan indicating whether it covers single or multiple transportation modes.

attributes.name: base_year
attributes.description: The reference year for existing conditions and baseline data used in the transportation plan analysis.

attributes.name: horizon_year
attributes.description: The future target year for which the transportation plan projects needs, investments, and outcomes (typically 20-30 years from base year).
attributes.references: 23 CFR 450.324 - Development and content of the metropolitan transportation plan

attributes.name: intermediate_milestone_years
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of intermediate planning years between base year and horizon year for phased implementation tracking.

attributes.name: adoption_date
attributes.description: Official date when the transportation plan was formally adopted by the governing body or planning organization.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the transportation plan becomes effective and begins guiding transportation investment decisions.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the transportation plan expires or is scheduled to be superseded by an updated plan.

attributes.name: last_amendment_date
attributes.description: Most recent date when the plan was formally amended to incorporate changes or updates.

attributes.name: next_update_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next required update or revision of the transportation plan per federal or state requirements.
attributes.references: 23 CFR 450.324 - Development and content of the metropolitan transportation plan

attributes.name: update_cycle_years
attributes.description: Required frequency in years for updating the transportation plan (typically 4-5 years for metropolitan areas, 5 years for non-metropolitan).
attributes.references: 23 CFR 450.324 - Development and content of the metropolitan transportation plan

attributes.name: federal_fiscal_year
attributes.description: Federal fiscal year associated with the plan for federal funding coordination and reporting. FFY runs October 1 through September 30.

attributes.name: state_fiscal_year
attributes.description: North Carolina state fiscal year associated with the plan for state funding coordination. SFY runs July 1 through June 30.

attributes.name: total_estimated_cost
attributes.description: Total estimated cost in US dollars for all projects and programs included in the transportation plan over the planning horizon.

attributes.name: federal_funding_amount
attributes.description: Total estimated federal funding allocation in US dollars for the transportation plan from FHWA, FTA, FAA, or other federal sources.

attributes.name: state_funding_amount
attributes.description: Total estimated North Carolina state funding allocation in US dollars for the transportation plan.

attributes.name: local_funding_amount
attributes.description: Total estimated local government funding contribution in US dollars for the transportation plan from counties, municipalities, or other local sources.

attributes.name: other_funding_amount
attributes.description: Total estimated funding from other sources in US dollars including private investment, grants, or alternative financing mechanisms.

attributes.name: funding_constraint_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan is fiscally constrained (limited to reasonably expected revenues) or unconstrained (vision-based without funding limitations).
attributes.references: 23 CFR 450.324 - Development and content of the metropolitan transportation plan

attributes.name: air_quality_conformity_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan is subject to transportation conformity requirements under the Clean Air Act for non-attainment or maintenance areas.

attributes.name: air_quality_conformity_status
attributes.description: Current air quality conformity determination status indicating whether the plan meets Clean Air Act requirements.

attributes.name: air_quality_conformity_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent air quality conformity determination for the transportation plan.

attributes.name: nepa_compliance_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA) Compliance Status
attributes.description: NEPA environmental review status for the plan. CE (Categorical Exclusion), EA (Environmental Assessment) with FONSI (Finding of No Significant Impact), EIS (Environmental Impact Statement) with ROD (Record of Decision).

attributes.name: environmental_justice_analysis_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether an environmental justice analysis was conducted to assess impacts on minority and low-income populations.

attributes.name: public_participation_plan_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the public participation plan document or process used for stakeholder engagement during plan development.

attributes.name: public_comment_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the public comment period for the transportation plan draft or amendment.

attributes.name: public_comment_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the public comment period for the transportation plan draft or amendment.

attributes.name: number_of_public_comments_received
attributes.description: Total count of public comments received during the public participation process for the plan.

attributes.name: goals_and_objectives
attributes.description: Comprehensive statement of the transportation plan's strategic goals and measurable objectives aligned with statewide and regional priorities.
attributes.references: 23 CFR 450.324 - Development and content of the metropolitan transportation plan

attributes.name: performance_measures_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan includes performance-based planning measures and targets as required by federal regulations.

attributes.name: performance_target_summary
attributes.description: Summary of key performance targets established in the plan for safety, pavement condition, bridge condition, system performance, and other federal measures.

attributes.name: safety_emphasis
attributes.description: Level of emphasis placed on safety improvements and Highway Safety Improvement Program (HSIP) projects within the plan.

attributes.name: congestion_management_process_integrated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan integrates a Congestion Management Process (CMP) as required for Transportation Management Areas.
attributes.references: 23 CFR 450.322 - Congestion management process in transportation management areas

attributes.name: freight_planning_integrated
attributes.description: Indicates whether freight transportation planning and considerations are integrated into the plan.

attributes.name: transit_planning_integrated
attributes.description: Indicates whether public transit planning and Federal Transit Administration (FTA) coordination are integrated into the plan.

attributes.name: bicycle_pedestrian_planning_integrated
attributes.description: Indicates whether bicycle and pedestrian infrastructure planning and active transportation considerations are integrated into the plan.
attributes.references: 23 USC 217 - Bicycle transportation and pedestrian walkways

attributes.name: climate_resilience_addressed
attributes.description: Indicates whether climate change impacts, adaptation strategies, and transportation system resilience are addressed in the plan.

attributes.name: equity_considerations_addressed
attributes.description: Indicates whether transportation equity, accessibility, and impacts on underserved communities are explicitly addressed in the plan.

attributes.name: travel_demand_model_used
attributes.description: Name and version of the travel demand forecasting model used for transportation analysis in the plan development.

attributes.name: model_validation_year
attributes.description: Year when the travel demand model was last validated against observed traffic data.

attributes.name: population_forecast_base_year
attributes.description: Base year population used as the starting point for demographic forecasting in the transportation plan.

attributes.name: population_forecast_horizon_year
attributes.description: Horizon year population projection used for long-range transportation demand forecasting.

attributes.name: employment_forecast_base_year
attributes.description: Base year employment used as the starting point for economic forecasting in the transportation plan.

attributes.name: employment_forecast_horizon_year
attributes.description: Horizon year employment projection used for long-range transportation demand forecasting.

attributes.name: socioeconomic_data_source
attributes.description: Primary source of socioeconomic data (population, employment, demographics) used in the plan analysis.

attributes.name: traffic_data_source
attributes.description: Primary source of traffic volume and operational data used in the plan analysis, such as HPMS (Highway Performance Monitoring System) or local traffic counts.

attributes.name: gis_data_layers_included
attributes.business_glossary_term: Geographic Information System (GIS) Data Layers Included
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of GIS data layers and spatial datasets included in the transportation plan analysis and documentation.

attributes.name: document_version
attributes.description: Version number or identifier for the transportation plan document to track revisions and amendments.

attributes.name: document_url
attributes.description: Web URL or document repository location where the official transportation plan document is published and accessible.

attributes.name: document_file_path
attributes.description: File system path or SharePoint location where the transportation plan document and supporting materials are stored.

attributes.name: executive_summary
attributes.description: Brief executive summary of the transportation plan highlighting key findings, recommendations, and strategic priorities.

attributes.name: approval_resolution_number

attributes.name: lead_planner_name
attributes.description: Name of the lead transportation planner or project manager responsible for coordinating the plan development.

attributes.name: lead_planner_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the lead transportation planner for plan inquiries and coordination.

attributes.name: consultant_firm_name
attributes.description: Name of the consulting firm contracted to support or lead the transportation plan development, if applicable.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: NCDOT contract number associated with consultant services for the transportation plan development.

attributes.name: federal_authorization_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether federal authorization or approval has been received for the transportation plan from FHWA, FTA, or other federal agencies.

attributes.name: federal_authorization_date
attributes.description: Date when federal authorization or approval was received for the transportation plan.

attributes.name: stip_integration_status

attributes.description: Status indicating whether projects from this plan have been integrated into the State Transportation Improvement Program (STIP) for funding and implementation.
attributes.references: 23 CFR 450.216 - Development and content of the statewide transportation improvement program

attributes.name: amendment_count
attributes.description: Total number of formal amendments made to the transportation plan since original adoption.

attributes.name: administrative_modification_count
attributes.description: Total number of administrative modifications made to the transportation plan since original adoption (minor changes not requiring full amendment process).

attributes.name: superseded_plan_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or name of the previous transportation plan that this plan supersedes or replaces.

attributes.name: related_studies_references
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of related transportation studies, corridor studies, or technical reports that informed the plan development.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of the project location or centroid.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the project location or centroid.

attributes.name: estimated_cost
attributes.description: Total estimated cost of the project in US dollars, including all phases and components.

attributes.name: cost_estimate_year
attributes.description: The year in which the cost estimate was prepared, used for inflation adjustments.

attributes.name: pe_cost
attributes.description: Estimated cost for preliminary engineering phase including design, surveys, and environmental studies.

attributes.name: row_cost
attributes.description: Estimated cost for right-of-way acquisition, including property purchases and relocations.

attributes.name: construction_cost
attributes.description: Estimated cost for the construction phase of the project.

attributes.name: ce_cost
attributes.description: Estimated cost for construction engineering and inspection services during project construction.

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Primary source of funding for the project.

attributes.name: federal_funding_program
attributes.description: Specific federal funding program supporting this project. NHPP = National Highway Performance Program, STP = Surface Transportation Program, HSIP = Highway Safety Improvement Program, CMAQ = Congestion Mitigation and Air Quality, TAP = Transportation Alternatives Program.

attributes.name: federal_amount
attributes.description: Amount of federal funding allocated to this project in US dollars.

attributes.name: state_amount
attributes.description: Amount of state funding allocated to this project in US dollars.

attributes.name: local_amount
attributes.description: Amount of local government funding allocated to this project in US dollars.

attributes.name: private_amount
attributes.description: Amount of private sector funding or contributions allocated to this project in US dollars.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_year
attributes.description: Planned fiscal or calendar year for project initiation or start of construction.

attributes.name: scheduled_completion_year
attributes.description: Planned fiscal or calendar year for project completion.

attributes.name: pe_start_date
attributes.description: Planned start date for the preliminary engineering phase.

attributes.name: pe_completion_date
attributes.description: Planned completion date for the preliminary engineering phase.

attributes.name: row_start_date
attributes.description: Planned start date for right-of-way acquisition activities.

attributes.name: row_completion_date
attributes.description: Planned completion date for right-of-way acquisition activities.

attributes.name: construction_start_date
attributes.description: Planned start date for construction activities.

attributes.name: construction_completion_date
attributes.description: Planned completion date for construction activities.

attributes.name: project_duration_months
attributes.description: Total planned duration of the project from initiation to completion, measured in months.

attributes.name: nepa_status
attributes.description: Current status of NEPA environmental review process. CE = Categorical Exclusion, EA = Environmental Assessment, EIS = Environmental Impact Statement, FONSI = Finding of No Significant Impact, ROD = Record of Decision.

attributes.name: nepa_document_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA) Document Type
attributes.description: Type of NEPA environmental document required for this project. CE = Categorical Exclusion, EA = Environmental Assessment, EIS = Environmental Impact Statement.

attributes.name: environmental_clearance_date
attributes.description: Date when environmental clearance was obtained or is expected to be obtained.

attributes.name: section_404_permit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Clean Water Act Section 404 permit is required for wetland impacts.

attributes.name: section_106_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether National Historic Preservation Act Section 106 review is required for historic properties.

attributes.name: air_quality_conformity_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether transportation conformity determination is required for air quality in non-attainment areas.

attributes.name: project_justification
attributes.description: Business case and rationale for the project, including needs assessment and expected benefits.

attributes.name: purpose_and_need
attributes.description: Formal statement of the project purpose and transportation need being addressed, required for NEPA documentation.

attributes.name: safety_improvement_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the project includes safety improvements or is part of a highway safety program.

attributes.name: congestion_relief_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the project is intended to reduce traffic congestion.

attributes.name: economic_development_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the project supports economic development objectives.

attributes.name: multimodal_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the project includes multiple transportation modes (e.g., highway, transit, bicycle, pedestrian).

attributes.name: bicycle_pedestrian_facility_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the project includes bicycle or pedestrian facilities.
attributes.references: 23 USC 217 - Bicycle Transportation and Pedestrian Walkways

attributes.name: transit_component_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the project includes public transit components or improvements.

attributes.name: ada_compliance_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Compliance Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the project includes ADA accessibility improvements or compliance requirements.

attributes.name: bridge_replacement_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the project includes bridge replacement or major bridge rehabilitation.

attributes.name: pavement_improvement_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the project includes pavement preservation, rehabilitation, or reconstruction.

attributes.name: its_component_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the project includes ITS technology components such as traffic signals, cameras, or dynamic message signs.

attributes.name: design_speed_mph
attributes.business_glossary_term: Design Speed in Miles Per Hour
attributes.description: Planned design speed for the roadway facility in miles per hour.
attributes.references: AASHTO Green Book - Geometric Design Standards

attributes.name: number_of_lanes
attributes.description: Total number of travel lanes planned for the facility.
attributes.references: AASHTO Green Book - Geometric Design Standards

attributes.name: lane_width_feet
attributes.description: Width of travel lanes in feet.
attributes.references: AASHTO Green Book - Geometric Design Standards

attributes.name: shoulder_width_feet
attributes.description: Width of roadway shoulders in feet.
attributes.references: AASHTO Green Book - Geometric Design Standards

attributes.name: median_type
attributes.description: Type of median separation planned for divided roadways.
attributes.references: AASHTO Green Book - Geometric Design Standards

attributes.name: access_control
attributes.description: Level of access control for the facility (full access control for freeways, partial for arterials, none for local roads).
attributes.references: AASHTO Green Book - Geometric Design Standards

attributes.name: current_aadt
attributes.description: Current annual average daily traffic volume on the facility.

attributes.name: projected_aadt
attributes.description: Projected annual average daily traffic volume after project completion or at design year.

attributes.name: design_year
attributes.description: Future year for which traffic projections and design are based, typically 20 years from project completion.
attributes.references: AASHTO Green Book - Geometric Design Standards

attributes.name: current_los
attributes.description: Current level of service rating for the facility, ranging from A (best) to F (worst).

attributes.name: projected_los
attributes.description: Projected level of service rating after project completion.

attributes.name: sponsor_agency
attributes.description: Name of the agency or organization sponsoring or requesting the project.

attributes.name: public_involvement_status
attributes.description: Current status of public involvement and stakeholder engagement activities for the project.

attributes.name: public_comment_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the public comment period for the project.

attributes.name: public_comment_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the public comment period for the project.

attributes.name: environmental_justice_area_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the project is located in or affects an environmental justice area with minority or low-income populations.

attributes.name: disadvantaged_community_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the project serves or benefits a disadvantaged community as defined by federal or state criteria.

attributes.name: climate_resilience_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the project includes climate resilience or adaptation measures.

attributes.name: stormwater_management_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the project includes stormwater management or water quality improvements.

attributes.name: dbe_goal_percentage
attributes.description: Target percentage of project value to be awarded to disadvantaged business enterprises.

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Overall risk assessment level for the project based on complexity, cost, schedule, and external factors.

attributes.name: contingency_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of project cost allocated for contingency to address unforeseen issues and risks.

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: Date when the project record was last updated in the planning system.

attributes.name: last_updated_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the person who last updated the project record.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or supplementary information about the project.

products.name: stakeholder
products.description: Master list of external and internal stakeholders involved in planning, such as MPOs, RPOs, local agencies, and advisory groups, with contact information and role.

attributes.name: stakeholder_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the stakeholder entity in the planning domain.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full legal or official name of the stakeholder organization or individual.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the stakeholder entity indicating their organizational category and role in transportation planning.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the stakeholder relationship with NCDOT planning activities.

attributes.name: mpo_designation
attributes.description: Official MPO designation name if the stakeholder is a federally designated metropolitan planning organization.

attributes.name: rpo_designation
attributes.description: Official RPO designation name if the stakeholder is a rural planning organization established under state guidelines.

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: Geographic area or jurisdiction that the stakeholder represents or serves in transportation planning activities.

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: Primary county where the stakeholder is located or operates within North Carolina.

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: NCDOT administrative region or division that the stakeholder primarily coordinates with for planning activities.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name

attributes.name: primary_contact_email

attributes.name: secondary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the secondary or alternate contact person for the stakeholder organization.

attributes.name: secondary_contact_email

attributes.name: mailing_address_line1

attributes.name: mailing_city

attributes.name: mailing_zip_code

attributes.name: physical_address_line1

attributes.name: physical_address_line2

attributes.name: physical_state

attributes.name: physical_zip_code
attributes.description: Five or nine-digit ZIP code for the stakeholder organization's physical office location.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Official website URL for the stakeholder organization providing public information and resources.

attributes.name: federal_ein
attributes.description: Federal tax identification number assigned by the IRS to the stakeholder organization.

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit unique identifier assigned by Dun & Bradstreet for business entity identification.

attributes.name: role_in_planning
attributes.description: Description of the stakeholder's specific role, responsibilities, and participation in NCDOT transportation planning processes.

attributes.name: planning_area_coverage
attributes.description: Geographic scope or planning area that the stakeholder has authority or interest in for transportation planning purposes.

attributes.name: participation_level
attributes.description: Level of formal participation and decision-making authority the stakeholder has in planning processes.

attributes.name: lrtp_involvement_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Long Range Transportation Plan (LRTP) Involvement Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stakeholder is actively involved in Long Range Transportation Plan development and updates.

attributes.name: ctp_involvement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stakeholder participates in Comprehensive Transportation Plan development for their jurisdiction.

attributes.name: stip_involvement_flag

attributes.description: Indicates whether the stakeholder participates in State Transportation Improvement Program development and prioritization.

attributes.name: tip_involvement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stakeholder is involved in metropolitan Transportation Improvement Program development.

attributes.name: modal_focus
attributes.description: Primary transportation modes that the stakeholder focuses on, such as highway, transit, rail, aviation, bicycle, pedestrian, or multimodal.

attributes.name: funding_source_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stakeholder provides funding or financial resources for transportation planning or projects.

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Type of formal agreement or arrangement governing the relationship between NCDOT and the stakeholder.

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the formal agreement or contract between NCDOT and the stakeholder.

attributes.name: agreement_start_date

attributes.name: agreement_end_date

attributes.name: agreement_renewal_date

attributes.name: meeting_frequency

attributes.name: last_meeting_date

attributes.name: next_meeting_date

attributes.name: communication_preference
attributes.description: Preferred method of communication for engaging with the stakeholder organization.

attributes.name: notification_list_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stakeholder is included in automated notification lists for planning updates and announcements.

attributes.name: public_involvement_role
attributes.description: Specific role the stakeholder plays in public involvement and community engagement activities for transportation planning.

attributes.name: environmental_justice_community_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stakeholder represents or serves an environmental justice community requiring special consideration under federal guidelines.

attributes.name: tribal_consultation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal tribal consultation is required when engaging with this stakeholder under federal and state law.

attributes.name: data_sharing_agreement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal data sharing agreement exists between NCDOT and the stakeholder for planning data exchange.

attributes.name: gis_data_provider_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Geographic Information System (GIS) Data Provider Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stakeholder provides GIS data or spatial information to support transportation planning activities.

attributes.name: travel_demand_model_participant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stakeholder participates in travel demand modeling activities or provides input data for transportation models.
attributes.references: FHWA Travel Model Validation and Reasonableness Checking Manual

attributes.name: priority_ranking
attributes.description: Numerical ranking indicating the relative priority or importance of the stakeholder in planning coordination activities.

attributes.name: influence_level
attributes.description: Assessment of the stakeholder's level of influence on transportation planning decisions and outcomes.

attributes.name: interest_level
attributes.description: Assessment of the stakeholder's level of interest and engagement in transportation planning activities.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes, comments, or context about the stakeholder relationship and engagement history.

attributes.name: established_date
attributes.description: Date when the stakeholder organization was officially established or recognized.

attributes.name: relationship_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the formal relationship or engagement between NCDOT and the stakeholder began.

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: Date when the stakeholder record was last reviewed or updated in the system.

attributes.name: inactive_date
attributes.description: Date when the stakeholder relationship became inactive or was terminated.

attributes.name: inactive_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or reason for the stakeholder relationship becoming inactive or terminated.

products.name: policy
products.description: Master record for policy documents that guide planning decisions, including policy identifier, title, description, effective date, and related statutes or regulations.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the policy document within the planning domain. Primary key for the policy data product.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Human-readable policy document number assigned for reference and tracking purposes. Format typically includes domain prefix, year, and sequence number.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Official title of the policy document as it appears on the policy header and in official records.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the policy purpose, scope, and key provisions. Provides context for policy application and interpretation.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the policy based on its primary purpose and application area within the transportation planning domain.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the policy document indicating its approval state and applicability.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the policy becomes officially effective and enforceable. Must be on or after approval date.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the policy expires or is scheduled for mandatory review. May be null for policies without a defined expiration.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the policy was officially approved by the authorizing body or official.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal review of the policy document, regardless of whether changes were made.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next mandatory review of the policy document to ensure continued relevance and compliance.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for the policy document following semantic versioning conventions. Major version changes indicate substantial policy revisions.

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential revision counter tracking the number of times the policy has been formally revised since original approval.

attributes.name: approving_authority
attributes.description: Name of the organizational unit, official, or body that has the authority to approve and authorize this policy.

attributes.name: approving_official_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual official who approved the policy document.

attributes.name: approving_official_title
attributes.description: Official title or position of the individual who approved the policy.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Geographic or organizational scope of the policy application, indicating whether it applies statewide, to specific regions, divisions, or project types.

attributes.name: applicability
attributes.description: Detailed description of the situations, projects, or organizational units to which the policy applies.

attributes.name: related_statute_reference
attributes.description: Citation of North Carolina General Statutes (NCGS) or other statutory authority that mandates or authorizes the policy.

attributes.name: related_regulation_reference
attributes.description: Citation of federal or state regulations (CFR, state administrative code) that the policy implements or complies with.

attributes.name: federal_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the policy is required by federal law, regulation, or funding conditions (FHWA, FTA, FAA, FRA requirements).

attributes.name: federal_agency
attributes.description: Federal agency whose requirements or regulations the policy addresses, such as Federal Highway Administration (FHWA), Federal Transit Administration (FTA), Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), or Federal Railroad Administration (FRA).

attributes.name: compliance_requirement
attributes.description: Level of compliance required for the policy, indicating whether adherence is mandatory, recommended as best practice, or optional.

attributes.name: enforcement_mechanism
attributes.description: Description of how compliance with the policy is monitored and enforced, including audit procedures, reporting requirements, or penalties for non-compliance.

attributes.name: related_mpo_rpo_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Related Metropolitan Planning Organization (MPO) or Rural Planning Organization (RPO) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the policy involves coordination with or applies to Metropolitan Planning Organizations (MPO) or Rural Planning Organizations (RPO).

attributes.name: stip_related_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: State Transportation Improvement Program (STIP) Related Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the policy directly relates to the State Transportation Improvement Program (STIP) development, approval, or implementation.

attributes.name: lrtp_related_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Long Range Transportation Plan (LRTP) Related Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the policy directly relates to Long Range Transportation Plan (LRTP) development, approval, or implementation.

attributes.name: ctp_related_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the policy directly relates to Comprehensive Transportation Plan (CTP) development, approval, or implementation.

attributes.name: nepa_related_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA) Related Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the policy addresses National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA) compliance, environmental review, or documentation requirements.

attributes.name: multimodal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the policy addresses multimodal transportation planning involving highways, rail, aviation, ferry, transit, bicycle, or pedestrian modes.

attributes.name: transportation_modes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of transportation modes addressed by the policy (highway, rail, ferry, aviation, transit, bicycle, pedestrian).

attributes.name: public_participation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the policy requires public participation, public comment periods, or public hearings as part of its implementation.

attributes.name: environmental_justice_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the policy addresses environmental justice considerations for minority and low-income populations.

attributes.name: ada_compliance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the policy addresses Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) compliance requirements for accessibility.

attributes.name: funding_source_applicability
attributes.description: Description of federal, state, or local funding sources to which the policy applies, such as HSIP, CMAQ, STP, BUILD, INFRA, RAISE, or state appropriations.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification of the policy indicating its importance to organizational operations and compliance.

attributes.name: document_location_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the official policy document stored in SharePoint, ProjectWise, or other document management system.

attributes.name: document_format
attributes.description: File format of the official policy document (PDF, Word, HTML, etc.).

attributes.name: keywords
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of keywords or tags for search and categorization of the policy document.

attributes.name: supersedes_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number of the previous policy document that this policy supersedes or replaces.

attributes.name: superseded_by_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number of the newer policy document that supersedes this policy.

attributes.name: related_policy_numbers
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of related policy numbers that should be referenced in conjunction with this policy.

attributes.name: amendment_history
attributes.description: Summary of amendments, revisions, or modifications made to the policy since original approval.

attributes.name: public_access_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the policy document is publicly accessible or restricted to internal NCDOT use only.

attributes.name: confidentiality_level
attributes.description: Data classification level of the policy document indicating access restrictions and handling requirements.

attributes.name: legal_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the policy requires legal review by NCDOT legal counsel or the NC Attorney General's office.

attributes.name: legal_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the policy was reviewed and approved by legal counsel.

attributes.name: impact_assessment_completed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal impact assessment was conducted to evaluate the policy's effects on operations, budget, or stakeholders.

attributes.name: impact_summary
attributes.description: Summary of the anticipated or actual impacts of the policy on NCDOT operations, projects, budget, or external stakeholders.

attributes.name: training_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether staff training is required for implementation or compliance with the policy.

attributes.name: training_materials_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to training materials, presentations, or guides related to the policy.

attributes.name: comment_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the public or internal comment period for the draft policy.

attributes.name: comment_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the public or internal comment period for the draft policy.

attributes.name: comments_received_count
attributes.description: Number of comments received during the comment period for the policy.

attributes.name: comments_summary
attributes.description: Summary of key themes, concerns, or recommendations from comments received during the comment period.

attributes.name: archive_date
attributes.description: Date on which the policy was archived due to supersession, expiration, or withdrawal.

attributes.name: archive_reason
attributes.description: Reason for archiving the policy document.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to planning.plan. Business justification: Policy documents guide planning decisions and should reference the specific plan they apply to. Policy has lrtp_related_flag, ctp_related_flag, and stip_related_flag indicating policies are tied to sp

attributes.name: stakeholder_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to planning.stakeholder. Business justification: Policies often have specific stakeholder ownership or coordination requirements. Policy has mpo_rpo_flag and related_mpo_rpo_flag indicating policies are associated with specific stakeholder organizat

products.name: plan_status
products.description: Reference table of possible statuses for a transportation plan (e.g., Draft, Approved, In‑Review, Archived) with status code and description.

attributes.name: plan_status_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the plan status record. Primary key for the plan status reference table.

attributes.name: status_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the plan status. Used as a lookup key in operational systems and reports.

attributes.name: status_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the plan status. Human-readable label for the status.

attributes.name: status_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of what the plan status represents, including business rules and conditions for when this status applies.

attributes.name: status_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the status type. Active statuses indicate ongoing work, inactive indicates no current activity, transitional indicates status changes in progress, terminal indicates final states.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this status represents an active state where work is ongoing on the transportation plan.

attributes.name: is_terminal
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this status represents a final state from which no further status transitions are expected (e.g., Approved, Archived, Cancelled).

attributes.name: requires_approval
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether plans in this status require formal approval before transitioning to the next status.

attributes.name: allows_editing
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether transportation plans in this status can be edited or modified by authorized users.

attributes.name: display_order
attributes.description: Numeric value controlling the sort order for displaying plan statuses in user interfaces and reports. Lower numbers appear first.

attributes.name: display_color_code
attributes.description: Hexadecimal color code used for visual representation of the status in dashboards, reports, and user interfaces.

attributes.name: notification_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether stakeholders must be notified when a plan transitions to this status.

attributes.name: public_visibility
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether plans in this status are visible to the public through citizen-facing portals and websites.

attributes.name: mpo_coordination_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Metropolitan Planning Organization (MPO) Coordination Required Indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether plans in this status require coordination with Metropolitan Planning Organizations.

attributes.name: rpo_coordination_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rural Planning Organization (RPO) Coordination Required Indicator

products.name: corridor_segment
products.description: This association product represents the membership relationship between highway segments and planning corridors. It captures the inclusion of specific highway segments within defined transportation corridors for planning, analysis, and phased improvement tracking. Each record links one segment to one corridor with attributes that define the segment's position and role within that corridor context.. Existence Justification: In NCDOT planning operations, highway segments are operational assets that can belong to multiple overlapping planning corridors simultaneously (e.g., a segment of US-1 may be part of the US-1 Strategic Corridor, the Triangle Regional Freight Corridor, and the Capital Area Mobility Corridor). Conversely, planning corridors are multi-segment constructs that span dozens to hundreds of segments for corridor-level analysis, STIP project development, and phased improvement planning. Planners actively manage these segment-corridor memberships, tracking each segment's position, role, and inclusion status within each corridor context.

attributes.name: corridor_segment_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the corridor_segment association

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the highway segment that is included in the corridor

attributes.name: corridor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the planning corridor that includes this segment

attributes.name: sequence_order
attributes.description: Sequential position of this segment within the corridor, used for ordering segments along the corridor path for analysis and reporting. Critical for phased improvement planning where projects are sequenced along the corridor.

attributes.name: milepost_start
attributes.description: Starting milepost of this segment within the corridor's milepost system. May differ from the segment's route-based milepoint as corridors can span multiple routes and use corridor-specific milepost references.

attributes.name: milepost_end
attributes.description: Ending milepost of this segment within the corridor's milepost system. Used with milepost_start to define the segment's extent within the corridor for corridor-level analysis and project limits definition.

attributes.name: inclusion_date
attributes.description: Date when this segment was officially included in the corridor definition. Supports historical tracking of corridor boundary changes and is used in corridor study documentation and planning history.

attributes.name: segment_role
attributes.description: Functional role of this segment within the corridor context (e.g., Primary mainline, Alternate route, Parallel facility, Connector, Future extension). Used for corridor analysis to distinguish between core corridor segments and supporting facilities.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of this segment's membership in the corridor. Supports corridor boundary refinement processes where segments may be proposed for inclusion, under review, or removed from corridor definitions.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the current status became effective. Used with status to track the lifecycle of segment membership in corridors over time.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting special considerations, rationale for inclusion, or planning context specific to this segment's membership in this corridor.
