attributes.description: Environmental compliance requirements, restrictions, or considerations for the task (e.g., herbicide application restrictions, erosion control measures).

attributes.name: permit_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the task requires environmental, utility, or other regulatory permits before execution.

attributes.name: permit_type
attributes.description: Type of permit(s) required if permit_required_flag is true (e.g., erosion control, utility coordination, environmental).

attributes.name: equipment_required
attributes.description: List of standard equipment and vehicles required to perform the task (e.g., dump truck, mower, plow, striping machine).

attributes.name: material_list
attributes.description: List of standard materials required for the task with typical quantities (e.g., asphalt mix, salt, herbicide, paint).

attributes.name: material_cost_estimate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Material Cost Estimate in US Dollars
attributes.description: Estimated cost of materials required for standard task execution in US dollars.

attributes.name: skill_requirements
attributes.description: Required skills, certifications, or qualifications for personnel performing the task (e.g., CDL, pesticide applicator license, traffic control certification).

attributes.name: training_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether specialized training is required before personnel can perform the task.

attributes.name: training_description
attributes.description: Description of required training programs or certifications if training_required_flag is true.

attributes.name: functional_location_category
attributes.description: Category of functional location (asset type) where the task is typically performed in SAP PM.

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: Classification of assets to which this task applies (e.g., Interstate, Primary Route, Secondary Route, Bridge Structure).

attributes.name: performance_standard
attributes.description: Quality or performance standard that must be met upon task completion (e.g., pavement smoothness, vegetation clearance height).

attributes.name: inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether quality assurance inspection is required after task completion.

attributes.name: inspection_type
attributes.description: Type of inspection required if inspection_required_flag is true (e.g., supervisor review, QA inspection, third-party verification).

attributes.name: warranty_period_days
attributes.description: Standard warranty or guarantee period in days for the completed task, after which rework is considered a new task.

attributes.name: emergency_response_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the task is classified as an emergency response activity requiring immediate action.

attributes.name: response_time_target_hours
attributes.description: Target response time in hours from notification to task initiation, particularly relevant for emergency and high-priority tasks.

attributes.name: completion_time_target_hours
attributes.description: Target time in hours from task initiation to completion, used for performance measurement and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: contract_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the task can be performed by external contractors rather than in-house maintenance crews.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Preferred execution method indicating whether the task should be performed in-house, by contractor, or either.

attributes.name: stip_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: State Transportation Improvement Program (STIP) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the task is eligible for inclusion in the State Transportation Improvement Program (STIP) for federal funding.

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Primary funding source for the task (state, federal, local, or mixed funding).

attributes.name: federal_program
attributes.description: Specific federal funding program if applicable (e.g., HSIP, CMAQ, STP, NHS).

attributes.name: gl_account
attributes.description: General Ledger (GL) account code in SAP for posting task-related expenses.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) element in SAP PS for project-based tasks, enabling project cost tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: activity_type
attributes.description: SAP CO activity type for internal cost allocation and activity-based costing.

attributes.name: hpms_code
attributes.description: Highway Performance Monitoring System (HPMS) activity code for federal reporting to FHWA.

attributes.name: mutcd_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices (MUTCD) Reference
attributes.description: Reference to relevant section(s) of the Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices (MUTCD) if the task involves traffic control or signage.

attributes.name: aashto_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: American Association of State Highway and Transportation Officials (AASHTO) Reference
attributes.description: Reference to relevant American Association of State Highway and Transportation Officials (AASHTO) standard or guideline for the task.

attributes.name: standard_operating_procedure
attributes.description: Reference to NCDOT Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) document number or title governing task execution.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when the task was created in the master list.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created the task in the master list.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date when the task was last modified in the master list.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified the task in the master list.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which the task becomes effective and available for use in work orders.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which the task is no longer effective and should not be used in new work orders.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the task definition, incremented when significant changes are made to task specifications.

attributes.name: superseded_by_task_id
attributes.description: Task ID of the newer task that supersedes this task if the task has been replaced or deprecated.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval status of the task definition, indicating whether it has been reviewed and approved for use.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who approved the task for use in work orders.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the task was approved for use in work orders.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.work_order. Business justification: Work orders decompose into multiple tasks assigned to crews. Each task belongs to one work order for scheduling, resource allocation, progress tracking, and cost rollup in maintenance management syste

attributes.name: feature_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gis.feature. Business justification: Individual maintenance tasks (pothole repair, sign replacement, guardrail fix) must reference the specific geographic feature being maintained for asset management, work tracking, and historical maint

attributes.name: assigned_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Individual maintenance tasks are assigned to specific employees for execution. Supervisors track task ownership for performance reviews, time tracking, and ensuring qualified personnel perform special

attributes.name: task_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.task_list. Business justification: Task should reference task_list for standardized task definitions and grouping. Task_list provides master reference for task categorization and standardization. No columns to remove as task_list_id is

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.work_center. Business justification: Task.work_center (STRING) should be normalized to FK reference to work_center master table. This eliminates redundant string storage and enables proper work center master data management. Removing wor

products.name: maintenance_schedule
products.description: Planned maintenance schedule linking work orders to calendar dates, locations, and resource windows for seasonal and routine activities.

attributes.name: maintenance_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the planned maintenance schedule record.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the maintenance schedule indicating whether it is preventive, corrective, seasonal, emergency, routine, or project-based maintenance.

attributes.name: activity_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the planned maintenance activity to be performed.

attributes.name: activity_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the type of maintenance activity (e.g., pavement patching, vegetation control, winter operations).

attributes.name: scheduled_start_date
attributes.description: Planned date when the maintenance activity is scheduled to begin.

attributes.name: scheduled_end_date
attributes.description: Planned date when the maintenance activity is scheduled to be completed.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the maintenance activity is scheduled to begin, including time of day.

attributes.name: scheduled_end_time
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the maintenance activity is scheduled to be completed, including time of day.

attributes.name: duration_hours
attributes.description: Estimated duration of the maintenance activity in hours.

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the roadway route where the maintenance activity is scheduled to occur.

attributes.name: route_name
attributes.description: Name or designation of the roadway route (e.g., I-40, US-1, NC-55).

attributes.name: begin_milepost
attributes.description: Starting milepost location on the route where the maintenance activity is scheduled.

attributes.name: end_milepost
attributes.description: Ending milepost location on the route where the maintenance activity is scheduled.

attributes.name: county_code
attributes.description: Three-digit code identifying the North Carolina county where the maintenance activity is scheduled.

attributes.name: county_name
attributes.description: Name of the North Carolina county where the maintenance activity is scheduled.

attributes.name: division_number
attributes.description: NCDOT division number (1-14) responsible for the maintenance activity.

attributes.name: maintenance_unit
attributes.description: Specific maintenance unit or crew assigned to perform the scheduled activity.

attributes.name: functional_location
attributes.description: SAP PM functional location identifier representing the physical asset or location where maintenance is scheduled.

attributes.name: equipment_number
attributes.description: SAP PM equipment number for the specific asset requiring maintenance.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the scheduled maintenance activity indicating urgency and importance.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the maintenance schedule indicating whether it is scheduled, confirmed, in progress, completed, cancelled, postponed, or on hold.

attributes.name: season
attributes.description: Season during which the maintenance activity is scheduled, particularly relevant for seasonal activities like winter operations or vegetation management.

attributes.name: weather_dependent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the scheduled maintenance activity is dependent on weather conditions.

attributes.name: mot_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Maintenance of Traffic setup is required for the scheduled activity.

attributes.name: mot_type
attributes.description: Type of traffic control required for the maintenance activity.

attributes.name: equipment_required
attributes.description: Description of equipment and machinery required for the scheduled maintenance activity.

attributes.name: material_required
attributes.description: Description of materials required for the scheduled maintenance activity (e.g., asphalt, aggregate, herbicide).

attributes.name: estimated_material_quantity
attributes.description: Estimated quantity of materials required for the maintenance activity.

attributes.name: material_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the estimated material quantity (e.g., tons, cubic yards, gallons).
attributes.references: SAP MM Unit of Measure Standards

attributes.name: contractor_name
attributes.description: Name of the contractor if the maintenance activity is contracted out rather than performed by NCDOT crews.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Contract number if the maintenance activity is performed under a specific contract.

attributes.name: permit_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether environmental or regulatory permits are required for the scheduled maintenance activity.

attributes.name: permit_number
attributes.description: Permit number if environmental or regulatory permits are required for the maintenance activity.

attributes.name: environmental_restrictions
attributes.description: Description of any environmental restrictions or considerations for the scheduled maintenance activity (e.g., protected species, wetlands, water quality).

attributes.name: recurring_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a recurring maintenance schedule that repeats on a regular basis.

attributes.name: recurrence_pattern
attributes.description: Pattern of recurrence for recurring maintenance schedules (e.g., weekly, monthly, annually).

attributes.name: parent_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent maintenance schedule if this is an instance of a recurring schedule.

attributes.name: notification_number
attributes.description: SAP PM notification number that triggered the creation of this maintenance schedule.

attributes.name: planner_name
attributes.description: Name of the maintenance planner who created or is responsible for this schedule.

attributes.name: planner_group
attributes.description: SAP PM planner group code responsible for planning this maintenance activity.

attributes.name: safety_requirements
attributes.description: Description of safety requirements and precautions for the scheduled maintenance activity.

attributes.name: traffic_impact_level
attributes.description: Expected level of impact on traffic flow from the scheduled maintenance activity.

attributes.name: public_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether public notification is required for the scheduled maintenance activity.

attributes.name: notification_date
attributes.description: Date when public notification was or will be issued for the maintenance activity.

attributes.name: coordination_required
attributes.description: Description of coordination required with other agencies, utilities, or stakeholders for the scheduled maintenance activity.

attributes.name: utility_coordination_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether coordination with utility companies is required for the maintenance activity.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the emergency contact person for the scheduled maintenance activity.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the emergency contact person for the scheduled maintenance activity.

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Any special instructions or notes for the scheduled maintenance activity.

attributes.name: completion_criteria
attributes.description: Criteria that must be met for the maintenance activity to be considered complete.

attributes.name: inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether inspection is required upon completion of the maintenance activity.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when the maintenance schedule record was created in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date when the maintenance schedule record was last modified.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date when the maintenance schedule was approved by the appropriate authority.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person who approved the maintenance schedule.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason for cancellation if the maintenance schedule was cancelled.

attributes.name: postponement_reason
attributes.description: Reason for postponement if the maintenance schedule was postponed.

attributes.name: rescheduled_date
attributes.description: New scheduled date if the maintenance activity was rescheduled.

attributes.name: asset_condition_before
attributes.description: Condition assessment of the asset before the scheduled maintenance activity.

attributes.name: pavement_condition_index
attributes.description: Pavement Condition Index score for the roadway segment where maintenance is scheduled, if applicable.

attributes.name: international_roughness_index
attributes.description: International Roughness Index measurement for the roadway segment where maintenance is scheduled, if applicable.

attributes.name: aadt
attributes.description: Annual Average Daily Traffic count for the roadway segment where maintenance is scheduled.

attributes.name: functional_class
attributes.description: Functional classification of the roadway where maintenance is scheduled.

attributes.name: nhs_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the roadway segment is part of the National Highway System.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of the maintenance activity location.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the maintenance activity location.

attributes.name: gis_feature_id
attributes.description: GIS feature identifier linking the maintenance schedule to a spatial feature in the NCDOT GIS system.

attributes.name: track_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rail.track_segment. Business justification: Preventive maintenance schedules are created per track segment based on usage, condition, and regulatory requirements. Essential for planning crew assignments and material procurement.

attributes.name: grade_crossing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rail.grade_crossing. Business justification: Federal regulations require periodic inspection schedules for grade crossings. Maintenance planning uses this to ensure compliance with FRA safety standards.

attributes.name: corridor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to planning.corridor. Business justification: Preventive maintenance schedules are organized by transportation corridor. Maintenance managers schedule routine activities (mowing, patching, inspections) based on corridor assignments to optimize cr

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.work_order. Business justification: Maintenance_schedule.work_order_number (STRING) should be normalized to FK reference to work_order. This links scheduled maintenance to actual work orders and eliminates string-based work order refere

attributes.name: crew_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.crew. Business justification: Maintenance_schedule should reference crew assigned to scheduled work. This enables crew resource planning and scheduling. Crew_size and supervisor_name are crew attributes.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.work_center. Business justification: Maintenance_schedule.work_center (STRING) should be normalized to FK reference to work_center master table. This enables proper work center scheduling and resource allocation.

products.name: material
products.description: Master data for all materials and supplies used in maintenance (e.g., asphalt, sealant, traffic cones) with unit of measure, cost, and inventory status.

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the material master record in the maintenance inventory system.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Business-facing material number used for procurement, inventory tracking, and work order assignment. This is the human-readable identifier used across SAP PM and MM modules.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Short textual description of the material identifying its purpose and characteristics (e.g., 'Asphalt Mix Type S9.5B', 'Traffic Cone 28-inch Orange').

attributes.name: long_description
attributes.description: Extended description providing detailed specifications, usage instructions, or technical characteristics of the material.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the material based on its usage category in maintenance operations (e.g., raw material for asphalt production, spare part for equipment repair, consumable for daily operations).

attributes.name: group
attributes.description: Hierarchical grouping code used for procurement and reporting purposes, aligning materials with similar characteristics or usage patterns.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit used for quantifying, ordering, and tracking the material (e.g., TON for asphalt, GAL for sealant, EA for traffic cones).

attributes.name: base_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The fundamental unit of measure used for inventory valuation and stock keeping, to which all alternative units are converted.

attributes.name: alternative_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Secondary unit of measure that may be used for ordering or issuing the material, with conversion factor to base unit (e.g., ordering in pallets but tracking in bags).

attributes.name: standard_cost
attributes.description: The standard unit cost of the material used for budgeting, cost estimation, and variance analysis in maintenance work orders.

attributes.name: moving_average_price
attributes.description: The weighted average cost of the material calculated based on historical procurement transactions, used for inventory valuation.

attributes.name: last_purchase_price
attributes.description: The most recent unit price paid for procurement of this material, used for cost trending and vendor performance analysis.

attributes.name: price_unit
attributes.description: The quantity to which the price refers (e.g., price per 1 unit, per 100 units, per 1000 units), used for materials sold in bulk.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 currency code for all pricing and valuation of the material. NCDOT operates in USD.

attributes.name: valuation_class
attributes.description: Accounting classification code that determines the general ledger accounts to which material movements and valuations are posted.

attributes.name: stock_on_hand
attributes.description: Current available inventory quantity of the material across all storage locations, measured in base unit of measure.

attributes.name: reserved_stock
attributes.description: Quantity of material currently reserved for specific work orders or maintenance activities but not yet issued.

attributes.name: available_stock
attributes.description: Unreserved inventory quantity available for new work order assignments, calculated as stock on hand minus reserved stock.

attributes.name: minimum_stock_level
attributes.description: The minimum inventory quantity that should be maintained to avoid stockouts and ensure continuous maintenance operations. Triggers reorder point.

attributes.name: maximum_stock_level
attributes.description: The maximum inventory quantity that should be stocked to avoid excess inventory carrying costs and storage constraints.

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: The inventory level at which a procurement request should be automatically triggered to replenish stock before reaching minimum level.

attributes.name: reorder_quantity
attributes.description: The standard quantity to order when replenishing inventory, calculated to optimize procurement costs and storage capacity.

attributes.name: safety_stock
attributes.description: Buffer inventory maintained to protect against demand variability and supply chain disruptions, especially critical for winter weather and emergency response materials.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Average number of days required from purchase order creation to material receipt and availability for use in maintenance operations.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days the material can be stored before expiration or degradation affects its usability, critical for chemicals, sealants, and paints.

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Code identifying the primary warehouse, yard, or storage facility where the material is typically stocked (e.g., district maintenance yard, central warehouse).

attributes.name: storage_bin
attributes.description: Specific bin, rack, or location identifier within the storage facility for precise material placement and retrieval.

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required environmental conditions for safe and effective storage of the material (e.g., climate-controlled for certain chemicals, outdoor covered for aggregates).

attributes.name: hazardous_material_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the material is classified as hazardous and requires special handling, storage, and disposal procedures per OSHA and EPA regulations.

attributes.name: hazard_class
attributes.description: DOT hazard classification code for hazardous materials (e.g., Class 3 Flammable Liquids, Class 8 Corrosives), used for transportation and storage compliance.
attributes.references: 49 CFR Part 172, DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN identification number for hazardous materials used in international and domestic transportation (e.g., UN1203 for gasoline).
attributes.references: 49 CFR Part 172, UN Recommendations on Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: msds_available
attributes.description: Indicator of whether a Material Safety Data Sheet (now Safety Data Sheet - SDS) is on file and accessible for this material, required for hazardous substances.

attributes.name: msds_document_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS) Document Number
attributes.description: Reference number or document identifier for the MSDS/SDS document stored in the document management system.

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the company that manufactures or produces the material, used for quality tracking and warranty claims.

attributes.name: manufacturer_part_number
attributes.description: The manufacturer's unique part number or model number for the material, used for precise identification and cross-referencing.

attributes.name: vendor_part_number
attributes.description: The vendor's catalog or part number for the material, used in purchase orders and receiving documentation.

attributes.name: procurement_type
attributes.description: Indicates how the material is typically procured: externally from vendors, internally produced, or both methods available.

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: Code identifying the procurement team or buyer responsible for purchasing this material category.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Reference number for any active procurement contract or blanket purchase order covering this material.

attributes.name: specification_number
attributes.description: NCDOT or AASHTO specification number defining the technical requirements, quality standards, and testing procedures for the material.

attributes.name: specification_description
attributes.description: Brief description of the specification requirements or quality standards that the material must meet.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether incoming material receipts require quality inspection and approval before being available for use in maintenance operations.
attributes.references: SAP MM Quality Management, NCDOT QA/QC Procedures

attributes.name: inspection_type
attributes.description: Type of quality inspection or testing required for the material (e.g., visual inspection for damage, laboratory testing for asphalt mix, certification review for manufactured products).
attributes.references: SAP MM Quality Management, NCDOT QA/QC Procedures

attributes.name: serialized_material
attributes.description: Indicates whether individual units of this material are tracked by unique serial numbers for warranty, maintenance history, or asset management purposes.

attributes.name: batch_managed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material is managed in batches or lots for traceability, quality control, and expiration tracking (critical for chemicals, asphalt mixes, and time-sensitive materials).

attributes.name: abc_indicator
attributes.description: ABC analysis classification based on consumption value and criticality: A (high value/critical), B (moderate), C (low value/routine), X (no movement). Used for inventory optimization.

attributes.name: xyz_indicator
attributes.description: XYZ analysis classification based on consumption variability: X (constant demand), Y (variable demand), Z (sporadic demand). Used for forecasting and safety stock planning.

attributes.name: seasonal_material
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the material has seasonal demand patterns (e.g., salt and brine for winter weather operations, asphalt for summer paving season).

attributes.name: critical_material
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the material is critical for emergency response, safety operations, or high-priority maintenance activities requiring guaranteed availability.

attributes.name: environmentally_sensitive
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material requires special environmental handling, disposal, or reporting per EPA and NCDEQ regulations (e.g., herbicides, petroleum products).

attributes.name: recyclable_material
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the material or its packaging can be recycled, supporting NCDOT environmental stewardship and sustainability goals.

attributes.name: weight_per_unit
attributes.description: Weight of one base unit of the material, used for transportation planning, load calculations, and freight cost estimation.

attributes.name: weight_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the weight per unit value (e.g., LB for pounds, TON for tons).

attributes.name: volume_per_unit
attributes.description: Volume occupied by one base unit of the material, used for storage space planning and transportation capacity calculations.

attributes.name: volume_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the volume per unit value (e.g., GAL for gallons, CU_YD for cubic yards).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the material master record indicating whether it is available for use in work orders and procurement.

attributes.name: status_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or justification for the current material status, especially for inactive, obsolete, or restricted materials.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the material master record became or will become active and available for use in maintenance operations.

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date when the material was or will be discontinued and no longer available for new work orders, though existing stock may still be used.

attributes.name: replacement_material_number
attributes.description: Material number of the replacement or successor material to be used when this material is discontinued or obsolete.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP plant code representing the organizational unit (e.g., division, district, or facility) responsible for managing this material.

attributes.name: division_code
attributes.description: NCDOT division code indicating which organizational division primarily uses or manages this material (e.g., DOH for Division of Highways, DMV for Division of Motor Vehicles).

attributes.name: district_code
attributes.description: NCDOT highway district code (1-14) if the material is managed at the district level for regional maintenance operations.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when the material master record was originally created in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date when the material master record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: last_goods_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent goods receipt transaction for this material, indicating when inventory was last replenished.

attributes.name: last_goods_issue_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent goods issue transaction for this material, indicating when it was last used in maintenance operations.

attributes.name: annual_consumption_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of the material consumed in the previous 12 months, used for demand forecasting and inventory optimization.

attributes.name: average_monthly_consumption
attributes.description: Average quantity of the material consumed per month based on historical usage patterns, used for reorder point calculations.

attributes.name: tax_classification
attributes.description: Tax category code determining applicable sales tax, use tax, or exemptions for the material procurement.
attributes.references: NCGS Chapter 105, SAP MM Tax Configuration

attributes.name: commodity_code
attributes.description: Standard commodity classification code (e.g., UNSPSC, NIGP) used for procurement reporting, spend analysis, and vendor categorization.

attributes.name: federal_supply_class
attributes.description: Four-digit Federal Supply Classification code used for materials procured with federal funding or through federal supply schedules.

attributes.name: dbe_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this material can be sourced from DBE-certified vendors to meet federal DBE participation requirements on federally funded projects.

attributes.name: hub_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this material can be sourced from HUB-certified vendors to meet North Carolina HUB participation goals.

attributes.name: buy_america_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material meets Buy America requirements for domestic content on federally funded transportation projects.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating where the material is manufactured or produced, relevant for Buy America compliance and trade regulations.

attributes.name: warranty_period_months
attributes.description: Duration in months of the manufacturer's warranty coverage for the material, used for defect claims and replacement planning.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Materials used in highway/infrastructure maintenance are sourced from specific vendors. Maintenance teams need vendor information for reordering, warranty claims, and material traceability. Normalizes

attributes.name: accounts_payable_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.accounts_payable_invoice. Business justification: Materials purchased for maintenance must link to the AP invoice for payment processing, vendor reconciliation, and audit trail. Procurement and finance departments use this to match receipts with invo

products.name: crew
products.description: Master record of maintenance crews, including crew leader, skill certifications, shift patterns, and contact information.

attributes.name: crew_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the maintenance crew. Primary key for the crew entity.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Business-facing crew number used for work order assignment and field operations. May align with SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) crew numbering conventions.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Official name or designation of the maintenance crew (e.g., 'District 5 Paving Crew A', 'Winter Operations Team 3').

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the crew based on primary maintenance function and specialization.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the maintenance crew.

attributes.name: division
attributes.description: NCDOT Division of Highways (DOH) division to which the crew is assigned (e.g., Division 1 through Division 14).

attributes.name: district
attributes.description: Maintenance district within the division responsible for the crew's geographic area of operations.

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: Primary North Carolina county where the crew is based and performs maintenance operations.

attributes.name: base_zip_code
attributes.description: ZIP code of the crew's base location.

attributes.name: leader_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier for the crew leader or supervisor. May reference Beacon HR system employee ID.

attributes.name: leader_name
attributes.description: Full name of the crew leader or supervisor responsible for the crew.

attributes.name: leader_phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the crew leader.

attributes.name: leader_email

products.name: assignment
products.description: This association product represents the operational assignment of maintenance crews to highway segments for specific maintenance work. It captures the work scheduling, crew deployment, and maintenance activity tracking that occurs when NCDOT assigns crews to perform maintenance on highway segments. Each record links one crew to one segment with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific work assignment.. Existence Justification: In NCDOT maintenance operations, crews are assigned to multiple highway segments over time for different maintenance activities (pothole repair, crack sealing, mowing, etc.), and each segment requires multiple crews throughout the year for various maintenance needs. The assignment itself is an operational business entity that maintenance supervisors actively create, schedule, track, and close out, with specific attributes like work type, assignment dates, duration, status, and costs that belong to the assignment relationship rather than to the crew or segment alone.

attributes.name: assignment_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the assignment association

attributes.name: crew_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the maintenance crew assigned to perform work on the highway segment

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the highway segment where maintenance work is to be performed

attributes.name: date
attributes.description: The date when the crew was assigned to perform maintenance work on the segment. This is the scheduled or actual start date of the maintenance activity.

attributes.name: duration_days
attributes.description: The planned or actual duration of the maintenance assignment measured in days. Represents how long the crew is expected to work on this segment.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The role or capacity in which the crew is assigned to this segment (e.g., Primary crew responsible for the work, Support crew assisting another crew, Emergency Response, Specialized work requiring specific certifications).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the crew assignment (e.g., Scheduled, In Progress, Completed, Cancelled, On Hold). Tracks the lifecycle of the maintenance assignment.

attributes.name: estimated_cost
attributes.description: Estimated cost in dollars for this specific crew assignment, including labor, equipment, and materials for the work on this segment.

attributes.name: actual_cost
attributes.description: Actual cost incurred in dollars for this crew assignment after work completion. Used for budget tracking and cost analysis.

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: The date when the crew completed the assigned maintenance work on the segment. Used for performance tracking and historical records.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the assignment, including special conditions, issues encountered, or additional context about the maintenance work performed.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.work_order. Business justification: Assignment.work_order_number (STRING) should be normalized to FK reference to work_order. This links crew-segment assignments to work orders. Priority is work_order attribute.

attributes.name: task_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.task. Business justification: Assignment should reference the specific task being performed. This enables task-level tracking of crew assignments. Work_type is task attribute.

products.name: material_application
products.description: This association product represents the Event of applying maintenance materials to pavement sections. It captures the operational record of material usage during maintenance, resurfacing, or rehabilitation activities. Each record links one material to one pavement section with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific application event.. Existence Justification: In NCDOT maintenance operations, materials (asphalt, sealant, concrete, etc.) are applied to multiple pavement sections across the highway network, and each pavement section receives multiple different materials over its lifecycle during routine maintenance, resurfacing, and rehabilitation activities. The business actively manages and tracks each material application as an operational event with specific quantities, dates, methods, costs, and work order references.

attributes.description: Primary key for the material_application association

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the material master record that was applied in this maintenance activity

attributes.name: pavement_section_id

attributes.name: quantity_used
attributes.description: The quantity of material applied to the pavement section in this specific application event, measured in the material's unit of measure

attributes.name: application_date
attributes.description: The date when the material was applied to the pavement section during maintenance or construction activity

attributes.name: application_method
attributes.description: The method or technique used to apply the material to the pavement section (e.g., spray application for sealant, spreading for asphalt, patching for repairs)

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: The cost per unit of material at the time of this specific application, which may differ from standard cost due to market conditions or procurement timing

attributes.name: total_cost
attributes.description: The total cost of material used in this application, calculated as quantity_used multiplied by unit_cost

attributes.name: crew_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the maintenance crew that performed the material application

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Weather conditions at the time of application, which can affect material performance and application quality

attributes.name: temperature_fahrenheit
attributes.description: Ambient temperature in Fahrenheit at the time of application, critical for proper curing and bonding of materials like asphalt and sealants

attributes.name: application_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting any special conditions, issues, or observations during the material application

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.work_order. Business justification: Material_application.work_order_number (STRING) should be normalized to FK reference to work_order. This links material usage to work orders for cost tracking and material management.

products.name: crew_assignment
products.description: Assignment of maintenance crews to work orders or construction activities, capturing crew composition, skill sets, shift timing, and work completion status. This association product represents the operational reality that multiple crews can be assigned to a single work order (e.g., electrical, structural, paving crews working on the same bridge repair), and crews are assigned to many work orders over time. Each record links crew members to specific work assignments including highway maintenance, construction projects, ferry sailing operations, and emergency response activities. Tracks crew role, hours worked, assignment timing, completion status, labor costs, materials used, safety compliance, and quality inspection results. Originally consolidated from highway and ferry domains, now unified with maintenance operations to serve as the single source of truth for all crew assignment tracking across NCDOT.
