attributes.name: completion_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of work completed during the crew assignment, expressed as a decimal value (0.00 to 100.00).

attributes.name: work_location
attributes.description: Physical location or site where the crew assignment work is performed. May include address, route, or facility name.

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: North Carolina county where the crew assignment work is performed.

attributes.name: division
attributes.description: NCDOT organizational division responsible for the crew assignment (e.g., Highway Division, Ferry Division).

attributes.name: district
attributes.description: Geographic district or maintenance unit within the NCDOT division responsible for the crew assignment.

attributes.name: milepost_begin
attributes.description: Starting milepost location on the route where the crew assignment work begins. Used for highway and roadway assignments.

attributes.name: milepost_end
attributes.description: Ending milepost location on the route where the crew assignment work ends. Used for highway and roadway assignments.

attributes.name: ferry_route
attributes.description: Designated ferry route name or identifier for crew assignments related to ferry operations.

attributes.name: vessel_name
attributes.description: Name of the ferry vessel to which crew members are assigned for ferry operations.

attributes.name: equipment_assigned
attributes.description: Description or identifier of equipment, vehicles, or machinery assigned to the crew for this work assignment.

attributes.name: vehicle_number
attributes.description: NCDOT fleet vehicle number or identifier for the vehicle assigned to the crew for this work assignment.

attributes.name: supervisor_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier for the supervisor or crew leader responsible for overseeing this crew assignment.

attributes.name: supervisor_name
attributes.description: Full name of the supervisor or crew leader responsible for overseeing this crew assignment. Contains personally identifiable information.

attributes.name: assigned_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee ID of the maintenance supervisor or dispatcher who created or authorized this crew assignment.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: SAP cost center code to which labor costs for this crew assignment are charged for financial accounting purposes.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: SAP Project System Work Breakdown Structure element to which this crew assignment is charged for project accounting.

attributes.name: labor_cost
attributes.description: Total labor cost for the employee's work on this crew assignment, including regular and overtime pay. Confidential financial information.

attributes.name: pay_rate
attributes.description: Hourly pay rate for the employee during this crew assignment. Confidential compensation information.

attributes.name: work_order_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the work order or activity to which the crew is assigned.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the crew assignment or work order (e.g., routine, high, urgent, emergency).

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Weather conditions at the time of the crew assignment work (e.g., clear, rain, snow, fog). May impact work safety and productivity.

attributes.name: temperature_fahrenheit
attributes.description: Ambient temperature in degrees Fahrenheit at the work location during the crew assignment. May impact work conditions and material performance.

attributes.name: safety_briefing_completed
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the required safety briefing was completed before the crew began work on this assignment.

attributes.name: mot_plan_number
attributes.description: Identifier for the Maintenance of Traffic plan associated with this crew assignment. Required for work in active traffic zones.

attributes.name: traffic_control_required
attributes.description: Indicator of whether traffic control measures are required for this crew assignment work.

attributes.name: lane_closure_type
attributes.description: Type of lane closure implemented for the crew assignment work (e.g., full closure, partial closure, shoulder closure, rolling roadblock).

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required
attributes.description: Indicator of whether quality assurance or quality control inspection is required for the work performed during this crew assignment.

attributes.name: inspection_result
attributes.description: Result of quality inspection performed on the work completed during this crew assignment (e.g., passed, failed, conditional approval).

attributes.name: materials_used
attributes.description: Description or list of materials consumed or used during the crew assignment work.

attributes.name: material_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of materials used during the crew assignment, expressed in the appropriate unit of measure.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for material quantity (e.g., tons, gallons, cubic yards, linear feet, square feet).

attributes.name: emergency_response_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the crew assignment is part of an emergency response operation (e.g., storm damage, accident cleanup, hazardous condition).

attributes.name: incident_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the traffic incident or emergency event that triggered this crew assignment. Applicable for emergency response assignments.

attributes.name: federal_funding_source
attributes.description: Federal funding program or source supporting the crew assignment work (e.g., FHWA, FTA, emergency relief).

attributes.name: grant_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the federal or state grant funding this crew assignment work.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes about the crew's assignment, work performed, issues encountered, or other relevant information.

attributes.name: assignment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to the crew assignment, including special instructions, observations, or issues.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the crew assignment record was created in the system. System audit field.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the crew assignment record was last modified in the system. System audit field.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system from which the crew assignment record originated (e.g., SAP, MAXIMO, ferry operations system).

attributes.name: sailing_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ferry.sailing_schedule. Business justification: Links crew assignments to specific ferry sailing schedules for ferry operations crew.

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to transit.route. Business justification: Links crew assignments to transit routes for transit maintenance crew assignments.

attributes.name: flight_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to aviation.flight_schedule. Business justification: Links crew assignments to aviation facility maintenance schedules.

attributes.name: project_boundary_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gis.project_boundary. Business justification: Links crew assignments to geographic project boundaries for spatial analysis and mapping.

attributes.name: task_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.task. Business justification: Crew_assignment should reference the specific task being performed. This enables detailed task-level crew assignment tracking and labor cost allocation. Activity_type is task attribute.

products.name: task_list
products.description: Master reference table for task_list. Referenced by task_list_id.

attributes.name: task_list_id
attributes.description: Primary key for task_list

attributes.name: task_list_type
attributes.description: Classification of the task list indicating the category of maintenance or operational activity it represents.

attributes.name: task_list_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the task list for reference and lookup purposes in SAP PM and other operational systems.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the task list that clearly identifies the maintenance activity or work procedure.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the task list including scope, purpose, and specific activities to be performed.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the task list indicating whether it is available for use in work order planning and execution.

attributes.name: usage_category
attributes.description: Category indicating the typical usage pattern or application context for the task list.

attributes.name: work_center_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the primary work center or maintenance facility responsible for executing tasks in this task list.

attributes.name: equipment_category
attributes.description: Category of transportation infrastructure or equipment that this task list applies to.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Default priority level assigned to work orders created from this task list, indicating urgency and resource allocation requirements.

attributes.name: estimated_duration_hours
attributes.description: Standard estimated time in hours required to complete all tasks in the task list under normal conditions.

attributes.name: estimated_labor_hours
attributes.description: Total estimated labor hours required across all crew members to complete the task list.

attributes.name: estimated_cost
attributes.description: Standard estimated total cost in USD to complete the task list including labor, materials, and equipment.

attributes.name: crew_size_required
attributes.description: Number of personnel required to safely and efficiently execute the task list.

attributes.name: safety_requirements
attributes.description: Description of safety protocols, personal protective equipment, and traffic control measures required for task list execution.

attributes.name: mot_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether maintenance of traffic setup and traffic control measures are required for this task list.

attributes.name: permit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether special permits or authorizations are required before executing this task list.

attributes.name: environmental_considerations
attributes.description: Description of environmental protection measures, restrictions, and compliance requirements for task list execution.

attributes.name: seasonal_applicability
attributes.description: Indicates the season(s) during which this task list is typically applicable or most effective.

attributes.name: frequency_type
attributes.description: Standard frequency or schedule pattern for executing this task list in preventive maintenance programs.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this task list is required for regulatory compliance with federal, state, or local regulations.

attributes.name: materials_required
attributes.description: Description of standard materials, supplies, and consumables typically required to complete the task list.

attributes.name: equipment_required
attributes.description: Description of specialized equipment, tools, and vehicles required to execute the task list.

attributes.name: certification_required
attributes.description: Description of professional certifications, licenses, or specialized training required for personnel executing this task list.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this task list version became effective and available for use in work order planning.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this task list version is scheduled to expire or be replaced by a newer version.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the supervisor or manager who approved this task list for operational use.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date when this task list was officially approved for operational use.

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Version or revision number of the task list indicating the iteration of updates and modifications.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when this task list was last reviewed for accuracy, relevance, and compliance with current standards.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review and update of this task list.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, special instructions, or contextual information relevant to the task list execution.

products.name: work_center
products.description: Master reference table for work_center. Referenced by work_center_id.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Primary key for work_center

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the work center in SAP PM and operational systems. Used for work order assignment and resource planning.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the work center facility or operational unit.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the work center's purpose, capabilities, and operational scope.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the work center based on its primary operational function within NCDOT maintenance operations.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: High-level category grouping for the work center used for organizational reporting and resource allocation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the work center indicating availability for work order assignment.

attributes.name: division
attributes.description: NCDOT organizational division responsible for the work center. DOH = Department of Highways, DMV = Department of Motor Vehicles.

attributes.name: district_number
attributes.description: NCDOT highway district number (1-14) where the work center is located. Used for regional maintenance planning and resource allocation.

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: North Carolina county where the work center is physically located.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the work center facility.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address information such as building number, suite, or unit designation.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the work center is located.

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code. Always NC for NCDOT work centers.

attributes.name: zip_code
attributes.description: Five-digit or nine-digit ZIP code for the work center location.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the work center in decimal degrees for GIS mapping and routing.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the work center in decimal degrees for GIS mapping and routing.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the work center facility.

attributes.name: supervisor_name
attributes.description: Name of the supervisor or manager responsible for the work center operations.

attributes.name: capacity_rating
attributes.description: Operational capacity rating of the work center measured in standard work hours per day or crew equivalents.

attributes.name: capacity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the work center capacity rating.

attributes.name: operating_hours_start
attributes.description: Standard daily start time for work center operations in HH:MM format.

attributes.name: operating_hours_end
attributes.description: Standard daily end time for work center operations in HH:MM format.

attributes.name: operates_24_7
attributes.description: Indicates whether the work center operates continuously 24 hours per day, 7 days per week (typical for emergency response centers).

attributes.name: winter_operations_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the work center is equipped and staffed for winter weather operations including snow removal and ice treatment.

attributes.name: emergency_response_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the work center is designated for emergency response and incident management operations.

attributes.name: mot_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the work center has certified staff and equipment for maintenance of traffic operations during roadway work.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP plant code associated with the work center for material management and inventory control.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: SAP cost center code for financial tracking and budget allocation for work center operations.

attributes.name: responsible_organization
attributes.description: Organizational unit code responsible for managing and maintaining the work center.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the work center became operational and available for work order assignment.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the work center ceased operations or was decommissioned. Null if currently active.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent safety or compliance inspection of the work center facility.

attributes.name: facility_size_sqft
attributes.description: Total building and covered area of the work center facility measured in square feet.

attributes.name: yard_size_acres
attributes.description: Total outdoor yard and storage area of the work center measured in acres.

attributes.name: vehicle_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of maintenance vehicles that can be stored at the work center facility.

attributes.name: equipment_storage_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of equipment units that can be stored at the work center facility.

attributes.name: material_storage_capacity_tons
attributes.description: Maximum material storage capacity measured in tons, typically for aggregates, salt, and other bulk materials used in maintenance operations.

attributes.name: fuel_facility_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the work center has on-site fuel storage and dispensing facilities for fleet vehicles.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the work center operations or facility.

products.name: route
products.description: Master reference table for route. Referenced by route_id.

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Primary key for route

attributes.name: route_number
attributes.description: Official route designation number assigned by NCDOT (e.g., I-40, US-1, NC-55). This is the public-facing route identifier used on signage and maps.

attributes.name: route_name
attributes.description: Common or official name of the route (e.g., Blue Ridge Parkway, Capital Boulevard). May be null for routes without designated names.

attributes.name: route_type
attributes.description: Classification of the route based on functional hierarchy and jurisdiction (interstate, US highway, state highway, secondary road, local road, ramp, service road).

attributes.name: route_class
attributes.description: Maintenance classification level indicating priority and resource allocation for maintenance activities (primary, secondary, tertiary).

attributes.name: route_direction
attributes.description: Primary directional orientation of the route for navigation and maintenance planning purposes.

attributes.name: begin_milepost
attributes.description: Starting milepost marker for the route segment. Used as the reference point for linear referencing and asset location.

attributes.name: end_milepost
attributes.description: Ending milepost marker for the route segment. Defines the terminus of the route for maintenance and asset management.

attributes.name: total_length_miles
attributes.description: Total length of the route measured in miles. Calculated as the difference between end and begin mileposts.

attributes.name: surface_type
attributes.description: Primary pavement surface material type for the route. Critical for determining appropriate maintenance and preservation strategies.

attributes.name: number_of_lanes
attributes.description: Total number of travel lanes on the route (both directions combined). Used for capacity planning and maintenance resource allocation.

attributes.name: median_type
attributes.description: Type of median separation between opposing traffic directions. Impacts maintenance requirements for vegetation management and barrier repair.

attributes.name: shoulder_width_feet
attributes.description: Average width of the paved or unpaved shoulder in feet. Important for maintenance operations and emergency vehicle access.

attributes.name: speed_limit_mph
attributes.description: Posted speed limit for the route in miles per hour. Used for traffic management and maintenance of traffic (MOT) planning.

attributes.name: maintenance_district
attributes.description: NCDOT maintenance district responsible for the route. Determines which district office manages maintenance activities and work orders.

attributes.name: maintenance_division
attributes.description: NCDOT division number responsible for the route. Higher-level organizational unit above maintenance district.

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: Primary county in which the route is located. Routes may span multiple counties; this represents the primary or starting county.

attributes.name: urban_rural_designation
attributes.description: Classification of the route location as urban, rural, or suburban. Impacts maintenance priorities, funding allocation, and operational strategies.

attributes.name: truck_route_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the route is designated for commercial truck traffic. Affects pavement maintenance frequency and winter weather priority.

attributes.name: snow_priority_level
attributes.description: Winter weather operations priority level for snow and ice removal. Priority 1 routes are cleared first during winter weather events.

attributes.name: pavement_condition_index
attributes.description: Numerical rating of overall pavement condition on a scale of 0-100, where 100 represents excellent condition. Used to prioritize pavement preservation activities.

attributes.name: last_resurfacing_date
attributes.description: Date when the route was last resurfaced or received major pavement rehabilitation. Used to track pavement lifecycle and plan future preservation.

attributes.name: average_daily_traffic
attributes.description: Average number of vehicles per day traveling on the route. Key metric for maintenance planning and resource allocation.

attributes.name: functional_classification
attributes.description: Federal functional classification of the route based on the role it serves in the transportation network (principal arterial, minor arterial, major collector, minor collector, local).

attributes.name: national_highway_system_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the route is part of the National Highway System. NHS routes receive federal funding and have specific maintenance standards.

attributes.name: strategic_highway_network_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the route is part of the Strategic Highway Network for national defense purposes. Affects maintenance standards and emergency response protocols.

attributes.name: hurricane_evacuation_route_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the route is designated as a hurricane evacuation route. These routes receive priority maintenance and emergency response during hurricane events.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the route. Active routes are open to traffic and receive regular maintenance.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the route record became effective in the system. Used for historical tracking and temporal queries.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the route record expires or is superseded by a new record. Null for currently active records.

products.name: qa_checklist
products.description: Master reference table for qa_checklist. Referenced by qa_checklist_id.

attributes.name: qa_checklist_id
attributes.description: Primary key for qa_checklist

attributes.name: checklist_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code used to identify the checklist type in operational systems and work orders.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the quality assurance checklist.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the purpose, scope, and application of the quality assurance checklist.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: Primary maintenance category or work type that this checklist applies to within NCDOT maintenance operations.

attributes.name: subcategory
attributes.description: Secondary classification or specific work activity within the primary category that this checklist addresses.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the quality assurance checklist indicating whether it is available for use in maintenance operations.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the checklist following semantic versioning to track revisions and updates over time.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this version of the checklist becomes active and available for use in maintenance operations.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this checklist version is no longer valid and should not be used for new inspections or quality checks.

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: Name or title of the organizational role or individual responsible for approving this checklist for operational use.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the checklist was officially approved by the designated authority for use in maintenance operations.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this checklist is mandated by federal, state, or local regulations versus being an internal NCDOT quality standard.

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: Citation or reference to the specific regulation, statute, or standard that mandates this checklist if applicable.

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.description: Required or recommended frequency for conducting inspections or quality checks using this checklist.

attributes.name: estimated_completion_time_minutes
attributes.description: Average time in minutes required to complete all items on this checklist during a typical inspection or quality check.

attributes.name: required_certifications
attributes.description: List of professional certifications, licenses, or training credentials required for personnel authorized to use this checklist.

attributes.name: equipment_required
attributes.description: List of tools, instruments, or equipment necessary to complete the inspection or quality check defined by this checklist.

attributes.name: safety_requirements
attributes.description: Personal protective equipment (PPE), safety protocols, or Maintenance of Traffic (MOT) requirements that must be followed when using this checklist.

attributes.name: total_checklist_items
attributes.description: Total number of individual inspection points, questions, or verification items included in this checklist.

attributes.name: critical_items_count
attributes.description: Number of checklist items designated as critical or mandatory that must pass for overall checklist compliance.

attributes.name: passing_score_percentage
attributes.description: Minimum percentage of checklist items that must be satisfactorily completed to consider the inspection or quality check as passed.

attributes.name: documentation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether photographic evidence, measurements, or other supporting documentation must be attached when completing this checklist.

attributes.name: supervisor_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether completed checklists must be reviewed and approved by a supervisor or quality assurance manager.

attributes.name: applicable_asset_types
attributes.description: Types of transportation infrastructure assets (roadways, bridges, signs, signals, etc.) that this checklist can be applied to.

attributes.name: applicable_work_order_types
attributes.description: SAP PM work order types or maintenance activity codes that should reference this checklist during execution.

attributes.name: seasonal_applicability
attributes.description: Seasons or time periods when this checklist is applicable, particularly relevant for winter weather operations and vegetation management.

attributes.name: geographic_applicability
attributes.description: Geographic scope or regions within North Carolina where this checklist applies, accounting for regional variations in maintenance practices.

attributes.name: superseded_by_checklist_qa_checklist_id
attributes.description: Reference to the newer checklist version that replaces this one when status is superseded, maintaining version history.

attributes.name: revision_notes
attributes.description: Summary of changes, updates, or corrections made in this version compared to the previous version of the checklist.

attributes.name: training_material_url
attributes.description: Web link to training materials, instructional videos, or documentation that explains how to properly use this checklist.

attributes.name: contact_person
attributes.description: Name or role of the subject matter expert or organizational contact for questions about this checklist.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the contact person or organizational unit responsible for maintaining this checklist.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the contact person or organizational unit for questions or issues related to this checklist.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Primary language in which the checklist is written, supporting multilingual workforce requirements.

attributes.name: digital_form_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this checklist is available in a digital or mobile application format for field use.

attributes.name: paper_form_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a paper copy of the completed checklist must be retained for regulatory or archival purposes.

attributes.name: retention_period_years
attributes.description: Number of years that completed checklists must be retained to comply with regulatory and organizational record-keeping requirements.

domains.name: grant
domains.description: Grants and federal programs administration including FHWA, FTA, BUILD, INFRA, RAISE, and TIFIA funding. Manages federal funding compliance, OMB Uniform Guidance (2 CFR 200), grant reporting, and reimbursement processes.

products.name: grant_program
products.description: Master record of federal and state grant programs administered by NCDOT, including program code, name, description, funding source (e.g., FHWA, FTA), eligibility criteria, statutory authority, and budget authority.

attributes.name: grant_program_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the grant program record. Primary key for the program entity.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the grant program for identification and tracking purposes. Used in financial systems and reporting.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Official name of the grant program as designated by the funding agency.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Comprehensive description of the grant program including purpose, objectives, and scope of eligible activities.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the grant program by funding source level (federal, state, local, private foundation, or joint funding).

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Primary federal or state agency or program providing the grant funding. Common sources include Federal Highway Administration (FHWA), Federal Transit Administration (FTA), Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), Federal Railroad Administration (FRA), Better Utilizing Investments to Leverage Development (BUILD), Infrastructure for Rebuilding America (INFRA), Rebuilding American Infrastructure with Sustainability and Equity (RAISE), Transportation Infrastructure Finance and Innovation Act (TIFIA), Congestion Mitigation and Air Quality (CMAQ), Highway Safety Improvement Program (HSIP), Surface Transportation Program (STP), National Highway System (NHS), or state funding.

attributes.name: federal_agency
attributes.description: Federal agency administering the grant program. Includes Federal Highway Administration (FHWA), Federal Transit Administration (FTA), Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), Federal Railroad Administration (FRA), National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA), or United States Department of Transportation (USDOT).

attributes.name: cfda_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Catalog of Federal Domestic Assistance (CFDA) Number
attributes.description: Five-digit Catalog of Federal Domestic Assistance number assigned to federal grant programs for tracking and reporting purposes. Format: XX.XXX.

attributes.name: statutory_authority
attributes.description: Legal citation of the federal or state statute that authorizes the grant program, including public law number, USC citation, or state general statute reference.

attributes.name: authorizing_legislation
attributes.description: Name and citation of the federal or state legislation that created or most recently reauthorized the grant program (e.g., Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act, FAST Act, MAP-21).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the grant program indicating whether it is actively accepting applications and awarding funds.

attributes.name: eligibility_criteria
attributes.description: Detailed description of the eligibility requirements for applicants and projects under this grant program, including entity types, project types, geographic restrictions, and matching requirements.

attributes.name: eligible_applicants
attributes.description: Types of organizations or entities eligible to apply for grants under this program (e.g., state DOTs, MPOs, RPOs, local governments, transit agencies, private entities).

attributes.name: eligible_activities
attributes.description: Types of transportation projects, activities, or expenditures that can be funded under this grant program (e.g., construction, planning, design, right-of-way acquisition, equipment purchase).

attributes.name: match_requirement_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of non-federal or local matching funds required for projects funded under this program. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 20.00 for 20% match).

attributes.name: federal_share_percentage
attributes.description: Maximum percentage of project costs that can be funded with federal grant dollars under this program. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 80.00 for 80% federal share).

attributes.name: budget_authority
attributes.description: Total budget authority or appropriation allocated to this grant program for the current fiscal year, expressed in US dollars.

attributes.name: total_program_funding
attributes.description: Total funding available under this grant program across all fiscal years, including multi-year authorizations, expressed in US dollars.

attributes.name: annual_allocation
attributes.description: Annual funding allocation for this grant program in the current fiscal year, expressed in US dollars.

attributes.name: minimum_award_amount
attributes.description: Minimum grant award amount that can be requested or awarded under this program, expressed in US dollars.

attributes.name: maximum_award_amount
attributes.description: Maximum grant award amount that can be requested or awarded to a single project or applicant under this program, expressed in US dollars.

attributes.name: application_cycle
attributes.description: Frequency with which the grant program accepts applications (annual, biennial, quarterly, continuous rolling basis, one-time, or as-needed).

attributes.name: application_deadline
attributes.description: Deadline date for submitting grant applications for the current funding cycle, in format yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: award_notification_date
attributes.description: Expected or actual date when grant award decisions will be announced to applicants, in format yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when the grant program became or will become active and eligible to accept applications, in format yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when the grant program authorization expires or is scheduled to sunset, in format yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: reauthorization_date
attributes.description: Date when the grant program was most recently reauthorized by legislation, in format yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Federal or state fiscal year for which the program budget and allocation apply. Format: YYYY.

attributes.name: federal_fiscal_year
attributes.description: Federal fiscal year designation for federal grant programs, running October 1 through September 30. Format: YYYY.

attributes.name: state_fiscal_year
attributes.description: North Carolina state fiscal year designation, running July 1 through June 30. Format: YYYY.

attributes.name: manager_name
attributes.description: Name of the NCDOT staff member responsible for administering and managing this grant program.

attributes.name: manager_email
attributes.description: Email address of the NCDOT program manager responsible for this grant program.

attributes.name: manager_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the NCDOT program manager responsible for this grant program.

attributes.name: maximum_extension_months

products.name: program_vendor_eligibility
products.description: This association product represents the prequalification and eligibility relationship between grant programs and vendors. It captures program-specific vendor certifications, eligibility status, and qualification dates that exist only in the context of a specific program-vendor combination. Each record links one grant program to one vendor with attributes tracking their eligibility and certification status for that specific program.. Existence Justification: In NCDOT grant administration, vendors must be prequalified for specific grant programs based on program-specific eligibility criteria and certifications. A single vendor can be eligible for multiple grant programs (e.g., a DBE-certified vendor may be prequalified for multiple federal highway programs), and each grant program maintains a roster of multiple eligible vendors. The eligibility relationship itself carries program-specific data including prequalification dates, certification types, eligibility status, and expiration dates that belong to neither the vendor master record nor the program master record alone.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the vendor whose eligibility is being tracked for this program

attributes.name: prequalification_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor was prequalified or approved for participation in this specific grant program. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning.

attributes.name: program_specific_certification
attributes.description: Type or identifier of program-specific certification required and held by the vendor for this grant program (e.g., DBE certification for DBE programs, SBTDC certification). Explicitly identified in detection reasoning.

attributes.name: eligibility_status
attributes.description: Current eligibility status of the vendor for this specific grant program. Tracks whether vendor meets program-specific requirements. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning.

attributes.name: certification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the program-specific certification or eligibility expires and requires renewal for this vendor-program combination. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning.

attributes.name: eligibility_determination_date
attributes.description: Date when the eligibility determination was made by the grant program administrator for this vendor-program combination.

attributes.name: determined_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the grant administrator or certifying official who determined eligibility for this vendor-program combination.

attributes.name: eligibility_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting special conditions, waivers, or additional requirements for this vendor's eligibility in this specific program.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this program-vendor eligibility record was created in the system.

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this program-vendor eligibility record was last modified.

products.name: budget
products.description: Master record of approved fiscal year budgets, including total appropriations, program allocations, and multi‑year planning.

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the budget record. Primary key for the finance budget entity.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which this budget is approved, typically represented as a four-digit year (e.g., 2024). May represent State Fiscal Year (SFY) or Federal Fiscal Year (FFY).

attributes.name: fiscal_year_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget is for State Fiscal Year (SFY) or Federal Fiscal Year (FFY).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Descriptive name or title of the budget (e.g., 'FY2024 Highway Operations Budget', 'FY2024 DMV Capital Budget').

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the budget by type: operating (day-to-day operations), capital (infrastructure and long-term assets), grant (specific grant-funded programs), federal (federally funded), state (state-funded), special revenue, debt service, or enterprise fund.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the budget in its lifecycle: draft (under development), proposed (submitted for approval), approved (authorized for execution), amended (modified after approval), closed (fiscal year ended), or cancelled.

attributes.name: total_appropriation_amount
attributes.description: Total authorized budget appropriation amount for the fiscal year, representing the maximum amount that can be obligated and expended.

attributes.name: total_revenue_amount
attributes.description: Total projected or budgeted revenue amount for the fiscal year, including all funding sources.

attributes.name: total_expenditure_amount
attributes.description: Total budgeted expenditure amount for the fiscal year across all programs and cost centers.

attributes.name: fund_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the governmental fund to which this budget belongs (e.g., general fund, highway fund, highway trust fund, federal aid fund).

attributes.name: fund_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the governmental fund (e.g., 'Highway Fund', 'Highway Trust Fund', 'General Fund', 'Federal Aid Highway Fund').

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the program or functional area to which this budget is allocated (e.g., highway maintenance, bridge rehabilitation, DMV operations).

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the program or functional area (e.g., 'Highway Maintenance', 'Bridge Rehabilitation', 'Division of Motor Vehicles Operations').

attributes.name: division_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the NCDOT division responsible for this budget (e.g., DOH for Division of Highways, DMV for Division of Motor Vehicles, DCH for Division of Central Highways).

attributes.name: division_name
attributes.description: Full name of the NCDOT division (e.g., 'Division of Highways', 'Division of Motor Vehicles', 'Division of Central Highways').

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP FI/CO cost center code to which this budget is assigned for financial tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the SAP cost center.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: SAP Project System (PS) Work Breakdown Structure element code for project-based budgets, enabling hierarchical project cost tracking.

attributes.name: internal_order_number
attributes.description: SAP internal order number used for tracking costs for specific activities or initiatives within the budget.

attributes.name: grant_number
attributes.description: Federal or state grant number if this budget is funded by a specific grant (e.g., FHWA grant, FTA grant, HSIP grant).

attributes.name: grant_program_name
attributes.description: Name of the grant program funding this budget (e.g., 'Highway Safety Improvement Program (HSIP)', 'Congestion Mitigation and Air Quality (CMAQ)', 'Surface Transportation Program (STP)').

attributes.name: federal_funding_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the budget funded by federal sources (FHWA, FTA, FAA, FRA, etc.).

attributes.name: state_funding_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the budget funded by North Carolina state appropriations.

attributes.name: local_funding_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the budget funded by local government sources (county, municipal).

attributes.name: other_funding_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the budget funded by other sources not classified as federal, state, or local (e.g., private contributions, bond proceeds).

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the budget period, typically the first day of the fiscal year (e.g., 2024-07-01 for SFY, 2023-10-01 for FFY).

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the budget period, typically the last day of the fiscal year (e.g., 2025-06-30 for SFY, 2024-09-30 for FFY).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the budget was officially approved by the NC Legislature or authorized body.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the authority that approved the budget (e.g., 'NC General Assembly', 'NCDOT Secretary', 'Board of Transportation').

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: Sequential number indicating the version of the budget if it has been amended after initial approval (0 for original, 1 for first amendment, etc.).

attributes.name: amendment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent budget amendment, if applicable.

attributes.name: amendment_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for the budget amendment (e.g., 'Additional federal grant awarded', 'Emergency response funding', 'Program reallocation').

attributes.name: personnel_cost_amount
attributes.description: Budgeted amount allocated for personnel costs including salaries, wages, and benefits.

attributes.name: operating_cost_amount
attributes.description: Budgeted amount allocated for operating expenses such as supplies, utilities, maintenance, and services.

attributes.name: capital_outlay_amount
attributes.description: Budgeted amount allocated for capital expenditures including infrastructure, equipment, and facilities.

attributes.name: debt_service_amount
attributes.description: Budgeted amount allocated for debt service payments including principal and interest on bonds and loans (e.g., GARVEE bonds).

attributes.name: contingency_amount
attributes.description: Budgeted contingency or reserve amount set aside for unforeseen expenses or emergencies.

attributes.name: stip_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the State Transportation Improvement Program (STIP) document or project identifier if this budget is tied to STIP projects.

attributes.name: tip_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the Transportation Improvement Program (TIP) document or project identifier if this budget is tied to TIP projects managed by MPO or RPO.

attributes.name: mpo_name
attributes.description: Name of the Metropolitan Planning Organization (MPO) if this budget is coordinated with or allocated to an MPO region.

attributes.name: rpo_name
attributes.description: Name of the Rural Planning Organization (RPO) if this budget is coordinated with or allocated to an RPO region.

attributes.name: object_code
attributes.description: Governmental accounting object code classifying the nature of the expenditure (e.g., salaries, supplies, equipment, contractual services).

attributes.name: object_code_description
attributes.description: Description of the object code classification.

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: Functional classification of the budget (e.g., 'Transportation', 'Public Safety', 'General Government').

attributes.name: owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual or role responsible for managing and executing this budget (e.g., division director, program manager).

attributes.name: owner_email
attributes.description: Email address of the budget owner for communication and accountability.

attributes.name: manager
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the budget manager responsible for day-to-day budget monitoring and reporting.

attributes.name: manager_email
attributes.description: Email address of the budget manager.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the budget amounts, typically USD for NCDOT.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the budget (e.g., 'Original', 'Revised Q1', 'Final').

attributes.name: multi_year_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget spans multiple fiscal years (true) or is for a single fiscal year (false).

attributes.name: multi_year_start_year
attributes.description: Starting fiscal year for multi-year budgets.

attributes.name: multi_year_end_year
attributes.description: Ending fiscal year for multi-year budgets.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or context about the budget for internal reference.

attributes.name: compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the budget is in compliance with all applicable regulations and policies (true) or has compliance issues (false).

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Details of any compliance issues or special compliance requirements for this budget.

attributes.name: encumbrance_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of budget that has been encumbered (committed) through purchase orders, contracts, or other obligations.

attributes.name: expended_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of budget that has been expended (actual payments made) as of the current reporting period.

attributes.name: available_balance_amount
attributes.description: Remaining budget balance available for obligation and expenditure (total appropriation minus encumbrances and expenditures).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Source system from which this budget record originated (e.g., SAP FI/CO, NCFS, manual entry).

attributes.name: source_system_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this budget record in the source system.

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: Date when the budget record was last updated in the source system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this budget record is effective and valid for use.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which this budget record is no longer valid or has expired.

attributes.name: justification
attributes.description: Detailed justification or rationale for the budget request, including business needs, strategic alignment, and expected outcomes.

attributes.name: performance_measure
attributes.description: Key performance measure or metric associated with this budget to track effectiveness and outcomes (e.g., 'Lane miles maintained', 'Licenses issued', 'Bridge inspections completed').

attributes.name: performance_target
attributes.description: Target value for the performance measure that this budget is intended to achieve.

products.name: budget_line
products.description: Transactional line items that allocate budget amounts to specific cost centers, projects, or programs; captures changes over time.

attributes.name: budget_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the budget line item. Primary key for the budget line entity.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within a budget document or allocation, used for ordering and reference purposes.

attributes.name: fund_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the fund associated with this budget line.

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the program or initiative to which this budget line is allocated.

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the program associated with this budget line.

attributes.name: project_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the project to which this budget line is allocated, if applicable. Used for capital projects and specific initiatives.

attributes.name: project_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the project associated with this budget line.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: Work Breakdown Structure element code for detailed project cost tracking and allocation within SAP Project System.

attributes.name: account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger account code identifying the nature of the expense or revenue for this budget line.

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the general ledger account associated with this budget line.

attributes.name: account_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the general ledger account (Asset, Liability, Equity, Revenue, Expense).

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: Code representing the functional area or business segment (e.g., Highway Operations, DMV, Ferry Operations) to which this budget line applies.

attributes.name: functional_area_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the functional area associated with this budget line.

attributes.name: division_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the NCDOT division responsible for this budget line (e.g., DOH, DMV, DCH, ITD).

attributes.name: division_name
attributes.description: Full name of the NCDOT division associated with this budget line.

attributes.name: budget_type
attributes.description: Classification of the budget line by type (Operating, Capital, Grant, Federal, State, Local, Other).

attributes.name: budget_category
attributes.description: Expenditure category classification for this budget line (e.g., Personnel, Equipment, Supplies, Contractual Services).

attributes.name: budget_subcategory
attributes.description: More detailed subcategory within the budget category for granular expense tracking.

attributes.name: original_budget_amount
attributes.description: The initial budget amount allocated to this line item at the beginning of the fiscal year or budget period.

attributes.name: revised_budget_amount
attributes.description: The current revised budget amount after adjustments, transfers, or amendments. This is the active budget amount.

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: The net amount of adjustments made to the original budget for this line item. Positive values indicate increases, negative values indicate decreases.

attributes.name: encumbrance_amount
attributes.description: The amount of budget committed through purchase orders, contracts, or other obligations but not yet expended.

attributes.name: actual_expenditure_amount
attributes.description: The actual amount expended against this budget line to date.

attributes.name: available_balance_amount
attributes.description: The remaining budget balance available for expenditure, calculated as revised budget minus encumbrances minus actual expenditures.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the budget amounts (typically USD for NCDOT).

attributes.name: budget_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the budget (e.g., Original, Revised, Final) to track budget iterations and amendments.

attributes.name: budget_status
attributes.description: Current status of the budget line in the budget lifecycle (Draft, Submitted, Approved, Active, Closed, Cancelled).

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval status of this budget line item within the budget approval workflow.

attributes.name: federal_funding_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget line includes federal funding sources (true) or not (false).

attributes.name: federal_agency_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the federal agency providing funding (e.g., FHWA, FTA, FAA, FRA) if federal funding is involved.

attributes.name: federal_program_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific federal program or grant providing funding (e.g., HSIP, CMAQ, STP).

attributes.name: cfda_number

attributes.description: The CFDA number identifying the federal assistance program for grant-funded budget lines. Format: XX.XXX

attributes.name: grant_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the grant award if this budget line is funded by a specific grant.

attributes.name: match_requirement_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of matching funds required for federal grants (e.g., 20.00 for 20% state match on 80% federal funding).

attributes.name: match_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of state or local matching funds required or allocated for this budget line.

attributes.name: stip_project_indicator

attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget line is associated with a project in the State Transportation Improvement Program (STIP).

attributes.name: tip_project_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget line is associated with a project in a regional Transportation Improvement Program (TIP).

attributes.name: mpo_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the Metropolitan Planning Organization if this budget line is associated with an MPO-planned project.

attributes.name: rpo_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the Rural Planning Organization if this budget line is associated with an RPO-planned project.

attributes.name: highway_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the highway system classification (NHS, Interstate, Primary, Secondary, Urban) if applicable to this budget line.

attributes.name: route_number
attributes.description: The route number or identifier if this budget line is associated with a specific highway or roadway route.

attributes.name: county_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the North Carolina county where the budget line activity or project is located.

attributes.name: county_name
attributes.description: Name of the North Carolina county associated with this budget line.

attributes.name: district_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the NCDOT highway district responsible for this budget line (NCDOT operates 14 highway districts).

attributes.name: district_name
attributes.description: Name of the NCDOT highway district associated with this budget line.

attributes.name: budget_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the budget period for this line item. Format: yyyy-MM-dd

attributes.name: budget_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the budget period for this line item. Format: yyyy-MM-dd

attributes.name: allocation_date
attributes.description: The date when this budget line was allocated or created. Format: yyyy-MM-dd

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date when this budget line was officially approved. Format: yyyy-MM-dd

attributes.name: last_revision_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent revision or amendment to this budget line. Format: yyyy-MM-dd

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when this budget line becomes effective and available for expenditure. Format: yyyy-MM-dd

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date when this budget line expires and is no longer available for new obligations. Format: yyyy-MM-dd

attributes.name: responsible_person_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual responsible for managing and executing this budget line.

attributes.name: responsible_person_email
attributes.description: Email address of the individual responsible for this budget line.

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual who approved this budget line.

attributes.name: budget_justification
attributes.description: Detailed justification or rationale for this budget line allocation, explaining the business need and expected outcomes.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the purpose, scope, and intended use of this budget line item.

attributes.name: carryover_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget line includes carryover funds from a previous fiscal year (true) or not (false).

attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget line represents capital outlay expenditures (true) or operating expenditures (false).

attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget line spans multiple fiscal years (true) or is limited to a single fiscal year (false).

attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget line represents contingency or reserve funds (true) or regular budget allocation (false).

attributes.description: Reference to the source document or transaction in the originating system (e.g., SAP document number).

products.name: fund
products.description: Master record of internal and external funding sources, including federal grants, state appropriations, and special revenue funds.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fund record. Primary key for the fund master data.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code used to identify the fund in financial systems and reporting. Typically follows state or federal coding standards.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the fund as used in official financial reports and budget documents.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the fund according to governmental accounting standards. Determines accounting treatment and reporting requirements.

attributes.name: source_type
attributes.description: Primary source of funding for this fund, indicating whether it originates from federal grants, state appropriations, special revenues, or other sources.

attributes.name: federal_agency_code
attributes.description: Two-digit code identifying the federal agency providing funding for federal grants. Examples: 20 for USDOT, 69 for DOT programs.
attributes.references: CFDA - Catalog of Federal Domestic Assistance

attributes.name: cfda_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Catalog of Federal Domestic Assistance (CFDA) Number
attributes.description: Five-digit number identifying the federal program providing grant funding. Format: XX.XXX where first two digits are agency code.
attributes.references: CFDA - Catalog of Federal Domestic Assistance

attributes.name: federal_program_name
attributes.description: Official name of the federal program providing grant funding, such as Highway Safety Improvement Program (HSIP) or Congestion Mitigation and Air Quality (CMAQ).
attributes.references: CFDA - Catalog of Federal Domestic Assistance

attributes.name: grant_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned by the federal or state agency for a specific grant award. Used for tracking and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: appropriation_number
attributes.description: Legislative appropriation identifier for state-funded accounts. References specific line items in the state budget act.

attributes.name: funding_agency
attributes.description: Name of the federal, state, or local agency providing the funding. Examples: FHWA, FTA, NC General Assembly.

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Internal or external code identifying the transportation program associated with this fund, such as STIP, HSIP, BUILD, INFRA.

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the transportation program or initiative funded by this account.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year designation for the fund. Format: FFY2024 for Federal Fiscal Year or SFY2024 for State Fiscal Year.

attributes.name: budget_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the budget period for which this fund is authorized. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: budget_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the budget period for which this fund is authorized. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: grant_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the grant performance period for federal or state grant funds. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: grant_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the grant performance period for federal or state grant funds. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: authorization_date
attributes.description: Date when the fund was officially authorized for use by legislative action, grant award, or administrative approval. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the fund authorization expires and no further obligations or expenditures are permitted. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the fund indicating whether it is available for transactions, closed, or pending approval.

attributes.name: authorized_amount
attributes.description: Total amount authorized for the fund by legislative appropriation, grant award, or administrative approval. Represents the maximum funding available.

attributes.name: budgeted_amount
attributes.description: Total budgeted amount allocated to the fund for the current fiscal period. May be less than or equal to authorized amount.

attributes.name: committed_amount
attributes.description: Amount of fund balance committed for specific purposes by formal action of the government's highest level of decision-making authority.

attributes.name: obligated_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of funds obligated through purchase orders, contracts, or other commitments but not yet expended.

attributes.name: expended_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of funds actually expended or disbursed from the fund to date.

attributes.name: available_balance
attributes.description: Current available balance in the fund, calculated as authorized amount minus obligated and expended amounts.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the fund. Typically USD for NCDOT funds.

attributes.name: federal_share_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of project costs covered by federal funding for grant-funded programs. Common values: 80%, 90%, 100%.

attributes.name: state_match_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of project costs that must be covered by state matching funds for federal grant programs. Typically 10-20%.

attributes.name: local_match_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of project costs that must be covered by local government matching funds for certain grant programs.

attributes.name: match_requirement_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fund requires matching funds from state or local sources. True if match is required, false otherwise.

attributes.name: reimbursable_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fund operates on a reimbursement basis where expenses are paid first and reimbursed later. True for reimbursable, false for direct payment.

attributes.name: carryover_allowed_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether unexpended funds can be carried over to the next fiscal period. True if carryover is allowed, false if funds lapse.

attributes.name: restricted_use_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fund has restrictions on its use imposed by external parties, legislation, or grant terms. True if restricted, false if unrestricted.

attributes.name: restriction_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of any restrictions on the use of the fund, including eligible expense categories, geographic limitations, or project type constraints.

attributes.name: eligible_expense_categories
attributes.description: List or description of expense categories that are eligible for payment from this fund, such as construction, maintenance, personnel, equipment.

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: Detailed description of the intended purpose and use of the fund, including specific programs, projects, or activities it supports.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Comprehensive description of the fund including its origin, purpose, restrictions, and relationship to organizational objectives.

attributes.name: administering_division
attributes.description: NCDOT division or unit responsible for administering and managing the fund. Examples: Division of Highways (DOH), Division of Motor Vehicles (DMV), Ferry Division.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: SAP cost center code associated with the fund for financial tracking and reporting purposes.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO - Financial Accounting and Controlling

attributes.name: manager_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual responsible for managing and overseeing the fund within NCDOT.

attributes.name: manager_email
attributes.description: Email address of the fund manager for correspondence and inquiries related to the fund.

attributes.name: manager_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the fund manager for contact purposes.

attributes.name: accounting_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the accounting system where the fund is recorded. Examples: SAP, NCFS (NC Financial System), legacy systems.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO - Financial Accounting and Controlling

attributes.name: general_ledger_account
attributes.description: General ledger account number in SAP or NCFS associated with this fund for financial posting and reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO - Financial Accounting and Controlling

attributes.name: group
attributes.description: Grouping classification for related funds used for consolidated reporting and analysis. Examples: Highway Trust Fund, Transit Fund, DMV Operations.

attributes.name: reporting_category
attributes.description: Category used for external financial reporting and compliance reporting to federal and state agencies.

attributes.name: audit_requirement_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fund is subject to specific audit requirements such as Single Audit or program-specific audits. True if audit required, false otherwise.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Subpart F

attributes.name: single_audit_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fund is subject to Single Audit requirements under OMB Uniform Guidance. True if subject to Single Audit, false otherwise.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Subpart F

attributes.name: compliance_requirements
attributes.description: Description of specific compliance requirements applicable to the fund, including federal regulations, state statutes, or grant terms.

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which financial reports must be submitted for the fund to federal or state agencies.

attributes.name: next_report_due_date
attributes.description: Date when the next financial or compliance report is due for submission. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: indirect_cost_rate
attributes.description: Approved indirect cost rate applicable to the fund for allocation of overhead and administrative costs. Expressed as a percentage.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Subpart E

attributes.name: indirect_cost_rate_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the current indirect cost rate became effective. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Subpart E

attributes.name: dbe_goal_percentage
attributes.description: Target percentage of fund expenditures to be awarded to Disadvantaged Business Enterprises as required by federal regulations.

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether projects funded by this fund require environmental compliance reviews under NEPA or state environmental laws. True if required, false otherwise.

attributes.name: prevailing_wage_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether projects funded by this fund are subject to prevailing wage requirements such as Davis-Bacon Act. True if required, false otherwise.

attributes.name: buy_america_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether projects funded by this fund are subject to Buy America requirements for steel, iron, and manufactured products. True if required, false otherwise.

attributes.name: stip_project_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: State Transportation Improvement Program (STIP) Project Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fund is associated with projects included in the State Transportation Improvement Program. True if STIP project, false otherwise.

attributes.name: mpo_involvement_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fund involves coordination with Metropolitan Planning Organizations for project planning and approval. True if MPO involved, false otherwise.

products.name: project_funding
products.description: This association product represents the allocation of funding sources to transportation projects. It captures the financial commitment of specific funding allocations to project scopes, tracking the amount, timing, fiscal year, phase, status, and percentage of each fund-to-project relationship. Each record links one funding source to one project with attributes that exist only in the context of this funding relationship. In NCDOT operations, transportation projects routinely receive funding from multiple sources (federal STIP allocations, HSIP grants, state bonds, local matching funds, CMAQ programs, special revenue funds), and each funding source typically supports multiple projects across the state. The finance and planning teams actively manage these fund-to-project allocations through the STIP (State Transportation Improvement Program) process, tracking specific amounts, fiscal years, allocation dates, project phases (preliminary engineering, right-of-way, construction), statuses (planned, committed, obligated, expended), expenditure amounts, and percentage splits for compliance reporting to federal agencies and state oversight bodies.
