products.description: Master reference table for audit_trail. Referenced by audit_trail_id.

attributes.name: audit_trail_id
attributes.description: Primary key for audit_trail

attributes.name: transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the business transaction or event being audited. Links to the source transaction in the operational system.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type or category of the financial transaction being audited (e.g., journal entry, budget allocation, payment, transfer).

attributes.name: entity_type
attributes.description: Type of business entity or object being audited (e.g., GL_ACCOUNT, COST_CENTER, BUDGET_LINE, VENDOR, EMPLOYEE).

attributes.name: entity_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the specific entity instance being audited within the entity type.

attributes.name: action_type
attributes.description: Type of action performed on the entity (e.g., create, update, delete, approve, reject, post, reverse).

attributes.name: action_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the audited action was performed. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: user_id
attributes.description: System user identifier of the person who performed the audited action.

attributes.name: user_name
attributes.description: Full name of the user who performed the audited action.

attributes.name: user_role
attributes.description: Role or authorization level of the user at the time the action was performed (e.g., Accountant, Budget Manager, Approver, System Administrator).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system where the audited transaction originated (e.g., SAP, DCH, Beacon, NCFS).

attributes.name: source_module
attributes.description: Specific module or component within the source system (e.g., SAP FI, SAP CO, NCFS GL, Beacon Budget).

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: State or federal fiscal year in which the audited transaction occurred. North Carolina fiscal year runs July 1 to June 30.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period or accounting period within the fiscal year (e.g., P01, P02, ..., P12 for monthly periods).

attributes.name: old_value
attributes.description: Previous value of the field or attribute before the change was made. Null for create actions.

attributes.name: new_value
attributes.description: New value of the field or attribute after the change was made. Null for delete actions.

attributes.name: field_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific field or attribute that was changed in the audited entity.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the business reason for the action (e.g., CORRECTION, ADJUSTMENT, YEAR_END_CLOSE, BUDGET_REVISION).

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual explanation or justification for the audited action provided by the user.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval status of the audited transaction at the time of the audit event (e.g., pending, approved, rejected, not required).

attributes.name: approver_id
attributes.description: System user identifier of the person who approved the transaction, if applicable.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the transaction was approved, if applicable. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the client or system from which the audited action was initiated.

attributes.name: session_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the user session during which the audited action was performed.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Cost center code associated with the audited transaction, if applicable.

attributes.name: gl_account
attributes.description: General ledger account number associated with the audited transaction, if applicable.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount associated with the audited transaction, if applicable.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the transaction amount. Typically USD for NCDOT transactions.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Document number or reference number of the financial document being audited (e.g., journal entry number, invoice number, payment document number).

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date when the transaction was posted to the general ledger. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the audited transaction is a reversal of a previous transaction.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or reason code for why the transaction was reversed, if applicable.

attributes.name: compliance_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the audited transaction complies with applicable financial regulations and policies.

attributes.name: exception_code
attributes.description: Code identifying any compliance exception or policy violation detected in the audited transaction.

attributes.name: exception_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the compliance exception or policy violation, if any.

attributes.name: data_classification
attributes.description: Classification level of the data involved in the audited transaction (restricted, confidential, internal, public).

attributes.name: retention_period_years
attributes.description: Number of years the audit trail record must be retained per regulatory and policy requirements.

attributes.name: archive_date
attributes.description: Date when the audit trail record is scheduled to be archived. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the audit trail record (active, archived, deleted).

products.name: payment_run
products.description: Master reference table for payment_run. Referenced by payment_run_id.

attributes.name: payment_run_id
attributes.description: Primary key for payment_run

attributes.name: run_number
attributes.description: Human-readable unique payment run number following the format PR followed by 8 digits (e.g., PR20240315). Used for business reference and tracking.

attributes.name: run_date
attributes.description: The date when the payment run was executed. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: scheduled_date
attributes.description: The originally scheduled date for the payment run execution. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument or method used for disbursement in this run (e.g., ACH, wire transfer, check, EFT, credit card, procurement card).

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: The category or type of payment being processed (e.g., vendor payment, employee reimbursement, contractor payment, grant disbursement, refund, benefit payment).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the payment run in its lifecycle (e.g., scheduled, in progress, completed, failed, cancelled, pending approval, approved, rejected).

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The state or federal fiscal year to which this payment run applies. North Carolina fiscal year runs July 1 to June 30.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year, ranging from 1 to 12.

attributes.name: total_payment_amount
attributes.description: The total monetary amount of all payments included in this payment run, in US dollars.

attributes.name: payment_count
attributes.description: The total number of individual payment transactions included in this payment run.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the payment run. Typically USD for NCDOT transactions.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The SAP Financial Accounting (FI) company code representing the legal entity executing the payment run.

attributes.name: payment_program
attributes.description: The SAP payment program or batch job identifier used to execute this payment run (e.g., F110 automatic payment program).

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: The identifier for the NCDOT bank account from which payments in this run are disbursed.

attributes.name: proposal_run_date
attributes.description: The date when the payment proposal was generated prior to final execution. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date when the payment run was approved for execution. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the authorized user who approved the payment run for execution.

attributes.name: execution_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the payment run execution was initiated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the payment run execution was completed. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: processing_duration_seconds
attributes.description: The total time in seconds taken to execute and complete the payment run.

attributes.name: successful_payment_count
attributes.description: The number of individual payments that were successfully processed in this payment run.

attributes.name: failed_payment_count
attributes.description: The number of individual payments that failed during this payment run execution.

attributes.name: error_message
attributes.description: Detailed error or exception message if the payment run encountered failures or issues during execution.

attributes.name: payment_file_name
attributes.description: The name of the payment file or batch file generated by this payment run for transmission to the bank or payment processor.

attributes.name: payment_file_path
attributes.description: The file system path or storage location where the payment file was saved.

attributes.name: transmission_status
attributes.description: The status of the payment file transmission to the bank or payment processor (e.g., not transmitted, transmitted, acknowledged, rejected, pending).

attributes.name: transmission_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the payment file was transmitted to the bank or payment processor. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: The reconciliation status indicating whether the payment run has been reconciled with bank statements and accounting records (e.g., not reconciled, reconciled, partially reconciled, discrepancy).

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date when the payment run was reconciled with bank statements and accounting records. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to the payment run, including special instructions, exceptions, or operational remarks.

products.name: bank_account
products.description: Master reference table for bank_account. Referenced by bank_account_id.

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: Primary key for bank_account

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: The unique account number assigned by the financial institution. Used for identifying the specific bank account for transactions and reconciliation.

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: The official name or title of the bank account as registered with the financial institution. Used for identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the bank account based on its purpose and functionality. Determines transaction rules and reporting requirements.

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the bank account. Indicates whether the account is available for transactions and financial operations.

attributes.name: financial_institution_name
attributes.description: The name of the bank or financial institution where the account is held. Used for reconciliation and reporting.

attributes.name: routing_number
attributes.description: The nine-digit American Bankers Association (ABA) routing transit number that identifies the financial institution. Required for electronic funds transfers and wire transactions.

attributes.name: swift_code
attributes.description: The international bank identifier code used for international wire transfers and cross-border transactions. Also known as Bank Identifier Code (BIC).

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO currency code representing the primary currency of the bank account. Typically USD for NCDOT accounts.

attributes.name: current_balance
attributes.description: The current available balance in the bank account as of the last reconciliation or update. Used for cash management and liquidity analysis.

attributes.name: opening_date
attributes.description: The date when the bank account was officially opened and became operational. Used for account lifecycle tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: closing_date
attributes.description: The date when the bank account was officially closed or deactivated. Null if the account is still active.

attributes.name: purpose_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the business purpose and intended use of the bank account. Explains what types of transactions and activities the account supports.

attributes.name: fund_code
attributes.description: The governmental fund code associated with this bank account. Links the account to specific funding sources and appropriations in the state budget structure.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: The SAP Financial Information and Cost Optimization (FI/CO) cost center responsible for managing and reconciling this bank account. Used for organizational accountability and budget tracking.

attributes.name: gl_account_number
attributes.description: The general ledger account number in SAP FI that corresponds to this bank account. Used for financial statement preparation and reconciliation.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The SAP company code that owns and manages this bank account. Represents the legal entity within NCDOT organizational structure.

attributes.name: house_bank_id
attributes.description: The SAP house bank identifier that groups bank accounts by financial institution. Used for payment processing and cash management in SAP.

attributes.name: account_holder_name
attributes.description: The legal name of the entity or individual who holds the bank account. Typically the North Carolina Department of Transportation or a specific division.

attributes.name: branch_name
attributes.description: The name of the specific bank branch where the account is maintained. Used for physical correspondence and in-person transactions.

attributes.name: branch_address
attributes.description: The complete physical address of the bank branch managing this account. Includes street, city, state, and ZIP code.

attributes.name: contact_person_name
attributes.description: The name of the primary contact person at the financial institution for account-related inquiries and issues.

attributes.name: contact_phone_number
attributes.description: The phone number of the primary contact person or customer service line at the financial institution.

attributes.name: contact_email_address
attributes.description: The email address of the primary contact person at the financial institution for electronic correspondence.

attributes.name: interest_bearing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bank account earns interest on deposited funds. True if interest-bearing, false otherwise.

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: The annual interest rate percentage applied to the account balance. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0250 for 2.50%).

attributes.name: minimum_balance_required
attributes.description: The minimum balance that must be maintained in the account to avoid fees or meet contractual requirements.

attributes.name: overdraft_protection_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account has overdraft protection enabled. True if overdraft protection is active, false otherwise.

attributes.name: fdic_insured_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bank account is insured by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation. True if FDIC insured, false otherwise.

attributes.name: reconciliation_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the bank account is reconciled with internal financial records. Determines the schedule for account verification and audit activities.

attributes.name: last_reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date when the most recent bank reconciliation was completed for this account. Used to track compliance with reconciliation policies.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The state fiscal year associated with the bank account for budgeting and reporting purposes. North Carolina fiscal year runs July 1 to June 30.

attributes.name: ncfs_integration_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bank account is integrated with the North Carolina Financial System for automated transaction processing and reporting.

attributes.name: electronic_payment_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account is enabled for electronic payment methods such as ACH transfers, wire transfers, and electronic funds transfers.

attributes.name: check_printing_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account is authorized for printing and issuing physical checks for payments.

attributes.name: online_banking_access_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether online banking access is enabled for this account, allowing web-based account management and transaction monitoring.

attributes.name: responsible_division
attributes.description: The NCDOT division or department responsible for managing and overseeing this bank account. May include Department of Highways (DOH), Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV), or other divisions.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the bank account. Used for documenting account-specific requirements or historical information.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this bank account record became effective in the system. Used for temporal tracking and historical analysis.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this bank account record ceased to be effective. Null if the record is currently active.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the current active record for the bank account in the master reference table. True if active, false if historical.

products.name: audit_session
products.description: Master reference table for audit_session. Referenced by session_id.

attributes.name: audit_session_id
attributes.description: Primary key for audit_session

attributes.name: session_identifier
attributes.description: Business-readable unique session identifier code used for tracking and referencing audit sessions across systems.

attributes.name: session_type
attributes.description: Classification of the audit session indicating the nature and scope of the audit being conducted.

attributes.name: audit_category
attributes.description: Specific category or focus area of the audit session within the finance domain, such as SAP Financial Accounting (FI), Controlling (CO), or GASB compliance.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which the audit session is being conducted, following state or federal fiscal year conventions.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month, quarter, or annual) covered by the audit session within the fiscal year.

attributes.name: auditor_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary auditor or audit team lead responsible for conducting the audit session.

attributes.name: auditor_organization
attributes.description: Name of the organization or department conducting the audit (e.g., NC Office of State Auditor, internal audit team, external audit firm).

attributes.name: audit_scope
attributes.description: Detailed description of the scope, objectives, and boundaries of the audit session, including specific accounts, transactions, or processes being examined.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date when the audit session officially commenced.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date when the audit session was completed or is scheduled to be completed.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the audit session in its lifecycle from planning through completion and closure.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification of the audit session based on risk assessment, regulatory requirements, or management directive.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Overall risk rating assigned to the audit session based on preliminary risk assessment of the area being audited.

attributes.name: compliance_framework
attributes.description: Primary compliance framework or standard against which the audit is being conducted (e.g., GASB, GAAP, OMB Uniform Guidance, NC General Statutes).

attributes.name: finding_count
attributes.description: Total number of audit findings identified during the audit session.

attributes.name: material_weakness_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether material weaknesses in internal controls were identified during the audit session.

attributes.name: report_issued_date
attributes.description: The date when the final audit report was officially issued to management and stakeholders.

attributes.name: report_reference_number
attributes.description: Official reference number assigned to the audit report for tracking and archival purposes.

attributes.name: management_response_received_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether management response to audit findings has been received and documented.

attributes.name: follow_up_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether follow-up audit procedures are required to verify implementation of corrective actions.

attributes.name: follow_up_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which follow-up audit procedures must be completed to verify corrective action implementation.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP cost center code associated with the audit session for tracking audit costs and resource allocation.

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: Budgeted amount allocated for conducting the audit session, including personnel, travel, and other direct costs.

attributes.name: actual_cost
attributes.description: Actual cost incurred for conducting the audit session, tracked for budget variance analysis.

attributes.name: planned_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours planned for completing the audit session, used for resource planning and scheduling.

attributes.name: actual_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours actually spent on the audit session, tracked for efficiency analysis and future planning.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the audit session is mandated by regulatory or legislative requirements (e.g., federal grant audit, state-mandated financial audit).

attributes.name: external_audit_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the audit session is being conducted by an external auditor or audit firm rather than internal audit staff.

attributes.name: confidentiality_level
attributes.description: Classification level indicating the sensitivity and distribution restrictions for audit session information and findings.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for capturing additional notes, observations, or context relevant to the audit session.

domains.name: procurement
domains.description: Procurement and contracts management including vendor management, DBE/MBE/WBE/HUB programs, materials management through SAP MM, contract administration, letting processes, RFP/RFQ/IFB solicitations, and QA/QC oversight.

products.name: vendor
products.description: Master record for each approved vendor, including legal entity details, tax IDs, contact information, certification status, and preferred categories.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each approved vendor in the procurement system.

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: The official registered legal name of the vendor entity as it appears on incorporation documents and tax filings.

attributes.name: doing_business_as_name
attributes.description: Trade name or fictitious business name under which the vendor operates, if different from legal name.

attributes.name: federal_tax_id
attributes.description: IRS-issued federal tax identification number (EIN) for the vendor entity used for tax reporting and compliance.

attributes.name: state_tax_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: North Carolina State Tax Identification Number
attributes.description: North Carolina Department of Revenue tax identification number for state tax reporting and compliance.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Legal structure classification of the vendor organization (corporation, LLC, partnership, sole proprietorship, etc.).

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Dun & Bradstreet unique nine-digit identifier for the vendor used for federal contracting and business verification.

attributes.name: cage_code
attributes.description: Five-character identifier assigned by the Defense Logistics Agency to identify vendors doing business with federal government.

attributes.name: sam_registration_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: System for Award Management (SAM) Registration Status
attributes.description: Current registration status in the federal System for Award Management database required for federal contract eligibility.

attributes.name: sam_expiration_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: System for Award Management (SAM) Expiration Date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor's SAM registration expires and requires renewal for continued federal contracting eligibility.

attributes.name: dbe_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is certified as a Disadvantaged Business Enterprise under USDOT DBE program requirements.

attributes.name: dbe_certification_number
attributes.description: Official certification number issued by the certifying agency for DBE status.

attributes.name: dbe_certification_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor received DBE certification from the certifying agency.

attributes.name: dbe_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor's DBE certification expires and requires renewal.

attributes.name: mbe_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is certified as a Minority Business Enterprise under state or federal diversity programs.

attributes.name: wbe_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is certified as a Women Business Enterprise under state or federal diversity programs.

attributes.name: hub_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is certified as a Historically Underutilized Business under North Carolina HUB program.

attributes.name: hub_certification_number
attributes.description: Official certification number issued by NC Department of Administration for HUB status.

attributes.name: hub_certification_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor received HUB certification from NC Department of Administration.

attributes.name: hub_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor's HUB certification expires and requires renewal.

attributes.name: small_business_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is certified as a small business under SBA size standards.

attributes.name: veteran_owned
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is certified as a veteran-owned business.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary contact person at the vendor organization for procurement communications.

attributes.name: primary_contact_title
attributes.description: Job title or position of the primary contact person at the vendor organization.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact person for official procurement correspondence.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the vendor contact person.

attributes.name: primary_contact_fax
attributes.description: Fax number for the vendor contact person, if applicable.

attributes.name: secondary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the secondary or backup contact person at the vendor organization.

attributes.name: secondary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the secondary contact person for backup communications.

attributes.name: secondary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Telephone number for the secondary vendor contact person.

attributes.name: physical_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the vendor's physical business address (street number and name).

attributes.name: physical_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the vendor's physical business address (suite, building, floor, etc.).

attributes.name: physical_city
attributes.description: City name for the vendor's physical business location.

attributes.name: physical_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code for the vendor's physical business location.

attributes.name: physical_zip_code
attributes.description: ZIP code for the vendor's physical business location (5-digit or ZIP+4 format).

attributes.name: physical_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the vendor's physical business location.

attributes.name: mailing_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the vendor's mailing address for correspondence and payments.

attributes.name: mailing_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the vendor's mailing address (PO Box, suite, etc.).

attributes.name: mailing_city
attributes.description: City name for the vendor's mailing address.

attributes.name: mailing_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code for the vendor's mailing address.

attributes.name: mailing_zip_code
attributes.description: ZIP code for the vendor's mailing address (5-digit or ZIP+4 format).

attributes.name: mailing_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the vendor's mailing address.

attributes.name: remittance_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the vendor's remittance address for payment processing.

attributes.name: remittance_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the vendor's remittance address.

attributes.name: remittance_city
attributes.description: City name for the vendor's remittance address.

attributes.name: remittance_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code for the vendor's remittance address.

attributes.name: remittance_zip_code
attributes.description: ZIP code for the vendor's remittance address (5-digit or ZIP+4 format).

attributes.name: remittance_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the vendor's remittance address.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Official website URL for the vendor organization.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the vendor in NCDOT procurement system indicating eligibility for contract awards.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor was approved and added to NCDOT's approved vendor list.

attributes.name: inactivation_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor status was changed to inactive or suspended.

attributes.name: inactivation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or reason code for why the vendor was inactivated or suspended.

attributes.name: debarment_status
attributes.description: Federal or state debarment status indicating whether the vendor is excluded from receiving government contracts.

attributes.name: debarment_start_date
attributes.description: Date when debarment or suspension of the vendor became effective.

attributes.name: debarment_end_date
attributes.description: Date when debarment or suspension of the vendor is scheduled to end.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms negotiated with the vendor specifying the number of days for invoice payment.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Preferred method for remitting payments to the vendor.

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution where the vendor maintains their payment account.

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit ABA routing number for the vendor's bank account used for ACH or wire transfers.

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: Vendor's bank account number for electronic payment processing.

attributes.name: bank_account_type
attributes.description: Type of bank account (checking or savings) for vendor payments.

attributes.name: w9_on_file
attributes.description: Indicates whether a current IRS Form W-9 (Request for Taxpayer Identification Number) is on file for the vendor.

attributes.name: w9_received_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent W-9 form was received from the vendor.

attributes.name: insurance_certificate_on_file
attributes.description: Indicates whether a current certificate of insurance meeting NCDOT requirements is on file.

attributes.name: insurance_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor's current insurance certificate expires.

attributes.name: general_liability_coverage_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of general liability insurance coverage maintained by the vendor.

attributes.name: workers_comp_coverage_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of workers compensation insurance coverage maintained by the vendor.

attributes.name: performance_rating
attributes.description: Overall performance rating assigned to the vendor based on contract delivery, quality, and compliance.

attributes.name: last_performance_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal performance evaluation conducted for the vendor.

attributes.name: prequalification_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the vendor has been prequalified for specific types of construction or professional services work.

attributes.name: prequalification_categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of work categories or specialties for which the vendor is prequalified.

attributes.name: prequalification_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor's prequalification status expires and requires renewal.

attributes.name: annual_revenue
attributes.description: Vendor's reported annual gross revenue used for capacity and financial stability assessment.

attributes.name: number_of_employees
attributes.description: Total number of employees working for the vendor organization.

attributes.name: years_in_business
attributes.description: Number of years the vendor has been operating in their industry.

attributes.name: incorporation_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor entity was legally incorporated or established.

attributes.name: incorporation_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code where the vendor entity is legally incorporated.

attributes.name: minority_owned_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the vendor business owned by minority individuals for MBE certification purposes.

attributes.name: women_owned_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the vendor business owned by women for WBE certification purposes.

attributes.name: naics_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code
attributes.description: Six-digit NAICS code identifying the vendor's primary industry classification.

attributes.name: sic_code
attributes.description: Four-digit SIC code identifying the vendor's primary industry classification (legacy system).

attributes.name: parent_company_name
attributes.description: Name of the parent company if the vendor is a subsidiary or division of a larger organization.

attributes.name: parent_company_duns
attributes.business_glossary_term: Parent Company Data Universal Numbering System (DUNS) Number
attributes.description: DUNS number of the parent company for corporate relationship tracking.

attributes.name: sap_vendor_number
attributes.description: Unique vendor identifier in NCDOT's SAP Materials Management (MM) system for procurement transactions.

attributes.name: purchasing_organization
attributes.description: SAP organizational unit responsible for procurement activities with this vendor.

attributes.name: payment_block_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether payments to this vendor are currently blocked due to compliance or performance issues.

attributes.name: payment_block_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or reason code for why vendor payments are blocked.

attributes.name: last_transaction_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent procurement transaction or payment made to the vendor.

attributes.name: total_contract_value
attributes.description: Cumulative dollar value of all active contracts awarded to the vendor.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the vendor.

products.name: contract
products.description: Master contract entity capturing contract number, effective and expiration dates, scope, total value, payment terms, and linked vendor. Also consolidates: asset.contract, bridge.contract. Also consolidates: asset.contract, highway.contract. Also consolidates: asset.contract, maintenance.contract. Also consolidates: asset.contract, project.project_contract.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the contract record. Primary key for the contract entity.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Official contract number assigned by NCDOT for tracking and reference purposes. This is the business-facing identifier used in all contract documentation and correspondence.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the contract based on the nature of work or procurement. Determines applicable regulations, approval workflows, and administration procedures.
attributes.references: FHWA Contract Administration Core Curriculum, AASHTO Procurement Guidelines

attributes.name: solicitation_method
attributes.description: The procurement method used to solicit and award the contract. IFB (Invitation for Bids) is used for price-based selection, RFP (Request for Proposal) for qualifications and technical approach, RFQ (Request for Qualifications) for professional services.

attributes.name: solicitation_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the solicitation (IFB, RFP, or RFQ) that resulted in this contract award.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Descriptive title of the contract summarizing the primary scope of work or services.

attributes.name: scope_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the work, services, or deliverables covered under the contract. Defines the boundaries and expectations for contract performance.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the contract indicating its stage in the procurement and execution process.

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract was formally executed and signed by all parties, establishing legal enforceability.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract terms become effective and work may commence. May differ from execution date based on contract terms.

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Scheduled or actual date when all contract work and deliverables are completed and accepted.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract term ends and the contract is no longer in force, unless renewed or extended.

attributes.name: original_value
attributes.description: The initial total monetary value of the contract as awarded, before any amendments or change orders.

attributes.name: current_value
attributes.description: The current total monetary value of the contract including all approved amendments, change orders, and modifications.

attributes.name: committed_amount
attributes.description: Total amount committed or encumbered against the contract for financial planning and budget tracking purposes.

attributes.name: paid_to_date_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative amount paid to the contractor from contract inception through the current date.

attributes.name: remaining_balance
attributes.description: Unpaid balance remaining on the contract, calculated as current value minus paid to date amount.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary values in the contract. NCDOT contracts are typically in USD.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Description of payment schedule, milestones, and conditions under which payments will be made to the contractor.

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which payments are processed and issued to the contractor.

attributes.name: retainage_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of each payment withheld by NCDOT until contract completion to ensure satisfactory performance and completion of all work.

attributes.name: retainage_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar amount currently held in retainage, to be released upon satisfactory contract completion and acceptance.

attributes.name: letting_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract was let (advertised for bidding) and bids were opened. Critical milestone in NCDOT procurement process.

attributes.name: award_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract was officially awarded to the selected contractor following bid evaluation and approval.

attributes.name: ntp_date
attributes.description: Date when the Notice to Proceed was issued, authorizing the contractor to begin work on the contract.

attributes.name: performance_bond_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a performance bond is required to guarantee the contractor's completion of work according to contract terms.

attributes.name: performance_bond_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the performance bond required, typically a percentage of the contract value.

attributes.name: payment_bond_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a payment bond is required to ensure payment to subcontractors and suppliers.

attributes.name: payment_bond_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the payment bond required to protect subcontractors and material suppliers.

attributes.name: bid_bond_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the bid bond submitted with the contractor's bid to guarantee they will enter into the contract if selected.

attributes.name: insurance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contractor is required to maintain insurance coverage for the duration of the contract.

attributes.name: insurance_requirements
attributes.description: Detailed description of insurance types, coverage amounts, and requirements the contractor must maintain.

attributes.name: dbe_goal_percentage
attributes.description: Target percentage of contract value to be performed by DBE-certified firms, as required by federal regulations for federally-funded projects.
attributes.references: CFR Title 49 Part 26, FHWA DBE Program

attributes.name: dbe_actual_percentage
attributes.description: Actual percentage of contract value performed by DBE-certified firms, tracked for compliance reporting.

attributes.name: hub_participation_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Historically Underutilized Business (HUB) Participation Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether participation by HUB-certified businesses is required or encouraged for this contract.

attributes.name: hub_goal_percentage
attributes.description: Target percentage of contract value to be performed by HUB-certified firms under North Carolina's HUB program.

attributes.name: mbe_participation
attributes.description: Percentage of contract value performed by MBE-certified firms, tracked for diversity and inclusion reporting.

attributes.name: wbe_participation
attributes.description: Percentage of contract value performed by WBE-certified firms, tracked for diversity and inclusion reporting.

attributes.name: federal_funding_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract is wholly or partially funded with federal dollars, triggering additional compliance requirements.

attributes.name: federal_funding_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of contract value funded by federal sources (FHWA, FTA, FAA, etc.).

attributes.name: federal_aid_number
attributes.description: Federal aid project number assigned by FHWA or other federal agency for tracking and reimbursement purposes.

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Primary source of funding for the contract (e.g., state funds, federal highway funds, GARVEE bonds, BUILD grant, INFRA grant).

attributes.name: stip_number
attributes.description: STIP project number linking the contract to North Carolina's multi-year transportation improvement program.

attributes.name: tip_number
attributes.description: TIP project number assigned by the relevant MPO or RPO for metropolitan or regional planning coordination.

attributes.name: administrator_name
attributes.description: Name of the NCDOT employee responsible for administering and overseeing the contract.

attributes.name: administrator_email
attributes.description: Email address of the NCDOT contract administrator for official contract correspondence.

attributes.name: administrator_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the NCDOT contract administrator for contract-related inquiries.

attributes.name: project_manager_name
attributes.description: Name of the NCDOT project manager overseeing the work performed under the contract.

attributes.name: division_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the NCDOT division (DOH, DMV, Ferry, Aviation, etc.) responsible for the contract.

attributes.name: district_number
attributes.description: NCDOT highway district number (1-14) responsible for the contract, applicable for geographically-based contracts.

attributes.name: county_code
attributes.description: North Carolina county code where the primary contract work is performed.

attributes.name: route_number
attributes.description: Highway route number (US, NC, Interstate) where contract work is performed, if applicable.

attributes.name: begin_milepost
attributes.description: Starting milepost location for linear highway contracts, used for geographic reference and asset management.

attributes.name: end_milepost
attributes.description: Ending milepost location for linear highway contracts, defining the geographic extent of work.

attributes.name: location_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the contract work location for public communication and reference.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate (decimal degrees) of the primary contract work location for GIS mapping and spatial analysis.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate (decimal degrees) of the primary contract work location for GIS mapping and spatial analysis.

attributes.name: nepa_classification
attributes.description: NEPA environmental review classification: CE (Categorical Exclusion), EA (Environmental Assessment), or EIS (Environmental Impact Statement).

attributes.name: environmental_clearance_date
attributes.description: Date when environmental clearance (FONSI, ROD, or CE approval) was obtained, allowing the project to proceed.

attributes.name: right_of_way_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether acquisition of additional right-of-way is required for the contract work.
attributes.references: NCDOT ROW Manual, CFR Title 23 Part 710

attributes.name: right_of_way_clearance_date
attributes.description: Date when all required right-of-way has been acquired and cleared for construction to proceed.

attributes.name: utility_relocation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether relocation of utilities (electric, gas, water, telecom) is required as part of the contract work.

attributes.name: liquidated_damages_rate
attributes.description: Daily dollar amount assessed as liquidated damages for each day the contractor fails to complete work by the contract completion date.

attributes.name: incentive_clause_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract includes incentive provisions for early completion or exceptional performance.

attributes.name: incentive_amount
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount available as incentive payment for early completion or performance exceeding contract requirements.

attributes.name: warranty_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days the contractor warrants materials and workmanship following contract completion and acceptance.
attributes.references: AASHTO Contract Administration, NCDOT Standard Specifications

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the contractor's warranty period expires and warranty obligations end.

attributes.name: change_order_count
attributes.description: Total number of change orders issued against the contract, indicating scope or cost modifications.

attributes.name: amendment_count
attributes.description: Total number of formal amendments made to the contract terms, conditions, or scope.

attributes.name: suspension_count
attributes.description: Number of times work has been suspended during the contract period, indicating potential performance or coordination issues.

attributes.name: time_extension_days
attributes.description: Total number of calendar days granted as time extensions to the original contract completion date.

attributes.name: percent_complete
attributes.description: Current percentage of contract work completed, based on approved progress measurements and milestones.

attributes.name: final_acceptance_date
attributes.description: Date when NCDOT formally accepted all contract work as complete and satisfactory, triggering final payment and warranty period.

attributes.name: closeout_date
attributes.description: Date when all contract administrative actions were completed, including final payment, documentation, and archiving.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason for contract termination if terminated prior to completion.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether there are active or unresolved disputes between NCDOT and the contractor.

attributes.name: sap_contract_number
attributes.description: Contract identifier in the SAP ERP system (MM Materials Management or PS Project System module) for financial and procurement integration.

attributes.name: purchasing_organization
attributes.description: SAP purchasing organization code responsible for procuring goods and services under this contract.

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: SAP purchasing group code identifying the buyer or procurement team responsible for the contract.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code representing the legal entity entering into the contract for financial accounting purposes.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Cost center code charged for contract expenditures, used for internal cost allocation and budget tracking.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: SAP PS Work Breakdown Structure element linking the contract to a specific project phase or deliverable for project accounting.

attributes.name: internal_order_number
attributes.description: SAP internal order number used for tracking costs and budget for non-project-based contracts.

attributes.name: grant_number
attributes.description: Grant award number if the contract is funded wholly or partially by a federal or state grant (BUILD, INFRA, RAISE, HSIP, CMAQ, etc.).

attributes.name: prevailing_wage_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract is subject to Davis-Bacon prevailing wage requirements for federally-funded construction.

attributes.name: buy_america_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract is subject to Buy America provisions requiring domestic steel and manufactured products.
attributes.references: CFR Title 23 Part 635.410, FHWA Buy America

attributes.name: arra_funded
attributes.business_glossary_term: American Recovery and Reinvestment Act (ARRA) Funded Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract was funded under the American Recovery and Reinvestment Act of 2009, requiring additional reporting.

attributes.name: document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the executed contract document stored in SharePoint, ProjectWise, or other document management system.

attributes.name: specifications_document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the technical specifications document governing the contract work.

attributes.name: plans_document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the engineering plans and drawings for the contract work, typically stored in ProjectWise.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes, comments, or special conditions related to the contract.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Contract is awarded to a vendor. Adding vendor_id FK enables joining to vendor master for legal_name, tax IDs, certifications, contact info. Remove sap_vendor_number as it is available via vendor.sap_

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.procurement_category. Business justification: Contract belongs to a procurement category. Adding procurement_category_id FK enables joining to category master for budget codes, compliance requirements, approval authority. Contract has contract_ca

attributes.name: operator_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rail.rail_operator. Business justification: Rail service contracts are awarded to specific rail operators. Procurement tracks multi-year operating agreements, maintenance contracts, and service delivery contracts with rail operators - critical

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.safety_program. Business justification: Major construction/maintenance contracts must comply with specific NCDOT safety programs (Work Zone Safety, Highway Safety Improvement Program). Contract managers link contracts to applicable safety p

attributes.name: planned_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to planning.planned_project. Business justification: Construction and service contracts are awarded to execute specific planned transportation projects. Procurement tracks which planning initiative each contract fulfills for budget reconciliation and pr

attributes.name: project_boundary_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gis.project_boundary. Business justification: Construction and maintenance contracts are geographically bounded. Procurement teams reference project boundaries to define service areas, verify vendor coverage zones, and ensure contract scope align

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fund. Business justification: Government contracts must be tied to specific funding sources (federal, state, bond). Contract managers verify fund availability and compliance with funding restrictions.

products.name: category
products.description: Reference table defining procurement spend categories, hierarchy levels, and associated budgeting codes used across all purchasing activities.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the procurement category record. Primary key for the procurement category reference table.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the procurement spend category. Used for classification and reporting across all purchasing activities.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the procurement category. Human-readable label for the spend classification.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the procurement category including scope, typical items or services included, and usage guidelines.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level in the procurement category hierarchy structure. Level 1 represents top-level categories, with increasing numbers representing more granular subcategories.

attributes.name: parent_category_code
attributes.description: Code of the parent category in the hierarchy. Null for top-level categories. Enables hierarchical rollup of spend data.

attributes.name: level_1_category
attributes.description: Top-level category name in the procurement hierarchy. Provides highest-level spend classification for executive reporting.

attributes.name: level_2_category
attributes.description: Second-level category name in the procurement hierarchy. Provides mid-level spend classification.

attributes.name: level_3_category
attributes.description: Third-level category name in the procurement hierarchy. Provides detailed spend classification.

attributes.name: budget_code
attributes.description: Associated budgeting code used for financial planning and tracking. Links procurement category to budget line items in SAP FI/CO.

attributes.name: general_ledger_account
attributes.description: General ledger account number associated with this procurement category. Used for financial accounting and reporting in SAP FI.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Default cost center code for purchases in this category. Used for internal cost allocation and management reporting.

attributes.name: fund_code
attributes.description: Government fund code associated with this procurement category. Identifies the funding source for purchases (e.g., State Highway Fund, Federal Highway Administration funds).

attributes.name: commodity_code
attributes.description: Standard commodity classification code (e.g., UNSPSC, NIGP) for goods and services in this category. Enables standardized procurement reporting.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the procurement category indicating whether it covers goods, services, construction, or other procurement types.

attributes.name: is_capital_expenditure
attributes.description: Indicates whether purchases in this category are typically classified as capital expenditures (true) or operating expenditures (false) for accounting purposes.

attributes.name: requires_competitive_bidding
attributes.description: Indicates whether purchases in this category require competitive bidding processes (RFP, RFQ, IFB) per state procurement regulations.

attributes.name: competitive_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Dollar threshold above which competitive bidding is required for purchases in this category. Based on state procurement regulations.

attributes.name: dbe_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this procurement category is eligible for Disadvantaged Business Enterprise (DBE) participation goals and tracking.

attributes.name: dbe_goal_percentage
attributes.description: Target percentage of contract value to be awarded to DBE firms for this procurement category. Used for compliance tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: hub_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this procurement category is eligible for Historically Underutilized Business (HUB) participation goals per North Carolina HUB program.

attributes.name: mbe_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this procurement category is eligible for Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) participation goals and tracking.

attributes.name: wbe_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this procurement category is eligible for Women Business Enterprise (WBE) participation goals and tracking.

attributes.name: federal_funding_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether purchases in this category are eligible for federal funding reimbursement (e.g., FHWA, FTA, FAA grants).

attributes.name: federal_program_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the federal funding program applicable to this procurement category (e.g., HSIP, CMAQ, STP, BUILD, INFRA).

attributes.name: requires_prevailing_wage
attributes.description: Indicates whether contracts in this category require payment of prevailing wages per Davis-Bacon Act or state wage requirements.

attributes.name: requires_environmental_review
attributes.description: Indicates whether purchases in this category require environmental review or compliance documentation (NEPA, Section 404, etc.).

attributes.name: nepa_category
attributes.description: Level of NEPA environmental review typically required for projects in this procurement category (CE, EA, EIS, or not applicable).

attributes.name: requires_right_of_way
attributes.description: Indicates whether projects in this procurement category typically require right-of-way acquisition or easements.

attributes.name: standard_contract_type
attributes.description: Default contract type typically used for procurements in this category (e.g., fixed price, cost plus, time and materials, unit price).

attributes.name: standard_solicitation_method
attributes.description: Default solicitation method used for this procurement category (RFP - Request for Proposal, RFQ - Request for Qualifications, IFB - Invitation for Bids, etc.).

attributes.name: standard_payment_terms
attributes.description: Default payment terms for contracts in this category (e.g., Net 30, Net 45, progress payments, milestone-based).

attributes.name: requires_performance_bond
attributes.description: Indicates whether contracts in this category require contractors to provide performance bonds to guarantee completion.

attributes.name: requires_payment_bond
attributes.description: Indicates whether contracts in this category require contractors to provide payment bonds to protect subcontractors and suppliers.

attributes.name: bond_percentage
attributes.description: Required bond amount as a percentage of contract value for performance and payment bonds in this category.

attributes.name: requires_insurance
attributes.description: Indicates whether contractors must provide proof of insurance (general liability, workers compensation, etc.) for contracts in this category.

attributes.name: minimum_insurance_amount
attributes.description: Minimum required insurance coverage amount for contractors working in this procurement category.

attributes.name: requires_prequalification
attributes.description: Indicates whether contractors must be prequalified by NCDOT before bidding on contracts in this category.

attributes.name: prequalification_category
attributes.description: Specific prequalification category or work class code required for contractors bidding in this procurement category.

attributes.name: requires_quality_assurance
attributes.description: Indicates whether contracts in this category require formal quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) processes and documentation.

attributes.name: standard_warranty_period_days
attributes.description: Default warranty period in days for goods or services procured in this category. Used for contract terms and asset management.

attributes.name: requires_materials_testing
attributes.description: Indicates whether materials procured in this category require laboratory testing and certification per AASHTO or NCDOT standards.

attributes.name: aashto_specification_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: American Association of State Highway and Transportation Officials (AASHTO) Specification Reference
attributes.description: Reference to applicable AASHTO specification or standard for materials or services in this procurement category.

attributes.name: ncdot_specification_reference
attributes.description: Reference to applicable NCDOT standard specification or special provision for this procurement category.

attributes.name: mutcd_compliance_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices (MUTCD) Compliance Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether materials or services in this category must comply with MUTCD standards for traffic control devices.

attributes.name: buy_america_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether purchases in this category must comply with Buy America provisions requiring domestic content for federally funded projects.

attributes.name: domestic_content_percentage
attributes.description: Minimum percentage of domestic content required for materials in this category when Buy America provisions apply.

attributes.name: stip_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: State Transportation Improvement Program (STIP) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether projects in this procurement category are eligible for inclusion in the State Transportation Improvement Program (STIP).

attributes.name: tip_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether projects in this procurement category are eligible for inclusion in regional Transportation Improvement Programs (TIP) through MPOs or RPOs.

attributes.name: letting_cycle
attributes.description: Standard letting cycle frequency for contracts in this procurement category (monthly, quarterly, etc.). Letting refers to the public bidding process.

attributes.name: average_procurement_lead_time_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Average Procurement Lead Time in Days
attributes.description: Typical number of days from requisition to contract award for purchases in this category. Used for planning and scheduling.

attributes.name: requires_safety_plan
attributes.description: Indicates whether contractors must submit and maintain a safety plan for work in this procurement category per OSHA and NCDOT requirements.

attributes.name: requires_traffic_control_plan
attributes.description: Indicates whether projects in this category require a traffic control plan (TCP) or maintenance of traffic (MOT) plan for work zone safety.

attributes.name: requires_erosion_control
attributes.description: Indicates whether projects in this category require erosion and sediment control plans and best management practices per environmental regulations.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the procurement category. Active categories are available for use in purchasing transactions.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this procurement category became or will become active and available for use in purchasing transactions.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this procurement category will be or was retired from active use. Null if currently active with no planned end date.

attributes.name: approval_authority_level
attributes.description: Organizational level required to approve purchases in this category (e.g., division, department, executive, board of transportation).

attributes.name: approval_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Dollar threshold above which higher-level approval authority is required for purchases in this category.

attributes.name: responsible_division
attributes.description: NCDOT division or organizational unit responsible for managing and overseeing procurements in this category (e.g., DOH, DMV, Ferry Division).

attributes.name: manager_name
attributes.description: Name of the procurement category manager or subject matter expert responsible for this spend category.

attributes.name: manager_email
attributes.description: Email address of the procurement category manager for inquiries and coordination.

attributes.name: manager_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the procurement category manager for inquiries and coordination.

attributes.name: preferred_vendor_list_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether purchases in this category must be made from a pre-approved preferred vendor list or state contract.

attributes.name: cooperative_purchasing_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this category is eligible for cooperative purchasing agreements with other government agencies or consortiums.

attributes.name: emergency_procurement_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this category can be procured through expedited emergency procurement procedures when urgent needs arise.

attributes.name: small_purchase_threshold
attributes.description: Dollar threshold below which simplified small purchase procedures can be used for this category without formal competitive bidding.

attributes.name: requires_vendor_registration
attributes.description: Indicates whether vendors must be registered with NCDOT or the state procurement system before bidding on contracts in this category.

attributes.name: allows_credit_card_payment
attributes.description: Indicates whether purchases in this category can be paid using procurement credit cards (P-cards) subject to dollar limits.

attributes.name: credit_card_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount that can be charged to a procurement credit card for purchases in this category.

attributes.name: requires_cost_benefit_analysis
attributes.description: Indicates whether purchases above certain thresholds in this category require formal cost-benefit analysis documentation.

attributes.name: sustainability_criteria_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether environmental sustainability criteria must be considered in vendor selection for this procurement category.

attributes.name: recycled_content_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether materials in this category must contain minimum recycled content per environmental regulations.

attributes.name: minimum_recycled_content_percentage
attributes.description: Minimum percentage of recycled content required for materials in this category when recycled content requirements apply.

attributes.name: allows_sole_source
attributes.description: Indicates whether sole source procurement (non-competitive) is permitted for this category under specific justification circumstances.

attributes.name: sole_source_justification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether written justification and approval are required for sole source procurements in this category.

attributes.name: audit_frequency
attributes.description: Required frequency of procurement audits or compliance reviews for contracts in this category.

attributes.name: retention_period_years
attributes.description: Number of years that procurement records and documentation for this category must be retained per state and federal regulations.
attributes.references: NCGS, OMB Uniform Guidance, CFR Title 23

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when this procurement category definition was last reviewed and validated for accuracy and completeness.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Date when this procurement category is scheduled for next periodic review and update.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when this procurement category record was originally created in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date when this procurement category record was last updated or modified.

products.name: purchase_requisition
products.description: Transactional record of internal purchase requests, including requester, required items, justification, approved budget, and workflow status.

attributes.name: purchase_requisition_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the purchase requisition record. Primary key for the purchase requisition entity.

attributes.name: requisition_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique requisition number assigned by the procurement system, typically from SAP MM module.

attributes.name: requisition_type
attributes.description: Classification of the purchase requisition indicating the procurement method and approval workflow required.

attributes.name: requisition_date
attributes.description: Date when the purchase requisition was created in the system.

attributes.name: required_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date by which the requested materials or services must be delivered to meet project or operational needs.

attributes.name: requester_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the person who initiated the purchase requisition, typically from Beacon HR system.

attributes.name: requester_name
attributes.description: Full name of the employee who created the purchase requisition.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the purchase requisition indicating its position in the approval and procurement lifecycle.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Specific approval status indicating whether the requisition has received necessary management and budget approvals.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the requisition indicating urgency and processing sequence.

attributes.name: justification
attributes.description: Detailed business justification explaining the need for the requested materials or services, required for approval workflow.

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: Brief description of the intended use or purpose of the requested items or services.

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: Total estimated dollar amount for all line items in the purchase requisition before taxes and fees.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the requisition amount, typically USD for NCDOT transactions.

attributes.name: budget_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year designation (Federal Fiscal Year or State Fiscal Year) against which the requisition budget is allocated.

products.name: contract_segment
products.description: This association product represents the work scope assignment between highway segments and procurement contracts. It captures the specific work to be performed on each segment under each contract, including milepost boundaries, work scope details, status tracking, and completion progress. Each record links one segment to one contract with attributes that exist only in the context of this contractual work assignment.. Existence Justification: In NCDOT highway operations, a single procurement contract routinely covers work on multiple highway segments (e.g., a resurfacing contract for a 50-mile corridor spanning 20 distinct segments), and conversely, a single segment frequently has multiple active contracts simultaneously for different types of work (resurfacing, guardrail replacement, drainage improvements, bridge work). Highway maintenance and construction managers actively track work scope, progress, completion percentage, and status for each segment-contract combination as a distinct operational unit.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the highway segment where contract work is being performed

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the procurement contract governing this work

attributes.name: segment_end_milepost
attributes.description: Ending milepoint within the segment where contract work ends. May differ from segment end_milepoint if contract covers only a portion of the segment.

attributes.name: work_scope
attributes.description: Detailed description of the specific work to be performed on this segment under this contract (e.g., 'Mill and overlay 2 inches asphalt', 'Replace guardrail', 'Drainage improvements').

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of work on this specific segment under this contract. Tracks progress independently from overall contract status since segments may be completed at different times.

attributes.name: completion_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of work completed on this segment under this contract, used for progress tracking and payment processing. Range 0.00 to 100.00.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_date
attributes.description: Planned date for work to begin on this specific segment. May differ from contract start_date as segments are often worked sequentially.

attributes.name: scheduled_completion_date

attributes.description: Actual date when work began on this segment.

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date when work was completed on this segment.

attributes.name: segment_contract_value
attributes.description: Portion of the total contract value allocated to work on this specific segment. Used for financial tracking and payment allocation.

attributes.name: last_updated_date

products.name: contract_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the assignment relationship between contracts and employees at NCDOT. It captures the formal assignment of NCDOT employees to contracts in specific roles (contract manager, technical lead, financial officer, compliance officer) with defined responsibilities and accountability. Each record links one contract to one employee with attributes that exist only in the context of this assignment relationship.. Existence Justification: In NCDOT operations, large contracts (construction, consulting, professional services) require multiple employees to be assigned in different roles such as contract manager, technical lead, financial officer, compliance officer, and inspectors. Each employee can be assigned to multiple contracts simultaneously with varying responsibility percentages. The business actively manages these assignments to track accountability, workload distribution, and ensure proper oversight of contract execution.

attributes.name: union_code

attributes.name: professional_license_expiration_date

attributes.name: cdl_endorsements

attributes.name: performance_rating

attributes.name: performance_review_date

attributes.name: probation_end_date

attributes.name: termination_date

attributes.name: termination_reason

attributes.name: rehire_eligibility

attributes.name: retirement_date

attributes.name: retirement_plan
