attributes.name: health_insurance_enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date the employee enrolled in health insurance benefits.

attributes.name: leave_balance_annual

attributes.name: leave_balance_sick

attributes.name: leave_balance_compensatory

attributes.name: background_check_date

attributes.name: background_check_status

attributes.name: drug_test_date

attributes.name: drug_test_result

attributes.name: safety_training_completion_date
attributes.description: Date the employee completed required safety training.

attributes.name: ncid_username

attributes.name: active_directory_username

attributes.name: badge_number

attributes.name: parking_permit_number

attributes.name: workers_comp_claim_count
attributes.description: Total number of workers compensation claims filed by the employee during their employment.

attributes.name: last_promotion_date
attributes.description: Date of the employee's most recent promotion or job reclassification.

attributes.name: last_salary_increase_date
attributes.description: Date of the employee's most recent salary increase.

attributes.name: last_salary_increase_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage amount of the employee's most recent salary increase.

attributes.name: i9_verification_date
attributes.description: Date the employee's I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification form was completed.

attributes.name: w4_on_file
attributes.description: Indicates whether a current W-4 tax withholding form is on file for the employee.

attributes.name: direct_deposit_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has active direct deposit for payroll.

attributes.name: telework_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee's position is eligible for telework arrangements.

attributes.name: telework_agreement_date
attributes.description: Date the employee's current telework agreement was signed, if applicable.

products.name: position
products.description: Master list of all job positions within NCDOT, defining titles, grade levels, functional classification, and reporting hierarchy.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the position within NCDOT. Primary key for the position master data.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Human-readable position number used in SAP HR and Beacon systems for position identification and tracking.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Official job title for the position as defined in NCDOT classification system.
attributes.references: NCGS Chapter 126 - North Carolina Human Resources Act

attributes.name: short_title
attributes.description: Abbreviated or shortened version of the position title for display and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: classification_code
attributes.description: State classification code that categorizes the position according to North Carolina Office of State Human Resources standards.
attributes.references: NCGS Chapter 126 - North Carolina Human Resources Act

attributes.name: classification_title
attributes.description: Official classification title corresponding to the classification code in the state classification system.
attributes.references: NCGS Chapter 126 - North Carolina Human Resources Act

attributes.name: salary_grade_id
attributes.description: Pay grade level assigned to the position within the NCDOT compensation structure (e.g., GS-65, NC-12, SE-08).
attributes.references: NCGS Chapter 126 - North Carolina Human Resources Act

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Type of employment arrangement for the position (full-time, part-time, temporary, seasonal, contract, intern).
attributes.references: NCGS Chapter 126 - North Carolina Human Resources Act

attributes.name: flsa_status
attributes.description: Classification of the position under the Fair Labor Standards Act indicating whether the position is exempt or non-exempt from overtime pay requirements.

attributes.name: eeo_category
attributes.description: Equal Employment Opportunity job category for federal reporting and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: Primary functional area or domain to which the position belongs (e.g., Highway Operations, DMV, Ferry Operations, Aviation, Rail, Finance, HR, IT).

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Code representing the NCDOT division to which the position is assigned (e.g., DOH, DMV, DCH, ITD).

attributes.name: unit_code_department_id
attributes.description: Code representing the specific organizational unit, section, or branch within the division where the position resides.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: SAP cost center code to which the position's salary and benefits expenses are charged for financial accounting purposes.

attributes.name: work_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the primary physical work location or facility where the position is based.

attributes.name: work_location_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary physical work location or facility where the position is based (e.g., Central Office Raleigh, District 5 Office).

attributes.name: work_city
attributes.description: City where the position's primary work location is situated.

attributes.name: work_county
attributes.description: North Carolina county where the position's primary work location is situated.

attributes.name: work_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code where the position's primary work location is situated (typically NC for North Carolina).

attributes.name: reports_to_position_number
attributes.description: Position number of the supervisory position to which this position directly reports in the organizational hierarchy.

attributes.name: supervisory_level
attributes.description: Level of supervisory responsibility assigned to the position within the organizational hierarchy.

attributes.name: direct_reports_count
attributes.description: Number of positions that directly report to this position in the organizational hierarchy.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the position indicating whether it is active, vacant, frozen, abolished, or pending approval.

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Primary source of funding for the position (state appropriations, federal funds, grant funding, trust fund, or mixed sources).

attributes.name: grant_number
attributes.description: Grant identification number if the position is funded wholly or partially by a specific grant program.

attributes.name: fte_allocation
attributes.description: Full-time equivalent allocation for the position expressed as a decimal (e.g., 1.0000 for full-time, 0.5000 for half-time).

attributes.name: standard_hours_per_week
attributes.description: Standard number of work hours per week expected for the position (e.g., 40.00 for full-time).

attributes.name: work_schedule_type
attributes.description: Type of work schedule arrangement for the position (standard business hours, shift work, flexible schedule, compressed workweek, remote, or hybrid).

attributes.name: shift_designation
attributes.description: Shift designation for positions that operate on shift schedules (day shift, evening shift, night shift, rotating shifts, or on-call).

attributes.name: telework_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position is eligible for telework or remote work arrangements based on job duties and operational requirements.

attributes.name: essential_personnel
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position is designated as essential personnel required to report during emergencies, inclement weather, or other operational disruptions.

attributes.name: cdl_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a valid Commercial Driver License is required for the position.

attributes.name: cdl_class
attributes.description: Class of Commercial Driver License required for the position if CDL is required (Class A, Class B, Class C, or not required).

attributes.name: security_clearance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a security clearance or background check is required for the position due to access to sensitive information or facilities.

attributes.name: security_clearance_level
attributes.description: Level of security clearance or background check required for the position (basic, moderate, high, or not required).

attributes.name: minimum_education_level
attributes.description: Minimum education level required for the position as specified in the position description and classification standards.
attributes.references: NCGS Chapter 126 - North Carolina Human Resources Act

attributes.name: preferred_education_level
attributes.description: Preferred education level for the position that exceeds the minimum requirement.

attributes.name: minimum_experience_years
attributes.description: Minimum number of years of relevant work experience required for the position.
attributes.references: NCGS Chapter 126 - North Carolina Human Resources Act

attributes.name: preferred_experience_years
attributes.description: Preferred number of years of relevant work experience for the position that exceeds the minimum requirement.

attributes.name: professional_certification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a professional certification or license is required for the position (e.g., PE license for engineers, CPA for accountants).
attributes.references: NCGS Chapter 89A - Engineering and Land Surveying

attributes.name: certification_type
attributes.description: Type of professional certification or license required for the position (e.g., Professional Engineer, Certified Public Accountant, Project Management Professional).
attributes.references: NCGS Chapter 89A - Engineering and Land Surveying

attributes.name: union_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position is eligible for union membership or collective bargaining representation.

attributes.name: bargaining_unit
attributes.description: Name or code of the collective bargaining unit to which the position belongs if union eligible.

attributes.name: hazard_pay_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position is eligible for hazard pay or hazardous duty compensation due to dangerous working conditions.
attributes.references: NCGS Chapter 126 - North Carolina Human Resources Act

attributes.name: overtime_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position is eligible for overtime compensation based on FLSA status and organizational policies.

attributes.name: on_call_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position is eligible for on-call duty pay or compensation for being available outside regular work hours.

attributes.name: travel_requirement_percentage
attributes.description: Estimated percentage of work time that requires travel for the position (0-100).

attributes.name: vehicle_provided
attributes.description: Indicates whether a state vehicle is provided to the position for official business use.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Comprehensive description of the position including purpose, duties, responsibilities, and key accountabilities.
attributes.references: NCGS Chapter 126 - North Carolina Human Resources Act

attributes.name: essential_functions
attributes.description: Description of the essential functions and primary duties of the position as defined under ADA requirements.

attributes.name: physical_requirements
attributes.description: Description of physical requirements and demands of the position (e.g., lifting, standing, outdoor work).

attributes.name: working_conditions
attributes.description: Description of typical working conditions and environment for the position (e.g., office, field, outdoor, hazardous).

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Date when the position was originally created in the NCDOT position management system.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the current position configuration became effective.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the current position configuration will end or was ended. Null indicates the position is currently active.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Date when the position record was last modified or updated in the system.

attributes.name: abolished_date
attributes.description: Date when the position was officially abolished or eliminated from the organizational structure.
attributes.references: NCGS Chapter 126 - North Carolina Human Resources Act

attributes.name: frozen_date
attributes.description: Date when the position was frozen and made unavailable for hiring due to budget constraints or organizational changes.

attributes.name: budgeted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position is included in the approved budget for the current fiscal year.

attributes.name: budget_fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year for which the position is budgeted (e.g., 2024 for FY 2024).

attributes.name: succession_plan_critical
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position is identified as critical for succession planning purposes due to specialized skills or organizational importance.

attributes.name: recruitment_difficulty
attributes.description: Assessment of the difficulty level in recruiting qualified candidates for the position based on market conditions and skill requirements.

attributes.name: control_number
attributes.description: State budget office position control number used for budget tracking and legislative reporting purposes.
attributes.references: NC Office of State Budget and Management

attributes.name: beacon_position_id
attributes.description: Position identifier in the North Carolina Beacon HR and Payroll system for integration and cross-reference purposes.

attributes.name: sap_position_id
attributes.description: Position identifier in the SAP HR system for integration and cross-reference purposes.

products.name: department
products.description: Master data for departments, divisions, and units, capturing unit codes, names, parent‑child relationships, and budget authority.

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the department, division, or organizational unit within NCDOT. Primary key for the department entity.

attributes.name: unit_code
attributes.description: Official alphanumeric code assigned to the department or unit for identification in SAP HR, Beacon, and other enterprise systems. Used for organizational hierarchy and reporting.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Official full name of the department, division, or organizational unit as recognized in NCDOT organizational structure.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the organizational unit indicating its hierarchical level and functional scope within NCDOT structure.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the department indicating whether it is actively functioning, temporarily inactive, or has been dissolved or merged.

attributes.name: parent_unit_code
attributes.description: Unit code of the parent department or division to which this unit reports, establishing the organizational hierarchy and reporting structure.

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: Numeric indicator of the department's position in the organizational hierarchy, with lower numbers representing higher-level units (e.g., 1 for divisions, 2 for units, 3 for sections).

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Financial accounting cost center code assigned to the department for budget tracking, expense allocation, and financial reporting in SAP FI/CO.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Financial Accounting and Controlling

attributes.name: budget_authority_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this department has independent budget authority and can approve expenditures within its allocated budget.

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: Total annual budget allocation for the department in US dollars for the current fiscal year, including personnel and operational expenses.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which the budget amount and other financial data are applicable, typically represented as the ending year (e.g., 2024 for FY 2023-2024).

attributes.name: function_code
attributes.description: Code representing the primary functional area or business domain of the department (e.g., highway operations, DMV services, ferry operations, aviation regulation).

attributes.name: function_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the primary functions, responsibilities, and scope of work performed by the department.

attributes.name: mission_statement
attributes.description: Official mission statement articulating the department's purpose, goals, and strategic objectives within NCDOT's overall mission.

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee ID of the manager or director responsible for leading the department, as recorded in SAP HR or Beacon systems.

attributes.name: manager_name
attributes.description: Full name of the current manager or director responsible for the department's operations and personnel.

attributes.name: manager_title
attributes.description: Official job title of the department manager or director (e.g., Division Director, Unit Manager, Section Chief).

attributes.name: headcount_authorized
attributes.description: Total number of authorized full-time equivalent (FTE) positions allocated to the department, regardless of current fill status.

attributes.name: headcount_filled
attributes.description: Current number of filled full-time equivalent (FTE) positions in the department, representing active employees.

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the primary physical location or facility where the department is headquartered or primarily operates.

attributes.name: location_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary physical location, building, or facility where the department operates.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: First line of the department's primary physical address, typically containing street number and street name.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Second line of the department's physical address for additional location details such as suite, floor, or building number.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City where the department's primary location is situated.

attributes.name: zip_code
attributes.description: United States Postal Service ZIP code for the department's primary location, in 5-digit or ZIP+4 format.

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: County in North Carolina where the department's primary location is situated, relevant for regional planning and coordination.

attributes.name: district_number
attributes.description: NCDOT highway district number (1-14) to which the department is assigned or primarily serves, used for geographic organization of highway operations.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the department, used for internal and external communication.

attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: Fax number for the department, if applicable, used for document transmission.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for the department, used for official correspondence and communication.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Web address of the department's official website or intranet page, if available.

attributes.name: established_date
attributes.description: Date when the department was officially established or created within NCDOT organizational structure.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the current department configuration, name, or organizational assignment became effective.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the current department configuration will end or ended, used for tracking organizational changes and historical records.

attributes.name: dissolution_date
attributes.description: Date when the department was officially dissolved, merged, or discontinued, if applicable.

attributes.name: successor_unit_code
attributes.description: Unit code of the department that assumed the responsibilities of this department after dissolution or merger, used for historical tracking.

attributes.name: union_representation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether employees in this department are represented by a labor union or collective bargaining unit.

attributes.name: safety_sensitive_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the department performs safety-sensitive functions requiring special compliance with FHWA, FTA, or DOT safety regulations.

attributes.name: emergency_response_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the department has designated emergency response responsibilities during incidents, natural disasters, or statewide emergencies.

attributes.name: public_facing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the department provides direct services to the public or primarily performs internal administrative or operational functions.

attributes.name: regulatory_authority_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the department has regulatory or enforcement authority over external entities, such as aviation operators, rail carriers, or commercial vehicles.

attributes.name: federal_funding_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the department's activities are eligible for federal funding through FHWA, FTA, FAA, or other federal transportation programs.

attributes.name: grant_administration_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the department is responsible for administering federal or state grants, requiring compliance with grant management regulations.

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the department has specific environmental compliance responsibilities under NEPA, Clean Water Act, or other environmental regulations.

attributes.name: business_hours
attributes.description: Standard operating hours for the department, indicating when staff are available and services are provided.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: Time zone in which the department operates, typically Eastern Time for North Carolina locations.

attributes.name: sap_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Unique organizational unit identifier in SAP HR system, used for integration and cross-system reference.

attributes.name: beacon_org_code
attributes.description: Organizational code used in the Beacon HR and payroll system for NC state employees, enabling integration with state-level HR systems.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or contextual information about the department, including special circumstances, historical context, or operational details.

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: Date when the department record was last updated in the master data system, used for data quality and audit purposes.

products.name: benefit_plan

attributes.name: benefit_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the benefit plan record. Primary key for the benefit plan entity.

attributes.name: plan_code

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the benefit plan as presented to employees and used in official documentation.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Category of benefit plan indicating the type of coverage or benefit provided to employees.

attributes.name: plan_category
attributes.description: High-level grouping of benefit plans for organizational and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: Name of the insurance carrier or provider administering the benefit plan.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the insurance carrier or benefit provider in external systems.

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: Master policy number assigned by the carrier for the group benefit plan contract.

attributes.name: plan_administrator
attributes.description: Name of the organization or entity responsible for administering the benefit plan, which may differ from the carrier.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the benefit plan indicating whether it is available for employee enrollment.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the benefit plan becomes active and available for employee enrollment or coverage.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the benefit plan is discontinued and no longer available for new enrollments or coverage.

attributes.name: plan_year_start_date
attributes.description: Beginning date of the benefit plan year for coverage, eligibility, and contribution calculations.

attributes.name: plan_year_end_date
attributes.description: Ending date of the benefit plan year for coverage, eligibility, and contribution calculations.

attributes.name: enrollment_period_start
attributes.description: Beginning date of the open enrollment period when employees can enroll in or make changes to the benefit plan.

attributes.name: enrollment_period_end
attributes.description: Ending date of the open enrollment period when employees can enroll in or make changes to the benefit plan.

attributes.name: coverage_level_options
attributes.description: Available coverage tiers for the benefit plan such as employee only, employee plus spouse, employee plus children, or family coverage.

attributes.name: employee_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Standard dollar amount that employees contribute per pay period for the benefit plan coverage.

attributes.name: employer_contribution_amount

attributes.name: employee_contribution_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the total premium cost that employees are required to contribute for benefit plan coverage.

attributes.name: employer_contribution_percentage

attributes.name: total_premium_amount
attributes.description: Total cost per pay period for the benefit plan coverage including both employee and employer contributions.

attributes.name: contribution_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which employee and employer contributions are collected for the benefit plan.

attributes.name: eligibility_rules
attributes.description: Detailed description of the criteria and conditions that employees must meet to be eligible for enrollment in the benefit plan.

attributes.name: waiting_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days an employee must wait after hire date or qualifying event before becoming eligible for the benefit plan.

attributes.name: minimum_hours_required
attributes.description: Minimum number of hours per week or pay period an employee must work to be eligible for the benefit plan.

attributes.name: employee_class_eligibility
attributes.description: Employee classification or categories eligible for the benefit plan such as full-time, part-time, temporary, or contract employees.

attributes.name: dependent_eligibility_rules
attributes.description: Criteria defining which dependents are eligible for coverage under the benefit plan including age limits and relationship requirements.

attributes.name: coverage_amount
attributes.description: Maximum benefit amount or coverage limit provided by the plan such as life insurance face value or maximum annual benefit.

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: Amount that the employee must pay out-of-pocket before the benefit plan begins to pay for covered services.

attributes.name: out_of_pocket_maximum
attributes.description: Maximum amount an employee will pay out-of-pocket for covered services during the plan year before the plan pays 100 percent.

attributes.name: coinsurance_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of covered service costs that the employee is responsible for paying after meeting the deductible.

attributes.name: copay_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount that the employee pays for specific covered services such as office visits or prescriptions.

attributes.name: network_type
attributes.description: Type of provider network structure for the benefit plan indicating how employees access care and provider reimbursement.

attributes.name: plan_description
attributes.description: Comprehensive description of the benefit plan including coverage details, exclusions, and key features.

attributes.name: summary_plan_description_url
attributes.description: Web address where employees can access the Summary Plan Description document required by ERISA.

attributes.name: plan_document_url
attributes.description: Web address where the official plan document and legal agreement can be accessed.

attributes.name: erisa_plan_indicator

attributes.name: erisa_plan_number

attributes.description: Three-digit plan number assigned for ERISA reporting purposes on Form 5500.

attributes.name: cobra_eligible_indicator

attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the benefit plan is subject to COBRA continuation coverage requirements.

attributes.name: aca_compliant_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the benefit plan meets Affordable Care Act minimum essential coverage and affordability requirements.

attributes.name: hsa_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the benefit plan qualifies as a high-deductible health plan eligible for Health Savings Account contributions.

attributes.name: fsa_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether employees enrolled in this plan can participate in a Flexible Spending Account.

attributes.name: pre_tax_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether employee contributions to the benefit plan are deducted on a pre-tax basis under Section 125 cafeteria plan rules.

attributes.name: imputed_income_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether employer-paid premiums for this benefit plan result in imputed income to the employee for tax purposes.

attributes.name: retirement_plan_type

attributes.name: vesting_schedule
attributes.description: Schedule defining when employees gain ownership of employer contributions to retirement or other benefit plans.

attributes.name: employer_match_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of employee retirement contributions that NCDOT will match for defined contribution plans.

attributes.name: employer_match_limit
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount or percentage of salary that NCDOT will contribute as matching funds for retirement plans.

attributes.name: annual_contribution_limit

attributes.name: catch_up_contribution_limit

attributes.name: plan_trustee

attributes.name: contact_name

attributes.name: contact_phone

attributes.name: contact_email

attributes.name: enrollment_method

attributes.name: auto_enrollment_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether eligible employees are automatically enrolled in the benefit plan unless they opt out.

attributes.name: default_contribution_rate

attributes.name: stop_loss_coverage_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the self-funded benefit plan has stop-loss insurance to limit financial exposure.

attributes.name: claims_administrator

attributes.name: pharmacy_benefit_manager

attributes.name: formulary_tier_structure

attributes.name: wellness_program_included_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the benefit plan includes wellness program features or incentives.

attributes.name: telemedicine_included_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the benefit plan includes telemedicine or virtual care services.

attributes.name: mental_health_parity_compliant_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the benefit plan complies with mental health parity requirements.

attributes.name: preventive_care_coverage_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the benefit plan covers preventive care services at no cost to the employee.

attributes.name: state_continuation_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the benefit plan is subject to North Carolina state continuation coverage requirements.

attributes.name: hipaa_compliant_indicator

attributes.name: plan_notes

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: Date when the benefit plan record was last modified or updated in the system.

products.name: training_course
products.description: Reference list of all training courses, certifications, and learning modules available to NCDOT staff, including delivery method and credit hours.

attributes.name: training_course_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the training course record. Primary key for the training course entity.

attributes.name: course_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to identify the training course in the learning management system. Used for course registration and tracking.

attributes.name: course_title
attributes.description: Official title or name of the training course as it appears in the course catalog and on certificates.

attributes.name: course_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the training course content, objectives, and learning outcomes. Provides employees with information about what they will learn.

attributes.name: course_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the training course type. Used for organizing courses in the catalog and reporting on training by category.

attributes.name: course_subcategory
attributes.description: More granular classification within the course category. Provides additional detail for course organization and filtering.

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: The method by which the training course is delivered to participants. Indicates whether the course is in-person, online, or a combination.

attributes.name: duration_hours
attributes.description: Total duration of the training course measured in hours. Used for scheduling, resource planning, and calculating training time for employees.

attributes.name: credit_hours
attributes.description: Number of continuing education or professional development credit hours awarded upon successful completion of the course. May be used for certification maintenance or professional licensing requirements.

attributes.name: ceu_credits
attributes.description: Number of Continuing Education Units awarded for course completion. CEUs are a standardized measure used by many professional organizations and licensing boards.
attributes.references: International Association for Continuing Education and Training (IACET)

attributes.name: course_level
attributes.description: Difficulty or experience level required for the training course. Helps employees select appropriate courses based on their current skill level.

attributes.name: prerequisites
attributes.description: Description of any prerequisite courses, certifications, or experience required before enrolling in this training course.

attributes.name: target_audience
attributes.description: Description of the intended audience for the training course, such as specific job roles, divisions, or employee groups.

attributes.name: instructor_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary instructor or facilitator who delivers the training course. May be internal NCDOT staff or external vendor.

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Name of the external training vendor or provider if the course is delivered by a third party rather than internal NCDOT staff.

attributes.name: vendor_contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for contacting the external training vendor regarding course logistics, content, or scheduling.

attributes.name: vendor_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for contacting the external training vendor regarding course logistics, content, or scheduling.

attributes.name: cost_per_participant
attributes.description: Cost charged per participant for the training course. Used for budgeting and tracking training expenditures.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the course cost. Typically USD for NCDOT courses.

attributes.name: maximum_enrollment
attributes.description: Maximum number of participants that can enroll in a single offering of the training course. Used for capacity planning and registration management.

attributes.name: minimum_enrollment
attributes.description: Minimum number of participants required for the training course to be conducted. Courses may be cancelled if minimum enrollment is not met.

attributes.name: certification_expiration_months
attributes.description: Number of months until the certification awarded by this course expires and requires renewal or recertification.

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether the training course is mandatory for certain employee groups or job roles. Mandatory training must be completed within specified timeframes.

attributes.name: is_compliance_training
attributes.description: Indicates whether the training course is required for regulatory compliance, such as safety training, ethics training, or legal requirements.

attributes.name: compliance_regulation
attributes.description: Name of the specific regulation, standard, or legal requirement that this compliance training addresses (e.g., OSHA 1910, FHWA regulations).
attributes.references: OSHA, FHWA, CFR Title 23, CFR Title 49

attributes.name: recertification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether employees must retake or renew this training course periodically to maintain certification or compliance.

attributes.name: recertification_frequency_months
attributes.description: Number of months between required recertification or refresher training for this course.

attributes.name: course_materials_url
attributes.description: Web address or link to access course materials, handouts, presentations, or supplementary resources for the training course.

attributes.name: learning_management_system
attributes.description: Name of the learning management system or platform where the course is hosted and managed (e.g., SAP SuccessFactors, Cornerstone, Moodle).

attributes.name: physical_requirements

attributes.name: work_schedule

attributes.name: shift_type

attributes.name: overtime_eligible

attributes.name: union_position

attributes.name: bargaining_unit

attributes.name: budget_code

attributes.name: funding_source

attributes.name: grant_funded

attributes.name: authorized_fte

attributes.name: priority_level

attributes.name: previous_incumbent_employee_id

attributes.name: reason_for_opening

attributes.name: approval_status

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id

attributes.name: target_fill_date

attributes.name: actual_fill_date

attributes.name: offer_date

attributes.name: start_date

attributes.name: total_applicants

attributes.name: qualified_applicants

attributes.name: interviewed_applicants

attributes.name: eeo_job_category

attributes.name: affirmative_action_plan

attributes.name: veteran_preference_eligible

attributes.name: posting_url

attributes.name: application_method

attributes.name: contact_email

attributes.name: contact_phone

attributes.name: benefits_summary

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: source_system

products.name: salary_grade
products.description: Reference data defining salary grades, pay ranges, and associated position levels used for compensation planning.

attributes.name: salary_grade_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the salary grade record. Primary key for the salary grade reference data.

attributes.name: grade_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code representing the salary grade level. Used as a business key for classification and reference in HR systems.

attributes.name: grade_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the salary grade level (e.g., 'Grade 10', 'Executive Level 3', 'Technician II').

attributes.name: grade_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the salary grade, including typical job responsibilities, qualifications, and organizational level.

attributes.name: pay_plan_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the pay plan or compensation structure to which this salary grade belongs (e.g., 'STATE', 'EXEMPT', 'NONEXEMPT').

attributes.name: pay_plan_name
attributes.description: Name of the pay plan or compensation structure (e.g., 'State Salary Plan', 'Executive Compensation Plan').

attributes.name: flsa_status
attributes.description: Classification under the Fair Labor Standards Act indicating whether positions in this grade are exempt or non-exempt from overtime provisions.

attributes.name: eeo_category
attributes.description: EEO job category classification for reporting purposes as defined by federal guidelines.

attributes.name: minimum_salary
attributes.description: Minimum annual salary amount for this grade in US dollars. Represents the floor of the compensation range.

attributes.name: midpoint_salary
attributes.description: Midpoint or target annual salary amount for this grade in US dollars. Represents the market-competitive rate for fully competent performance.

attributes.name: maximum_salary
attributes.description: Maximum annual salary amount for this grade in US dollars. Represents the ceiling of the compensation range.

attributes.name: minimum_hourly_rate
attributes.description: Minimum hourly wage rate for this grade in US dollars. Applicable for hourly or non-exempt positions.

attributes.name: maximum_hourly_rate
attributes.description: Maximum hourly wage rate for this grade in US dollars. Applicable for hourly or non-exempt positions.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for salary amounts. Typically USD for NCDOT.

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: Standard pay frequency for positions in this grade (e.g., monthly, biweekly).

attributes.name: step_count
attributes.description: Number of incremental pay steps within this salary grade. Used for progression-based compensation structures.

attributes.name: step_increment_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of each incremental step increase within the salary grade.

attributes.name: step_increment_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage increase for each incremental step within the salary grade.

attributes.name: grade_level
attributes.description: Numeric level of the grade within the organizational hierarchy. Used for sorting and comparison purposes.

attributes.name: job_family
attributes.description: Broad occupational category or job family to which this grade applies (e.g., 'Engineering', 'Administrative', 'Transportation Operations').

attributes.name: occupational_group
attributes.description: Specific occupational group or series within the job family (e.g., 'Civil Engineering', 'Highway Maintenance').

attributes.name: bargaining_unit_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the collective bargaining unit or union representation applicable to this grade, if any.

attributes.name: bargaining_unit_name
attributes.description: Name of the collective bargaining unit or union representation applicable to this grade.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this salary grade configuration becomes effective. Used for temporal tracking of compensation changes.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when this salary grade configuration expires or is superseded. Null indicates currently active grade.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the salary grade record indicating whether it is active, inactive, pending approval, or superseded by a newer version.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for salary grade changes. Indicates whether the grade has been approved by appropriate authorities.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the authority who approved this salary grade configuration (e.g., HR Director, State Legislature).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this salary grade configuration was officially approved.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: State fiscal year (SFY) for which this salary grade is applicable. Format: YYYY.

attributes.name: budget_code
attributes.description: Budget or appropriation code associated with positions in this salary grade for financial planning and tracking.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Default cost center for positions assigned to this salary grade. Used for financial accounting and budget allocation.

attributes.name: position_count
attributes.description: Number of authorized positions allocated to this salary grade. Used for workforce planning and budget management.

attributes.name: minimum_education_level
attributes.description: Minimum educational qualification typically required for positions in this salary grade.

attributes.name: minimum_experience_years
attributes.description: Minimum number of years of relevant work experience typically required for positions in this salary grade.

attributes.name: certification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether professional certification or licensure is required for positions in this salary grade.

attributes.name: certification_type
attributes.description: Type of professional certification or licensure required (e.g., 'PE - Professional Engineer', 'CDL - Commercial Driver License').

attributes.name: overtime_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether positions in this salary grade are eligible for overtime compensation under FLSA and state regulations.

attributes.name: shift_differential_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether positions in this salary grade are eligible for shift differential pay for non-standard work hours.

attributes.name: hazard_pay_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether positions in this salary grade are eligible for hazard or danger pay due to working conditions.

attributes.name: telework_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether positions in this salary grade are eligible for telework or remote work arrangements.

attributes.name: market_reference_rate
attributes.description: External market benchmark salary rate for comparable positions. Used for competitive compensation analysis.

attributes.name: market_survey_source
attributes.description: Source of market compensation data used for benchmarking this salary grade (e.g., 'Bureau of Labor Statistics', 'State Salary Survey').

attributes.name: market_survey_date
attributes.description: Date of the market compensation survey used for benchmarking this salary grade.

attributes.name: compa_ratio_target
attributes.description: Target comparative ratio (actual salary divided by midpoint salary) for positions in this grade. Typically 1.00 represents market rate.

attributes.name: range_spread_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage spread between minimum and maximum salary for this grade. Calculated as (max - min) / min * 100.

attributes.name: grade_type
attributes.description: Classification type of the salary grade indicating employment category (e.g., classified civil service, unclassified, temporary).

attributes.name: supervisory_level
attributes.description: Level of supervisory responsibility typically associated with positions in this salary grade.

attributes.name: span_of_control_min
attributes.description: Minimum number of direct reports typically expected for supervisory positions in this grade.

attributes.name: span_of_control_max
attributes.description: Maximum number of direct reports typically expected for supervisory positions in this grade.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to this salary grade configuration.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when this salary grade was last reviewed for market competitiveness and internal equity.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next review of this salary grade for market competitiveness and internal equity.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: System of record from which this salary grade data originated (e.g., SAP HR, Beacon, Manual entry).

attributes.name: source_system_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this salary grade record in the source system of record.

products.name: performance_review
products.description: Transactional record of employee performance evaluations, including rating scores, reviewer comments, and development plans.

attributes.name: performance_review_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the performance review record. Primary key for the performance review entity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the employee being reviewed. Links to the employee master record in SAP HR or Beacon system.

attributes.name: employee_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the employee being reviewed.

attributes.name: employee_position_title
attributes.description: Official job title or position of the employee at the time of the review.

attributes.name: employee_division
attributes.description: NCDOT division where the employee is assigned (e.g., Division of Highways (DOH), Division of Motor Vehicles (DMV), Division of Central Highways (DCH)).

attributes.name: employee_department
attributes.description: Specific department or unit within the division where the employee works.

attributes.name: reviewer_employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the supervisor or manager conducting the performance review.

attributes.name: reviewer_name
attributes.description: Full name of the supervisor or manager who conducted the performance review.

attributes.name: reviewer_position_title
attributes.description: Official job title or position of the reviewer at the time of conducting the review.

attributes.name: review_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the performance evaluation period being assessed.

attributes.name: review_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the performance evaluation period being assessed.

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date when the performance review was completed and finalized.

attributes.name: review_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled due date by which the performance review should be completed.

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Type or category of performance review (e.g., annual, probationary, mid-year, special, project-based).

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: Current status of the performance review in the workflow (e.g., draft, pending employee review, pending approval, completed, cancelled).

attributes.name: overall_rating_score
attributes.description: Composite numerical score representing the employee's overall performance rating for the review period.

attributes.name: overall_rating_category
attributes.description: Categorical rating representing the employee's overall performance level (e.g., exceeds expectations, meets expectations, needs improvement, unsatisfactory, outstanding).

attributes.name: job_knowledge_rating
attributes.description: Rating score for the employee's knowledge and understanding of job responsibilities and technical competencies.

attributes.name: quality_of_work_rating
attributes.description: Rating score for the accuracy, thoroughness, and quality of the employee's work output.

attributes.name: productivity_rating
attributes.description: Rating score for the employee's efficiency and volume of work completed.

attributes.name: communication_rating
attributes.description: Rating score for the employee's verbal and written communication effectiveness.

attributes.name: teamwork_rating
attributes.description: Rating score for the employee's ability to work collaboratively with colleagues and contribute to team success.

attributes.name: leadership_rating
attributes.description: Rating score for the employee's leadership abilities, including mentoring, decision-making, and guiding others.

attributes.name: initiative_rating
attributes.description: Rating score for the employee's proactive approach, problem-solving, and innovative contributions.

attributes.name: attendance_reliability_rating
attributes.description: Rating score for the employee's punctuality, attendance record, and dependability.

attributes.name: customer_service_rating
attributes.description: Rating score for the employee's effectiveness in serving internal or external customers and stakeholders.

attributes.name: safety_compliance_rating
attributes.description: Rating score for the employee's adherence to safety protocols and Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) standards.

attributes.name: strengths_comments
attributes.description: Narrative comments describing the employee's key strengths and positive contributions during the review period.

attributes.name: areas_for_improvement_comments
attributes.description: Narrative comments identifying specific areas where the employee needs development or improvement.

attributes.name: goals_achieved_comments
attributes.description: Narrative comments describing the goals and objectives the employee successfully achieved during the review period.

attributes.name: goals_not_achieved_comments
attributes.description: Narrative comments describing goals or objectives that were not met and reasons for non-achievement.

attributes.name: overall_comments
attributes.description: General narrative comments providing an overall assessment of the employee's performance during the review period.

attributes.name: development_plan_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the employee development plan, including training, mentoring, and growth opportunities identified for the upcoming period.

attributes.name: training_recommendations
attributes.description: Specific training courses, certifications, or learning activities recommended for the employee's professional development.
attributes.references: NCDOT HR Training and Development Standards

attributes.name: career_development_goals
attributes.description: Long-term career objectives and development goals established for the employee in collaboration with the reviewer.

attributes.name: next_review_goals
attributes.description: Specific performance goals and objectives set for the employee to achieve by the next review period.

attributes.name: employee_acknowledgement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has acknowledged receipt and review of the performance evaluation.

attributes.name: employee_acknowledgement_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee acknowledged receipt and review of the performance evaluation.

attributes.name: employee_comments
attributes.description: Comments provided by the employee as part of self-assessment or response to the performance review.

attributes.name: employee_signature_captured_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee's signature has been captured electronically or physically on the review document.

attributes.name: reviewer_signature_captured_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reviewer's signature has been captured electronically or physically on the review document.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the higher-level manager or Human Resources (HR) representative who approved the performance review.

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the higher-level manager or Human Resources (HR) representative who approved the performance review.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the performance review was officially approved by the designated approver.

attributes.name: approval_comments
attributes.description: Comments provided by the approver regarding the performance review approval or any additional observations.

attributes.name: probationary_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is in probationary status at the time of the review (probationary, permanent, not applicable).

attributes.name: probationary_recommendation
attributes.description: Recommendation for probationary employees regarding continuation, conversion to permanent status, extension, or termination.

attributes.name: promotion_recommendation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reviewer recommends the employee for promotion based on performance.

attributes.name: promotion_recommendation_comments
attributes.description: Detailed comments supporting the promotion recommendation, including justification and readiness assessment.

attributes.name: salary_increase_recommendation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reviewer recommends a salary increase or merit raise for the employee.

attributes.name: salary_increase_percentage
attributes.description: Recommended percentage increase in salary based on performance evaluation results.

attributes.name: salary_increase_amount
attributes.description: Recommended dollar amount of salary increase based on performance evaluation results.

attributes.name: bonus_recommendation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reviewer recommends a performance bonus for the employee.

attributes.name: bonus_amount
attributes.description: Recommended dollar amount of performance bonus based on evaluation results.

attributes.name: performance_improvement_plan_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has been placed on a Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) as a result of the review.

attributes.name: performance_improvement_plan_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) if the employee has been placed on one.

attributes.name: performance_improvement_plan_end_date
attributes.description: Expected end date of the Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) period.

attributes.name: performance_improvement_plan_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the Performance Improvement Plan (PIP), including specific performance deficiencies and required improvements.

attributes.name: disciplinary_action_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether disciplinary action was recommended or taken as a result of the performance review.

attributes.name: disciplinary_action_type
attributes.description: Type of disciplinary action taken or recommended (e.g., verbal warning, written warning, suspension, termination, none).

attributes.name: disciplinary_action_comments
attributes.description: Detailed comments describing the disciplinary action, reasons, and expected corrective measures.

attributes.name: review_document_url
attributes.description: Uniform Resource Locator (URL) or file path to the stored performance review document in SharePoint or document management system.

attributes.name: review_template_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the performance review template or form used for this evaluation.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: State Fiscal Year (SFY) or Federal Fiscal Year (FFY) during which the performance review was conducted.

attributes.name: review_cycle
attributes.description: Identifier for the review cycle or period (e.g., FY2024-Q1, Annual-2024) to group reviews conducted in the same timeframe.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: System of record where the performance review data originated (e.g., SAP HR, Beacon, Manual entry, Other).

attributes.name: source_system_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier or key of the performance review record in the source system for traceability and reconciliation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the performance review record was last modified or updated in the source system.

products.name: time_entry
products.description: Transactional record of daily employee work hours, project codes, and overtime, used for payroll and labor reporting.

attributes.name: time_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each time entry record. Primary key for the time entry transaction.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the employee submitting the time entry. Links to employee master record in Beacon or SAP HR.

attributes.name: work_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the work was performed. Used for payroll period assignment and labor cost allocation.

attributes.name: entry_date
attributes.description: The date when the time entry record was created or submitted by the employee.

attributes.name: hours_worked
attributes.description: Total number of hours worked on the specified work date. Includes regular and overtime hours.

attributes.name: regular_hours
attributes.description: Number of regular hours worked, typically up to 8 hours per day or 40 hours per week for non-exempt employees.

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: Number of overtime hours worked beyond regular hours threshold. Subject to overtime pay rates per FLSA and state regulations.

attributes.name: leave_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours recorded as paid leave (vacation, sick, personal, etc.) for the work date.

attributes.name: leave_type
attributes.description: Category of leave taken if leave hours are recorded. Determines leave balance deduction and pay treatment.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Organizational cost center to which the labor cost is allocated. Represents the division or unit responsible for the expense.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: Hierarchical project structure element for detailed project cost tracking and reporting. Used in SAP PS for project management.
attributes.references: SAP PS Module, AASHTO Project Management Guidelines

attributes.name: activity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the work activity performed (e.g., design, construction inspection, maintenance, administrative). Used for labor distribution analysis.

attributes.name: work_location
attributes.description: Physical location or site where the work was performed. May be office, field site, or remote.

attributes.name: division_code
attributes.description: NCDOT division identifier (e.g., DOH, DMV, Ferry, Aviation) to which the employee and time entry belong.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current approval and processing status of the time entry record. Controls payroll processing and editing permissions.

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the employee submitted the time entry for supervisor approval.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the time entry was approved by the supervisor or authorized approver.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the supervisor or manager who approved the time entry.

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the supervisor or manager who approved the time entry for audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Explanation provided by the approver if the time entry was rejected. Guides employee correction.

attributes.name: payroll_period
attributes.description: Identifier for the payroll period (e.g., bi-weekly period ending date) to which this time entry belongs.

attributes.name: pay_code
attributes.description: Code representing the type of pay associated with the time entry (e.g., regular pay, overtime, shift differential, hazard pay).

attributes.name: shift_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the work shift (e.g., day, evening, night) if applicable. May affect shift differential pay.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Classification code for the job or position under which the work was performed. Used for labor cost analysis.

attributes.name: equipment_id
attributes.description: Identifier for equipment or vehicle operated during the work period, if applicable. Used for equipment utilization tracking.
attributes.references: SAP PM Module, NCDOT Fleet Management

attributes.name: work_order_number
attributes.description: Maintenance or service work order number to which the time is charged, if applicable.

attributes.name: grant_number
attributes.description: Federal or state grant identifier if the time is charged to grant-funded work. Required for federal compliance reporting.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200, FHWA Grant Requirements

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Primary source of funding for the work performed (state, federal, local, or other). Critical for grant compliance and financial reporting.
attributes.references: OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200, GASB Statement 34

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes provided by the employee to describe the work performed or provide additional context.

attributes.name: is_billable
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the time entry is billable to an external party or reimbursable under a contract or agreement.

attributes.name: billing_rate
attributes.description: Hourly billing rate applied to billable time entries for cost recovery or reimbursement calculations.

attributes.name: labor_cost
attributes.description: Calculated labor cost for the time entry based on employee pay rate and hours worked. Used for project cost accounting.

attributes.name: is_overtime_eligible
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the employee is eligible for overtime pay for this time entry based on FLSA classification and state rules.

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: System or method through which the time entry was created (e.g., employee self-service portal, mobile app, supervisor entry).

attributes.name: correction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this time entry is a correction or adjustment to a previously submitted and processed entry.

attributes.name: original_entry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original time entry identifier if this record is a correction or adjustment. Maintains audit trail.

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.project. Business justification: Employees charge time to specific projects for labor cost tracking. Payroll and project accounting use this daily to allocate costs and manage project budgets.

attributes.name: trip_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to transit.trip. Business justification: Transit operators log time entries against specific trips they operated. Payroll uses this to calculate hours worked, overtime, and verify actual service delivery against scheduled trips.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Time entries must be charged to cost centers for labor cost allocation and project accounting. Used daily to distribute employee time costs across NCDOT organizational units.

products.name: skill
products.description: Reference list of skill definitions and competency levels used for workforce planning and training alignment.

attributes.name: skill_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the skill definition in the workforce planning and training system.

attributes.name: code

products.name: project_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the Assignment between employee and project_boundary. It captures the formal assignment of NCDOT employees to transportation projects with specific roles, responsibilities, and time periods. Each record links one employee to one project boundary with attributes that exist only in the context of this assignment relationship.. Existence Justification: In NCDOT operations, transportation projects require multiple employees with different roles (project managers, engineers, inspectors, environmental specialists, ROW agents) working simultaneously or sequentially on the same project. Conversely, employees work on multiple projects across different districts and time periods throughout their careers. The business actively manages these assignments with specific roles, responsibility areas, and time periods for resource allocation, project staffing, and workforce utilization tracking.

attributes.name: role_on_project

attributes.name: primary_responsibility_area

products.name: map_layer

attributes.description: Unique identifier for each map layer published in ArcGIS Enterprise. Primary key for the map layer entity.

attributes.description: The display name of the map layer as it appears in ArcGIS Enterprise and web mapping applications. This is the human-readable identifier used by GIS analysts and business users.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the map layer content, purpose, and intended use cases. Provides context for GIS users and transportation planners.

attributes.name: layer_type
attributes.description: The technical type of the map layer indicating the data structure and rendering method used in ArcGIS Enterprise.

attributes.name: geometry_type
attributes.description: The geometric representation type for feature layers, defining how spatial features are stored and displayed (e.g., highway centerlines as polylines, bridge locations as points).

attributes.name: source_dataset_name
attributes.description: The name of the underlying source dataset or feature class from which this map layer is derived. Links the published layer to its authoritative data source.

attributes.name: source_database
attributes.description: The database or geodatabase containing the source dataset for this map layer (e.g., SDE connection, file geodatabase path).

attributes.name: service_url

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: The type of ArcGIS service through which this layer is published, determining the capabilities and access methods available.

attributes.name: folder_path

attributes.description: The ArcGIS Enterprise username of the individual or service account that owns and maintains this map layer.

attributes.name: sharing_level
attributes.description: The ArcGIS Enterprise sharing configuration controlling which users and groups can access this layer.

attributes.name: min_scale
attributes.description: The minimum map scale at which this layer is visible. Layers are hidden when zoomed out beyond this scale to optimize performance and readability.

attributes.name: max_scale
attributes.description: The maximum map scale at which this layer is visible. Layers are hidden when zoomed in beyond this scale to prevent inappropriate detail levels.

attributes.name: default_visibility
attributes.description: Indicates whether this layer is visible by default when added to a map or web application. Users can toggle visibility after loading.

attributes.name: opacity

attributes.name: popup_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether popup windows displaying feature attributes are enabled when users click on features in this layer.

attributes.name: popup_template

attributes.name: feature_count
attributes.description: The total number of spatial features (points, lines, or polygons) contained in this map layer.

attributes.name: extent_ymax

attributes.name: truck_percentage

attributes.name: pavement_condition_index
attributes.description: The Pavement Condition Index (PCI) score representing the overall condition of the pavement surface (0-100 scale).

attributes.name: iri_value
attributes.description: The International Roughness Index (IRI) value measuring pavement roughness in inches per mile or meters per kilometer.

attributes.name: construction_year
attributes.description: The year the feature was originally constructed or installed.

attributes.name: last_rehabilitation_year
attributes.description: The year the feature was last rehabilitated or underwent major reconstruction.

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: The date the feature last received maintenance activities.

attributes.name: next_inspection_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next inspection of the feature.

attributes.name: inspection_frequency_months
attributes.description: The required frequency of inspections in months for the feature.

attributes.name: asset_condition_rating
attributes.description: The overall condition rating of the asset (excellent, good, fair, poor, critical).

attributes.name: estimated_useful_life_years
attributes.description: The estimated useful life of the feature in years from the time of construction or last major rehabilitation.
attributes.references: GASB (Governmental Accounting Standards Board) Asset Management

attributes.name: replacement_cost_usd
attributes.description: The estimated cost to replace the feature in current US dollars.
