attributes.name: acquisition_cost_usd
attributes.description: The original acquisition or construction cost of the feature in US dollars.
attributes.references: GASB (Governmental Accounting Standards Board) Asset Valuation

attributes.name: right_of_way_width_feet
attributes.description: The width of the right-of-way (ROW) corridor in feet for transportation features.

attributes.name: environmental_clearance_status
attributes.description: The status of environmental clearance for the feature (not required, pending, approved, CE, EA, EIS, FONSI).

attributes.name: environmental_document_type
attributes.description: The type of environmental documentation completed for the feature (CE - Categorical Exclusion, EA - Environmental Assessment, EIS - Environmental Impact Statement, FONSI - Finding of No Significant Impact).

attributes.name: historic_designation
attributes.description: The historic preservation designation status of the feature (none, eligible, listed, contributing, non-contributing).

attributes.name: ada_compliant_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Compliant Indicator
attributes.description: Indicator whether the feature meets Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) accessibility requirements.

attributes.name: stip_project_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: State Transportation Improvement Program (STIP) Project Identifier
attributes.description: The State Transportation Improvement Program (STIP) project identifier associated with the feature construction or improvement.

attributes.name: tip_project_id
attributes.description: The Transportation Improvement Program (TIP) project identifier for metropolitan planning organization projects.

attributes.name: federal_aid_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Indicator whether the feature is eligible for federal transportation funding.
attributes.references: FHWA (Federal Highway Administration) Federal-Aid Highway Program

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: The primary funding source for the feature construction or maintenance (state, federal, local, private, mixed).

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: The source system or method from which the feature data was collected (e.g., GPS survey, aerial imagery, CAD conversion, field collection).

attributes.name: data_collection_date
attributes.description: The date the feature data was originally collected or surveyed.

attributes.name: data_accuracy_meters
attributes.description: The horizontal positional accuracy of the feature geometry in meters.
attributes.references: FGDC (Federal Geographic Data Committee) Geospatial Positioning Accuracy Standards

attributes.name: vertical_accuracy_meters
attributes.description: The vertical positional accuracy of the feature elevation data in meters.
attributes.references: FGDC (Federal Geographic Data Committee) Geospatial Positioning Accuracy Standards

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: A composite data quality score (0-100) assessing completeness, accuracy, consistency, and timeliness of the feature data.

attributes.name: metadata_standard
attributes.description: The metadata standard used to document the feature (e.g., FGDC CSDGM, ISO 19115).
attributes.references: FGDC (Federal Geographic Data Committee) Content Standard for Digital Geospatial Metadata

attributes.name: publication_status
attributes.description: The publication status of the feature in the GIS system (draft, published, archived, deprecated).

attributes.name: public_access_indicator
attributes.description: Indicator whether the feature data is available for public access and distribution.
attributes.references: NCGS (North Carolina General Statutes) Public Records Law

attributes.name: security_classification
attributes.description: The security classification level of the feature data (public, internal, confidential, restricted).

attributes.name: editor_name
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the user who last edited the feature.

attributes.name: edit_date
attributes.description: The timestamp when the feature was last edited or modified.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the user who originally created the feature record.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: The timestamp when the feature record was originally created in the GIS system.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the feature became or will become effective or operational.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the feature ceased or will cease to be effective or operational.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: The version number of the feature record for tracking changes and history.

attributes.name: parent_feature_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the parent feature in hierarchical feature relationships (e.g., a segment belonging to a route).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: A detailed textual description of the feature providing additional context and information.

attributes.name: attachment_count
attributes.description: The number of file attachments (photos, documents, drawings) associated with the feature.

attributes.name: hyperlink_url
attributes.description: A hyperlink URL to external resources or documentation related to the feature.

attributes.name: map_layer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gis.map_layer. Business justification: Features are published and organized through map layers in ArcGIS Enterprise. Each feature belongs to a specific map layer for visualization, querying, and analysis. This is a fundamental GIS relation

products.name: spatial_reference
products.description: Reference table of spatial reference identifiers (EPSG codes) used to define coordinate systems for GIS data.

attributes.name: spatial_reference_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the spatial reference system record. Primary key for the spatial reference table.
attributes.references: ISO 19111 Geographic Information - Spatial Referencing by Coordinates

attributes.name: epsg_code
attributes.description: Standardized numeric code identifying the coordinate reference system as defined by the EPSG Geodetic Parameter Dataset. Primary identifier used across GIS applications.

attributes.name: srid
attributes.description: Spatial Reference System Identifier used in spatial databases to uniquely identify coordinate systems. Often synonymous with EPSG code.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Official name of the spatial reference system or coordinate reference system.
attributes.references: ISO 19111 Geographic Information - Spatial Referencing by Coordinates

attributes.name: authority
attributes.description: Organization or body that defines and maintains the spatial reference system standard.
attributes.references: OGC Well-Known Text Representation of Coordinate Reference Systems

attributes.name: authority_code
attributes.description: Code assigned by the authority organization to uniquely identify this spatial reference system within their namespace.
attributes.references: OGC Well-Known Text Representation of Coordinate Reference Systems

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the coordinate reference system indicating its fundamental structure and application domain.
attributes.references: ISO 19111 Geographic Information - Spatial Referencing by Coordinates

attributes.name: projection_name
attributes.description: Name of the mathematical projection method used to transform coordinates from the ellipsoid to a planar surface. Applicable only to projected coordinate systems.
attributes.references: USGS Map Projections - A Working Manual

attributes.name: datum_name
attributes.description: Name of the geodetic datum defining the reference ellipsoid and its relationship to the Earth. Examples include NAD83, WGS84, NAD27.
attributes.references: ISO 19111 Geographic Information - Spatial Referencing by Coordinates

attributes.name: ellipsoid_name
attributes.description: Name of the mathematical ellipsoid model used to approximate the shape of the Earth for this coordinate system.
attributes.references: ISO 19111 Geographic Information - Spatial Referencing by Coordinates

attributes.name: semi_major_axis
attributes.description: Length of the semi-major axis (equatorial radius) of the reference ellipsoid, measured in meters.
attributes.references: ISO 19111 Geographic Information - Spatial Referencing by Coordinates

attributes.name: inverse_flattening
attributes.description: Inverse of the flattening parameter of the reference ellipsoid, defining the ellipsoid's shape. Calculated as a/(a-b) where a is semi-major axis and b is semi-minor axis.
attributes.references: ISO 19111 Geographic Information - Spatial Referencing by Coordinates

attributes.name: prime_meridian_name
attributes.description: Name of the prime meridian (zero longitude reference) used by this coordinate system. Most commonly Greenwich.
attributes.references: ISO 19111 Geographic Information - Spatial Referencing by Coordinates

attributes.name: prime_meridian_offset
attributes.description: Angular offset in degrees of the prime meridian from the Greenwich meridian. Zero for Greenwich-based systems.
attributes.references: ISO 19111 Geographic Information - Spatial Referencing by Coordinates

attributes.name: linear_unit_name
attributes.description: Name of the linear unit of measurement used for coordinate values in projected coordinate systems.
attributes.references: ISO 19111 Geographic Information - Spatial Referencing by Coordinates

attributes.name: linear_unit_conversion_factor
attributes.business_glossary_term: Linear Unit Conversion Factor to Meters
attributes.description: Conversion factor to transform the linear unit to meters. For example, US survey foot = 0.3048006096012192 meters.
attributes.references: ISO 19111 Geographic Information - Spatial Referencing by Coordinates

attributes.name: angular_unit_name
attributes.description: Name of the angular unit of measurement used for coordinate values in geographic coordinate systems.
attributes.references: ISO 19111 Geographic Information - Spatial Referencing by Coordinates

attributes.name: angular_unit_conversion_factor
attributes.business_glossary_term: Angular Unit Conversion Factor to Radians
attributes.description: Conversion factor to transform the angular unit to radians. For example, degree = 0.0174532925199433 radians.
attributes.references: ISO 19111 Geographic Information - Spatial Referencing by Coordinates

attributes.name: false_easting
attributes.description: Value added to all x-coordinates in a projected coordinate system to ensure all coordinates are positive. Measured in the linear unit of the projection.
attributes.references: USGS Map Projections - A Working Manual

attributes.name: false_northing
attributes.description: Value added to all y-coordinates in a projected coordinate system to ensure all coordinates are positive. Measured in the linear unit of the projection.
attributes.references: USGS Map Projections - A Working Manual

attributes.name: central_meridian
attributes.description: Longitude of the central meridian for the map projection, measured in angular units. Defines the line of zero distortion for many projections.
attributes.references: USGS Map Projections - A Working Manual

attributes.name: standard_parallel_1
attributes.description: Latitude of the first standard parallel for conic projections, measured in angular units. Defines a line of true scale.
attributes.references: USGS Map Projections - A Working Manual

attributes.name: standard_parallel_2
attributes.description: Latitude of the second standard parallel for conic projections, measured in angular units. Defines a second line of true scale.
attributes.references: USGS Map Projections - A Working Manual

attributes.name: latitude_of_origin
attributes.description: Latitude at which the projection plane intersects the ellipsoid, measured in angular units. Origin point for coordinate calculations.
attributes.references: USGS Map Projections - A Working Manual

attributes.name: scale_factor
attributes.description: Scale reduction factor applied at the central meridian or origin to minimize overall distortion across the projection zone.
attributes.references: USGS Map Projections - A Working Manual

attributes.name: wkt
attributes.description: Complete Well-Known Text string representation of the coordinate reference system including all parameters and definitions.
attributes.references: OGC Well-Known Text Representation of Coordinate Reference Systems

attributes.name: proj4_text
attributes.description: PROJ.4 format string defining the coordinate reference system parameters for use with PROJ library and compatible software.

attributes.name: esri_wkt
attributes.description: ESRI-specific Well-Known Text representation of the coordinate reference system, which may differ from OGC WKT in syntax and parameter names.

attributes.name: area_of_use_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the geographic area or region where this coordinate reference system is intended to be used and provides accurate results.
attributes.references: ISO 19111 Geographic Information - Spatial Referencing by Coordinates

attributes.name: area_of_use_west_bound
attributes.business_glossary_term: Area of Use Western Boundary Longitude
attributes.description: Western longitude boundary of the area where this coordinate reference system is valid, measured in decimal degrees.
attributes.references: ISO 19111 Geographic Information - Spatial Referencing by Coordinates

attributes.name: area_of_use_east_bound
attributes.business_glossary_term: Area of Use Eastern Boundary Longitude
attributes.description: Eastern longitude boundary of the area where this coordinate reference system is valid, measured in decimal degrees.
attributes.references: ISO 19111 Geographic Information - Spatial Referencing by Coordinates

attributes.name: area_of_use_north_bound
attributes.business_glossary_term: Area of Use Northern Boundary Latitude
attributes.description: Northern latitude boundary of the area where this coordinate reference system is valid, measured in decimal degrees.
attributes.references: ISO 19111 Geographic Information - Spatial Referencing by Coordinates

attributes.name: area_of_use_south_bound
attributes.business_glossary_term: Area of Use Southern Boundary Latitude
attributes.description: Southern latitude boundary of the area where this coordinate reference system is valid, measured in decimal degrees.
attributes.references: ISO 19111 Geographic Information - Spatial Referencing by Coordinates

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Description of the intended application domain and use cases for this coordinate reference system, such as large-scale mapping, engineering surveys, or navigation.
attributes.references: ISO 19111 Geographic Information - Spatial Referencing by Coordinates

attributes.name: accuracy_meters
attributes.description: Estimated positional accuracy or precision of coordinates expressed in this reference system, measured in meters.
attributes.references: ISO 19111 Geographic Information - Spatial Referencing by Coordinates

attributes.name: deprecated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this spatial reference system has been deprecated or superseded by a newer definition. True if deprecated, false if current.

attributes.name: deprecated_date
attributes.description: Date on which this spatial reference system was officially deprecated or superseded, formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: superseded_by_epsg_code
attributes.description: EPSG code of the spatial reference system that supersedes or replaces this deprecated system.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or guidance regarding the use, limitations, or special considerations for this spatial reference system.
attributes.references: ISO 19111 Geographic Information - Spatial Referencing by Coordinates

attributes.name: information_source
attributes.description: Citation or reference to the authoritative source document or organization that defines this spatial reference system.
attributes.references: ISO 19111 Geographic Information - Spatial Referencing by Coordinates

attributes.name: revision_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent revision or update to the spatial reference system definition, formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: ncdot_usage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this spatial reference system is actively used in NCDOT GIS operations and data products. True if used by NCDOT, false otherwise.

attributes.name: ncdot_primary_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a primary or standard coordinate system for NCDOT statewide operations. True if primary standard, false otherwise.

attributes.name: state_plane_zone
attributes.description: Identifier for the State Plane Coordinate System zone applicable to North Carolina, if this spatial reference represents a state plane system.

attributes.name: utm_zone
attributes.description: UTM zone identifier if this spatial reference represents a UTM coordinate system. Format includes zone number and hemisphere (e.g., 17N, 18S).

attributes.name: vertical_datum_name
attributes.description: Name of the vertical datum or reference surface used for elevation measurements, such as NAVD88 or NGVD29.
attributes.references: ISO 19111 Geographic Information - Spatial Referencing by Coordinates

attributes.name: coordinate_system_type
attributes.description: Mathematical type of the coordinate system defining how coordinates are structured and interpreted.
attributes.references: ISO 19111 Geographic Information - Spatial Referencing by Coordinates

attributes.name: axis_count
attributes.description: Number of coordinate axes in the coordinate system. Typically 2 for 2D systems, 3 for 3D systems including elevation.
attributes.references: ISO 19111 Geographic Information - Spatial Referencing by Coordinates

attributes.name: axis_1_name
attributes.description: Name of the first coordinate axis, such as Easting, Longitude, or X.
attributes.references: ISO 19111 Geographic Information - Spatial Referencing by Coordinates

attributes.name: axis_1_orientation
attributes.description: Direction or orientation of the first coordinate axis in the coordinate system.
attributes.references: ISO 19111 Geographic Information - Spatial Referencing by Coordinates

attributes.name: axis_2_name
attributes.description: Name of the second coordinate axis, such as Northing, Latitude, or Y.
attributes.references: ISO 19111 Geographic Information - Spatial Referencing by Coordinates

attributes.name: axis_2_orientation
attributes.description: Direction or orientation of the second coordinate axis in the coordinate system.
attributes.references: ISO 19111 Geographic Information - Spatial Referencing by Coordinates

attributes.name: axis_3_name
attributes.description: Name of the third coordinate axis for 3D systems, typically Elevation, Height, or Z.
attributes.references: ISO 19111 Geographic Information - Spatial Referencing by Coordinates

attributes.name: axis_3_orientation
attributes.description: Direction or orientation of the third coordinate axis in 3D coordinate systems.
attributes.references: ISO 19111 Geographic Information - Spatial Referencing by Coordinates

attributes.name: transformation_method
attributes.description: Name of the mathematical method or algorithm used to transform coordinates between this system and other reference systems.
attributes.references: ISO 19111 Geographic Information - Spatial Referencing by Coordinates

attributes.name: transformation_accuracy_meters
attributes.description: Expected accuracy of coordinate transformations from this reference system to other systems, measured in meters.
attributes.references: ISO 19111 Geographic Information - Spatial Referencing by Coordinates

attributes.name: arcgis_compatible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this spatial reference system is natively supported and compatible with ESRI ArcGIS Enterprise platform used by NCDOT.

attributes.name: ogc_urn
attributes.business_glossary_term: Open Geospatial Consortium (OGC) Uniform Resource Name
attributes.description: OGC URN identifier for this coordinate reference system, used in web services and standards-compliant applications.

attributes.name: iso_code
attributes.description: ISO 19111 standard code or identifier for this coordinate reference system.
attributes.references: ISO 19111 Geographic Information - Spatial Referencing by Coordinates

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this spatial reference system definition became officially effective and available for use, formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the spatial reference system indicating whether it is actively used, deprecated, or superseded.

products.name: geocode_request
products.description: Transactional record of each address-to-coordinate lookup request, including input address, request timestamp, status, and resulting latitude/longitude.

attributes.name: geocode_request_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each geocoding request submitted to the GIS system.

attributes.name: request_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the geocoding request was submitted to the system.

attributes.name: input_address
attributes.description: The raw address string submitted for geocoding, as provided by the requestor.

attributes.name: input_street_number
attributes.description: The street number component extracted or provided from the input address.

attributes.name: input_street_name
attributes.description: The street name component extracted or provided from the input address.

attributes.name: input_street_type
attributes.description: The street type suffix (e.g., Road, Street, Avenue, Boulevard) from the input address.

attributes.name: input_city
attributes.description: The city name component from the input address.

attributes.name: input_state
attributes.description: The state abbreviation or name from the input address.

attributes.name: input_zip_code
attributes.description: The postal ZIP code from the input address, in 5-digit or ZIP+4 format.

attributes.name: input_county
attributes.description: The county name from the input address, if provided.

attributes.name: request_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the geocoding request.

attributes.name: result_latitude
attributes.description: The latitude coordinate (in decimal degrees) returned by the geocoding service for the matched location.

attributes.name: result_longitude
attributes.description: The longitude coordinate (in decimal degrees) returned by the geocoding service for the matched location.

attributes.name: match_score
attributes.description: Confidence score (0-100) indicating the quality and accuracy of the geocoding match.

attributes.name: match_type
attributes.description: Classification of the geocoding match quality indicating how the coordinates were determined.

attributes.name: matched_address
attributes.description: The standardized address string returned by the geocoding service that was used to determine coordinates.

attributes.name: matched_street_number
attributes.description: The standardized street number from the matched address.

attributes.name: matched_street_name
attributes.description: The standardized street name from the matched address.

attributes.name: matched_street_type
attributes.description: The standardized street type suffix from the matched address.

attributes.name: matched_city
attributes.description: The standardized city name from the matched address.

attributes.name: matched_state
attributes.description: The standardized two-letter state abbreviation from the matched address.

attributes.name: matched_zip_code
attributes.description: The standardized ZIP code from the matched address.

attributes.name: matched_county
attributes.description: The county name associated with the matched address location.

attributes.name: spatial_reference_id
attributes.description: The EPSG numeric code identifying the coordinate reference system used.

attributes.name: locator_name
attributes.description: The name of the geocoding locator or service used to process the request.

attributes.name: locator_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the geocoding locator used for this request.

attributes.name: reference_data_source
attributes.description: The authoritative address or street dataset used as reference for geocoding (e.g., NCDOT Road Centerline, USPS Address Database).

attributes.name: reference_data_version
attributes.description: The version or effective date of the reference data used for geocoding.

attributes.name: processing_time_ms
attributes.description: The elapsed time in milliseconds to complete the geocoding request.

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the geocoding request processing was completed.

attributes.name: error_code
attributes.description: System error code returned if the geocoding request failed or encountered issues.

attributes.name: error_message
attributes.description: Detailed error message describing why the geocoding request failed or returned low-quality results.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: The system user identifier or NCID of the person or application that submitted the geocoding request.

attributes.name: requestor_application
attributes.description: The name of the application or system that initiated the geocoding request.

attributes.name: requestor_ip_address
attributes.description: The IP address of the client or system that submitted the geocoding request.

attributes.name: request_purpose
attributes.description: The business purpose or use case for the geocoding request (e.g., project planning, asset location, incident mapping).

attributes.name: batch_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking this request to a batch geocoding job, if applicable.

attributes.name: is_batch_request
attributes.description: Indicates whether this geocoding request was part of a batch processing job.

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: The NCDOT route identifier if the matched location is associated with a specific highway or road route.

attributes.name: milepost
attributes.description: The milepost location along the route if the geocoded address is on a state-maintained roadway.

attributes.name: offset_distance_ft
attributes.description: The perpendicular distance in feet from the road centerline to the geocoded point.

attributes.name: side_of_street
attributes.description: Indicates which side of the street the geocoded address is located on relative to the direction of the road.

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: The governmental jurisdiction responsible for the road or location (e.g., State, County, Municipality).

attributes.name: municipality
attributes.description: The incorporated city or town name if the location falls within municipal boundaries.

attributes.name: township
attributes.description: The township name if applicable to the geocoded location.

attributes.name: division_number
attributes.description: The NCDOT highway division number (1-14) in which the geocoded location resides.

attributes.name: mpo_name
attributes.description: The name of the MPO if the location falls within a metropolitan planning area.

attributes.name: rpo_name
attributes.description: The name of the RPO if the location falls within a rural planning area.

attributes.name: congressional_district
attributes.description: The US Congressional district number in which the geocoded location resides.

attributes.name: state_senate_district
attributes.description: The North Carolina State Senate district in which the geocoded location resides.

attributes.name: state_house_district
attributes.description: The North Carolina State House of Representatives district in which the geocoded location resides.

attributes.name: census_tract
attributes.description: The US Census Bureau tract identifier for the geocoded location.

attributes.name: census_block_group
attributes.description: The US Census Bureau block group identifier for the geocoded location.

attributes.name: elevation_ft
attributes.description: The elevation above sea level in feet at the geocoded location.

attributes.name: accuracy_radius_ft
attributes.description: The estimated accuracy radius in feet representing the confidence area around the geocoded coordinates.

attributes.name: is_interpolated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the coordinates were interpolated from address ranges rather than matched to a specific point.

attributes.name: address_type
attributes.description: Classification of the input address type (e.g., street address, intersection, postal code, landmark).

attributes.name: land_use_code
attributes.description: The land use classification code for the parcel or area at the geocoded location.
attributes.references: NC Department of Revenue Property Tax

attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: The county tax parcel identifier if the geocoded location can be associated with a specific property parcel.

attributes.name: retry_count
attributes.description: The number of retry attempts made for this geocoding request before success or final failure.

attributes.name: cache_hit
attributes.description: Indicates whether the geocoding result was retrieved from cache rather than processed in real-time.

attributes.name: quality_flag
attributes.description: Overall quality assessment flag for the geocoding result based on match score and validation rules.

attributes.name: manual_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the geocoding result requires manual review due to low match score or ambiguous results.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments about the geocoding request or result.

attributes.name: driver_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to dmv.driver. Business justification: Geocoding driver addresses for spatial analysis, route planning for mobile DMV services, and verifying address accuracy during license applications and renewals.

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to dmv.vehicle. Business justification: Geocoding vehicle registration addresses for spatial distribution analysis, enforcement zone mapping, and validating registration address accuracy for tax jurisdiction determination.

attributes.name: requested_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: GIS geocoding requests are submitted by NCDOT employees for incident locations, asset mapping, or planning analysis. System tracks which employee initiated each geocode request for audit and workload

attributes.name: destination_municipality

attributes.name: travel_mode

attributes.name: route_geometry_wkt

attributes.name: toll_cost_usd

attributes.description: Total estimated toll costs along the route in US dollars.

attributes.name: includes_toll_roads_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the route includes any toll roads.

attributes.name: includes_ferry_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the route includes ferry crossings.

attributes.name: ferry_crossing_count
attributes.description: Number of ferry crossings included in the route.

attributes.name: includes_unpaved_roads_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the route includes unpaved or gravel roads.

attributes.name: restriction_applied
attributes.description: Description of any routing restrictions or constraints applied to the calculation.

attributes.name: vehicle_height_restriction_feet
attributes.description: Maximum vehicle height restriction applied to the routing calculation in feet.

attributes.name: vehicle_weight_restriction_tons
attributes.description: Maximum vehicle weight restriction applied to the routing calculation in tons.

attributes.name: vehicle_length_restriction_feet
attributes.description: Maximum vehicle length restriction applied to the routing calculation in feet.

attributes.name: hazmat_restriction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether hazardous materials routing restrictions were applied.

attributes.name: avoid_highways_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the routing calculation was configured to avoid highways.

attributes.name: avoid_tolls_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the routing calculation was configured to avoid toll roads.

attributes.name: calculation_status
attributes.description: Status of the routing calculation execution.

attributes.name: error_message
attributes.description: Error message or description if the routing calculation failed or encountered issues.

attributes.name: calculation_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Time taken to complete the routing calculation in seconds.

attributes.name: waypoint_count
attributes.description: Number of intermediate waypoints included in the routing calculation.

attributes.name: turn_count
attributes.description: Total number of turns or maneuvers in the calculated route.

attributes.name: highway_miles
attributes.description: Total distance traveled on highway facilities in miles.

attributes.name: local_road_miles
attributes.description: Total distance traveled on local roads in miles.

attributes.name: interstate_miles
attributes.description: Total distance traveled on interstate highways in miles.

attributes.name: nhs_miles
attributes.description: Total distance traveled on National Highway System routes in miles.

attributes.name: traffic_condition
attributes.description: Overall traffic condition along the route at the time of calculation.

attributes.name: time_of_day
attributes.description: Time period classification when the routing calculation was performed.

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Weather condition at the time of routing calculation that may affect travel time.

attributes.name: incident_count
attributes.description: Number of traffic incidents along the route at the time of calculation.

attributes.name: construction_zone_count
attributes.description: Number of active construction zones along the route.

attributes.name: bridge_count
attributes.description: Number of bridges crossed along the route.

attributes.name: elevation_gain_feet
attributes.description: Total elevation gain along the route in feet.

attributes.name: elevation_loss_feet
attributes.description: Total elevation loss along the route in feet.

attributes.name: maximum_elevation_feet
attributes.description: Highest elevation point along the route in feet above sea level.

attributes.name: minimum_elevation_feet
attributes.description: Lowest elevation point along the route in feet above sea level.

attributes.name: fuel_consumption_gallons
attributes.description: Estimated fuel consumption for the route in gallons.

attributes.name: carbon_emissions_kg
attributes.description: Estimated carbon dioxide emissions for the route in kilograms.

attributes.name: route_confidence_score
attributes.description: Confidence score for the routing calculation accuracy on a scale of 0-100.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Source system or service that provided the routing data.

attributes.name: routing_engine_version
attributes.description: Version of the routing calculation engine used.

attributes.name: network_dataset_version
attributes.description: Version of the transportation network dataset used for routing.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system that requested the routing calculation.

attributes.name: application_name
attributes.description: Name of the application or system that initiated the routing request.

attributes.name: session_id
attributes.description: Session identifier for the user or application session that generated the routing request.

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: NCDOT business unit or division that requested the routing calculation.

attributes.name: purpose_code
attributes.description: Business purpose or use case for the routing calculation.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the routing request.

attributes.name: route_name
attributes.description: User-defined name or label for the calculated route.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments about the routing calculation.

attributes.name: spatial_reference_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gis.spatial_reference. Business justification: Routing results contain geographic paths requiring coordinate system definition. Spatial reference ensures route geometry aligns with base maps for navigation and work order routing.

products.name: project_boundary
products.description: Master definition of the geographic boundary for a transportation project, stored as a polygon geometry with associated project identifiers and versioning.

attributes.name: project_boundary_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the project boundary polygon geometry record.

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the transportation project to which this boundary applies, typically from the State Transportation Improvement Program (STIP) or project management system.

attributes.name: stip_project_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: State Transportation Improvement Program (STIP) Project Number
attributes.description: The official STIP project number assigned to the transportation improvement project.

attributes.name: tip_project_number
attributes.description: The Transportation Improvement Program project number for MPO or RPO coordinated projects.

attributes.name: boundary_geometry
attributes.description: The spatial polygon geometry defining the geographic extent of the project boundary, stored in Well-Known Text (WKT) or GeoJSON format.

attributes.name: geometry_type
attributes.description: The type of spatial geometry used to represent the project boundary.

attributes.name: boundary_version
attributes.description: Version number of the project boundary geometry, incremented when boundary is revised or updated.

attributes.name: boundary_status
attributes.description: Current approval and lifecycle status of the project boundary definition.

attributes.name: boundary_type
attributes.description: Classification of the boundary purpose and scope within the project context.

attributes.name: project_name
attributes.description: The official name or title of the transportation project.

attributes.name: project_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the transportation project scope, purpose, and planned improvements.

attributes.name: project_type
attributes.description: The primary category or type of transportation improvement project.
attributes.references: FHWA Project Classification, NCDOT Project Standards

attributes.name: project_phase
attributes.description: The current phase of the project lifecycle at the time the boundary was defined.

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: The primary North Carolina county where the project is located.

attributes.name: additional_counties
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of additional counties if the project boundary spans multiple counties.

attributes.name: municipality
attributes.description: The incorporated municipality or city where the project is located, if applicable.

attributes.name: mpo_name
attributes.description: The name of the MPO responsible for transportation planning in the project area, if applicable.

attributes.name: rpo_name
attributes.description: The name of the RPO responsible for transportation planning in the project area, if applicable.

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: The primary route or highway identifier associated with the project (e.g., US-1, I-40, NC-55).

attributes.name: begin_milepost
attributes.description: The starting milepost location on the route where the project begins.

attributes.name: end_milepost
attributes.description: The ending milepost location on the route where the project ends.

attributes.name: project_length_miles
attributes.description: The total linear length of the project corridor in miles.

attributes.name: boundary_area_acres
attributes.description: The total area enclosed by the project boundary polygon, measured in acres.

attributes.name: boundary_area_sq_miles
attributes.description: The total area enclosed by the project boundary polygon, measured in square miles.

attributes.name: perimeter_length_feet
attributes.description: The total perimeter length of the project boundary polygon, measured in feet.

attributes.name: centroid_latitude
attributes.description: The latitude coordinate of the geometric centroid of the project boundary polygon.

attributes.name: centroid_longitude
attributes.description: The longitude coordinate of the geometric centroid of the project boundary polygon.

attributes.name: federal_program
attributes.description: The specific federal funding program supporting the project (e.g., HSIP, CMAQ, STP, BUILD, INFRA, RAISE).

attributes.name: estimated_cost
attributes.description: The total estimated cost of the transportation project in US dollars.

attributes.name: nhs_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the project is located on the National Highway System.

attributes.name: functional_classification
attributes.description: The functional classification of the roadway within the project boundary.

attributes.name: urban_rural_designation
attributes.description: Designation of whether the project is located in an urban or rural area.
attributes.references: US Census Bureau Urban Area Definitions

attributes.name: environmental_classification
attributes.description: The NEPA environmental review classification for the project: Categorical Exclusion (CE), Environmental Assessment (EA), or Environmental Impact Statement (EIS).

attributes.name: environmental_document_number
attributes.description: The reference number of the environmental review document (EA, EIS, or CE) associated with the project.

attributes.name: row_acquisition_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether right-of-way acquisition is required for the project.

attributes.name: row_parcels_count
attributes.description: The estimated or actual number of property parcels requiring right-of-way acquisition.

attributes.name: utility_relocation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether utility relocation is required within the project boundary.

attributes.name: railroad_involvement
attributes.description: Indicates whether the project involves railroad crossings, coordination, or infrastructure.

attributes.name: bridge_involvement
attributes.description: Indicates whether the project includes bridge construction, replacement, or rehabilitation.

attributes.name: bridge_count
attributes.description: The number of bridges included within the project boundary.

attributes.name: its_components
attributes.description: Indicates whether the project includes ITS infrastructure such as traffic signals, cameras, or dynamic message signs.

attributes.name: bicycle_pedestrian_facilities
attributes.description: Indicates whether the project includes bicycle lanes, sidewalks, or other pedestrian facilities.

attributes.name: ada_compliance_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Compliance Required
attributes.description: Indicates whether ADA accessibility compliance is required for the project.

attributes.name: historic_properties_present
attributes.description: Indicates whether historic properties subject to Section 106 review are present within the project boundary.
attributes.references: National Historic Preservation Act Section 106, 36 CFR 800

attributes.name: wetlands_present
attributes.description: Indicates whether wetlands subject to Clean Water Act Section 404 permitting are present within the project boundary.

attributes.name: endangered_species_present
attributes.description: Indicates whether federally listed endangered or threatened species are present within the project boundary.

attributes.name: floodplain_involvement
attributes.description: Indicates whether the project boundary includes areas within FEMA-designated floodplains.

attributes.name: public_involvement_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal public involvement and outreach activities are required for the project.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the person or authority who approved the project boundary definition.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date when the project boundary was officially approved.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when the project boundary definition became effective for planning and design purposes.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date when the project boundary definition expires or is scheduled for review and update.

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: The date when the project boundary record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: last_updated_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the person who last updated the project boundary record.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: The source system or method used to create the project boundary geometry (e.g., ArcGIS Enterprise, field survey, CAD conversion).

attributes.name: accuracy_level
attributes.description: The level of spatial accuracy of the project boundary geometry.

attributes.name: horizontal_accuracy_feet
attributes.description: The estimated horizontal positional accuracy of the boundary geometry, measured in feet.

attributes.name: data_quality_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes regarding data quality, limitations, or special considerations for the project boundary.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional comments or notes regarding the project boundary definition, revisions, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: gis_layer_name
attributes.description: The name of the GIS feature layer or dataset where the project boundary is published.

attributes.name: arcgis_feature_service_url
attributes.description: The URL of the ArcGIS Enterprise feature service where the project boundary is published for web access.

attributes.name: metadata_url
attributes.description: The URL or reference to the formal metadata record documenting the project boundary dataset.

attributes.name: publication_status
attributes.description: The publication and access status of the project boundary in GIS systems and public portals.

attributes.name: superseded_by_boundary_id
attributes.description: The project_boundary_id of the newer boundary version that supersedes this record, if applicable.

attributes.name: spatial_reference_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gis.spatial_reference. Business justification: Project boundaries define construction limits requiring precise coordinate system. Spatial reference ensures boundary geometry matches survey data and legal property descriptions.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fund. Business justification: Transportation projects are funded by specific funds (federal, state, local). Project boundaries must track which fund finances the project for budget tracking and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Each transportation project (highway expansion, bridge repair) is assigned to a cost center for financial accountability. Project managers track expenditures against cost centers for budget control.

products.name: tile_cache
products.description: Reference data describing cached map tiles, including tile matrix set, zoom levels, storage location, and refresh schedule.

attributes.name: tile_cache_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cached map tile configuration. Primary key for the tile cache reference data.

attributes.name: cache_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the tile cache service or layer, used for identification and reference by GIS applications and users.

attributes.name: cache_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the tile cache content, purpose, and intended use cases within NCDOT transportation planning and operations.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Type of ArcGIS service that the tile cache supports, determining the rendering method and data structure.

attributes.name: tile_format
attributes.description: Image or data format used for storing individual tiles in the cache, affecting file size, quality, and compatibility.

attributes.name: tile_matrix_set
attributes.description: Tiling scheme identifier defining the spatial reference system, origin, tile dimensions, and scale levels used for the cache.

attributes.name: spatial_reference_id
attributes.description: EPSG code or ESRI WKID identifying the coordinate system used for the tile cache, typically 3857 (Web Mercator) or 2264 (NC State Plane).

attributes.name: min_zoom_level
attributes.description: Lowest level of detail (most zoomed out) available in the tile cache, typically ranging from 0 (world view) to higher numbers.

attributes.name: max_zoom_level
attributes.description: Highest level of detail (most zoomed in) available in the tile cache, determining the finest resolution accessible to users.

attributes.name: tile_width_pixels
attributes.description: Width of each tile image in pixels, typically 256 or 512 pixels for standard web mapping applications.

attributes.name: tile_height_pixels
attributes.description: Height of each tile image in pixels, typically 256 or 512 pixels for standard web mapping applications.

attributes.name: tile_origin_x
attributes.description: X-coordinate of the tile matrix origin point in the spatial reference system, defining the starting point for tile indexing.

attributes.name: tile_origin_y
attributes.description: Y-coordinate of the tile matrix origin point in the spatial reference system, defining the starting point for tile indexing.

attributes.name: storage_location_path
attributes.description: File system path, network share, or cloud storage location where the tile cache files are physically stored.

attributes.name: storage_type
attributes.description: Method used to store tile cache files, affecting performance, scalability, and management characteristics.

attributes.name: cache_size_bytes
attributes.description: Total storage space consumed by the tile cache in bytes, used for capacity planning and storage management.

attributes.name: tile_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual tiles stored in the cache across all zoom levels and spatial extents.

attributes.name: cache_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the tile cache, indicating availability and maintenance state.

attributes.name: refresh_schedule_type
attributes.description: Frequency pattern for updating the tile cache with new source data to maintain currency and accuracy.

attributes.name: refresh_schedule_cron
attributes.description: Cron expression defining the specific timing for automated tile cache refresh operations.

attributes.name: last_refresh_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the tile cache was last successfully updated with new source data.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_refresh_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the next automated tile cache refresh is scheduled to occur.

attributes.name: source_layer_name
attributes.description: Name of the source GIS layer or feature class from which the tile cache is generated.

attributes.name: source_data_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the source data used to build the current tile cache was last modified or published.

attributes.name: antialiasing_mode
attributes.description: Level of antialiasing applied during tile rendering to smooth edges and improve visual quality.

attributes.name: compression_quality
attributes.description: Quality level for lossy compression formats (JPEG), ranging from 0 (lowest quality, smallest size) to 100 (highest quality, largest size).

attributes.name: resampling_method
attributes.description: Algorithm used to resample source imagery when generating tiles at different zoom levels.

attributes.name: transparency_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tile cache supports transparent backgrounds, allowing overlay on other map layers.

attributes.name: background_color_hex
attributes.description: Hexadecimal color code for the tile background when transparency is not enabled.

attributes.name: extent_xmin
attributes.description: Minimum X-coordinate of the geographic bounding box covered by the tile cache.

attributes.name: extent_ymin
attributes.description: Minimum Y-coordinate of the geographic bounding box covered by the tile cache.

attributes.name: extent_xmax
attributes.description: Maximum X-coordinate of the geographic bounding box covered by the tile cache.

attributes.name: extent_ymax
attributes.description: Maximum Y-coordinate of the geographic bounding box covered by the tile cache.

attributes.name: geographic_coverage_area
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the geographic area covered by the tile cache, such as county names, regions, or statewide.

attributes.name: service_url
attributes.description: Web service endpoint URL where the tile cache is accessible to client applications and users.

attributes.name: rest_endpoint_url
attributes.description: RESTful API endpoint for programmatic access to tile cache metadata and tiles.

attributes.name: wmts_endpoint_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: Web Map Tile Service (WMTS) Endpoint URL
attributes.description: OGC WMTS standard endpoint for accessing the tile cache through standard web mapping protocols.

attributes.name: access_level
attributes.description: Security classification determining who can access and use the tile cache service.

attributes.name: authentication_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether users must authenticate before accessing the tile cache service.

attributes.name: authentication_method
attributes.description: Authentication mechanism used to verify user identity when accessing the tile cache.

attributes.name: owner_division
attributes.description: NCDOT division or organizational unit responsible for maintaining and managing the tile cache.

attributes.name: owner_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary contact person responsible for the tile cache service.

attributes.name: owner_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact person for questions and issues related to the tile cache.

attributes.name: owner_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary contact person for the tile cache service.

attributes.name: business_domain
attributes.description: NCDOT business domain or functional area that the tile cache primarily supports, such as Highway Operations, DMV, or Ferry Operations.

attributes.name: usage_category
attributes.description: Primary use case category for the tile cache within NCDOT operations and services.

attributes.name: performance_tier
attributes.description: Service level tier indicating expected performance, availability, and support priority for the tile cache.

attributes.name: cache_build_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Time required to generate or rebuild the complete tile cache, used for maintenance planning.

attributes.name: average_tile_size_bytes
attributes.description: Mean file size of individual tiles in the cache, used for performance and bandwidth estimation.

attributes.name: cache_hit_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of tile requests served from cache versus requiring regeneration, indicating cache effectiveness.

attributes.name: daily_request_count_avg
attributes.description: Average number of tile requests served per day, used for capacity planning and usage analysis.

attributes.name: concurrent_user_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of simultaneous users or connections supported by the tile cache service.

attributes.name: cdn_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tile cache is distributed through a content delivery network for improved performance.

attributes.name: cdn_provider
attributes.description: Name of the CDN service provider used to distribute the tile cache, if applicable.

attributes.name: backup_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tile cache is included in automated backup procedures for disaster recovery.

attributes.name: backup_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the tile cache is backed up to secondary storage.

attributes.name: last_backup_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the tile cache was last successfully backed up.

attributes.name: retention_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days that tile cache versions and backups are retained before archival or deletion.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for the tile cache configuration and content, used for change tracking.

attributes.name: creation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the tile cache was initially created and configured.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the tile cache configuration or metadata was last updated.

attributes.name: deprecation_date
attributes.description: Planned date when the tile cache will be deprecated and no longer actively maintained.

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: Planned date when the tile cache will be retired and removed from service.

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Comma-separated keywords or labels for categorizing and searching the tile cache in GIS portals.

attributes.name: metadata_url
attributes.description: URL to the formal metadata document describing the tile cache content, lineage, and quality.
attributes.references: FGDC Content Standard for Digital Geospatial Metadata

attributes.name: license_type
attributes.description: Data license or usage rights governing the distribution and use of the tile cache content.

attributes.name: copyright_statement
attributes.description: Copyright notice and attribution requirements for the tile cache content.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Numerical score from 0 to 1 representing the overall quality, accuracy, and completeness of the tile cache source data.

attributes.name: horizontal_accuracy_meters
attributes.description: Estimated horizontal positional accuracy of features in the tile cache, measured in meters.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional comments, special instructions, or operational notes about the tile cache configuration and usage.
